strings.注意事项\n1. 乐享扭蛋可重置扭蛋结果，重置次数上限为50次；\n2. 对扭:
Notes
1. The Choice Portal lets you redraw your result, up to 50 times.
2. When you like a result, you can save it as a candidate (up to 2 saved results).
3. When you reach the redraw limit or find the result you want, choose your final result to get those units and leave the Choice Portal.

strings.摇曳的迷宫中出土的绝品。异界的守护女神曾使用的神盾。能保护持有者免受一切风暴伤害: A masterpiece unearthed in the Kaleidoscope. The divine shield of an otherworldly guardian goddess. Protects its holder from all storm damage.
strings.摇曳的迷宫中出土的绝品。异界的守护女神曾使用的神盾。能保护持有者免受一切烈焰伤害: A masterpiece unearthed in the Kaleidoscope. The divine shield of an otherworldly guardian goddess. Protects its holder from all flame damage.
strings.摇曳的迷宫中出土的绝品。异界的守护女神曾使用的神盾。能保护持有者免受一切激流伤害: A masterpiece unearthed in the Kaleidoscope. The divine shield of an otherworldly guardian goddess. Protects its holder from all torrent damage.
strings.摇曳的迷宫中出土的绝品。异界的守护女神曾使用的神盾。能保护持有者免受一切雷光伤害: A masterpiece unearthed in the Kaleidoscope. The divine shield of an otherworldly guardian goddess. Protects its holder from all lightning damage.
strings.摇曳的迷宫中出土的绝品。异界的守护女神曾使用的神盾。能保护持有者免受一切冥暗伤害: A masterpiece unearthed in the Kaleidoscope. The divine shield of an otherworldly guardian goddess. Protects its holder from all darkness damage.
strings.摇曳的迷宫中出土的绝品。异界的守护女神曾使用的神盾。能保护持有者免受一切光芒伤害: A masterpiece unearthed in the Kaleidoscope. The divine shield of an otherworldly guardian goddess. Protects its holder from all light damage.
strings.使用橙机兵的外壳制作而成的绝品。有着盾与武器两种形态的机械盾，能通过变形机关转变: A masterpiece made from the Orange Steambot's shell. A mechanical shield with two forms, shield and weapon, that turns into a deadly blade with its transforming mechanism.
strings.使用暗机兵的炮身制作而成的绝品。能将力量汇聚于一点并贯穿敌人的机械拳套，装载了以: A masterpiece made from the Dark Steambot's barrel. A mechanical gauntlet that focuses its force on one point to pierce foes, fitted with a wedge made from bullets.
strings.试图将天之伟力化为吾物的绝品。吸收了从歼灭者处得到的结晶后，能逐渐进化并强化的镰: A masterpiece that tries to make heaven's might its own. A scythe that slowly evolves and grows stronger after absorbing the crystal taken from the Purger.
strings.表面闪烁着群星光芒的神奇之物，能够引导持有者觉醒内在的潜能，获得突破桎梏的力量。: A wondrous thing that shines with the light of the stars. It draws out its holder's hidden potential, granting the power to break their limits.
strings.用于觉醒角色的神奇之物。: A wondrous thing used to awaken units.
strings.开放星见图鉴中信息的钥匙。: A key that unlocks notes in the Flipperpedia.
strings.依照城门模样打造的厚重盾牌，给顽强的战士带来幸运与庇佑。: A heavy shield shaped like a city gate. It brings luck and protection to stalwart warriors.
strings.公会打造的绝品。模仿惠惠的法杖制成的武器，镶嵌着某种魔力充沛的矿石。颜色鲜艳，充: A masterpiece made by the Guild. A weapon modeled on Megumin's staff, set with an ore full of magic. Vivid in color and full of shine.
strings.公会打造的绝品。模仿阿克娅的法杖制成的武器，似乎还能拿来当晾衣杆。: A masterpiece made by the Guild. A weapon modeled on Aqua's staff. It also seems to work as a laundry pole.
strings.公会打造的绝品。模仿达克妮丝的剑制成的武器，十分坚固，不论何种攻击都能轻松挡下。: A masterpiece made by the Guild. A weapon modeled on Darkness's sword. It's so sturdy it can easily block any attack.
strings.在崩塌的始原中发现的绝品。能够轻易击碎星辰的枪尖形似冰冷的火焰，散发着的正是诸多: A masterpiece found in the collapsing Origin. A spearhead that can easily shatter stars, shaped like a cold flame and giving off the lingering heat of countless destroyed worlds.
strings.在崩塌的始原中发现的绝品。巨刃献上温柔轻吻时，一切生命的界限不复存在，而始龙眼中: A masterpiece found in the collapsing Origin. When the great blade gives its gentle kiss, the boundaries of all life vanish, much like the world as seen through the Origin Dragon's eye.
strings.在崩塌的始原中发现的绝品。超凡者欣喜于始龙之眼的恩赐，却不知虚幻之力的代价正是湮: A masterpiece found in the collapsing Origin. The transcendent rejoice in the gifts of Origin's Eye, not knowing that the price of illusory power is the end of reality.
strings.使用领主币兑换的绝品。沾染了风元素的隐秘长弓，向其注入元素之力，即可获得强大的力: A masterpiece obtained with Boss Coins. A hidden longbow steeped in wind elements. Pour elemental power into it to gain great strength.
strings.使用领主币兑换的绝品。由世界树树枝打造的法杖，蕴含着森林贤者的祝福。: A masterpiece obtained with Boss Coins. A staff made from a branch of the Spirit Tree, holding the blessing of the forest sages.
strings.采用坚硬水晶打造的绝品。其沉重坚硬的斩击能够造成巨大的攻击力。: A masterpiece made from hard crystal. Its heavy, solid slashes deal enormous damage.
strings.参考蝴蝶羽翼形态制作的绝品。佩戴时会感受到徐徐清风。: A masterpiece modeled on a butterfly's wings. Wearing it, you can feel a gentle breeze.
strings.使用神秘钥匙制作的绝品。神秘的蓝色花朵能够使佩戴者提升水魔法的感知能力。: A masterpiece made with a mysterious key. Its mysterious blue flower sharpens the wearer's sense for water magic.
strings.模仿阿斯塔挥舞的断魔之剑的绝品。虽然反魔法还未能出现，但即便如此，也依然以能压制: A masterpiece modeled on the demon-slayer sword Asta wields. It can't produce anti-magic, but it's still proud of a strength that can overpower and cut down monsters.
strings.这是一个模仿由诺拥有的吊坠的绝品。佩戴它时，会感觉到有精灵在助力: A masterpiece modeled on the pendant Yuno owns. Wearing it, you can feel a spirit lending its power.
strings.诺艾尔持有的杖的仿制品。这把杖的尾端镶嵌着用元素加工制作的宝石，闪闪发光，具有辅: A replica of the wand Noelle carries. The end of the wand is set with a sparkling gem made from elements, with the power to support water magic.
strings.以碧之女王的薄翼制成的绝品。能让人联想到飒爽清凉的微风的羽衣，能赋予穿着者风之加: A masterpiece made from the Jade Queen's thin wings. A feathered robe that brings to mind a cool, crisp breeze, granting its wearer the blessing of wind.
strings.与金之女王战斗后获得的绝品。能够放出等离子体的刀剑型兵器，甚至能贯穿超硬合金。其: A masterpiece obtained after battling the Gold Queen. A sword-shaped weapon that emits plasma and can pierce even superhard alloys. Its slashes trace a path like a thunderbolt.
strings.以金之女王的薄翼制成的绝品。能让人联想到轰鸣不绝的雷霆的羽衣，能赋予穿着者雷之加: A masterpiece made from the Gold Queen's thin wings. A feathered robe that brings to mind endlessly roaring thunder, granting its wearer the blessing of thunder.
strings.与皓之女王战斗后获得的绝品。高功率光子缠绕的刀剑型兵器，甚至能切断超硬合金。其斩: A masterpiece obtained after battling the White Queen. A sword-shaped weapon wrapped in high-powered photons that can cut even superhard alloys. Its slashes leave afterimages behind.
strings.与墨之女王战斗后获得的绝品。寄宿有邪恶意念的刀剑型兵器，甚至能腐蚀超硬合金。其斩: A masterpiece obtained after battling the Ink Queen. A sword-shaped weapon possessed by an evil will that can corrode even superhard alloys. Its slashes carry voices of resentment.
strings.以墨之女王的薄翼制成的绝品。能让人联想到深不见底的黑暗的羽衣，能赋予穿着者暗之加: A masterpiece made from the Ink Queen's thin wings. A feathered robe that brings to mind bottomless darkness, granting its wearer the blessing of darkness.
strings.以赤之女王的薄翼制成的绝品。能让人联想到熊熊燃烧的火焰的羽衣，能赋予穿着者火之加: A masterpiece made from the Garnet Queen's thin wings. A feathered robe that brings to mind blazing flames, granting its wearer the blessing of fire.
strings.以青之女王的薄翼制成的绝品。能让人联想到通透清澈的流水的羽衣，能赋予穿着者水之加: A masterpiece made from the Azure Queen's thin wings. A feathered robe that brings to mind clear, flowing water, granting its wearer the blessing of water.
strings.以皓之女王的薄翼制成的绝品。能让人联想到耀眼闪烁的光芒的羽衣，能赋予穿着者光之加: A masterpiece made from the White Queen's thin wings. A feathered robe that brings to mind dazzling, sparkling light, granting its wearer the blessing of light.
strings.以异世界的素材打造的绝品。戴上便能获得直面困难的勇气: A masterpiece made from otherworldly materials. Wearing it gives you the courage to face any hardship.
strings.以异世界的素材打造的绝品。敲打便会发出美妙的音色，对其喊叫则能赋予世界莫大的鼓励: A masterpiece made from otherworldly materials. Strike it and it makes a lovely sound; shout into it and it gives the world a huge boost.
strings.以异世界的素材打造的绝品。某位乖巧的少女总是拿在手中阅读的书本: A masterpiece made from otherworldly materials. The book a certain quiet girl always has in her hands.
strings.特别周、无声铃鹿和黄金船三人从特雷森学园的体育仓库来到了陌生的迷宫之中。在遇到了: Special Week, Silence Suzuka and Gold Ship stumble out of Tracen Academy's sports shed into an unfamiliar labyrinth. After meeting Alk's party, the three learn they've ended up in another world.
strings.特别周一行人对是否还能回到原来的世界感到不安，好在众人回到迷宫进行调查后发现，连: Special Week's group worries whether they can ever go home, but when everyone goes back to investigate the labyrinth, they find the passage between the two worlds has stabilized and the three can travel back and forth any time. So they decide to tour this other world, only to get caught up in a runaway golem incident at the magic academy.
strings.阿尔克一行人制服了魔像之后，重新坐回观众席上观看起了三位少女与魔像们一同竞争冠军: After subduing the golems, Alk's party returns to the stands to watch the three girls race the golems for the championship in the "Palpebra Cup." When the race ends and Special Week's group prepares to go home, Gold Ship suddenly wants to stay in this world, turning what should have been a heartwarming farewell into chaos.
strings.阿尔克一行人接到了公会的委托，负责监视从异世界漂流而来的和真等人。虽然遭到了公会: The Guild asks Alk's party to keep watch over Kazuma and the others, who drifted in from another world. Even after being disciplined by the Guild, Kazuma's party keeps doing whatever they want, leaving Alk with nothing but a wry smile. Meanwhile, new trouble is stirring in the labyrinth.
strings.众人在公会吃饭时，浑身黏乎乎的莉莉艾冲进了公会，并宣布发生了紧急事态。众人急忙赶: While everyone is eating at the Guild, a slime-covered Lilie bursts in and announces an emergency. Rushing outside, they find slimes all over town. To deal with it, they take on a giant slime that falls from the sky.
strings.为异世界也献上祝福！: A Blessing for Another World Too!
strings.和真以解除监视为要求，帮助众人策划了史莱姆歼灭作战。然而，在事件解决之后，却只有: In exchange for ending his surveillance, Kazuma helps everyone plan a slime extermination operation. But once it's resolved, Kazuma is the only one still being watched. Aqua laughs at him for it, and Kazuma stirs up new trouble. And so Starview Village returns to its noisy but wonderful everyday life.
strings.阿虚等人认为在异世界就只能仰仗阿尔克一行人，便将春日拥有能改写世界的能力一事告知: Deciding that Alk's party is all they can rely on in this world, Kyon and the others tell them that Haruhi can rewrite reality, and agree that from now on their plan is to keep Haruhi satisfied. After the SOS Brigade members gain new powers through training, they invite Haruhi to defeat a boss monster together with Alk's party.
strings.众人齐心协力消灭了BOSS之后，通往原来世界的裂缝出现在了他们面前。意识到能回到: After everyone works together to defeat the boss, a rift back to their own world appears before them. Kyon and the others are relieved they can go home, but when Haruhi declares that the ultimate team of the SOS Brigade and Alk's party will liven up "the whole world," they decide to stay a little longer and enjoy their trip to another world.

strings.【概要】\n\n勇者莱特为了完成王的命令而踏上了旅程。\n他在决战之地·魔王城跟:
[Summary]

The hero was turned into a powerless beast,
and at the last moment, wrapped in light, vanished into the sky.
strings.【概要】\n\n阿尔克和史黛拉尝试启动神秘的装置。\n装置发出光芒，光芒暗去之后:
[Summary]

Alk and Stella try to start a mysterious device.
It shines, and when the light fades, a small creature appears.
strings.【概要】\n\n小小的野兽莱特出现在了阿尔克和史黛拉面前。\n魔王的追兵逼近了正:
[Summary]

Light, now a small beast, appears before Alk and Stella.
The Demon Lord's pursuers close in as they talk,
and Light climbs onto Alk's head to fight alongside him.
strings.【概要】\n\n打倒魔物之后，神秘的装置再次发出光芒。\n少女与少年手握着手，\:
[Summary]

Once the monster is defeated, the mysterious device shines again.
Hand in hand, the girl and the boy
call out: "World Flipper, activate!"

strings.走吧，史黛拉！\n让我们一起去那个世界看看吧！:

Let's go see that world together!
strings.为了完成王命，勇者莱特踏上了旅程。在那决战之地——魔王城中，莱特与同伴们合力将魔:
To carry out the King's orders, the hero Light set out on a journey. At the final battlefield, the Demon Lord's castle, Light and his allies drove the Demon Lord into a corner. But just as it was all about to end, the Demon Lord's curse turned Light into a small creature.
  Meanwhile, a boy and a girl were trying to start a mysterious device. It suddenly came to life and summoned Light, a little creature who could speak. When the Demon Lord's minions came after Light, the boy, Alk, had to fight. Working together, the powerless Light and Alk drove off their pursuers. As Light grew more and more confused under Alk's endless questions, the mysterious girl said to Alk:
  "The worlds are connected now."
   Each with their own thoughts, the three of them finally opened the door to a new world—

strings.诶嘿嘿……好想多聊聊，\\n但今天我得先回去了。\\n加油做毕业作品哦！: Ehehe... I wish we could talk more,\nbut I have to head back today.\nGood luck with your graduation project!
strings.她好可爱啊……\\n好喜欢她…………: She's so cute...\nI love her so much...
strings.现、现在还不是时候……\\n我已经决定了啊……: N-not yet...\nI've already made up my mind...
strings.我要向梅莉求婚。\\n一定要和她说出……\\n“请你和我结婚”！: I'm going to propose to Mary.\nI'm going to tell her...\n"Please marry me!"
strings.话说……这也太奇怪了吧？: Hey... isn't this kind of weird?
strings.嗯嗯，就是说啊。\\n为什么求婚还要先修行啊？: Yeah, right?\nWhy do you have to train before proposing?
strings.而且，威尔不都当着大家的面\\n告白过了吗？虽然我也不太懂，\\n但用那时的气势: Besides, Will, didn't you already\nconfess in front of everyone? I don't really get it,\nbut can't you just propose with that same energy?
strings.求、求婚和告白不一样啊！\\n需要做好种种觉悟……\\n所以，我才想变得更强……: P-proposing isn't the same as confessing!\nYou have to be ready for all sorts of things...\nThat's why I want to get stronger...
strings.唔，总之就是……\\n威尔觉得必须变强了才能求婚吧？: Hmm, so basically...\nyou think you have to be strong before you can propose?
strings.不过，你不是说，\\n已经买好戒指了吗？: But didn't you say\nyou already bought the ring?
strings.啊、嗯。\\n我打算求婚的时候给她呢……: Ah, yeah.\nI'm going to give it to her when I propose...
strings.你根本干劲很足啊。\\n完全以她一定会答应为前提了吧。: You're totally fired up already.\nYou're assuming she'll say yes.
strings.话说，来找我们商量\\n根本就找错人了吧？？？\\n好了，大家解散——: Anyway, coming to us for advice\nwas the wrong move, wasn't it???\nOkay, everyone, meeting adjourned—
strings.我想和梅莉组建一个家庭啊！: I want to start a family with Mary!
strings.所以，我想变得像你们那样强。\\n我必须成为……配当她家人的人啊！: That's why I want to be strong like you guys.\nI have to become someone...\nworthy of being her family!
strings.不变强……就没法组建家庭吗？: You can't start a family... unless you're strong?
strings.因、因为……\\n继续像现在这样，肯定不行啊……: B-because...\nif I stay the way I am now, it'll never work...
strings.我不了解真正美好的家庭……\\n所以我根本没资格成为梅莉的家人……: I don't know what a truly happy family is like...\nSo I don't have the right to be Mary's family...
strings.我说啊，威尔弗雷德，\\n强大这种东西，\\n也能靠你自己的力量创造出来吧？: Listen, Wilfred.\nStrength is something\nyou can build with your own hands too, right?
strings.总之，好好加油吧。\\n不管结果怎样，\\n我都会拿你的故事下酒的。: Anyway, give it your best.\nHowever it turns out,\nI'll enjoy your story over a drink.
strings.那家伙……甩了一通帅气的台词，\\n结果就去喝酒了啊……: That guy... dropped a cool line\nand then just went off drinking...
strings.用我的力量创造……\\n既然如此——: Build it with my own hands...\nIn that case—
strings.是、是不是很帅呢？\\n这同时也是我的毕业作品！\\n我还找了魔像部帮忙呢！: I-isn't it cool?\nIt's also my graduation project!\nI even got the Golem Club to help!
strings.它的性能也很厉害哦！你们看说明书！\\n攻击方式参考了涩谷的机器人动画，\\n还: Its specs are amazing too! Read the manual!\nThe attacks are based on a Shibuya robot anime,\nand it has a high-performance long-range communicator—
strings.呃、嗯……怎么说呢……\\n当然很帅没错……但怎么说好呢……: Uh, yeah... how do I put this...\nIt's cool, sure... but how should I say it...
strings.你的理解真是独特啊。: You sure have a unique take on things.
strings.头部的形状很可爱呢。\\n是为了和梅莉安娜小姐凑对吗？: The head is really cute.\nIs it meant to match Miss Mary?
strings.不、不过，我还没在实战中用过。\\n所以……我想请翔太来当我的对手！: B-but I haven't used it in a real fight yet.\nSo... Shota, I'd like you to be my opponent!
strings.喔？既然这样，\\n我就作为前辈来教教你战斗吧！: Oh? In that case,\nlet your senior teach you how to fight!
strings.那、那么，我要上了！\\n代号·火焰工艺，启动！: H-here I come!\nCodename: Flame Craft, activate!
strings.呜哇？！刚、刚才那招好强！\\n你这不是变得超强嘛！: Whoa?! Th-that move was strong!\nYou've gotten super strong!
strings.我……变强了？像大家一样强了？\\n只要有了这个，我就——: I... got stronger? As strong as everyone?\nWith this, I can—
strings.可恶~不仅要和可爱的青梅竹马结婚，\\n还要扮演装甲英雄吗~！太不公平了！: Dang it~ You get to marry your cute childhood friend\nAND play an armored hero~?! That's so unfair!
strings.要说不公平……\\n翔太才让人觉得不公平吧？: If we're talking unfair...\nyou're the unfair one, Shota.
strings.你总是那么坦率，那么坚持自我。\\n永远能靠本来的自己闪闪发光！\\n实在是……: You're always so honest, so true to yourself.\nYou always shine just by being who you are!\nIt's just... so unfair!
strings.阿尔克也是！\\n总是那么温柔地听我说话——: You too, Alk!\nYou always listen to me so kindly—
strings.却不肯对我露出真实随意的一面！\\n我也想和你站在对等的位置上啊！: but you never show me your real, relaxed side!\nI want to stand on equal footing with you too!
strings.你、你这是怎么了？\\n你平时不会那么强势——: Wh-what's gotten into you?\nYou're never this pushy—
strings.呵呵……我已经变强了！\\n现在的我什么都说得出口！\\n什么都能做到啊！: Heh heh... I've gotten stronger!\nNow I can say anything!\nI can do anything!
strings.阿尔克！看这里……\\n有行小字写着“感情增幅”！: Alk! Look here...\nThere's fine print that says "emotion amplification"!
strings.为、“为了让使用者通过思考\\n控制装甲的输出功率，本装甲\\n搭载了咒具羊羊制: "T-to let the user control the armor's\noutput with their thoughts, this armor\nuses the core of the Sheep-Making Curse Machine"?
strings.“使用者的感情也会随输出功率上升\\n而被放大，穿着时请注意！哈哈哈！\\nby: "The user's emotions are amplified as output rises,\nso take care when wearing it! Hahaha!\nby the former Golem Club captain"...
strings.好厉害……太厉害了！\\n这样我就能向梅莉求婚了！\\n这下我们一定能成为一家人: Amazing... this is amazing!\nNow I can propose to Mary!\nNow we can definitely be a family!
strings.等下啊，这也太奇怪了吧！\\n最开始我就说了！: Hold on, that's so weird!\nI said it from the start!
strings.就算没有这种东西，\\n你也能向她求婚的吧？！: You could propose to her\neven without this thing, right?!
strings.嗯，是啊。\\n强大的你们是不会理解的！: Yeah, sure.\nStrong people like you would never understand!
strings.我根本就不行啊……\\n我让父亲他们都失望了！\\n如果是那样的我——: I'm no good at all...\nI let my father and the others down!\nSomeone like me—
strings.怎么可能去求婚！\\n怎么可能拥有家庭啊——: How could I ever propose!\nHow could I ever have a family—
strings.也……也不用飞到天上\\n那么大声地喊吧……: Y-you don't have to fly up into the sky\nand shout it that loud...
strings.总感觉不太妙啊……我们快追！: This feels bad... let's go after him!
strings.诶，他没向你求婚吗？\\n我还以为他毕业以后马上\\n就会若无其事地和你结婚呢。: Huh, he didn't propose to you?\nI figured he'd marry you right after\ngraduating like it was nothing.
strings.他肯定又在害怕什么，\\n所以才没法说出口吧？: He's probably scared of something again,\nso he can't bring himself to say it, right?
strings.没、没事啦……不结也行！\\n又不是只有结婚了才能在一起啊。: I-it's fine... we don't have to get married!\nIt's not like you can only be together if you're married.
strings.诶？\\n威、威尔？是威尔吧？\\n你在飞……你身上这是？: Huh?\nW-Will? It's Will, right?\nYou're flying... what are you wearing?
strings.终于找到你了！梅莉，走吧！\\n和我去只有我们两个人的世界！: I finally found you! Mary, let's go!\nCome with me to a world with just the two of us!
strings.等下啊！\\n到底是怎么回事？！: Wait a second!\nWhat on earth is going on?!
strings.威尔……\\n他要以那种状态求婚吗？: Will...\nis he going to propose like that?
strings.真的非常抱歉★\\n我要怎么做才能征得各位的原谅？: I'm so, so sorry★\nWhat can I do to earn everyone's forgiveness?
strings.但、但是~我突然就被叫过来，\\n一进来还发现面前还是各位啊！: B-but~ I got called over out of nowhere,\nand when I walk in, it's all of you!
strings.哈哈哈哈，抱歉抱歉。\\n搞得好像是压力面试一样呢。: Hahaha, sorry, sorry.\nIt does feel like a pressure interview, doesn't it?
strings.是我拜托大家聚集过来的。\\n为了实施我们的计划，\\n我们需要莉莉艾小姐的帮助: I'm the one who asked everyone to gather.\nTo carry out our plan,\nwe need your help, Miss Lilie.
strings.我们打算在这里建造船和港口。\\n要造一艘能横跨世界的龙舰。: We intend to build a ship and a port here.\nA dragon ship that can cross the worlds.
strings.然后我们要乘上它冲进敌阵，\\n去帮助史黛拉和阿尔克他们！\\n要集合我们全员的: Then we'll ride it straight into enemy lines\nand go help Stella, Alk and the others!\nWith all of our strength together!
strings.沃伦塔斯天塔是依靠枪\\n去贯穿天空的仪式机关。\\n但这次，我们没有枪了。: The Voluntas Splice was a ritual device\nthat pierced the sky with a spear.\nBut this time, we have no spear.
strings.既然如此，哪怕潜入深渊也要去。\\n必须造出一艘异想天开的船，\\n让我们能突破: Then we'll go even if we have to dive into the abyss.\nWe need to build an outrageous ship,\none that can break through the bottom of hell and the edge of the underworld.
strings.我们需要资材、人力和技术。\\n更重要的是能推进这一计划的“环境”。: We need materials, manpower and technology.\nMore than that, we need an "environment"\nthat can push this plan forward.
strings.那么，我们想要先了解一下\\n帕尔佩布拉现在需要“什么”。: Well, first we'd like to know\nwhat Palpebra needs right now.
strings.需要什么吗……\\n为了重建，必须有食物、药品，\\n还有干净的衣服之类……: What it needs...\nTo rebuild, we need food, medicine,\nclean clothes and things like that...
strings.就是那些。\\n毕竟要借助你们的力量，\\n有借没还可不像话吧？: That's it.\nWe're borrowing your people's strength, after all.\nIt'd be wrong to take without giving back, right?
strings.这也确实呢……\\n没有回报的工作……\\n这里的人们是不会做的！: That's true...\nWork without a reward...\nThe people here won't do that!
strings.既然这个谈妥了。\\n接下来我想和你“聊聊”。: Now that that's settled,\nnext I'd like to have a "chat" with you.
strings.我们公会准备将建造计划\\n作为大规模委托发布。\\n但是，仅仅那样还不够。: Our guild plans to post the construction plan\nas a large-scale request.\nBut that alone won't be enough.
strings.不信任和消极会让我们难以前进。\\n因此，我们必须博得人们的理解和期待。: Distrust and pessimism will make it hard to move forward.\nSo we have to win people's understanding and hopes.
strings.让他们能够怀抱希望，\\n相信前方仍有道路可行——: So they can hold on to hope,\nand believe there's still a road ahead—
strings.所以，我们想要了解这里的人。: That's why we want to understand the people here.
strings.希望你能将我们要做的事告诉大家。\\n你就是连接我们与这里的桥梁啊。: We'd like you to tell everyone what we're going to do.\nYou're the bridge between us and this place.
strings.我只是个公会职员。\\n没法像库库斯小姐那样——: I'm just a guild clerk.\nI can't do it like Lady Kugala—
strings.我确实是为人们发声之人。\\n但是，人越是身处高位，\\n就越容易混淆自己的理想: I am indeed someone who speaks for the people.\nBut the higher up a person climbs,\nthe easier it is to confuse their ideals with reality.
strings.而你们面对的一直是真实的群众。\\n所以，我们需要你的力量啊，莉莉艾。: You, though, have always faced the real people.\nThat's why we need your strength, Lilie.
strings.我明白了！\\n迷宫探索者生活安全改善宣传部\\n部长普·莉莉艾，愿意接受使命！: Understood!\nPur Lilie, Head of the Labyrinth Explorer\nSafety Awareness Department, accepts the mission!
strings.那么！\\n首先要做的就是——★: All right!\nThe first thing to do is—★
strings.好朴素……\\n莉莉艾姐，这种事真的有用吗~？: That's so plain...\nSis Lilie, does this stuff really work~?
strings.你在说什么呢！\\n推销冒险者伤病保险的时候，\\n我们不是也靠这样吸引了很多人: What are you saying!\nWhen we were selling adventurer injury insurance,\ndidn't we pull in lots of people this way?
strings.确实有人会看也不看就扔掉。\\n但是！还是要反复地！坚持广发！\\n要一遍一遍让: Sure, some people throw them away without looking.\nBut! We keep at it! Hand them out everywhere!\nAgain and again until everyone knows★
strings.重大委托说明会即将开始★: The briefing on the major request is about to begin★
strings.如之前向各位说明的那样——\\n本次重大委托需要各位齐心协力，\\n才能达成我们: As we explained to you all before—\nthis major request will take everyone\nworking together to reach our shared goal.
strings.不过，希望各位在委托中\\n也能互相切磋较量——\\n因此，我们引入了积分制！: However, we'd also like you all to compete\nwith one another during the request—\nso we've introduced a points system!
strings.简而言之就是根据完成情况\\n为各位计算分数和等级的制度！: In short, it's a system that calculates\nyour score and tier based on what you complete!
strings.而且！除了常规报酬之外，\\n公会还会根据等级为各位发放豪华奖励！: And! On top of the usual rewards,\nthe guild will hand out deluxe prizes based on tier!
strings.达到光荣的白金等级的冒险者\\n将收到由格雷布商会捐赠的\\n“伟大冒险者铜像”: Adventurers who reach the glorious Platinum tier\nwill receive a "Great Adventurer Statue"\ndonated by the Grebe Company~★
strings.另外！作为附赠奖励，\\n各位还将获得与知名冒险者\\n一对一训练一天的权利★: Also! As a bonus prize,\nyou'll earn the right to one day of one-on-one\ntraining with a famous adventurer★
strings.真的假的？！\\n能找梅媞斯小姐吗？: No way?!\nCan I pick Miss Metis?
strings.能和雷恩那家伙拼死战斗了吗？！: Can I finally have a fight to the death with Leon?!
strings.我根本没听说这回事啊……\\n包括铜像在内……: I never heard anything about this...\nincluding the statue...
strings.哎呀，不是挺好的吗。\\n应该能度过很刺激的一天吧。: Oh, isn't it fine?\nIt should make for a thrilling day.
strings.另外另外！\\n指定知名冒险者中还包括了现在\\n十分耀眼的偶像冒险者蕾维小姐★: And also! The famous adventurers you can choose\ninclude the dazzling idol adventurer\nMiss Levy★
strings.我一定……\\n一定会拼尽全力的！: I'll... I'll give it\neverything I've got!
strings.诶，艾莉亚呢？！\\n能选艾莉亚吗？！: Huh, what about Ellya?!\nCan we pick Ellya?!
strings.我？我也不太清楚，\\n但如果你们想的话，\\n我随时愿意奉陪。: Me? I'm not really sure,\nbut if that's what you want,\nI'm happy to join anytime.
strings.那么，各位！\\n请鼓起劲来，加油工作吧！: All right, everyone!\nLet's get fired up and get to work!
strings.这样一来，我的评定也能急速上升了★: With this, my performance review will skyrocket too★
strings.辛苦了，莉莉艾部长。\\n不过，太拼命对身体不好哦。: Good work, Head Lilie.\nBut pushing yourself too hard is bad for your health.
strings.那之后已经过了两个月了。\\n距离作战开始只剩一个月了啊。\\n我能理解你心中的: It's been two months since then.\nThere's only one month left before the operation starts.\nI understand how anxious you must feel.
strings.我只是想做自己力所能及的事。\\n基本只是在自我满足啦~\\n毕竟……这就是我的: I just want to do what I can.\nIt's mostly for my own satisfaction~\nAfter all... this is my battle.
strings.既然是自我满足就没办法了。\\n那我们也来做点让自己满意的事吧~: If it's for your own satisfaction, there's no stopping you.\nThen we'll do something for our own satisfaction too~
strings.既然担心我们，那部长也要知道度。\\n明天记得好好休息啊。\\n最近你连午饭都没: If you worry about us, you need to know your limits too, Head.\nMake sure you rest properly tomorrow.\nYou haven't even eaten lunch with us lately.
strings.说到午饭……你知道吗？\\n白乃小姐和帕尔菲小姐\\n摆了摊位，正在暗暗较劲呢。: Speaking of lunch... did you hear?\nMiss Shirano and Miss Parfait\nset up food stalls and they're quietly competing.
strings.难道是决出谁才是真正的师父！\\n之类的吗？: Don't tell me it's to decide\nwho's the real master?
strings.那她们二位当然都是了~\\n不过……白乃小姐倒意外地认真呢。: Well, they both are, of course~\nBut... Miss Shirano is surprisingly serious about it.
strings.菲、菲勒斯小姐？！\\n但、但是，那个，圣夜祭早就、\\n倒不如说，新年都过去很: M-Miss Folus?!\nB-but, um, the Holy Night Festival was ages ago—\nactually, even New Year's was a long time ago!
strings.我才不管那些呢。\\n我可是恶魔啊。\\n当然要做自己喜欢的事。: I don't care about any of that.\nI'm a demon, you know.\nOf course I do whatever I like.
strings.来，拿着。这是给你的哦。: Here, take it. This is for you.
strings.孤儿院的孩子们向圣诞老人许了愿，\\n希望能把这个带给努力的莉莉艾小姐呢。: The children at the orphanage wished to Santa\nthat this would reach Miss Lilie,\nwho's been working so hard.
strings.我会加油的~\\n我一定会好好珍惜它的~~~~: I'll do my best~\nI'll treasure it forever~~~~

strings.该死的虫子们，\\n不管杀死多少、\\n杀死多少还是会冒出来！: Damned vermin!\nNo matter how many I kill,\nmore of you just keep crawling out!
strings.去死……去死！去死！\\n都给我去死！\\n全都给我去死——: Die... Die! Die!\nAll of you, die!\nEvery last one of you—DIE!
strings.我抱着我的孩子、雷伊尔的遗骸，\\n在那死亡旋风的裹挟之中，\\n不停地呼号，不: Clutching the remains of my child, Reil,\ncaught in that whirlwind of death,\nI screamed, and screamed, and screamed.
strings.返魂术。\\n后世的人们称为回复魔法的东西。\\n而当时，它却是被禁止的渎神之术: The art of soul-returning.\nWhat later ages would call healing magic.\nBack then, it was forbidden blasphemy.
strings.然而，为了从病魔手中拯救\\n我的妻子、雷伊尔的母亲，\\n我需要那股力量。: But to save my wife,\nReil's mother, from her illness,\nI needed that power.
strings.在充斥着血腥味的房间里，\\n那些自称断罪者的人们\\n带着轻蔑和怜悯的神情看着: In a room reeking of blood,\nthe ones who called themselves judges\nlooked at me with scorn and pity.
strings.那些从未掌握过半点真理的人，\\n那些从未想要去追求智慧的人，\\n当他们试图向: Those who had never grasped a shred of truth,\nwho had never once sought wisdom,\ndared to lecture me on what was right—
strings.我第一次，使用了真正的禁术。: And so, for the first time,\nI used a truly forbidden art.
strings.死亡的旋风席卷而至。\\n我任凭自己陷入愤怒与憎恶，\\n斩下了逃向神谕室的王的: A whirlwind of death swept through.\nI gave myself over to rage and hatred\nand took the head of the king as he fled.
strings.唯有那些尖叫、痛楚、愤怒，\\n才能证明我的爱——: Only the screams, the pain, the fury\ncould prove my love—
strings.为了抹去一切虚伪，\\n我毁灭了世界。: To wipe away every falsehood,\nI destroyed the world.
strings.等到死亡不断传播，\\n这里除了自己再无其他生命，\\n一切都被灰与雪覆盖之时。: When death had spread so far\nthat no life remained here but my own,\nand all was buried in ash and snow...
strings.我才发现，需要我掩饰弱小、\\n需要我用爱为自己的行为做借口\\n才能去面对的人: Only then did I realize the one I needed\nto hide my weakness from, to excuse myself to\nin the name of love, was long gone—
strings.然后，我才终于意识到自己的愚蠢。: And at last, I understood\nhow foolish I had been.
strings.我的悔恨，持续了十余年。\\n而在剩下数不清的时间中，\\n我都在祈祷绝不会来临: My regret lasted more than ten years.\nAnd for the countless years after,\nI prayed for a death that would never come—
strings.我是瑞西塔尔。\\n瑞西塔尔·穆埃尔特。\\n孤身乞求死亡、歌颂死亡之人。: I am Regitare.\nRegitare Muerte.\nHe who begs for death alone, and sings its praise.
strings.这世界上没有神。: There are no gods in this world.
strings.如果，神真的存在，\\n为何要给予我这种人救赎呢？: If there truly were,\nwhy would they grant salvation\nto someone like me?
strings.不错……很好。\\n长了千年的颜色很棒啊。: Not bad... Very nice.\nA fine color, for something\nthat's grown a thousand years.
strings.我的自言自语又变多了……: I've started talking to myself more...
strings.唔，但为了维持认知能力，\\n这是必须——: Well, it's necessary to keep\nmy mind sharp, after all—
strings.不对！这不是我的声音！\\n也不是幻听！！！: Wait! That wasn't my voice!\nAnd it's not in my head!!!
strings.是你吗？\\n大、大树啊……\\n是你、在对我——: Is it you?\nO-O great tree...\nAre you talking to me—
strings.可、可怕？！\\n不对，等等，\\n你怎么知道我的名字？！: S-Scary?!\nNo, wait, hold on—\nhow do you know my name?!
strings.等等等等等等一下！请等一下！\\n我改！我换个态度！\\n请你等一下……: W-W-W-Wait a moment! Please wait!\nI'll change! I'll be nicer!\nPlease, just wait...
strings.谁……学谁好呢……\\n对了……\\n雷伊尔说过，要模仿爷爷——: Who... who should I act like...\nOh, right...\nReil always said I should be more like Grandpa—
strings.咳、咳咳……\\n老、老夫是瑞西塔尔！\\n如你所见，是个老人了！: Ahem, ahem...\nI-I am Regitare!\nAs you can see, an old man!
strings.老夫、并不危险！\\n所、所以……请你、来这边……: I-I'm not dangerous!\nS-So... please, come over here...
strings.你想要个名字？\\n“大树的精灵”不好吗？\\n都一百年了，真让老夫震惊……: You want a name?\nWhat's wrong with "Spirit of the Great Tree"?\nA hundred years, and now this... I'm amazed.
strings.那个名字，很好。\\n世界上，到处都是我。\\n名字，并不重要。: That name is good.\nI am everywhere in the world.\nA name doesn't matter.
strings.但是，下一个我——\\n不，我的孩子，不一样。: But the next me—\nNo, my child, is different.
strings.那么……你果然要消失了吗？: Then... you're going to disappear after all?
strings.不会消失。只是，回去而已。\\n所以，不要哭，瑞西塔尔。: I won't disappear. I'm only going back.\nSo don't cry, Regitare.
strings.你愿意，给我名字吗？: Will you give me a name?
strings.嗯……嗯！\\n其实，老夫早就为你想好名字了。: Mm... Mm-hm!\nTruth be told, I thought\nof one for you long ago.
strings.会说话的精灵啊！\\n吾友啊！: O spirit who speaks!\nO my dear friend!
strings.呜哇？！\\n啊……是茶露亚吗……\\n哎呀……真是个漫长的梦啊……: Whoa?!\nAh... Is that you, Challua...\nMy, my... What a long dream that was...
strings.唔~~~~\\n瑞西塔尔，最近，睡太多了。\\n总是，迷迷糊糊的。: Mmmmm~\nRegitare, sleeps too much lately.\nAlways dozing.
strings.唔……是吗。\\n看来，老夫也同样在改变啊……: Hmm... Is that so.\nIt seems I'm changing too...
strings.也许心愿实现之后，\\n老夫就该走了吧。\\n所以——: Perhaps once my wish is granted,\nit'll be time for me to go.\nSo—
strings.哎呀，没事，那只是假设罢了？\\n生命的循环已经发生了变化。\\n不过，不管怎样: Oh, never mind, just a hypothetical!\nThe cycle of life has changed now.\nAnyway, that's a long way off—
strings.不要不要不要不要不要不要不要！\\n茶露亚！绝对————————: No no no no no no no!\nChallua! Absolutely—
strings.你都送走了那么多灵魂，\\n不能到了老夫这儿就不情愿啊？: You've sent off so many souls.\nYou can't refuse when it's my turn, you know?
strings.茶露亚说得没错。\\n就算您想退休，也还早啊。: Challua's right.\nIt's too early for you to retire.
strings.莉莉丝公主她们在下面等您。\\n说是有事务必想要拜托您。: Princess Lilith and the others are waiting below.\nThey say there's something\nthey really want to ask of you.
strings.哦哦~！是吗是吗！\\n已经生下来了啊~？\\n哎呀呀呀~~软软糯糯的呢？: Oh ho~! Is that so, is that so!\nSo the little one's been born~?\nOh my, my~ So soft and squishy!
strings.然后，那个……\\n我们希望瑞西塔尔大人\\n能为这个孩子起名……: And, um...\nwe'd like you, Lord Regitare,\nto name this child...
strings.什么？！你们认真的吗？\\n老夫可是不死者啊？？？\\n让老夫这把骨架子——: What?! Are you serious?\nI'm undead, you know???\nYou want this old bag of bones to—
strings.能像以往那样，\\n让茶露亚，为这孩子祝福吗？: Will you let Challua bless this child,\nlike always?
strings.当、当然！完全没问题！\\n二位的祝福就是我们\\n能给这孩子的最好的礼物！: O-Of course! No problem at all!\nThe blessing of you two is the best gift\nwe could ever give this child!
strings.我也想拜托您。\\n请您为他们送上贤者的祝福吧。: I'd like to ask you too.\nPlease give them the blessing of a sage.
strings.真是的……\\n这样也太不公平了吧。\\n这样老夫还怎么能消失啊。: Good grief...\nThat's hardly fair.\nHow am I supposed to disappear now?
strings.好吧！老夫明白了！\\n这孩子的名字是菲利斯！\\n幸福之子，菲利斯！: Very well! I understand!\nThis child's name shall be Felis!\nFelis, child of happiness!
strings.菲利斯！\\n很棒的名字！一定，能幸福！: Felis!\nA wonderful name! Will surely be happy!
strings.茶露亚，森之子。世界树之子！\\n倾听声音，编织愿望。悠久的继承人！: Challua, child of the forest. Child of the World Tree!\nListen to voices, weave wishes. Heir of the ages!
strings.太阳、星星、夜晚、\\n还有茶露亚将为你祝福！: The sun, the stars, the night,\nand Challua will bless you!
strings.呵呵呵呵，\\n这里真的热闹了很多啊~: Heh heh heh heh,\nit's gotten so lively around here~
strings.您愿意接纳我们——\\n接纳移民来到这里定居，\\n我真的不知该如何谢您才好。: For accepting us—\nfor letting us settle here as immigrants—\nI don't know how I can ever thank you.
strings.不用谢老夫，做决定是茶露亚她们啊。\\n而且，你们搬完家以后还有很多事要做吧？: Don't thank me, it was Challua and the others who decided.\nBesides, you've got plenty left to do\nnow that you've moved in, don't you?
strings.是啊……\\n许多人心中一定都还留有不安。\\n所以，今后我们也必须互相扶持——: Yes...\nI'm sure many people still feel uneasy.\nSo from now on, we must support each other—
strings.够了没有？！\\n所以我就说你们这帮魔族——: Haven't you said enough?!\nThis is why I said you fiends—
strings.你说什么？！\\n区区一个人类——: What did you say?!\nA mere human like you—
strings.非常抱歉，莉莉丝殿下……\\n是我僭越了。: My deepest apologies, Lady Lilith...\nI overstepped.
strings.而且……\\n你应该也很“克制”了吧？: Besides...\nyou were holding back quite a lot, weren't you?
strings.怎么了？\\n有什么想说的就尽管说吧……: What is it?\nIf you have something to say, go ahead...
strings.初次见面，不胜荣幸！！！\\n我叫查特丽娜！是个不值一提的前谍报员，\\n我一直: It is an honor to meet you!!!\nI'm Chatrina! A humble former spy\nwho has been supporting Lady Lilith from the shadows!
strings.不、不值一提的前谍报员？\\n也就是说——: A h-humble former spy?\nSo that means—
strings.没错，没错。我隶属于反抗组织内部的\\n治安维持小组，负责清缴萌芽的叛乱份子。\: That's right, that's right. I was in the resistance's\nsecurity unit, rooting out rebellions before they sprouted.\nThe intel unit has been disbanded due to various issues—
strings.既有内部的权力争斗，\\n又有跟神秘组织的里应外合！\\n处理这些实在是超级辛苦: There were internal power struggles,\nand collusion with a mysterious organization!\nDealing with all that was super exhausting!
strings.话虽如此，但由于我是难民出身，\\n所以只能默默做着自己的工作——: That said, since I started out as a refugee,\nall I could do was quietly get on with my job—
strings.但我一直！\\n一——直都很想和你们聊聊呢！\\n莱特大人，瑞西塔尔大人！: But I always!\nAlwaaays wanted to talk with you all!\nLord Light, Lord Regitare!
strings.你们为我们带来了和平，\\n给了我们名为新天地的希望，\\n我实在不知该如何感谢: You brought us peace,\nand gave us the hope of a new land.\nI don't know how to thank you enough!
strings.而且，你们一个毛茸茸的，\\n一个又只有骨架子，\\n实在是充满个性，又非常有趣: And one of you is all fluffy,\nand the other is nothing but bones!\nYou're both so full of character, it's so fun—
strings.等、等一下等一下！\\n你先冷静一点！: W-Wait, wait a sec!\nCalm down a little!
strings.啊、啊啊啊啊~~~~！\\n非常抱歉，我又说太多了……: Ah, aaaah~!\nI'm so sorry, I talked too much again...
strings.如她介绍的那样，\\n她原本是反抗组织的成员。\\n现在则是我的护卫兼传令官。: As she said,\nshe was originally a member of the resistance.\nNow she's my bodyguard and herald.
strings.她的工作能力非常优秀，\\n但又十分喜欢和人聊天……: She's extremely capable at her work,\nbut she does love to chat...
strings.在阴影中守护殿下的时候，\\n我总是默默在心中祈祷……\\n希望能直接向拯救了我: Whenever I guarded Her Highness from the shadows,\nI always prayed silently in my heart...\nthat I could thank all of you who saved us in person!
strings.啊，我实在太开心了！\\n如果没能过来和你们搭话，\\n我肯定会后悔一辈子的！: Ah, I'm so happy!\nIf I hadn't come over to talk to you,\nI would have regretted it for the rest of my life!
strings.谢谢你，查特丽娜。\\n不过，正是有大家的支持，\\n我们才能一路走到现在。: Thank you, Chatrina.\nBut it's thanks to everyone's support\nthat we've made it this far.
strings.今后我们还有很多时间能畅谈。\\n届时我也可以为你介绍我们的朋友。: We'll have plenty of time to talk from now on.\nI can introduce you to our friends then, too.
strings.真的吗？非常感谢您！\\n顺便问一句，能现在就去见他们吗？！: Really? Thank you so much!\nBy the way, could we go see them right now?!
strings.太快了吧？！\\n现、现在马上去可能有点难？！: That's way too soon?!\nR-Right now might be a bit difficult?!
strings.啊，也、也是呢……\\n毕竟我一直过着不知明天\\n会如何的人生，不自觉就~……: Ah, r-right...\nI've lived not knowing what tomorrow would bring\nfor so long, I just couldn't help it~...
strings.查特丽娜，\\n我希望今后你能来台前工作。: Chatrina,\nfrom now on, I'd like you to work out in the open.
strings.去寻找新天地生活中出现的问题，\\n收集情报，以及辅佐我。\\n想要和民众直接对: Look into problems in life in the new land,\ngather information, and assist me.\nYou're free to talk with the people directly, too.
strings.真的可以吗？\\n我完全能一直待在您身后……: Are you sure?\nI'd be perfectly happy staying behind you forever...
strings.为了让大家都拥有明天——\\n我希望你也能与我们一起支撑人民。: So that everyone can have a tomorrow—\nI want you to help support the people with us.
strings.我认为你一定能做到。\\n你就把这当作是我对你的期待吧。: I'm sure you can do it.\nThink of it as what I expect from you.
strings.哈哈哈……\\n既然殿下都这么说了，\\n那我也不能再拒绝啊。: Hahaha...\nIf Your Highness puts it like that,\nI can't very well refuse.
strings.也许现在的我就只能\\n和大家聊聊而已——: Though maybe all I can do right now\nis chat with everyone—
strings.呃、我……那个……\\n没、没什么。\\n我马上就回去——: Um, I... well...\nN-Never mind.\nI'll go back right away—
strings.近几年这花的数量减少了很多，\\n我还以为它已经灭绝了呢！\\n亏你能把它带过来: There've been so few of these the last few years,\nI thought they'd gone extinct!\nI can't believe you brought one all the way here!
strings.啊，难道你想在这里种它？: Oh, do you want to plant it here?
strings.哎呀……\\n我们还没安排过种花的区域吧？\\n我听说这里要用来种植作物……: Oh dear...\nWe haven't set aside any space for flowers, have we?\nI heard this land is meant for crops...
strings.这是我妈妈喜欢的花……\\n她说，就算没法在这里种也没关系……\\n至少要把它带: It was my mom's favorite flower...\nShe said it's okay if we can't plant it here...\nbut to at least keep it with us until the very end...
strings.非、非常抱歉。\\n现在我们应该不需要\\n花这种没有用的东西吧？: I-I'm so sorry.\nWe don't need something as useless\nas flowers right now, do we?
strings.莉莉丝殿下，\\n我们已经有足够的土地种作物了，\\n因此我认为完全可以种种看！: Lady Lilith,\nwe already have plenty of land for crops,\nso I think we could certainly try planting it!
strings.人们有时也会像刚才那样，\\n因为些许不满爆发争执。\\n届时花朵或许能抚平大家: Sometimes people get into fights over small\ngrievances, like just now.\nFlowers might help ease their worries!
strings.嗯，你说的没错呢。\\n我也不希望创造一个只能\\n让人们生存而非生活的环境。: Yes, you're right.\nI don't want to build a place where people\ncan only survive, not truly live.
strings.查特丽娜，这里就拜托你了。\\n我交给你的任务是收集情报，\\n听取民众的愿望也: Chatrina, I'll leave this to you.\nYour task is to gather information,\nand hearing the people's wishes is part of that.
strings.那我们走吧，宝拉妹妹！\\n面前那块田还没有安排过种什么，\\n我想应该能请他们: Let's go, Paula!\nThey haven't decided what to plant in that field yet,\nso I bet they'll let us have it!
strings.你、你怎么知道我叫什么……: H-How do you know my name...
strings.虽然我一直在幕后工作，\\n但我也想把大家的名字都记住呢。\\n你的母亲是米拉小: I may have always worked behind the scenes,\nbut I want to remember everyone's names.\nYour mother is Miss Mira, right?
strings.我只是想到什么就说什么而已。\\n莉莉丝殿下一定也是一样的！: I just said whatever came to mind.\nI'm sure Lady Lilith feels the same way!
strings.而且……不让自己后悔才最重要。\\n让我们把力所能及的事都做一遍吧？: Besides... what matters most is having no regrets.\nLet's do everything we can, okay?
strings.我也来帮忙吧。\\n力气活就交给我好了。: I'll help too.\nLeave the heavy lifting to me.
strings.哇……您真的可以变身啊！\\n好帅哦~……: Wow... You really can transform!\nSo cool~...
strings.非常感谢您，莱特大人！\\n那就再次请您多关照了！: Thank you so much, Lord Light!\nI look forward to working with you!
strings.嗯，请多指教。\\n你应该还有很多想和我说的吧？: Yeah, likewise.\nI bet you still have plenty you want to tell me, huh?
strings.啊，我还没自我介绍吧！\\n我叫查特丽娜，是个不值一提的前谍报员，\\n现在正在: Oh, I haven't introduced myself yet!\nI'm Chatrina, a humble former spy,\ncurrently assisting Lady Lilith—
strings.还有那边的小姐姐，\\n你也超级可爱啊！: And you over there, miss—\nyou're super cute too!
strings.我们是SOS团哦！\\n我是团长凉宫春日！: We're the SOS Brigade!\nI'm the brigade chief, Haruhi Suzumiya!
strings.哇，果然说话了！\\n我刚才还以为自己幻听了呢，\\n你是异世界人吗？: Whoa, it really talks!\nI thought I was hearing things just now.\nAre you from another world?
strings.也就是说这里果然是异世界？！\\n太厉害了，真的来到异世界了啊！: So this really IS another world?!\nAmazing, we actually made it to another world!
strings.当然是过来玩的啦！\\n事不宜迟，赶紧带我们看看这个世界吧？: Here to have fun, obviously!\nNo time to waste—hurry up and show us around this world!
strings.这样真的没问题吗？！\\n春日那家伙已经意识到\\n这里是异世界了啊……: Is this really okay?!\nHaruhi's already realized\nthat this is another world...
strings.不……凉宫同学似乎还没有完全认为\\n这里发生的一切都是现实。: No... Suzumiya doesn't seem to fully believe\nthat everything happening here is real yet.
strings.就和以前在闭锁空间那次一样吗……\\n真是好险啊……: Just like that time in the closed space...\nThat was a close one...
strings.真对不住啊，\\n还要麻烦你们提供吃住……: Sorry about this,\nmaking you put us up and feed us too...
strings.我、我多少会做一点家务的，\\n有需要的话就请让我帮忙吧！: I-I can do some housework,\nso please let me help if you need anything!
strings.那真是太好了！\\n哎呀，真的帮大忙了！: That's wonderful!\nOh, that'd be a huge help!
strings.总之，经常会有异世界的人来这里，\\n你们也不用太过在意。: Anyway, people from other worlds\nshow up here all the time,\nso don't worry about it too much.
strings.凉宫同学的影响是毋庸置疑的……\\n但这个世界……: Suzumiya's influence is beyond question...\nbut this world...
strings.我同意。\\n这里并非是游戏中的世界，\\n也并非是以其为蓝本改造的世界。: Agreed.\nThis is not the world of the game,\nnor a world modeled after it.
strings.这里的数据本身就与我们的世界不同……\\n搞不好我们才是入侵的异物。: The data here is fundamentally different from our world's...\nWe may well be the foreign bodies intruding.
strings.也许还是和他们说清楚的好。: It might be best to explain things to them.
strings.我们现在就只能仰仗你们了啊。: Right now, you're all we've got to rely on.
strings.所以，\\n有些事必须要告诉你们……: So,\nthere's something we need to tell you...
strings.诶诶，凉宫同学有着能改变世界的力量？！: Wait, Haruhi has the power\nto change the world?!
strings.嘘，小声点！\\n要是被春日听到了就糟糕了。: Shh, keep it down!\nIt'd be bad if Haruhi heard.
strings.凉宫同学并不知道自己有这样的力量。\\n所以我们为了维持现状，\\n每天都得十分: Suzumiya is unaware she has this power.\nSo, to keep things as they are,\nwe have to be very careful every day.
strings.过去她甚至险些让世界归于空白……\\n那时真是多亏了阿虚的努力啊。: Once, she very nearly reset the world to a blank slate...\nWe have Kyon's efforts to thank for stopping that.
strings.别、别再提那个了！\\n话说回来，虽然这一切很难以置信——: D-Don't bring that up again!\nAnyway, I know this is all hard to believe—
strings.我相信你们的话。\\n你们身上确实有股非同寻常的力量。: I believe you.\nYou definitely have an unusual power about you.
strings.毕竟我们以前可从来没有直接\\n从星见镇传送进迷宫里过呢……: After all, nobody's ever been warped\nstraight from Starview into the labyrinth before...
strings.是的。\\n而且，我认为你们并没有说谎。: Yes.\nAnd I don't think you're lying.
strings.你、你们愿意相信我们说的吗？\\n实在是太谢谢了！: Y-You believe us?\nThank you so much!
strings.真不好意思，给你们添麻烦了。\\n我们会想办法尽量快点把春日带回去的。: Sorry for all the trouble.\nWe'll figure out how to take Haruhi home\nas soon as we can.
strings.没事啦。\\n有什么需要帮忙的请不要客气，\\n尽管来找我们好了。: It's no trouble.\nIf you need help with anything,\ndon't hesitate to come to us.
strings.那么，你们打算怎么办呢？: So, what are you planning to do?
strings.这个嘛……\\n我们来到这里的契机毫无疑问\\n就是那个游戏……: Well...\nWhat brought us here was\ndefinitely that game...
strings.那、那个，如果能像上次暑假那样，\\n尽量让凉宫同学感到满足，\\n是不是……就: U-Um, if we keep Suzumiya as\nsatisfied as possible, like last summer break,\nmaybe... we can go back?
strings.既然这样，事情就简单了。\\n毕竟这次的目标非常明确啊。: In that case, this is simple.\nOur goal is very clear this time.
strings.消灭BOSS，\\n以及在过程中必不可少的修炼。: Defeat the boss,\nand do the training that's essential along the way.
strings.现在需要的就是所谓的——\\n修行环节啊。: What we need now is the so-called—\ntraining arc.
strings.嗯，就是这样对吧！\\n怎么样？我给你们都上了支援魔法哦！: Yep, that's right!\nHow's that? I put support magic on all of you!
strings.噢噢！\\n确实有种力量涌上来了的感觉，\\n真不错啊！: Ooh!\nI really do feel power welling up.\nNice!
strings.难以置信……\\n只听了那么简短的说明\\n就能用出魔法了吗？: Unbelievable...\nShe can use magic after hearing\njust that short explanation?
strings.只要受到异世界人的启发，\\n就能用出能力！\\n这不是经典桥段吗！: You get inspired by someone from another world,\nand suddenly you've got powers!\nThat's a total classic!
strings.你、你们的世界中还有这样的法则吗？: D-Does your world have rules like that too?
strings.怎么可能，\\n能这么乱来的也只有这家伙一个了。: No way.\nShe's the only one who could pull off something that absurd.
strings.大家怎么样呢？\\n都学会新技能了吗？: How's everyone doing?\nDid you all learn new skills?
strings.我也学会了呢~\\n感觉浑身暖洋洋的，\\n非常舒服呢。: I learned one too~\nI feel all warm and fuzzy.\nIt's really nice.
strings.话说回来……\\n真没想到你竟然会提出要\\n“为了打倒BOSS而修行”啊。: Still...\nI never thought you'd be the one to suggest\n"training to defeat the boss."
strings.也没有很奇怪吧。\\n难得来一次异世界，\\n我也想好好享受一番嘛。: It's not that weird.\nWe came all the way to another world,\nso I want to enjoy it too.
strings.什么呀，你这不是很懂吗！\\n那我会好好加倍使唤你的！: Oh, so you do get it!\nThen I'll work you twice as hard!
strings.是是是。\\n我会加油在前面抗伤害的啦。: Yeah, yeah.\nI'll do my best tanking damage up front.
strings.到现在为止……都还挺顺利的吧？: So far... things are going pretty well, right?
strings.没错。\\n我们的战斗力应该已经达到了基准值。: Correct.\nOur combat strength should have reached the baseline.
strings.也已经把必须打倒BOSS的概念\\n成功灌输给凉宫同学了……\\n剩下的就是付诸: We've also successfully planted the idea\nthat the boss must be defeated in Suzumiya's mind...\nAll that's left is to act.
strings.放心吧……\\n我会好好守护朝比奈学姐的。\\n这次我可是承担坦克职责的战士啊。: Don't worry...\nI'll protect you, Miss Asahina.\nThis time I'm a warrior with the tank role.
strings.不过，如果学姐太害怕的话，\\n就留在这里等我们吧。: But if it's too scary for you,\nyou can stay here and wait for us.
strings.但凉宫同学恐怕不会同意吧？: I doubt Suzumiya would allow that, though.
strings.无视她无视她，\\n自身的安全才是最重要的啊。: Just ignore her.\nYour own safety comes first.
strings.而且……如果朝比奈学姐\\n没法好好享受这趟旅程的话，\\n我是不会让春日乱来的: Besides... if Miss Asahina\ncan't enjoy this trip,\nI won't let Haruhi do anything crazy.
strings.嗯……说得是啊，\\n这次确实是你占理呢。: Hmm... You have a point.\nYou're in the right this time.
strings.是啊……\\n这次我们是来享受异世界的啊。: Yeah...\nThis time, we're here to enjoy another world.
strings.哎呀，这个世界真是让人大开眼界呢！\\n史黛拉，还有什么其他有趣的地方吗？: Wow, this world is such an eye-opener!\nStella, are there any other fun places?
strings.啊，春日，\\n我们都已经做好战斗的准备了，\\n是不是该出发了啊？: Hey, Haruhi,\nwe're all ready for battle,\nso shouldn't we get going?
strings.嗯？是吗？\\n但先到处逛逛不也挺好吗，\\n不用那么着急吧？: Hm? Really?\nWouldn't it be nice to look around first?\nNo need to rush, right?
strings.我、我们也想体验一下\\n你们说的游戏呢！\\n可以现在就带我们去吗？: W-We'd like to try out\nthe game you talked about too!\nCan you take us there right now?
strings.好吧！既然都说到这个份上了，\\n我凉宫春日可是会好好使唤你们的！: Fine! If you insist,\nI, Haruhi Suzumiya, will work you all hard!
strings.好了，各位！\\n要出发去挑战BOSS了哦！: All right, everyone!\nWe're heading out to take on the boss!
strings.装填完毕，充能完毕。\\n等离子引擎没有异常。: Loading complete, charging complete.\nPlasma engine shows no anomalies.
strings.天气和风向都绝妙！\\n简直是最适合工作的日子了！: Perfect weather, perfect wind!\nJust the day for a job!
strings.真是的……来处理“工作”，\\n需要这么全副武装吗？: Good grief... Do we really need\nto be armed to the teeth\nfor a "job"?
strings.别这么说嘛，莱特。\\n这可是我们难得的初次合作啊。: Don't be like that, Light.\nThis is our first time working together!
strings.也是……那我再确认一下。\\n这次的委托内容是镇压革新者组织，\\n并俘虏其首领: Fine... Let me double-check, then.\nThe request is to suppress the Innovator organization\nand capture its leader. Right?
strings.委托人是机体设计师卡西瓦尔斯。\\n她的工作室被非法侵入，开发资料遭窃……: The client is mech designer Käsivars.\nSomeone broke into her workshop\nand stole her development data...
strings.革新者。应该是革新派吧。\\n不管哪个世界都有这种人啊~: Innovators. Revolutionaries, I'd guess.\nEvery world's got people like that, huh~
strings.不过，我们也不会输的！\\n反正委托人也说了，\\n“把他们的基地轰烂也没事”嘛: But we're not gonna lose!\nBesides, the client said\n"It's fine if you blow up their base!"
strings.我能理解他们追求浪漫的心情，\\n但默不作声偷资料实在是不能放过啊。: I get wanting to chase your dreams,\nbut quietly stealing data\nis something I can't let slide.
strings.而且我也受了卡西瓦尔斯很多照顾。\\n她帮我延长了\\n制作费和手术费的还款期限: Plus, Käsivars has done a lot for me.\nShe extended the deadline on paying back\nmy build costs and surgery fees!
strings.难怪她要回收这次的报酬啊……\\n我都说了多少次，让你别借太多钱……: No wonder she's taking this job's reward back...\nHow many times have I told you\nnot to borrow so much money...
strings.别这么说嘛，莱特~！\\n你就当是帮帮有困难的人呗~！: Don't be like that, Light~!\nJust think of it as helping someone in need~!
strings.我自然是那么想的。\\n终于有机会让我去帮助朋友了。: That's how I see it, of course.\nAt last I get the chance to help a friend.
strings.嘿嘿，那就多仰仗你了啊，勇者！: Heh heh, I'm counting on you, hero!
strings.哟，革新者们！\\n抱歉啊，现在才来打招呼。: Yo, Innovators!\nSorry, I'm only just now saying hello.
strings.我是麻烦射手，塔吉斯！\\n给我记好了啊！: I'm the troublemaking gunner, Teurgis!\nRemember it!
strings.哇哦！不错嘛！\\n那这次来比比速度吧！: Whoa! Not bad!\nLet's race to see who's faster this time!
strings.敌人的数量比预期中多啊……\\n希望其他人那边没什么事……: There are more enemies than we expected...\nI hope the others are okay...
strings.放心吧，他们肯定没问题的。\\n毕竟——: Don't worry, I'm sure they're fine.\nAfter all—
strings.区区“人类”。\\n不……在其他世界，\\n应该叫作自然人和改造人吗。: Mere "humans."\nNo... in other worlds,\nI suppose they're called naturals and augments.
strings.我们好想见你啊，组织的老大。\\n你打扮得相当帅气嘛。: We've been dying to meet you, boss.\nYou're dressed pretty sharp.
strings.立刻投降，把一切都交出来……\\n包括你们的秘密情报，和前往异世界的方法。: Surrender at once and hand over everything...\nincluding your secret intel and the way to other worlds.
strings.我们定能超越人类。\\n胆敢妨碍，就等着被掠夺、破坏殆尽吧。: We will surpass humanity.\nIf you dare stand in our way, prepare to be plundered and destroyed.
strings.我可不想被掠夺被破坏啊。\\n而且，我只会站在自己中意的家伙身边哦。: I'd rather not be plundered or destroyed.\nBesides, I only side with people I like.
strings.我升级了卡西瓦尔斯的数据，\\n制作出了这些新机型。\\n别把它们和刚才的老家伙: I upgraded Käsivars's data\nand built these new models.\nDon't compare them to those old relics.
strings.抵抗也是无用的。\\n其他据点也配备了同样的数量。\\n你们的伙伴绝对不会来。: Resistance is futile.\nOur other bases have just as many.\nYour friends will never come.
strings.哎呀……这种感觉真不错。\\n我一直都很想试试看呢！: Wow... That felt amazing.\nI've always wanted to try that!
strings.能请你乖乖投降吗？\\n再抵抗也是没用——: Will you surrender quietly?\nResisting any more is pointless—
strings.是我们输了。\\n赶紧把我们交给卡西瓦尔斯吧。: We lose.\nHurry up and hand us over to Käsivars.
strings.清除也好解体也好，都随你们便。\\n如果要我资料都交出来，不如……: Purge us or dismantle us, do as you like.\nIf you want me to hand over the data, I'd rather...
strings.真是的，你怎么这么死板。\\n亏你这样还想追求浪漫啊？: Geez, you're so stiff.\nAnd you call yourself a dreamer?
strings.你们最想要的！\\n就是“吃饭功能”吧？\\n区区那种东西，给就给了！: What you want most!\nIs the "eating function," right?\nSomething like that, you can just have!
strings.什……什么？！\\n你在说什么！！！: Wh... What?!\nWhat are you talking about!!!
strings.话说，这有什么好隐瞒的~？\\n你们不就是想吃饭嘛？: I mean, what's there to hide~?\nYou just want to eat, right?
strings.委托人表示，她愿意为你们提供技术。\\n没想到你们没来谈判，却用了这种方式。: The client said she's willing to provide you the tech.\nWe didn't expect you to skip negotiating\nand do it like this.
strings.正是为了追踪非法侵入路径，\\n方便让我们来解除你们的武装，\\n她才故意让你们: She deliberately let you hack her workshop\nso we could trace your intrusion route\nand come disarm you.
strings.总之，人生最重要的是坦率！\\n不用在乎钱，哪怕先欠着，\\n也要说出我想吃你做: Anyway, the most important thing in life is honesty!\nForget the money—even if it goes on your tab,\nyou've gotta say "I want to eat your cooking!"
strings.你、你们骗人！\\n她怎么可能轻易将技术给我们……: Y-You're lying!\nThere's no way she'd just give us that tech...
strings.那、那可是要将异物纳入体内，\\n给脑神经乃至于全身刺激的\\n破坏性的功能啊！: Th-That's a destructive function that takes\nforeign matter into the body and stimulates\nthe brain's nerves and the entire system! Something like that—
strings.那不是破坏。\\n是创造新的世界啊！: That's not destruction.\nIt's creating a whole new world!
strings.我们吃东西不仅是为了摄取营养，\\n而是填饱肚子，享受那种味道。\\n不同的料理: We don't eat just to get nutrients.\nWe eat to fill our bellies and enjoy the taste.\nDifferent dishes bring people different kinds of happiness!
strings.尤其是咖喱。咖喱可厉害了。\\n越了解越能发现乐趣，非常刺激，\\n其中的细节真: Especially curry. Curry's amazing.\nThe more you know, the more fun it gets. So exciting.\nThere are honestly countless details to it—
strings.这是……轰炸？\\n难道是敌人的增援——: Is that... a bombing?\nCould it be enemy reinforcements—
strings.啊，糟了，忘记了。\\n我前面往周围都扔了定时炸弹呢！: Ah, crap, I forgot.\nI threw time bombs all over the place earlier!
strings.委托人不是说“把基地轰烂也没事”吗？\\n所以我想给他们来一发大的！: The client said "It's fine if you blow up the base," right?\nSo I figured I'd give 'em a big one!
strings.你这种性格真的是！\\n赶紧离开这里吧！: Your personality, I swear!\nLet's get out of here, now!
strings.你、你们到底想怎样啊……: Wh-What do you people even want...
strings.我很期待能和你们一起吃饭哦！: I'm looking forward to eating with you!
strings.总之，总能找到办法的！\\n明天一定也能立刻有趣起来！: Anyway, we'll figure something out!\nTomorrow's bound to get fun right away too!
strings.然后，听说他们准备先做点\\n能让机人食用的广告食品出来，\\n现在正铆足了劲开: And then, I heard they're starting with\npromotional food that machines can eat,\nand they're developing it like crazy right now!
strings.我也试吃了一下，真的超好吃啊！\\n不过，因为是机人专用的食物，\\n让我的消化: I tried some, and it was super tasty!\nBut since it's food for machines only,\nmy digestive function crashed for a while!
strings.呃，我可以把这个当笑话听吗……: Uh, am I supposed to laugh at that...
strings.不过，果然还是阿尔克做的最好吃~！\\n风味完全不一样啊，风味上！: Still, Alk's cooking is the best after all~!\nThe flavor's totally different, the flavor!
strings.是是是。\\n就算被奉承我也不会让你赊账哦。: Yeah, yeah.\nFlattery won't get you a tab.
strings.我才没在奉承你呢！\\n不过偶尔还是想赊个账啦——: I'm not flattering you!\nThough I do want a tab once in a while—
strings.对了！\\n以后把你的店开去其他世界吧！\\n做成环世界连锁店！: I know!\nLet's open your shop in other worlds!\nAn inter-world restaurant chain!
strings.我来当老板，\\n阿尔克就负责掌勺和管理！: I'll be the owner,\nand Alk can handle the cooking and management!
strings.那我绝对会过劳的吧？\\n只有你既轻松又能拿钱吧？？？: I'd totally be worked to death, wouldn't I?\nYou'd be the only one taking it easy and getting paid???
strings.没事没事！\\n毕竟是我们俩嘛！: It's fine, it's fine!\nIt's the two of us, after all!
strings.他们就那样。不也挺好的吗？: That's just how they are. Isn't it nice?
strings.但是，我就只能这么做了啊……: But this is all I can do...
strings.到此为止了，咏星者卡佩拉。\\n不管你造出多少诅咒之剑——: It ends here, Capella of the Star Augurs.\nNo matter how many cursed swords you make—
strings.我们都定会无数次斩断它！: We'll cut them down, again and again!
strings.嗯……我也想是啊……\\n所以，我就只能出此下策了……: Hmm... I'd like to think so too...\nWhich is why I have no choice but this...
strings.这就是我的最终计划。\\n永别了，诸位。: This is my final plan.\nFarewell, everyone.
strings.那人只有一块冥龙的碎片……\\n和原型样本没有任何关系的她\\n是无法穿越深渊与: She only has a single fragment of the Dragon of Darkness...\nHaving nothing to do with the prototype sample,\nshe can't cross the abyss and the void...
strings.但是，我能明白。\\n那个人只能做出“这种”选择啊……: But I understand.\nThat person could only choose "this"...
strings.对不起，珂艾特……\\n我要去。让我去吧。: Sorry, Couette...\nI'm going. Let me go.
strings.我想明白了。\\n我还有事要想要告诉她——\\n还有事想要和她说啊！: I've figured it out.\nThere's still something I want to tell her—\nsomething I want to say to her!
strings.这次轮到我们来帮忙了。\\n那时候……真是对不住啊？: This time it's our turn to help.\nBack then... I'm really sorry, okay?
strings.你在干什么呢？\\n你也要去的吧？: What are you doing?\nYou're coming too, right?
strings.不对……应该这么说——: No... I should put it this way—
strings.这次轮到我来保护你了！: This time, it's my turn to protect you!
strings.到极限了吗……\\n不过，能走多远走多远吧。\\n阿鲁玛……: Is this the limit...\nStill, I'll go as far as I can.\nArma...
strings.追到这里来了吗……\\n也是，你们确实有这样的力量……: You followed me all the way here...\nWell, you certainly do have that kind of power...
strings.冥龙……不，“阿鲁玛”，\\n我看到了你的记忆。: Dragon of Darkness... No, "Arma."\nI saw your memories.
