strings.唔……话说回来，\\n我们为什么要做这些呢？: Hmm... Come to think of it,\nwhy are we doing all this?
strings.哪有为什么。你不是说\\n“还不知道自己能做什么”吗？: What do you mean, why? Didn't you say\n"I still don't know what I can do"?
strings.但我们付得起钱，也能喝酒。\\n只要诺瓦也有翅膀，大家就都能当职业了！\\n我们: But we can pay, and we can drink.\nAs long as Nova has wings too, we can all go pro!\nWe can do anything!
strings.来，试试看吧？\\n这就是变形式机翼外装的体验版！: Here, give it a try!\nThis is the trial version of the transforming wing gear!
strings.哇？！哇……\\n好厉害……太厉害了！\\n原来能像这样在天上飞啊！: Whoa?! Whoa...\nAmazing... This is amazing!\nSo this is what flying through the sky is like!
strings.什么啊，\\n原来你只是想拉着诺瓦一起玩吗？: What,\nso you just wanted to drag Nova along to play?
strings.噢噢！也许是吧？\\n做自己想做的事才最爽快嘛！: Ooh! Maybe so?\nDoing what you wanna do feels the best, after all!
strings.别哭丧着脸啊，搭档！\\n你身边可是有神速射手，\\n还有料理和迷宫的英雄呢。: Don't look so glum, partner!\nYou've got a lightning-fast gunner by your side,\nplus a hero of cooking and labyrinths.
strings.更何况，你是最最最最喜欢朋友\\n和帕尔佩布拉和松饼和欧姆蛋的帅哥啊！: And besides, you're a cool guy who loves loves LOVES\nhis friends, Palpebra, pancakes and omelets!
strings.如果加上职业选手和会飞，\\n不就更加帅气了吗？\\n所以，多笑笑嘛！: Add pro racer and flying to that,\nand you'd be even cooler, right?\nSo smile more!
strings.你这家伙根本只会靠气势做加法啊~\\n不过我倒不讨厌这点啦！: You just keep piling stuff on with sheer momentum~\nNot that I hate that about you!
strings.那我们也装上翅膀去当职业吧？\\n来一起做英雄兼职业选手吧？？？: Then should we get wings and go pro too?\nLet's be heroes AND pro racers together???
strings.很好！你说了吧？是你说的啊？\\n那就一起走吧，踏上赏金王之路！: Great! You said it, right? You said it!\nThen let's go together, on the road to becoming bounty kings!
strings.那我就用和塔吉斯一样的机翼吧。\\n氮气什么的听起来就很帅呢！: Then I'll get the same wings as Teurgis.\nNitro and stuff sounds so cool!
strings.太棒了！\\n让我们一起翱翔世界吧！: Awesome!\nLet's soar across the world together!
strings.我决定了，还是不当职业选手了！: I've decided, I'm not going pro after all!
strings.我也不去了。\\n机翼手术也取消了！: Me neither.\nI'm canceling the wing surgery too!
strings.太快了吧！\\n怎么才过一天就成这样了？？: That was fast!\nHow'd it come to this in just one day??
strings.但是啊~要装机翼的话，\\n好像得做很可怕的神经手术才行！\\n光是想想就觉得后: But see~ to get wings installed,\napparently you need some scary nerve surgery!\nJust thinking about it sends chills down my spine!
strings.他们说想要一个专职的职业选手~\\n但我怎么能舍弃超一流麻烦射手的名号呢。\\n: They said they wanted a full-time pro~\nbut how could I give up my title as top-class troublemaking gunner?\nSo I turned 'em down!
strings.哈哈哈。\\n你们两个果然是老样子呢。: Hahaha.\nYou two are the same as ever.
strings.不过，也有那种穿戴式的机翼呢！\\n虽然价格不低，但也更加安全！\\n所以——: Still, there are wearable wings too!\nThey're not cheap, but they're way safer!\nSo—
strings.我找了一堆看起来能\\n一发赚大钱的工作！\\n和我一起上吧，搭档们！: I found a ton of jobs that look like\nthey'll make us rich in one shot!\nCome with me, partners!
strings.感觉那样只会让你的\\n赔偿金和债务变多啊~……: Feels like that'll just pile on\nmore compensation and debt for you~...
strings.但是……总能有办法的吧？: But... we'll figure something out, right?
strings.当然！\\n我们一定能有办法的！: Of course!\nWe'll definitely figure something out!
strings.这下实在是……\\n有点糟糕啊……: Now this is...\na bit of a problem...
strings.还没有画出这粒沙啊——: I still haven't painted this grain of sand—
strings.喂！老爷子！你没事吧！\\n快回答我啊！喂！: Hey! Old man! Are you okay?!\nAnswer me! Hey!
strings.哎呀~真是帮大忙了！\\n没想到竟然能在沙漠中\\n遇到星见镇的人！: Ahh~ You really saved me!\nWho'd have thought I'd run into\npeople from Starview in the desert!
strings.我们发现你的时候，\\n你就只剩一口气了啊……\\n实在是你运气好啊，老爷子。: When we found you,\nyou were on your last breath...\nYou're a lucky one, old man.
strings.唔，我也没打算小瞧沙漠。\\n但这里实在比想象中惊人得多啊？: Well, I didn't plan on underestimating the desert.\nBut it's far more astonishing than I imagined, eh?
strings.不过，来这趟真是值了。\\n这种一望无际的沙漠，\\n在我的世界根本想画也画不出: Still, this trip was worth it.\nA desert stretching as far as the eye can see—\nI couldn't paint that in my world even if I wanted to.
strings.噢噢……这就是画狂老人Z的作品吗！\\n我虽然没有经手过美术品，\\n但也能看出: Ooh... So this is a work by Gramp Zigza!\nI've never dealt in art myself,\nbut even I can tell this painting is something special.
strings.在这个世界，画根本卖不出去啊？\\n拜这所赐，我筹路费都很辛苦呢。: In this world, paintings don't sell at all, see?\nThanks to that, I've had a hard time scraping up travel money.
strings.这……这也没办法。\\n美术品在这里是高级货。\\n只有和王族亲近的大商人才弄得: Well... that can't be helped.\nArt is a luxury here.\nOnly big merchants close to the royals can get their hands on it.
strings.这个世界难道没有大众艺术吗？: Doesn't this world have any popular art?
strings.并非完全没有……\\n但很少会成为商品呢。\\n尤其是画作。: It's not that there's none...\nbut it rarely becomes merchandise.\nEspecially paintings.
strings.我也顶多只有小时候\\n在墙上涂鸦的经历……: All I ever did was scribble\non walls as a kid...
strings.所以，等我们的事业有了成效，\\n边境的人们也有享受艺术的精力时，\\n能请您再: So once our business takes off,\nand people on the frontier have the energy to enjoy art,\nwould you come back here again?
strings.好啊，你们很有意思啊。\\n以你们为题材画一幅似乎也不错呢！: Sure, you lot are interesting.\nMaybe I'll paint you as my subject!
strings.当然，绝对把你画成一等一的男子汉！: Of course, I'll paint you as a first-rate man!
strings.话说回来，既然有涂鸦的经历，\\n那你也来画画看吧。\\n我想见识见识这个世界的: By the way, since you've scribbled before,\nwhy don't you try painting too?\nI'd like to see this world's art.
strings.诶诶……我是彻头彻尾的外行啊？\\n你可别太期待我哦。: Huh... I'm a total amateur, you know?\nDon't expect too much.
strings.你直接说很烂就行了！\\n不用在这种时候顾虑我！: Just say it's bad!\nYou don't have to spare my feelings now!
strings.想让我再画多少都没问题！\\n那边的！你想让我画什么呢！: I'll paint as many as you want!\nYou there! What would you like me to paint!
strings.我、我吗？！\\n可、可是，这要很多钱吧……: M-Me?!\nB-But that must cost a lot...
strings.呵，不用！\\n我和卖艺的不一样。\\n我的把戏不需要钱。: Heh, no need!\nI'm not like those street performers.\nMy tricks don't cost a thing.
strings.接下来轮到你了，\\n你有什么想看的？: Now it's your turn.\nWhat would you like to see?
strings.Z阁下。\\n你过得不错啊。: Mr. Z.\nYou seem to be doing well.
strings.哎呀，不好意思！\\n我的投资人来了！\\n今天就先到这儿！下回见！: Oh, sorry about this!\nMy investor's here!\nThat's all for today! See you next time!
strings.像这样把绘画当作表演……\\n真的好吗？: Is it really okay\nto turn painting into a show like this?
strings.我的画才没有那么高尚呢！\\n我可是大众画家啊，\\n最重要的是画出让客人开心的: My paintings aren't that highbrow!\nI'm a painter for the people, you know.\nWhat matters most is painting things that make folks happy.
strings.话说回来，怎么了？\\n找我有什么事吗？: Anyway, what is it?\nDo you need me for something?
strings.抱歉啊，那些把戏倒无所谓，\\n但画是用来卖的啊。\\n想要的话就得掏钱！: Sorry, the tricks are one thing,\nbut the paintings are for sale.\nIf you want one, you'll have to pay!
strings.为什么要偷画呢？\\n这也卖不出大价钱呀。: Why would you steal a painting?\nIt's not like it'd sell for much.
strings.还是说……你只是想要？: Or... did you just want it?
strings.我、我才不要呢！\\n画这种东西——: I-I don't want it!\nPaintings are just—
strings.填不饱肚子，也挡不了风雨。\\n顶多只能在冬天拿来当柴烧。: They don't fill your belly or keep off the rain.\nAt best you can burn 'em for firewood in winter.
strings.呵呵，嘴巴不饶人的家伙\\n基本都会这么说。\\n不过，确实也没错。: Heh heh, the sharp-tongued ones\npretty much always say that.\nStill, you're not wrong.
strings.真拿你没办法！\\n喂，稍微等一下！\\n别逃跑啊！: You're hopeless!\nHey, wait a sec!\nDon't run off!
strings.既然这么想要，\\n就自己画画看吧！\\n方法都在这上面了！: If you want one so badly,\ntry painting one yourself!\nEverything you need to know is in here!
strings.这叫画帖。\\n是用来练习绘画的……\\n倒也不是秘传书之类夸张的东西。: It's called a sketchbook.\nIt's for practicing drawing...\nNothing so grand as a book of secret techniques.
strings.等一下，\\n这上面记载的不只有画——: Wait,\nthere's more than just pictures in here—
strings.制图也好测量也好织物的设计也好，\\n都是绘画的一环啊。\\n记录和传承也是画的: Mapmaking, surveying, textile design—\nthey're all part of painting.\nRecording and passing things on is one of art's jobs too.
strings.听好了，首先，\\n画画只是游戏这种想法大错特错。\\n这可是能拿来吃饭的工具啊: Listen up. First of all,\nthinking painting is just a game is dead wrong.\nIt's a tool you can make a living with, see?
strings.那、那个，Z先生，\\n你难道在教他画画吗？: U-Um, Mr. Z,\nare you teaching him to paint?
strings.怎么，你也感兴趣？\\n那来吧，过来这边！: What, you're interested too?\nThen come on, over here!
strings.对了，拉绮夏也来试试吧？\\n难得你有支那么厉害的笔！\\n学学也没坏处啊？: Oh right, Rakisha, why don't you try too?\nYou've got such an amazing brush!\nIt can't hurt to learn, right?
strings.我的笔并非画笔……\\n不过好吧，呵呵，机会难得嘛。: My brush isn't for painting...\nBut very well, heh heh, it's a rare opportunity.
strings.没想到最后还借助了您的力量\\n为大家启蒙了艺术啊……: Who'd have thought we'd end up borrowing your help\nto introduce everyone to art...
strings.无妨无妨！\\n只是我自己忍不住想教而已！: Not at all, not at all!\nI just couldn't help wanting to teach!
strings.结果村里真的流行起画画了。\\n老爷子实在是太厉害了啊。: And painting really caught on in the village.\nYou're something else, old man.
strings.你也来试试吗？\\n拿来放松还挺有趣的哦。: Want to give it a try?\nIt's pretty fun for unwinding.
strings.算了算了，我还是更想当鉴赏家！: Nah, nah, I'd rather be a connoisseur!
strings.是吗？\\n我也很喜欢你那别具风味的画哦？: Is that so?\nI quite like your charming paintings, though.
strings.别说了别说了！\\n您这样认真夸我也太恶劣了吧！: Stop, stop!\nPraising me that sincerely is just cruel!
strings.等下次见面有机会再说吧……\\n您可别再昏倒在沙漠里了？: Let's talk again next time we meet...\nAnd don't go collapsing in the desert again, okay?
strings.嗯。多谢你们照顾！\\n回见！: Right. Thanks for taking care of me!\nSee you!
strings.你们怎么还能追到这里来？！\\n这次又怎么了？: How did you manage to follow me all the way here?!\nWhat is it this time?
strings.是这样的，\\n稻穗小姐说什么也想\\n请画狂老人阁下画画……: Well, you see,\nMiss Inaho absolutely insists\non having Master Zigza paint for her...
strings.好像是新的妖怪剧的分镜？\\n她说想请你来画那个呢。\\n所以我们跑遍了各个世界: Storyboards for a new yokai play, I think?\nShe wants you to draw them.\nSo we've been running all over every world looking for you!
strings.好吧……\\n该久违地认真画一下了！\\n走了，你们两个！: All right...\nTime to get serious about painting for once!\nLet's go, you two!
strings.对了，你都在这里遇到了什么？: By the way, what happened to you out here?
strings.嗯？这个嘛……久违地收了徒弟呢。\\n是个和你们俩很不一样的画师——: Hm? Well... I took on an apprentice for the first time in ages.\nA painter quite unlike you two—
strings.诶？！\\n影、影丘同学要去《观察》工作了？！: Huh?!\nK-Kageoka, you're going to work at Observer?!
strings.还没定下来呢。\\n只是你妈妈说编辑部人手不够之类——: It's not decided yet.\nYour mom just said the editorial team is short-handed or something—
strings.所以为什么我会在这里啊……\\n虽然也无所谓了……: So why am I even here...\nNot that it matters...
strings.哎呀，是这样啊。\\n难怪你能和妈妈说上话……\\n原来你们在一个地方工作……: Oh, so that's how it is.\nNo wonder you could talk to my mom...\nYou work at the same place...
strings.不算吧，只是说如果我想去就去……\\n反正我们都毕业了，\\n而且那里也不需要经: Not really. She just said I could come if I wanted...\nWe've both graduated anyway,\nand they don't need parental permission there—
strings.咦，但影丘的爸爸也醒了吧？\\n我记得和我老爸是差不多时间醒的。: Huh, but your dad woke up too, right, Kageoka?\nI remember he woke up around the same time as my old man.
strings.嗯……好像是吧。\\n但我也没去见过他。: Yeah... I guess so.\nBut I haven't gone to see him.
strings.这样吗？\\n他也没来找过你吗？\\n问问你今后的打算之类的。: Really?\nHe hasn't come looking for you either?\nTo ask what you plan to do from now on or whatever.
strings.随便吧。\\n那种家伙只会按自己心情否定对方，\\n让别人成为他自我良好感觉的佐: Whatever.\nA guy like that just shoots people down on a whim\nand uses them to season his own self-satisfaction—
strings.我根本没道理再被他左右。\\n那家伙和你的父母完全不一样啊。: There's no reason I should let him jerk me around anymore.\nHe's nothing like your parents.
strings.诶，怎么回事，\\n影丘的老爸比歼灭者还吓人吗？: Huh, what's that mean?\nIs your dad scarier than a Purger, Kageoka?
strings.哈？\\n不算吧……他只是个很垃圾的人罢了。: Huh?\nNot really... He's just a garbage person.
strings.那不是很轻松就能对付嘛？\\n你可是影丘啊。: Then isn't he easy to deal with?\nYou're Kageoka, after all.
strings.我也不太懂啦。\\n但可以不见面的话，不也挺好吗？\\n我家也只有我爸，但也过得: I don't really get it.\nBut if you don't have to see him, isn't that fine?\nMy family's just me and my dad, and we get by.
strings.谁管你啊……\\n话说，你的面要坨了哦。: Who asked you...\nAnyway, your noodles are getting soggy.
strings.唉……累死了。\\n就该早点结束话题的……: Ugh... I'm beat.\nShould've ended that conversation sooner...
strings.事到如今，就算想做什么……\\n也根本就——: At this point, even if I wanted to do something...\nthere's just no—
strings.咦~？这不是龙一嘛！\\n真是太巧了~~！: Huh~? If it isn't Ryuichi!\nWhat a coincidence~~!
strings.你是海之家的——\\n呃，酒味好重……\\n你到底喝了多少啊？: You're the guy from the beach house—\nUgh, you reek of booze...\nJust how much have you had?
strings.今天就放他一马吧。\\n他好像……又没能和父亲和解。: Go easy on him today.\nIt seems he... couldn't make up with his father again.
strings.啊哈哈，\\n老爸很不满意我出来经营海之家~\\n我们吵了一次以后，就一直没能和: Ahaha,\nmy old man's really unhappy that I left to run a beach house~\nWe had a fight once, and we've never made up since.
strings.嘿嘿……我老爸真的超吓人的，\\n到现在还会来我店里找茬呢。\\n我明明是那么努: Heh heh... My old man is super scary,\nhe still comes to my shop to pick fights.\nEven though I've been trying so hard...
strings.不过，我是不会放弃的！\\n因为我很美丽啊！\\n我一定要让老爸认可我——: But I won't give up!\nBecause I'm beautiful!\nI'll definitely make my old man accept me—
strings.你是不是傻啊……\\n算了，反正也和我没关系。: Are you an idiot...\nWhatever, it's got nothing to do with me.
strings.小孩子过家家搞得有多厉害似的。\\n给我动手。: Kids playing house like it's some big deal.\nGet to work.
strings.真是没品味的找茬方式啊。\\n我还以为你们有更聪明的做法呢。: What a tasteless way to pick a fight.\nI thought you had a smarter way of doing things.
strings.你也是我儿子的朋友吗……\\n怎么每个人都这样……: You're my son's friend too...\nWhy is everyone like this...
strings.都以为只要摆摆架子就真能“成功”\\n为什么非得逼我让你们明白呢？: You all think putting on airs means you've "made it."\nWhy do I have to force you to understand?
strings.是啊……我也想问为什么。: Yeah... I'd like to know why too.
strings.你的儿子明明那么拼命，\\n像个白痴一样想原谅你——: Your son tries so desperately,\nlike an idiot, to forgive you—
strings.为什么你连这种事都不明白？: So why can't you understand even that?
strings.蠢货不管做什么都是没用的。\\n连自己被利用了都不知道——: Fools are useless no matter what they do.\nThey don't even know they're being used—
strings.所以你根本不明白啊。\\n我才更了解你的儿子，难道不是吗？: That's why you don't get it at all.\nI understand your son better than you, don't I?
strings.呃，倒也不需要你们出手啊……: Uh, we didn't really need you to step in...
strings.他就交给我了。\\n这次我一定会让他变得美丽。: Leave him to me.\nThis time I'll make him beautiful for sure.
strings.只要把他们随便扔到路边就行了吧——\\n为什么我要做这种事啊……: We could just dump them by the side of the road—\nWhy do I have to do this...
strings.我之前以为，\\n龙一一定对斯考特的父亲很生气。: I thought for sure\nRyuichi was angry at Scott's father.
strings.嗯……是啊。\\n我一定是……: Yeah... I guess.\nI must have been...
strings.嗯，嗯。我明白，斯考特。\\n如果我也能有机会好好面对父亲，\\n好好和他聊一聊: Mm, mm. I get it, Scott.\nIf only I'd had the chance to face my father\nand have a proper talk with him...
strings.为什么醉鬼变多了啊……\\n喂，别在这里睡——: Why are there more drunks now...\nHey, don't sleep here—
strings.嘿嘿……我、一定……\\n一定要和老爸和好……\\n一定要让他原谅我，然后~……: Heh heh... I'll... definitely...\ndefinitely make up with my old man...\nI'll make him forgive me, and then~...
strings.也没那个必要吧……\\n不需要得到原谅……\\n也不需要去原谅他。: There's no need for that...\nYou don't need to be forgiven...\nand you don't need to forgive him.
strings.不管你如何改变，\\n让你火大的事情都不会消失。: No matter how much you change,\nthe things that piss you off won't go away.
strings.既然如此……只要保持距离就好吧。\\n好好正视你不想失去的东西就行了。: So... just keep your distance.\nLook properly at the things you don't want to lose.
strings.我也……打算这么做。\\n虽然……这不关我的事啦。: That's what... I plan to do too.\nNot that... it's any of my business.
strings.龙一~~……\\n你真的是我的朋友！死党！！！\\n谢谢你~~！！！！: Ryuichiii~~...\nYou really are my friend! My best friend!!!\nThank youuu~~!!!!
strings.完全搞不懂啊，好恶心！\\n放手啊你……力气好大！: I don't get it at all, gross!\nLet go of me... You're so strong!
strings.你真的成了一名优秀的青年啊……\\n你刚来星见镇的时候，\\n我们别提多担心了，: You've really grown into a fine young man...\nWhen you first came to Starview,\nwe were so worried, and Nimbus too—
strings.龙一！你去哪儿了啊？\\n我有好多事想和你说呢！: Ryuichi! Where did you go?\nThere's so much I want to tell you!
strings.秘密。\\n不管你怎么求我都不会说的。: It's a secret.\nI won't tell you no matter how much you beg.
strings.你最近在做什么？: What have you been up to lately?
strings.我、我去帕尔佩布拉一个\\n叫《观察》的杂志编辑部工作了。\\n虽然暂时还只是兼: I-I've been working at the editorial office\nof a magazine in Palpebra called Observer.\nIt's just part-time for now, though...
strings.度假回来以后，我去找了我爸。\\n他跟我说了一大通，\\n但我说我已经不需要他照: After I got back from vacation, I went to see my dad.\nHe lectured me about all sorts of things,\nbut I told him I don't need him looking after me anymore—
strings.度、度假也不是我自己想去的！\\n是伊野里他非拉着我……: I-It's not like I wanted to go on vacation!\nInori dragged me along...
strings.这样啊。\\n下次记得叫上我啊？: I see.\nInvite me next time, okay?
strings.你终于回来了啊……\\n走吧，去图书室。\\n我上次说了吧？书上有我看不懂的字。: You're finally back...\nLet's go to the library.\nI told you last time, right? There are words in a book I can't read.
strings.龙一！你下定决心与我一同旅行了吗！\\n如果你需要的话，\\n我愿意再把迄今的旅: Ryuichi! Have you made up your mind to travel with me?!\nIf you wish,\nI'll tell you all the stories of my travels once more!
strings.我早都拒绝过你们了吧！\\n你们这群人真是烦啊——: I already turned you all down!\nYou people are such a pain—
strings.塔吉斯从来没来过这家店。\\n一次都没有啊。: Teurgis hasn't come to this shop.\nNot even once.
strings.不会吧？！那可是骗吃骗喝\\n四天王之一的塔吉斯啊！: No way?! He's one of the Four Heavenly Kings\nof eating on credit!
strings.他终于还是被债主沉进海里了？！\\n亏我还想向他推销阿尔克的假签名，\\n给他当: Did his creditors finally sink him in the sea?!\nAnd here I was hoping to sell him a fake Alk signature\nto use as a joint guarantor!
strings.你真是开不起玩笑啊~\\n那毕竟是塔吉斯啊，\\n只要吹个口哨就会唰地一下出现了: You can't take a joke, can you~\nIt's Teurgis, after all.\nJust whistle and he'll pop right up, right?
strings.诶~\\n不过他不来也好，\\n我也乐得安宁……: Eh~\nWell, it's fine if he doesn't come.\nI get some peace and quiet...
strings.而且，要我主动去找他，\\n总感觉有点让人不爽——: Besides, going looking for him myself\nwould just feel kinda annoying—
strings.哎呀……一定是我听错——: Oh dear... I must be hearing things—
strings.让你们久等了！\\n我来啦！: Sorry to keep you waiting!\nI'm here!
strings.哟，阿尔克！\\n来一碗大份特制咖喱！\\n钱先记在账上哦！: Yo, Alk!\nOne large special curry!\nPut it on my tab!
strings.哈——太好吃了！\\n阿尔克，你的手艺更好了吧~？: Haaah—that was so good!\nAlk, your cooking's gotten even better, huh~?
strings.这个嘛……毕竟我从帕尔菲\\n和咖喱的师父那里学了很多，\\n还认真研究了香料—: Well... I learned a lot from Parfait\nand my curry master,\nand I've been seriously studying spices—
strings.不行，做不到……\\n好想无视……但根本不行啊！: No, I can't do it...\nI want to ignore it... but I just can't!
strings.你的身体是怎么了！\\n和之前也差太多了吧？？？: What happened to your body!\nIt's totally different from before???
strings.很棒吧？！\\n这套机翼外装很帅吧？！: Awesome, right?!\nThis wing gear is so cool, right?!
strings.呜哇？！\\n这可是名牌货啊！\\n是超火的那款！天呐！: Whoa?!\nThat's designer stuff!\nThe super hot model! Oh my god!
strings.呵呵呵，完全没错！\\n它能最大限度削减空气阻力！\\n装载了重新流行的氮气等离: Heh heh heh, exactly right!\nIt cuts air resistance to the max!\nAnd it's loaded with the newly trendy nitro plasma engine—
strings.还有，你们看这最新的机械眼！\\n想变成什么帅气的颜色都没问题！\\n清理高层建: And look at these brand-new mech eyes!\nThey can turn any cool color I want!\nClearing high-rise districts is a piece of cake!
strings.好强——太棒了，真好啊~~！\\n诶，可以拍照吗？！可以传到网上吗？！: So strong—so awesome, so good~~!\nHey, can I take a picture?! Can I post it online?!
strings.你、你真的没事吗？\\n亏你能活下来啊！: A-Are you really okay?\nI'm amazed you survived!
strings.那、那是要完全改造脊椎\\n和眼睛的神经手术吧？！\\n听说做完得痛几个月，脑子: Th-That's nerve surgery that completely remodels\nyour spine and eyes, right?!\nI heard it hurts for months and fries your brain...
strings.啊！确实呢！真的超可怕！\\n痛得我都要吐了——\\n不过我靠喝酒睡觉熬过来了呢: Ah! Totally! It was super scary!\nIt hurt so bad I almost threw up—\nbut I got through it by drinking and sleeping!
strings.诶、诶诶……怎么回事……\\n所以你一直没来这家店……\\n是因为痛得根本起不来: H-Huh... what's going on...\nSo the reason you never came to the shop...\nwas because it hurt too much to get up???
strings.嘿嘿。不过，那样也值得！\\n这下我就不会输给阿尔克了！: Heh heh. But it was worth it!\nNow I won't lose to Alk!
strings.就是那个啦，你的翅膀！\\n你变身以后不是会长出翅膀吗？: You know, your wings!\nYou grow wings when you transform, right?
strings.而且，我都看到了。\\n你在帕尔佩布拉的闹市区变身，\\n来了个超大亮相不是吗！: Plus, I saw it.\nYou transformed in Palpebra's downtown\nand made a huge entrance, didn't you!
strings.啊，那次是吧。\\n喝完酒回去帮了被缠住的女孩子，\\n来了个根本没意义的变身。: Ah, that time.\nOn my way home from drinking I helped a girl who was being harassed,\nand transformed for no reason at all.
strings.啊……就是那个有点\\n像雷拉斯感觉的传闻……: Ah... That rumor that sounded\nkind of like Reylas...
strings.别说了！！！\\n我根本不记得有那种事啊！: Stop it!!!\nI don't remember anything like that!
strings.所以，我才下定了决心。\\n我也一定要有双翅膀才行！: So, I made up my mind.\nI had to get wings too!
strings.是啊！\\n我把赚到的钱全用在这上面了！: Yep!\nI spent all the money I made on these!
strings.呜哇……好可怕……竟然……\\n但是，不过……但这真的——: Whoa... That's scary... I can't believe...\nBut, still... this is really—
strings.那现在赶紧去飞一趟吧！\\n我好想快点和阿尔克一起翱翔啊~！: Then let's go fly right now!\nI can't wait to soar with Alk~!
strings.你就去吧，阿尔克！\\n毕竟我之前突然离开了那么久，\\n给你添了很多麻烦嘛！: Go on, Alk!\nI did suddenly leave for a long time before,\nand caused you a lot of trouble!
strings.那个与其说是突然，\\n不如说是先斩后奏啊……: That wasn't so much sudden\nas doing it first and telling me after...
strings.等下！别说完就走啊！\\n我绝对不会帮你付的啊！: Wait! Don't just say that and leave!\nI'm definitely not paying for you!
strings.呼——飞得好爽！\\n喉咙都干了，来喝酒吧！: Whew—that was an awesome flight!\nMy throat's all dry, let's drink!
strings.诶诶，刚飞完马上喝绝对会上头的——: Whoa, whoa, drinking right after flying will totally go to your head—
strings.阿尔克？！你、你没事吧？！\\n难道是晕机了？！: Alk?! A-Are you okay?!\nAre you airsick?!
strings.啊，没事没事。\\n怎么说呢，变身结束以后，\\n总会有种脱力的感觉。: Ah, I'm fine, I'm fine.\nHow do I put it... After a transformation ends,\nI always feel kind of drained.
strings.哈？！那你怎么不早点说！\\n吓死我了……真的没大碍吧？: Huh?! Then why didn't you say so sooner!\nYou scared me... Are you really okay?
strings.哎呀，应该没问题的。\\n我也不知道。但反正很开心嘛。: Eh, I should be fine.\nNot sure. But anyway, it was fun.
strings.这样吗！\\n那我也一起睡了！: Is that so!\nThen I'll take a nap too!
strings.对了，明天去哪儿？\\n听说旧矿山城也很有趣，\\n但我又好想去法兰德观光啊！: Oh yeah, where should we go tomorrow?\nI heard Miner's Front is fun,\nbut I really wanna go sightseeing in the Farlands too!
strings.我都不用猜，\\n你肯定想让我请长假吧？: I don't even have to guess.\nYou want me to take a long vacation, right?
strings.总是埋头工作也不好吧~？\\n赶紧请带薪假！带薪假！\\n和我好好玩一圈放松一下: Working nonstop isn't good for you either~?\nTake your paid leave already! Paid leave!\nCome have fun and relax with me!
strings.反正你绝对想让我掏钱吧。\\n你不是说你已经把钱花完了吗？: You're definitely going to make me pay anyway.\nDidn't you say you'd already spent all your money?
strings.？？？不用客气？\\n你的意思是能给我花钱很开心？: ??? You're welcome?\nYou mean you're happy to spend money on me?
strings.完全不是啊。\\n拜托你自己解决财政问题。: Not at all.\nPlease sort out your own finances.
strings.说老实话，那对翅膀也太棒了。\\n你绝对还借了钱吧？: Honestly, those wings are incredible.\nYou definitely borrowed money too, didn't you?
strings.呵，那还用说吗？\\n制作费和手术费都还等着我还呢！: Heh, need you ask?\nThe build costs and surgery fees are still waiting to be paid back!
strings.这是能一脸得意说出口的话吗……\\n我绝对不会当你的连带保证人啊。: Is that something to say with such a smug face...\nI'm definitely not being your joint guarantor.
strings.没问题的！\\n现在收债人也还在追我呢！: No problem!\nThe debt collectors are still chasing me right now!
strings.发现对象。开始捕获。\\n不论生死，只需回收他的身体。: Target found. Beginning capture.\nDead or alive, only his body need be recovered.
strings.你就这么想把我的身体拿去卖吗？！\\n不过确实能卖出大价钱就是了！: You want to sell my body that badly?!\nThough I guess it would fetch a high price!
strings.那我先回去了！\\n我还要准备明天的咖喱呢！: I'm heading back first!\nI've gotta prepare tomorrow's curry!
strings.喂！那我们的假期呢？！\\n阿尔克？！搭档~~~~？！: Hey! What about our vacation?!\nAlk?! Partner~~~~?!
strings.没事没事。就当是回礼了。\\n毕竟重建的时候你帮了我们很多啊。: It's fine, it's fine. Think of it as a thank-you.\nYou helped us out a lot with the rebuilding.
strings.这是香蕉巧克力味的。诺瓦很喜欢吧？\\n不过最近天凉了，小心别吃坏肚子哦。: This is banana chocolate. You like it, right, Nova?\nIt's getting chilly lately, though, so don't upset your stomach.
strings.谢谢你……\\n下次我还会来帮忙的。: Thank you...\nI'll come help again next time.
strings.嗯，就是第七区。\\n那里不是还没开始重建吗？: Yeah, Sector Seven.\nThey haven't started rebuilding there yet, right?
strings.是啊……那边也很严重。\\n中央区域都恢复生机了，\\n但那里果然还是——: Right... It's bad over there too.\nThe central district's come back to life,\nbut that place still—
strings.欢迎回来，诺瓦。\\n你今天也去帮忙重建了？: Welcome back, Nova.\nWere you helping with the rebuilding again today?
strings.你看起来有点累啊。\\n好好休息也是很重要的。\\n就像我们现在这样。: You look a little tired.\nGetting proper rest is important too.\nLike we're doing right now.
strings.但是，帕尔佩布拉的事\\n就是现在的我能做的事了。: But Palpebra is\nwhat I can do right now.
strings.我想让城镇恢复原样。\\n所以，必须尽自己所能——: I want to restore the city.\nSo I have to do everything I can—
strings.机会难得，我就直说了。\\n那种想法是错误的啊。: Since we have the chance, I'll be blunt.\nThat way of thinking is wrong.
strings.你就是你。是诺瓦，而非雷姆纳。\\n难道不是吗？: You are you. You're Nova, not Remna.\nIsn't that right?
strings.你不知道一切，也不希望悲剧发生。\\n所以，你不需要——\\n不，不应该背负那些: You didn't know everything, and you didn't want the tragedy to happen.\nSo you don't have to—\nNo, you shouldn't carry those sins.
strings.但是，是我把他们——: But I'm the one who made them—
strings.你们这样聊下去就没完没了了。: If you keep talking like this, it'll never end.
strings.想做什么的话，去做就好。\\n这种时候，大人说什么都没用哦？: If you want to do something, just do it.\nAt times like this, nothing grown-ups say will help, you know?
strings.当然，我也能理解你\\n“看不过去”的心情。: Of course, I understand how you feel\nabout "not being able to just watch."
strings.不过啊，诺瓦，\\n那里的人可不会满足于\\n“恢复原样”哦？: But you know, Nova,\nthe people there won't be satisfied\nwith just "restoring" things.
strings.啊……对了。\\n机会难得，要跟我一起去看看嘛？: Ah... That's right.\nSince we're at it, want to come see with me?
strings.各位！\\n欢迎你们今天能聚集于此★\\n那么，就鼓起干劲——: Everyone!\nWelcome to today's gathering★\nNow then, let's get fired up and—
strings.开始第五次“帕尔佩布拉城市开发”\\n意见交流会吧~！: Begin the fifth "Palpebra City Development"\nidea exchange meeting~!
strings.第七区！希望能建设“大厦”！\\n那样一定能容纳更多民居和商社！: Sector Seven! We'd like to build "towers"!\nThat way we could fit more homes and businesses!
strings.还、还有养护设施和疗养设施！\\n今后肯定会在迷宫里找到更多人……: A-And care facilities and sanatoriums too!\nWe're bound to find more people in the labyrinths from now on...
strings.人口增长的话就需要工作吧？\\n马奇安特商会愿意立刻\\n提交建设商业街的方案哦: A growing population needs jobs, right?\nThe Marchant Company is ready to submit\na plan for a shopping district right away!
strings.是为了商讨城镇今后的“发展”啊。\\n毕竟有不少区域都被夷为平地了——: We're discussing the town's future "development."\nQuite a few districts were razed to the ground, after all—
strings.所以，干脆把那些地方清理出来，\\n用来建设“新的东西”★\\n只是恢复原样也太: So why not clear those areas out\nand build "something new"★\nJust restoring them would be a wasted opportunity, right~?
strings.诺瓦先生有没有主意呢？\\n你希望在帕尔佩布拉看到什么！: Do you have any ideas, Mr. Nova?\nWhat would you like to see in Palpebra!
strings.啊，不只是猫，还有狗……\\n我经常会在路上看到。\\n所以想说，能不能把它们保: Ah, not just cats, but dogs too...\nI often see them on the streets.\nSo I was wondering if we could protect them...
strings.对不起……\\n不该在这时候提这个吧？: Sorry...\nThis isn't the time to bring that up, is it?
strings.哪里！才没那回事呢★\\n鹰森镇长！你觉得呢？！: Not at all! That's not true at all★\nMayor Takamori! What do you think?!
strings.有道理啊……\\n从公共卫生角度来看，确实是必须的。\\n而且……我个人也赞同。: That makes sense...\nFrom a public health standpoint, it's certainly necessary.\nAnd... I personally agree.
strings.应该会有很多人愿意帮忙吧。\\n也许这会是个好主意哦？: I'm sure lots of people would want to help.\nThis might be a good idea, you know?
strings.嗯，果然还是“收容猫咖”\\n运营起来最方便呢？\\n人手也够，对吧，优娜？: Hmm, a "rescue cat cafe" would be\nthe easiest to run, I think?\nAnd we'd have enough hands, right, Yuna?
strings.嗯嗯！\\n我告诉喜欢动物的朋友以后，\\n他们都说一定能来帮忙！: Mm-hm!\nWhen I told my animal-loving friends,\nthey all said they'd come help!
strings.那太好了★\\n公会骑士也会请琉农先生来协助！: That's great★\nWe'll ask Mr. Ryunon to help on the Guild Knights' side too!
strings.不过我也得负责巡视呢。\\n涩谷那边也会派部分警备队来帮忙。: I'll be on patrol duty too, though.\nPart of the Shibuya security team will come help as well.
strings.我也要帮忙！\\n我会把龙带到安巴赫那里，\\n所以已经很习惯这种事了！: I'll help too!\nI bring dragons over to Anbach,\nso I'm used to this kind of thing!
strings.能不能……也收容离群的龙呢？: Could we... take in stray dragons too?
strings.把龙也保护起来，\\n然后建个互动广场。\\n怎么样呢？！: We protect the dragons too,\nand build a petting plaza.\nHow about it?!
strings.听起来超级有趣啊？！\\n能行吗？！: That sounds super fun?!\nCan we do it?!
strings.那、那还是有点困难呢~~~~\\n这构想太宏大了啊！: Th-That might be a little difficult~~~~\nThat's a huge idea!
strings.不过，就按这个势头继续吧！\\n毕竟这座城镇无所不能啊★: Still, let's keep up this momentum!\nThis town can do anything, after all★
strings.其实我早该知道的。\\n大家早就告诉过我，\\n这里的人一直都是这样——: I really should have known.\nEveryone told me long ago\nthat people here have always been like this—
strings.但没想到……会感觉这么充实啊？: But I never thought... it would feel so fulfilling.
strings.其实……公会正打算设立城市开发课。\\n诺瓦先生想不想加入呢？: Actually... the Guild is planning to set up a City Development Division.\nWould you like to join, Mr. Nova?
strings.毕竟公会的人手还远远不足嘛。\\n一起热情满满地创造美好的城市吧！: The Guild is still way short on hands.\nLet's create a wonderful city together, full of passion!
strings.为了让这里的大家都露出笑容，\\n为了能尽量减轻大家的痛苦——\\n我也会加油的: So that everyone here can smile,\nand to ease their pain as much as I can—\nI'll do my best too.
strings.好痛！好痛啦！\\n都说了很痛诶？！？！\\n说了多少次了，不能伸爪子——呜哇？: Ow! Ow, that hurts!\nI said it hurts?!?!\nHow many times do I have to say no claws—Whoa?!
strings.呵、呵呵呵……\\n你以为自己能逃出我的手心吗？: Heh, heh heh heh...\nYou think you can escape my grasp?
strings.不管你如何哭喊——好痛！！: No matter how much you cry—OW!!
strings.没、没想到……\\n收容猫咪原来这么难啊……\\n还有……猫的数量是不是太多了？: I-I never thought...\nrescuing cats would be this hard...\nAlso... aren't there way too many cats?!
strings.对、对不起啊？！\\n应该有很多都是师父画出来的！: S-Sorry?!\nI think a lot of them were painted by my master!
strings.喂！诺瓦！快带它去洗澡啦！\\n后面还有很多只等着呢！: Hey! Nova! Take it to get washed!\nThere are plenty more waiting!
strings.我、我可以的，爱丽丝前辈！\\n我已经很擅长应付猫——: I-I can do it, Alice!\nI've gotten really good at handling cats—
strings.不过，这样吗……\\n原来如此……: Still, I see...\nSo that's how it is...
strings.这一定就是现在的你啊。: This must be who you are now.
strings.一起来吧！\\n这真的非常开心呢！: Come join us!\nThis is really so much fun!
strings.有种……不好的预感。: I have... a bad feeling about this.
strings.和之前都不一样……是特异点？\\n不，这种凶残的感觉是——: It's different from before... A singularity?\nNo, this savage feeling is—
strings.喂，惠惠！\\n哪有你这样突然放爆裂魔法的！\\n你倒下了可是我来背，倒是考虑下: Hey, Megumin!\nYou can't just fire off Explosion out of nowhere!\nI'm the one who has to carry you when you collapse, think of me!
strings.我、我可是确认过那里没人的，\\n而且不是把袭击我们的魔物打倒了吗！: I-I checked that nobody was there,\nand I took out the monster that attacked us, didn't I!
strings.话说回来，太奇怪了吧！\\n我们刚才不还在室外吗？！\\n为什么会突然进迷宫啊？: More importantly, isn't this weird?!\nWeren't we just outside?!\nHow'd we suddenly end up in a labyrinth?!
strings.就是说啊！\\n而且这里到处都一模一样！\\n这到底是哪儿啊？！: Exactly!\nAnd everywhere here looks the same!\nWhere even are we?!
strings.你、你们三个都冷静一下。\\n我们先整理一下状况……: Y-You three, calm down.\nLet's assess the situation first...
strings.你们几个，快去避难！\\n刚才的爆炸非同寻常……\\n也许出现了某种危险的魔物！: You there, evacuate now!\nThat explosion just now was no ordinary one...\nSome dangerous monster may have appeared!
strings.我必须要指正！\\n那不是爆炸，是“爆裂魔法”！: I must correct you!\nThat was not an explosion, it was "Explosion magic"!
strings.我的必杀魔法能碎岩崩山！\\n你们可别把它和寻常爆炸混为一谈——: My ultimate spell can shatter rocks and topple mountains!\nDon't you dare lump it in with some ordinary blast—
strings.你们被逮捕了！\\n立刻跟我们回公会说清楚！: You're under arrest!\nCome back to the Guild with us and explain yourselves at once!
strings.哈？！\\n我可是阿克娅大人，是女神啊！\\n你们怎么能随便逮捕我——: Huh?!\nI'm the Lady Aqua, a goddess!\nHow dare you arrest me—
strings.你们没事吧？！刚才的爆炸——: Are you all right?! That explosion just now—
strings.等等！我们什么坏事都没做！\\n我们只是善良的一般市民！真的！: Wait! We didn't do anything wrong!\nWe're just good, ordinary citizens! Really!
strings.我也没想到事情会闹这么大！: I didn't think it'd turn into such a huge mess either!
strings.没、没错，\\n要抓也请只抓我吧！: Th-That's right.\nIf you must arrest someone, please arrest only me!
strings.就算要被下贱的男人们\\n残酷地蹂躏，我也能接受！: Even if I'm to be cruelly ravaged\nby lowly men, I can accept it!
strings.求你了！别在这时候\\n说这种只会让人误解的话啊！: Please! Don't say stuff that'll\nonly get people the wrong idea right now!
strings.呃，唔，看起来倒不可疑……\\n不，好像也……挺可疑的？: Uh, well, they don't look suspicious...\nNo, actually... they do seem pretty suspicious?
strings.对，快帮帮我们！\\n突然有人说要逮捕我们！\\n那帮白衣服的人还在追我们！: Yes, help us!\nSome people suddenly said they're arresting us!\nThose guys in white are still chasing us!
strings.就算惠惠用了爆裂魔法，\\n也不至于逮捕我们吧！: Even if Megumin used Explosion,\nthat's no reason to arrest us!
strings.我可是女神啊？！\\n为什么我非得倒这种霉不可？！\\n我平时可没少行善积德啊！: I'm a goddess, you know?!\nWhy do I have to suffer like this?!\nI do plenty of good deeds every day!
strings.呃，也就是说……\\n你们就是制造爆炸的犯人？: Uh, so in other words...\nyou're the ones who caused the explosion?
strings.我、我们真的没有恶意！\\n虽然正因为她们没有恶意，\\n事情的性质才变得更加恶: W-We really didn't mean any harm!\nThough the fact that they meant no harm\nis exactly what makes it worse!
strings.不过重点是，这里到底是哪里？！\\n我们根本不记得自己\\n进过这样大的迷宫啊…: But the real question is, where are we?!\nWe don't remember going into\na labyrinth this big at all...
strings.那个……请你们先冷静一点听我们解释……\\n我想，你们应该是来到了异世界。: Um... please calm down and hear us out...\nI think you've come to another world.
strings.请、请等一下，\\n这几位恐怕是漂流者……: P-Please wait.\nThese people are probably castaways...
strings.忍不了了，既然你们想动手……\\nSTEAL——: I can't take it anymore. If you want a fight...\nSTEAL—
strings.怎、怎么了？你做了什么？！: Wh-What happened? What did you do?!
strings.我只是想和她好好聊聊，\\n所以没收了她的武器……: I just wanted to have a proper talk with her,\nso I took away her weapon...
strings.不！这是误会！\\n我只是想偷她的武器啊！: No! This is a misunderstanding!\nI was only trying to steal her weapon!
strings.我都说了是误会了！\\n喂，你也帮我说两句——: I told you it's a misunderstanding!\nHey, back me up here—
strings.啊，请吧。赶紧逮捕他们。: Ah, go ahead. Arrest them already.
strings.冤、冤枉啊！\\n我们是无辜的啊啊啊啊！: W-We're innocent!\nWe're innocent, I tell youuuu!
strings.让我们来监视他们？: You want us to keep watch over them?
strings.没错！只需给点指导与帮助即可，\\n希望各位务必能帮我们这个忙！: Correct! Just some guidance and help is all we ask.\nWe'd really appreciate it if you could do this for us!
strings.倒是没问题……\\n不过公会竟然愿意放你们一马啊？: That's no problem...\nBut I'm surprised the Guild let you off.
strings.多亏有你们帮我们说话啊。\\n不过，接下来的一个月内我们必须\\n处于监视之下，: Thanks to you speaking up for us.\nBut for the next month we have to\nstay under watch, and we can't enter the labyrinth.
strings.而且还得继续麻烦你们，\\n实在是对不住。\\n真希望能早些找到办法回去……: And we'll have to keep troubling you.\nI'm really sorry.\nI hope we find a way home soon...
strings.你们突然来到了异世界，\\n想必会有很多不明白，\\n我们会尽量帮忙的。: You suddenly came to another world,\nso there must be lots you don't understand.\nWe'll help as much as we can.
strings.那真是太好了！\\n我们只是迷路了而已，\\n没想到还要被监视。: That's great!\nWe just got lost,\nI didn't think we'd end up under watch.
strings.啊哈哈哈，\\n但那主要是内衣的问题……\\n你明白吗？: Ahahaha,\nbut that was mostly about the underwear...\nYou understand that, right?
strings.但、但能遇见你们，\\n我觉得我的运气还是很不错的。: B-But meeting you all,\nI think my luck's still pretty good.
strings.跟你说，阿尔克……\\n我觉得我们一定能成为好兄弟，\\n这是我身为男人的预感！: Listen, Alk...\nI just know we'll be great buddies.\nCall it a man's intuition!
strings.所以，虽然对双方来说都挺够呛的，\\n但还是放轻松点来吧。\\n监视工作完全可以: So, it's rough on both sides,\nbut let's take it easy.\nFeel free to go easy on the watching!
strings.既然答应了，那我们肯定不会放水哦。\\n你下次再用那什么“STEAL”的话，\\: We agreed to it, so we definitely won't go easy.\nIf you use that "STEAL" thing again,\nI'll turn you in immediately.
strings.各位，今后就请多多关照了。: Everyone, please take care of us from now on.
strings.嗯，请多关照！\\n话说回来——: Yeah, nice to meet you!\nBy the way—
strings.你一定愿意相信我是女神吧？！\\n那些穿白衣服的人完全不肯\\n听我说阿克西斯教: You believe I'm a goddess, don't you?!\nThose people in white wouldn't listen\nto a single word about the Axis Church!
strings.这里有没有能让我放爆裂魔法的地方？\\n红魔族一天不放一次爆裂魔法就会死的！: Is there anywhere here I can fire off Explosion?\nA Crimson Demon will die if she doesn't cast Explosion once a day!
strings.别那么任性了！\\n真受不了你们~~~~！: Stop being so selfish!\nI can't stand you guyyys~~~~!
strings.唔，真的没问题吗……: Hmm, is this really going to be okay...
strings.开什么玩笑……\\n光破坏还不满足，\\n甚至释放了那种麻烦东西……: You've got to be kidding...\nNot content with destruction,\nthey even unleashed that troublesome thing...
strings.随便吧！\\n我可不管外面会变成什么样了！: Whatever!\nI don't care what happens out there anymore!
strings.提欧！都准备好了吗？\\n没有忘东西吧？: Teo! Are you all ready?\nDidn't forget anything?
strings.嗯。我还带了笔和笔记本！\\n我一定会好好学习\\n利比尔德乐园的文化和技术！: Yep. I even brought a pen and notebook!\nI'm going to properly study\nParadise Isle's culture and technology!
strings.哎呀哎呀，不用那么紧张！\\n总而言之，只要好好享受，\\n我相信提欧一定能明白: Oh, oh, no need to be so nervous!\nBasically, just have a good time,\nand I'm sure you'll understand, Teo!
strings.喂，干什么啊，玛格诺斯！\\n你把大家都吓着了！: Hey, what're you doing, Magnos!\nYou scared everyone!
strings.你小子……\\n竟敢把提欧送去那种不道德的地方……\\n万一提欧堕落了该怎么办！: You brat...\nHow dare you send Teo to such an immoral place...\nWhat if Teo becomes corrupted!
strings.玛格诺斯，\\n我不是去玩的哦。: Magnos,\nI'm not going there to play.
strings.哎呀，这次好歹有正事要办。\\n他是去参加异世界交流项目的呢。: Well, this time there's actual business.\nHe's taking part in an inter-world exchange program.
strings.玛格诺斯想太多了啦。\\n而且，我很期待呢！\\n海水浴之类、赌场之类……: You're overthinking it, Magnos.\nBesides, I'm really looking forward to it!\nSwimming in the sea, the casino...
strings.对了！还有和翔太一起去搭讪！: Oh right! And picking up girls with Shota!
strings.诶。呃，唔~……\\n我觉得提欧还是别去的好哦~: Huh. Uh, um~...\nI don't think you should do that, Teo~
strings.诶？但你不是说搭讪真的很辛苦，\\n还邀请了大家吗？\\n我还以为那是像修行一样: Huh? But didn't you say picking up girls is really hard work,\nand invite everyone along?\nI thought it was something like training...
strings.话、话是没错~\\n但又不太一样吧~？: W-Well, that's true~\nbut it's kinda different, right~?
strings.总而言之！\\n我不是去玩的。: Anyway!\nI'm not going there to play.
strings.了解利比尔德乐园发展的原因，\\n一定能帮到我们的世界！\\n我只是去学习那个的: Learning why Paradise Isle has prospered\nis sure to help our world!\nI'm just going to study that!
strings.不行！还是不行！\\n你不需要那种知识！！！\\n赶紧跟我一起回去！: No! I still say no!\nYou don't need that kind of knowledge!!!\nCome home with me right now!
strings.哦哦？教你吗……\\n好啊，就跟着我好好学学吧。\\n看好了啊，提欧！: Oh ho? Teach you, huh...\nSure, follow me and learn well.\nWatch closely, Teo!
strings.你没听过吗？概率是会收束的！\\n也就是说！之前输的都能赢回来！: Haven't you heard? Probability converges!\nIn other words! I'll win back everything I lost!
strings.原、原来如此？\\n这、这也是学习的一部分吧？: I-I see?\nTh-This is part of studying too, right?
strings.哎呀，白阁下又在勤奋地\\n重复这种空虚的行为了吗……: My, so Lord Nimbus is once again\ndiligently repeating such empty acts...
strings.唔……提欧阁下，如果你有空，\\n可否来帮在下“工作”一下？: Hmm... Lord Teo, if you have time,\nmight you help this one with some "work"?
strings.工作吗？！\\n好、好的！我愿意帮忙！: Work?!\nS-Sure! I'd be glad to help!
strings.这样一来，我一定能学到东西——: This way, I'll definitely learn something—
strings.二位！刚才那个角度正好哦！\\n提欧！赶紧趁现在调整反光板角度！\\n就差五毫米: You two! That angle was perfect!\nTeo! Adjust the reflector angle now!\nJust five more millimeters!
strings.这、这就是工作？\\n不、不就是在玩吗……\\n而且……还穿成那样——: Th-This is work?\nI-Isn't it just playing...\nAnd... dressed like that—
strings.做这些真的能让我搞懂\\n利比尔德乐园发展的原因吗……: Will doing this really help me understand\nwhy Paradise Isle prospered...
strings.不对不对……\\n黑不是也说了吗……: No, no...\nDidn't Claw say so too...
strings.这里一定有某些东西！\\n我就是来找那个的！: There's definitely something here!\nThat's what I came to find!
strings.翔太和杰拉尔跟我说过……\\n这里就是岛上最可怕的地方……: Shota and Gerard told me...\nthis is the scariest place on the island...
strings.我一定能在这里学到点什么……\\n一定能找到这座岛的秘密！: I'm sure I can learn something here...\nI'll find this island's secret for sure...
strings.这里一定有我需要的东西……\\n走吧！: What I need must be here...\nLet's go!
strings.莉莉丝小姐！\\n我是来这里学习的！！！: Miss Lilith!\nI came here to study!!!
strings.我、我完全不知道……\\n我真的不知道那里原来是……\\n呃呜呜呜~~~~: I-I had no idea...\nI really didn't know that place was...\nUgh, uuugh~~~~
strings.我明白的，你想学习嘛。\\n弄清自己想要什么并不是件坏事哦。: I understand, you wanted to learn.\nFiguring out what you want isn't a bad thing.
strings.不、不是那样的！\\n绝对不是你想的那样！: N-No, that's not it!\nIt's definitely not what you think!
strings.我到底在干什么啊……\\n明明是过来学习的，\\n却一直在玩……: What am I even doing...\nI came here to study,\nbut all I've done is play...
strings.这样根本没有进展啊……\\n既弄不明白黑的意思，\\n也搞不懂这里的情况……: I'm not getting anywhere like this...\nI don't get what Claw meant,\nand I don't understand anything about this place...
strings.呵呵……你真是一本正经啊。\\n不过，我觉得不用担心哦，\\n你一定已经学到东西: Heh heh... You're so earnest.\nBut I don't think you need to worry.\nI'm sure you've already learned something.
strings.但我来了这里以后，\\n就一直在玩啊！\\n倒不如说，大家也一直在玩！: But ever since I got here,\nall I've done is play!\nIf anything, everyone's been playing nonstop!
strings.但是……光顾着玩肯定是不行的啊……: But... just playing can't be right...
strings.这里一定有什么秘密！\\n那个秘密一定能帮我们\\n把自己的世界变得更好……: There must be some secret here!\nA secret that can help us\nmake our own world better...
strings.所以，我必须弄清才行……\\n如果不学到点什么……\\n我根本没法挺起胸膛回去！: So I have to figure it out...\nIf I don't learn something...\nI can't go home with my head held high!
strings.亏你在这里玩了一整天，\\n还能说出这种话啊。\\n真是个叫人吃惊的孩子呢。: You spent the whole day playing here,\nand you can still say that?\nWhat a surprising child.
strings.这是爱美尔达小姐。\\n是这座岛的创始人之一哦。: This is Miss Esmeralda.\nShe's one of the founders of this island.
strings.简而言之，\\n你想要了解这里的本质吧？\\n没问题……我可以告诉你哦。: In short,\nyou want to understand what this place really is?\nVery well... I can tell you.
strings.当然。\\n不过，也不能免费教你。: Of course.\nBut I can't teach you for free.
strings.我身上没钱……\\n但、但我什么都愿意做！: I don't have any money...\nB-But I'll do anything!
strings.不用你掏钱。\\n不过，你得完成我交给你的工作。: I don't need your money.\nBut you'll have to finish the job I give you.
strings.那样一来，你应该就能发现某些\\n无法从客人的角度看到的细节了。\\n也许也能找: That way, you should notice details\nyou can't see from a guest's point of view.\nMaybe you'll find what you're looking for, too.
strings.当然，我也会给你报酬——: Of course, I'll pay you as well—
strings.我会做的，请让我做！: I'll do it, please let me!
strings.那就这么定了。\\n可别等上手了再发牢骚哦。: Then it's settled.\nDon't come complaining once you've started.
strings.我知道！为了弄清黑的意思……\\n为了了解这里……我一定会努力的！: I know! To figure out what Claw meant...\nto understand this place... I'll do my best!
strings.吵死了，给我闭嘴。\\n别让我看这种丢人的东西。: Shut up, be quiet.\nDon't make me look at something so shameful.
strings.是我们太蠢了，竟然会期待你。\\n想做研究员也好什么也好都随你。\\n别再让我们: We were fools to expect anything of you.\nBe a researcher or whatever you like.\nJust don't let us see you again.
strings.我想要成为你那样的人。\\n想变得更温柔，能支撑你、关心你。\\n我想成为你的家: I want to become someone like you.\nKinder, someone who can support you and care for you.\nI want to be your family, so you won't be lonely anymore—
strings.所以，我要变得更强，\\n变得不再害怕任何东西！: So I'm going to get stronger,\nuntil I'm not afraid of anything!
strings.威、威尔？到底是怎么了？\\n你为什么要穿成那样——: W-Will? What's going on?\nWhy are you dressed like that—
strings.我可爱的梅莉，我一直都想告诉你，\\n我有多爱你，有多想触碰你……: My lovely Mary, I've always wanted to tell you\nhow much I love you, how much I want to touch you...
strings.爱、爱、爱我？！威尔？！\\n你、你绝对有哪里不对劲啊——: L-L-Love me?! Will?!\nTh-There's definitely something wrong with you—
strings.我了解你的所有。\\n包括你心底想要什么——: I know everything about you.\nIncluding what you want deep down—
strings.我知道你想要永远不会分开的家人。: I know you want a family\nthat will never be torn apart.
strings.现在的我一定能给你一个家，\\n我绝对不会让你感到不安的！\\n所以，梅莉，请和: The me of now can surely give you a home,\nand I'll never make you feel uneasy!\nSo, Mary, please, with me—
strings.啧……为什么要来妨碍我！\\n我好不容易能说出口了啊！: Tch... Why are you getting in my way!\nI was finally able to say it!
strings.啊啊啊~~~麻烦死了——\\n你现在就像以前的我！\\n我讨厌这样的你啊！: Aaargh~~~ what a pain—\nYou're just like I used to be!\nI hate you like this!
strings.明明说了一大堆家人怎样怎样的！\\n就这副样子去和她求婚真的好吗？！: You went on and on about family and stuff!\nAre you really gonna propose to her like THAT?!
strings.给我住口……\\n我已经没什么好怕的了！: Shut up...\nI'm not afraid of anything anymore!
strings.我已经舍弃了弱小的自己啊！: I've cast aside my weak self!
strings.真、真的吗？\\n他是因为那套装甲才失控的？: R-Really?\nHe went out of control because of that armor?
strings.嗯。是感情增幅功能在捣乱。\\n只要切断那个应该就行了……: Yes. The emotion amplifier is acting up.\nCutting it off should do the trick...
strings.他的感情被放大了？\\n不是被压抑了吗？: His emotions are being amplified?\nNot suppressed?
strings.那要不要反过来试试，\\n继续放大他的感情？: Then why not try the opposite\nand amplify his emotions even more?
strings.说明书上写了，\\n有个“隐藏模式：极限爆发”。\\n那样能进一步提升功率，让感: The manual says\nthere's a "Hidden Mode: Limit Burst."\nIt boosts the output further and lets his emotions pour out.
strings.这种东西……\\n真要说我还挺喜欢的……: Something like this...\nHonestly, I kind of like it...
strings.还能远程操控呢。\\n那我要按按钮咯？: It can even be operated remotely.\nShall I press the button?
strings.呃唔唔唔唔……\\n那种东西——我直说了啊！\\n说实话，你一点都不帅啊！: Urrrrgh...\nThat thing—I'll just say it!\nHonestly, you don't look cool at all!
strings.而且看起来完全不强！\\n简直土到没边了！！: And you don't look strong in the slightest!\nIt's tacky beyond belief!!
strings.烦、烦死了！给我闭嘴！\\n为什么你能说出这种话啊？！: Sh-Shut up! Be quiet!\nHow can you even say stuff like that?!
strings.因为我是个坦率的男人啊~~\\n既然这么羡慕我，\\n为什么不和你女朋友说你家—: Because I'm an honest man~~\nIf you envy me so much,\nwhy not just tell your girlfriend your family—
strings.我怎么说得出口啊——: How could I ever say that—
strings.事到如今，还在结婚这事上\\n那么懦弱！\\n万一让她失望了！我！我……: Even now, I'm such a coward\nwhen it comes to marriage!\nWhat if I disappoint her! I! I...
strings.我不会对你失望！不会讨厌你！\\n懦弱也没关系！: I won't be disappointed in you! I won't hate you!\nIt's okay to be a coward!
strings.说出来啊！\\n把威尔的一切都告诉我啊！: Say it!\nTell me everything about you, Will!
strings.我很害怕啊！\\n我根本就不了解什么才是真正的家庭！\\n我从来没被爸爸和妈妈爱: I'm scared!\nI don't even know what a real family is!\nMy mom and dad never loved me!
strings.那样的我！\\n完全没自信能和你组建幸福的家庭！\\n我实在是很怕，实在不安得不: Someone like me!\nI have no confidence I can build a happy family with you!\nI'm so scared, so anxious I can't stand it!!!
strings.下去说啊，白痴——: Say it down there, you idiot—
strings.还是很想成为你的家人啊！\\n我想让你不再感到寂寞啊！！: I still want to be your family!\nI don't want you to feel lonely anymore!!
strings.拜托了……请你！\\n请你、嫁给我吧！！: Please... I'm asking you!\nPlease, marry me!!
strings.我的心情……\\n和你完全一样哦！: How I feel...\nis exactly the same as you!
strings.我也想和威尔结婚！\\n但如果我先提的话，\\n威尔一定会担心我的——: I want to marry you too, Will!\nBut if I brought it up first,\nI knew you'd worry about me—
strings.所以，其实我一直很期待，\\n威尔会不会主动向我求婚……: So actually, I've been hoping\nthat you'd propose to me yourself...
strings.我也要和你道歉……\\n是我顾虑太多，太想依赖你了。: I need to apologize too...\nI worried too much, and wanted to lean on you too much.
strings.哈哈哈……今后我们也\\n一定会重复这样的事吧。: Hahaha... I'm sure we'll\nkeep going through things like this from now on.
strings.到了那种时候，一定要一起商量啊？\\n说出自己的不安，一起想办法解决。\\n我想: When that happens, let's talk it over together, okay?\nShare our worries and work things out together.\nThat's the kind of family I want to be... with you.
strings.那么，威尔，\\n能重新向我求一次婚吗？: So, Will,\nwill you propose to me one more time?
strings.求婚时的台词也好，动作也好，\\n你一定想过很多吧？\\n我想要听你亲口说出来呢: Your proposal lines, your gestures—\nI'm sure you thought about them a lot, right?\nI want to hear it from you properly~
strings.我……我想和你组建家庭。: I... I want to make a family with you.
strings.不论是幸福、寂寞、\\n还是爱和不安——\\n我都想和你一起分享！: Happiness, loneliness,\nlove, and worry—\nI want to share all of it with you!
strings.他们每次都这样。\\n虽然抱怨了一大堆，\\n但本来就没想要放弃啊……: They're always like this.\nThey complain and complain,\nbut they never meant to give up in the first place...
strings.嗯嗯。\\n不过，果然还是坦率点最好呢。: Mm-hm.\nStill, being honest really is best.
strings.这话轮得到你说吗？\\n你真的知道自己在说什么吗？？？: Are YOU the one to say that?\nDo you even know what you're saying???
strings.他们真是有够任性的啊。\\n你说是吧~蕾缇希娅？: They really are so self-indulgent.\nDon't you think so~ Reticia?

strings.拜他所赐，议会才会以为我的领地里\\n“住着一个能从画里变出魔物的\\n奇怪的魔: Thanks to him, the council thinks my lands are home to\n"a strange wizard who conjures monsters\nout of paintings." It's given me quite the headache.

strings.找到了！\\n有能让惠惠小姐放爆裂魔法的委托哦！: Found one!\nA request that'll let Megumin cast Explosion!
strings.是这样的，\\n各位前阵子讨伐史莱姆的那片区域\\n现在似乎有强大的魔物盘踞……: It seems that the area where you all\nexterminated the slimes the other day\nis now overrun by powerful monsters...
strings.公会对此也很头疼。\\n不过，惠惠小姐的爆裂魔法\\n应该能一击消灭那些魔物吧？: The Guild is at its wits' end too.\nBut Megumin's Explosion\nshould wipe those monsters out in one shot, right?
strings.真、真的可以吗？\\n真的可以用爆裂魔法吗？！: R-Really? Am I really\nallowed to use Explosion?!
strings.嗯！\\n这次算是破例给予许可！\\n而且只要有我随行，应该没有问题♪: Yes!\nPermission granted as a special exception!\nAnd as long as I'm with you, it should be fine♪
strings.为我们考虑了这么多，\\n真是太感谢你了。: Thank you so much\nfor being so considerate of us.
strings.惠惠需要时间准备爆裂魔法，\\n所以得有人拖住魔物才行。\\n能拜托你一起吗，阿: Megumin needs time to prepare Explosion,\nso someone has to hold off the monsters.\nWill you come along, Alk?
strings.谢谢你们，各位！\\n为了报答这份恩情，\\n我一定会成功施展爆裂魔法！: Thank you, everyone!\nTo repay your kindness,\nI'll cast Explosion flawlessly!
strings.让阿尔克他们好好看看你的魔法吧！: Show Alk and the others your magic!
strings.这……这时机简直太完美了！\\n谢谢你们！太感激了，各位！: Th-This timing is absolutely perfect!\nThank you! I'm so grateful, everyone!
strings.请看好了！\\n这便是爆裂魔法的精髓！: Watch closely!\nThis is the very essence of Explosion magic!
strings.自比黑更黑的深渊之中，\\n希求漆黑之暗——: From the abyss darker than black,\nI call upon the pitch-black darkness—
strings.吾所求之物乃崩坏！\\n吾所欲之途乃混沌！\\n以红魔之名，让一切化为灰烬！: What I seek is ruin! The path I desire is chaos!\nIn the name of the Crimson Demons,\nreduce all to ashes!
strings.起舞吧！狂气显现！\\n击穿它们吧！吾之永恒的破坏魔法！: Dance! Let madness manifest!\nPierce them through! My eternal magic of destruction!
strings.哎呀，对付史莱姆的时候\\n我都没机会说……: Wow, when we fought the slimes\nI didn't get the chance to say it...
strings.但爆裂魔法……真棒啊！\\n让人有种想背过身摆决胜姿势的感觉！: But Explosion... is amazing!\nIt makes you want to turn your back and strike a victory pose!

strings.多谢各位的帮助了♪\\n那么，接下来~……: Thank you for your help, everyone♪\nNow then, next~...
strings.我回去之后，会努力和公会商讨，\\n让惠惠小姐能继续在这里释放爆裂魔法！: When I get back, I'll do my best to talk it over with the Guild\nso Megumin can keep casting Explosion here!
strings.应该很快就能得到许可的！\\n正好公会想把这一片清理干净，\\n然后利用起来呢♪: I'm sure we'll get permission soon!\nAs it happens, the Guild wants to clear this area out\nand put it to use♪
strings.呜哇啊啊，太感谢了！\\n每日一次爆裂魔法复活了，和真！: Waaah, thank you so much!\nMy daily Explosion is back, Kazuma!
strings.是是是，这都得多亏了大家啊，\\n你就别得意了。: Yeah, yeah, it's all thanks to everyone,\nso don't get cocky.

strings.惠惠，我还想多了解一些爆裂魔法。: Megumin, I want to learn more about Explosion.
strings.没问题！\\n你们的爆裂之道才刚刚起步呢！: No problem!\nYour path of Explosion has only just begun!
strings.阿尔克，史黛拉！\\n今后也要和我一同踏上爆裂之道啊！: Alk, Stella!\nKeep walking the path of Explosion with me from now on!
strings.嘿嘿，我好歹也是冒险者啊！\\n虽然还是新人就是了。: Heh heh, I am an adventurer, after all!\nStill a newbie, though.
strings.没空让你得意了啦！\\n这么多史莱姆，到底该怎么办才好啊！: No time to be smug!\nThere are so many slimes, what are we supposed to do!
strings.唔唔唔……这里还是镇中心，\\n不然我就能用爆裂魔法把它们轰干净了！: Grrr... This is the middle of town,\notherwise I could blow them all away with Explosion!
strings.啊——我想到了——\\n我知道该怎么消灭这些史莱姆了！: Ah—I've got it—\nI know how to wipe out these slimes!
strings.你、你是上次那个……: Y-You're the one from last time...
strings.不过，就算我们不出力，\\n公会骑士们一定也能有办法的~: But even if we don't lift a finger,\nI'm sure the Guild Knights can handle it~
strings.所以，如果能解除对我们的监视？\\n或者在事后给我们多来点谢礼？\\n要有这样的: So, how about you lift the watch on us?\nOr give us a bigger reward afterward?\nWith perks like that, I might actually get motivated~~!

strings.现在确实……能帮忙的人越多越好！\\n你说的解除监视一事……\\n我们会考虑的！: Right now... the more help the better!\nAs for lifting the watch...\nwe'll consider it!
strings.很好，那就好好听听我的作战方案吧。\\n让我们一起拯救帕尔佩布拉！: Great, then listen carefully to my battle plan.\nLet's save Palpebra together!
strings.你别老是一得便宜就买乖啊~~……: Quit getting cocky every time things go your way~~...
strings.达克妮丝拥有名为“诱饵”的技能，\\n能吸引魔物的注意力。: Darkness has a skill called "Decoy"\nthat draws monsters' attention.
strings.首先拜托达克妮丝将史莱姆们\\n引到镇外空旷的地方，\\n然后就轮到惠惠出场了。: First, Darkness lures the slimes\nout to an open area outside town,\nand then it's Megumin's turn.
strings.没错！就让我的爆炎\\n再次响彻这个世界吧！: That's right! Let my explosive flames\nresound across this world once more!

strings.到这里应该没问题了……\\n达克妮丝小姐！\\n解除“诱饵”，回大家身边——: This should be far enough...\nMiss Darkness!\nCancel "Decoy" and come back to everyone—
strings.为了不让镇上的人们被波及，\\n身为骑士，我有义务留到最后，\\n履行好诱饵的职: So that the townspeople aren't caught up in it,\nas a knight, it's my duty to stay until the end\nand fulfill my role as the decoy...
strings.没错！就让史莱姆下流地纠缠我的身体！\\n然后沐浴在爆裂之中！\\n所以，请不用: That's right! Let the slimes lewdly entangle my body!\nAnd then bathe me in the explosion!\nSo, please, don't mind me—
strings.为什么？！为什么要阻拦我？！\\n黏黏的史莱姆！爆裂~~~~~！: Why?! Why are you stopping me?!\nThe slimy slimes! The explosiooon~~~~~!
strings.惠惠，就是现在！\\n不用留手，尽情上吧！: Megumin, now!\nDon't hold back, let it rip!
strings.吾名惠惠！\\n红魔族首屈一指的魔法师！\\n兼爆裂魔法的操纵者！: My name is Megumin!\nForemost mage of the Crimson Demons!\nAnd wielder of Explosion magic!
strings.比黑更黑的漆黑、流转闪耀的星光！\\n世界相交、与真红邂逅——\\n将我等从森罗: Pitch-black darker than black, starlight that flows and gleams!\nWorlds intersect, meeting the deep crimson—\nRelease us from the laws of all creation!
strings.呵、呵呵……这就是、爆裂魔法。\\n爆裂魔法、最棒了……: Heh, heh heh... This is, Explosion magic.\nExplosion magic, is the best...

strings.哈哈哈哈哈哈！这算什么事啊？？？\\n唉，真拿你们没办法！: Hahahahahaha! What even is this???\nSigh, you guys are hopeless!

strings.不是啦！\\n为什么我还得继续接受监视啊？\\n明明她们三个都没事了！: That's not it!\nWhy am I still under watch?\nThose three are all off the hook!

strings.往好了想，\\n公会不是允许和真进入迷宫了吗？\\n这下就能找办法回去了吧？: Look on the bright side,\nthe Guild's allowing you into the labyrinth now, Kazuma.\nNow you can look for a way home, right?

strings.呀嚯！我是深渊探索队的索维♡\\n今天我有一件重要的事情要告诉大家，\\n所以为: Yoohoo! I'm Sohvi from the Abyss Exploration Team♡\nI have something important to tell everyone today,\nso we made this recording for you♡

strings.呃，话说，平行世界应该\\n就是所谓的多元宇宙吧？\\n真的没问题吗？世界不会崩: Uh, by the way, parallel worlds are\nbasically a multiverse, right?\nIs this really okay? Won't the world collapse?

strings.嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿♡\\n我们一定要办一场最棒的婚礼哦♡♡: Hee hee hee hee hee hee hee hee hee hee hee♡\nLet's have the best wedding ever♡♡
strings.咦，你把他送走了？\\n你不和他一起去吗？: Huh, you sent him off?\nYou're not going with him?
