strings.有空聊天不如快动手吧？！\\n这是三号桌和四号桌的！: If you've got time to chat, get to work!\nThese are for tables three and four!
strings.你倒是也来前面帮忙啊！\\n魔物海鲜炒面马上来——: Then come help out front too!\nMonster seafood yakisoba coming right up—
strings.话说，你脑子也有问题吧……\\n不是拜托了就能随便使唤的啊——: By the way, there's something wrong with your head too...\nYou can't just order people around because you asked nicely—
strings.非常抱歉……\\n我只是觉得……\\n影丘应该会愿意帮忙……: I'm very sorry...\nI just thought...\nKageoka would be willing to help...
strings.搞什么啊……\\n去找其他人也行吧……: What the hell...\nYou could've asked someone else...
strings.你不用去上菜吗？: Don't you have to go serve food?
strings.唉……糟透了……\\n如果别人看见我这副模样，\\n绝对会被嘲笑的……: Ugh... This sucks...\nIf anyone sees me like this,\nthey'll definitely laugh at me...
strings.埃癸斯的家伙之类……\\n虽然现在他们都不在……: The Aegis guys and such...\nNot that any of them are here right now...
strings.哎呀，他们也不会笑你吧。\\n和树还有拓也都对你评价很高啊。: Oh, they wouldn't laugh at you.\nKazuki and Takuya think really highly of you.
strings.原来你真的不记得了啊~\\n他们都是埃癸斯的啊，\\n而且和你是一个小队的。: So you really don't remember~\nThey're both from Aegis,\nand they were in your squad.
strings.他们还说你让他们超感动的，\\n很想和你道歉之类的，笑死我了。: They said you really moved them,\nthat they want to apologize to you and stuff, it cracked me up.
strings.你在开哪门子玩笑……\\n埃癸斯的人怎么可能这么说……: What kind of joke is that...\nThere's no way Aegis people would say that...
strings.哎呀哎呀，怎么没可能。\\n连绯河也夸过你呢，\\n虽然是带点傲娇的那种。: Come on, why not?\nEven Hikawa praised you,\nin a kind of tsundere way.
strings.我也听孤儿院的孩子们说了呢，\\n他们说“龙一是守护大家的英雄！”。: I heard it from the kids at the orphanage too.\nThey said "Ryuichi is a hero who protects everyone!"
strings.真的假的？！英雄？！\\n龙一真是个了不起的男人啊~！: Seriously?! A hero?!\nRyuichi really is a great man~!
strings.哈？什么……啊？？\\n你们脑袋是不是都坏了——: Huh? What... Huh??\nHave your brains all broken—
strings.为什么还要我来打扫……\\n那三个人什么时候\\n才能从别的店回来啊……: Why do I have to clean up too...\nWhen are those three\ncoming back from the other shops...
strings.啊……对了，\\n之前，怎么说呢，上次也谢谢你了。\\n不对，倒不如说，对不起啊: Ah... right.\nBefore, how do I put it, thanks for last time.\nNo, actually, I mean, sorry.
strings.哎呀……之前你来帮忙的时候，\\n我不是还说你只会居高临下什么……\\n现在想来: Well... when you came to help before,\nI said you only ever look down on people or something...\nThinking about it now, that wasn't great. Sorry.
strings.能别说这些吗？\\n我们又不是“那种关系”。: Can you not?\nWe're not "that kind of relationship."
strings.我讨厌你，你也讨厌我。\\n我们谁都不想和彼此做表面朋友，\\n不管是从前，还是: I hate you, and you hate me.\nNeither of us wants to pretend to be friends,\nnot before, and not from now on... right?
strings.确实……到现在我也\\n还是不太擅长应付你。: True... Even now I'm\nstill not great at dealing with you.
strings.嗯，我明白。\\n所以，不需要那些无谓的客套话——: Yeah, I know.\nSo there's no need for pointless pleasantries—
strings.但我并不讨厌你啊。\\n虽然之前……也许是那样没错。: But I don't hate you.\nThough before... maybe I did.
strings.但那也只是因为我\\n先入为主地认为你是那种人……\\n所以，确实是我不对。: But that was only because\nI'd decided you were that kind of person...\nSo I really was in the wrong.
strings.为什么所有人都、连你也……\\n这叫人怎么可能相信啊！: Why is everyone, even you...\nHow am I supposed to believe that!
strings.明明那样地看不起我，\\n明明被我那样地嘲笑过……: You all looked down on me so much,\nand I mocked you so much...
strings.最近翔总是提起的那个和树，\\n以前就嘲笑过他哦。: That Kazuki that Sho keeps bringing up lately\nused to make fun of him, you know.
strings.虽说他们俩是一个班的，\\n但我也觉得他们绝对没法成为朋友呢。: They were in the same class,\nbut I figured they'd never be friends.
strings.没想到，\\n现在他们关系却那么好……\\n简直不可置信吧？: Who'd have thought\nthey'd get along so well now...\nUnbelievable, right?
strings.这……倒确实……\\n但那又怎么样？: That's... true, I guess...\nBut so what?
strings.哎呀……我只是想说，\\n这种事其实很常见啊。\\n人都是会变的。: Well... I'm just saying,\nthis kind of thing actually happens a lot.\nPeople change.
strings.我之前也以为，\\n你看到我遇到麻烦了，\\n估计只会嘲笑我吧。: I used to think\nif you saw me in trouble,\nyou'd probably just laugh at me.
strings.所以，我想要好好了解你。\\n我想说的就是这个。: So I want to get to know you properly.\nThat's all I wanted to say.
strings.虽然完全搞不明白，\\n虽然很让人想吐——: I don't get it at all,\nand it makes me want to puke—
strings.但现在……就这样吧。: But for now... let's leave it at that.
strings.嗯……那就请你多关照了。: Yeah... I'll be counting on you, then.
strings.这种话就不必了……\\n真受不了，怎么你们所有人都这副样子？: Don't bother with that stuff...\nSeriously, why are you all like this?
strings.哎呀，我应该不会像翔那样……: Well, I don't think I'm like Sho...
strings.我看你们也差不多。\\n你妈也经常问我莫名其妙的问题，\\n什么“饭吃了没啊”之: You're all about the same, if you ask me.\nYour mom keeps asking me weird stuff too,\nlike "Have you eaten yet?"
strings.哈？诶？？？\\n为、为什么会突然提到妈妈——: Huh? What???\nWh-Why bring up my mom all of a sudden—
strings.二位，真的辛苦你们了——\\n今晚就来办一个庆功慰劳会吧！\\n其他人也都会来哦: Thank you both so much for your hard work—\nLet's have a celebration party tonight!\nEveryone else will be there too!
strings.感觉又会很吵闹啊……: Feels like it's gonna be noisy again...
strings.要不要来一起吃工作餐？: Want to have a staff meal together?
strings.看好了，这就是水之女神的力量！: Behold, the power of the Goddess of Water!
strings.喔——太强了！\\n你说要帮忙做家务的时候，\\n我看阿尔克也紧张兮兮的呢……: Whoa—amazing!\nWhen you offered to help with the housework,\neven Alk looked nervous...
strings.你真没礼貌啊。等阿尔克回来，\\n我早就把盘子都洗得干干净净的了！: How rude. By the time Alk gets back,\nI'll have washed every plate squeaky clean!
strings.很好，\\n就按这个势头，一口气洗了——: Great,\nat this rate, we'll wash them all in one go—
strings.呃、我说……\\n这盘子是不是阿尔克特别喜欢的那个……: Uh, hey...\nIsn't this plate the one Alk really loves...
strings.这、这下怎么办啊，和真！\\n我不想再惹阿尔克生气了！\\n和真，帮帮我啦！: Wh-What do we do, Kazuma!\nI don't want to make Alk mad again!\nKazuma, help me!
strings.我、我也不想啊！\\n那家伙笑着发火的样子真的很可怕啊？！: I-I don't want that either!\nHe's really scary when he gets mad with a smile?!
strings.阿克娅，不要慌……\\n只要不让他发现就行了！: Aqua, don't panic...\nAs long as he doesn't find out, we're fine!
strings.找个完全同样的盘子来，\\n把我们的失误掩盖过去！\\n说走就走，去帕尔佩布拉！: We'll find an identical plate\nand cover up our mistake!\nNo time to waste, to Palpebra!
strings.啊啊啊，根本找不到一模一样的啊！\\n再找不到的话——: Aaargh, we can't find an identical one anywhere!\nIf we don't find one soon—
strings.咦，你们俩也来帕尔佩布拉了？: Huh, you two came to Palpebra too?
strings.哎、哎呀，这不是阿尔克吗~\\n好巧啊，怎么在这儿遇到了呢！: O-Oh, if it isn't Alk~\nWhat a coincidence, running into you here!
strings.巧什么……话说，你们不是主动提出\\n要在我出门采购的时候帮忙洗盘子吗？: Coincidence... Wait, didn't you two offer\nto wash the plates while I was out shopping?
strings.啊~盘、盘子已经全都洗好了，\\n一个不差，洗得干干净净的！\\n所以我们才出来: Ah~ Th-The plates are all washed,\nevery last one, squeaky clean!\nSo we came out to play... Yep!
strings.是吗，那谢谢你们了！\\n我再买点东西就回去——: Really? Thanks!\nI'll pick up a few more things and head back—
strings.对、对了，阿尔克！\\n今天就和我们一起好好玩一圈吧！: O-Oh, right, Alk!\nCome hang out with us today!
strings.哎呀，我也挺想陪你们的，\\n但今天我还得回去打扫厨房……: Well, I'd love to,\nbut I've got to go back and clean the kitchen today...
strings.厨、厨房明天再打扫也来得及！\\n赶紧走吧，出发——: Th-The kitchen can wait until tomorrow!\nLet's go, come on—
strings.啊，对了对了！\\n接下来去团子店怎么样？: Oh, right, right!\nHow about the dango shop next?
strings.我、我们不是刚吃了冰淇淋和松饼吗？\\n我看阿克娅也吃得挺饱了……: D-Didn't we just have ice cream and pancakes?\nAqua looks pretty full too...
strings.可恶，这里也没有……\\n得快点找到才行啊……: Dammit, not here either...\nWe have to find one fast...
strings.不行，等等，先别回去！\\n我还想再和阿尔克一起玩一会儿嘛！: No, wait, don't go back yet!\nI wanna hang out with Alk a little longer!
strings.但我得回去准备晚饭了呢~: But I have to go get dinner ready~
strings.我、我们会帮你做饭的，\\n今天你就好好歇着吧！: W-We'll help you cook,\nso just take it easy today!
strings.没错没错！\\n阿尔克总是那么努力，\\n偶尔也得和我们撒撒娇嘛！: That's right, that's right!\nYou always work so hard, Alk,\nso once in a while you should let us pamper you!
strings.没错！今天阿克娅大人还有和真\\n会满足你所有要求哦！: That's right! Today, Lady Aqua and Kazuma\nwill grant your every wish!
strings.那好吧。那我就恭敬不如从命——\\n尽我所能向二位撒娇了！: All right then. I'll gratefully accept—\nand let you two pamper me as much as I can!
strings.“祝福”是提升幸运的技能！\\n这样应该就没问题了！: "Blessing" is a skill that raises luck!\nThat should do it!
strings.谢谢你，阿克娅。\\n快开始了……你们准备好了吗？: Thanks, Aqua.\nIt's about to start... Are you two ready?
strings.那么……每月一次的大特卖！\\n现在——开始！: And now... the once-a-month mega sale!\nStarts—now!
strings.二位！先拿右边柜子里\\n从上往下数第二种调料！: You two! First, grab the second seasoning\nfrom the top in the shelf on the right!
strings.稍、稍微等一下！\\n人太多了……呜啊啊啊啊！: W-Wait a sec!\nThere's too many people... Waaaaah!
strings.和真，向右上方四十五度伸手！\\n粗盐就在那里！: Kazuma, reach up and to the right, forty-five degrees!\nThe coarse salt's right there!
strings.阿克娅，去拿那边架子上的平底锅！\\n还有大锅！: Aqua, grab the frying pan from that shelf!\nAnd the big pot!
strings.阿尔克，快看！拿到了！\\n两种锅都拿到了——: Alk, look! I got them!\nBoth pots—
strings.实在是帮大忙了！\\n这大特卖每次都像打仗一样……\\n总是很难抢到想要的东西！: You were a huge help!\nThis mega sale is a battlefield every time...\nIt's always hard to grab what I want!
strings.哈、哈……有、有阿克娅大人帮忙，\\n这种事根本是小菜一碟！\\n只要阿尔克能满: Hah, hah... W-With Lady Aqua helping,\nthis kind of thing is a piece of cake!\nAs long as you're happy, Alk—
strings.那么，该去下一个地方了！: Now, on to the next place!
strings.呼……好舒服，\\n自我堕落最棒了……: Whew... This feels great,\nbeing a total slob is the best...
strings.这也都是……\\n多亏了……阿克娅还有和真……: It's all... thanks to...\nAqua and Kazuma...
strings.和、和真！\\n还是叫阿尔克来帮忙吧！: K-Kazuma!\nLet's just wake Alk up and get him to help!
strings.不能放弃，阿克娅！\\n你忘了我们的目标吗！: Don't give up, Aqua!\nHave you forgotten our goal!
strings.对了。\\n今天要让阿尔克好好地撒娇才行！: Right.\nToday we have to let Alk be properly pampered!
strings.阿尔克平日总是那么努力，\\n绝对不允许你们打扰他午睡！: Alk always works so hard,\nso we won't let you disturb his nap!
strings.好好尝尝女神的怒火吧！\\n神之一击——: Taste the wrath of a goddess!\nGod Blow—
strings.太好了，和真，干掉了！\\n这样就能守护好阿尔克的睡眠——: Yes, Kazuma, we got it!\nNow we can protect Alk's sleep—
strings.果、果然还是把阿尔克叫起来吧！\\n和真————: L-Let's wake Alk up after all!\nKazumaaa—
strings.你刚才的决心呢！\\n你这个废物女神——: What happened to your resolve!\nYou useless goddess—
strings.哎呀，多亏有你们，\\n我睡得超舒服呢！: Wow, thanks to you two,\nI slept super well!
strings.哎呀……哈哈哈……\\n我们做这些是为了什么来着的……: Ahh... Hahaha...\nWhat were we doing all this for again...
strings.真的谢谢你们了，阿克娅、和真。: Thank you so much, Aqua, Kazuma.
strings.那么——\\n去买了新盘子再回去吧！: Now then—\nlet's buy a new plate before we head home!
strings.这个嘛，唔。\\n我就是觉得，\\n偶尔换我来耍耍你们也挺不错的~？: Well, hmm.\nI just thought it'd be nice\nto be the one messing with you for a change~?
strings.诶、哈~~~？\\n会把人耍得团团转的明明只有阿克娅吧？！: Wha, huuuh~~~?\nAqua's supposed to be the only one who messes with people, right?!
strings.给我等下！明明是和真搞砸的啊！: Hold on! Kazuma's the one who messed up!
strings.我想顺便再买点晚饭的食材。\\n你们想吃什么？: I want to pick up ingredients for dinner while we're at it.\nWhat would you like?
strings.阿尔克特制的碎肉洋葱欧姆蛋！: Alk's special minced meat and onion omelet!
strings.你都让我们干了这么多活，\\n今天的欧姆蛋得比平时好吃才行~！: After making us do all that work,\ntoday's omelet better be tastier than usual~!
strings.阿克娅小姐。\\n你们还是没找到回去的办法吗？: Miss Aqua.\nStill no luck finding a way back?
strings.是啊！\\n本阿克娅大人都这么拼命了，\\n为什么还是回不去啦，太过分了吧？！: Nope!\nThe great Lady Aqua is trying so hard,\nso why can't we go back? It's so unfair?!
strings.你拼了什么命啊。\\n你只会拉着不死者到处跑，\\n你这个废物女神。: What have you been trying so hard at?\nAll you do is drag undead around everywhere,\nyou useless goddess.
strings.提、提那个干什么啦。\\n说到底，我贵为女神大人，\\n为什么会穿越到异世界啦，: Wh-Why bring that up!\nAnyway, why would an exalted goddess like me\nend up transported to another world? It's absurd!
strings.女神大人？\\n就你这老抱着个大瓶子\\n睡得东倒西歪的家伙？: Goddess?\nYou, who sleeps sprawled all over the place\nhugging a giant bottle?
strings.唔，我们身处的世界不一样，\\n肯定很多东西都不一样……: Well, the worlds we're from are different,\nso lots of things must be different too...
strings.为什么大家都不相信我是女神啦！: Why won't anyone believe I'm a goddess!
strings.归根结底，\\n这个世界就没有阿克西斯教啊？: When it comes down to it,\nthis world doesn't even have the Axis Church, does it?
strings.所以，怎么可能有人相信你是女神——: So how could anyone believe you're a goddess—
strings.怎么看都被不像啊……: That doesn't look like it at all...
strings.真没礼貌啊！\\n他们可是打从心底相信我是女神，\\n而且由衷地尊敬着我呢！: How rude!\nThey believe with all their hearts that I'm a goddess,\nand they respect me from the bottom of their hearts!
strings.没错！我们乃女神阿克娅大人的后援会！\\n我们会一生追随阿克娅大人！: That's right! We are the fan club of the goddess Lady Aqua!\nWe'll follow Lady Aqua for the rest of our lives!
strings.他刚才说的是后援会没错吧？: He did just say fan club, right?
strings.来吧，今天也来开宴会吧！\\n一起饱餐一顿、畅饮一番！: Come on, let's have a feast today too!\nLet's eat our fill and drink to our hearts' content!
strings.阿、阿克娅大人……非常抱歉，\\n我得先告辞了！: L-Lady Aqua... I'm so sorry,\nbut I have to take my leave!
strings.发、发生什么事了？\\n你不是平时吃得最开心了吗！: Wh-What happened?\nAren't you usually the one who eats the happiest!
strings.我一直装作没注意到——\\n但是，终于连我的恋人都说，\\n我的小肚子现在……软: I've been pretending not to notice—\nbut finally, even my sweetheart said\nmy tummy is now... all soft and squishy!
strings.所以，我目前正在减肥！\\n我要努力节食，\\n争取拥有阿克娅大人那样美丽的身材: So, I'm on a diet right now!\nI'm going to watch what I eat\nand aim for a beautiful figure like Lady Aqua's—
strings.等、等一下，阿克娅，\\n她肯定是想努力自律……: W-Wait a sec, Aqua,\nshe's obviously trying to discipline herself...
strings.为什么要自律呀？\\n为什么要否定自己真正的愿望和幸福呢，\\n根本不需要那么做: Why discipline yourself?\nWhy deny your true wishes and happiness?\nThere's no need for that at all.
strings.就算这个世界和你的恋人无法原谅，\\n我也会宽恕你。: Even if this world and your sweetheart can't forgive you,\nI will forgive you.
strings.去热爱你所爱之物吧。\\n尽管遵循你的心，去大吃大喝吧。\\n尽管……崇敬我吧！: Love what you love.\nFollow your heart, eat and drink all you want.\nAnd... worship me all you want!
strings.阿克娅大人……非常感谢您！\\n我也要参加宴会！！: Lady Aqua... thank you so much!\nI'm joining the feast too!!
strings.这样才对嘛！\\n不如把你的恋人也带上，\\n让他也了解享用美食的幸福吧！: That's more like it!\nWhy not bring your sweetheart along too,\nand let him learn the joy of good food!
strings.她会长胖……都因为阿克娅吧？\\n都得怪阿克娅天天拉她开宴会吧？: She's gaining weight... because of Aqua, right?\nIsn't it Aqua's fault for dragging her to feasts every day?
strings.白，拜托了，\\n太麻烦了，别去思考了。: Nimbus, please,\nit's too much trouble, don't think about it.
strings.哼哼。\\n这下你们见识到我的女神风范了吧？\\n赶紧赶紧，你们也快来加入阿克西: Hmph hmph.\nNow you've seen my goddess-like grace, haven't you?\nHurry, hurry, you should all join the Axis Church too—
strings.为什么当场否决啦！: Why'd you turn me down on the spot!
strings.史黛拉——\\n我就知道你愿意！: Stellaaa—\nI knew you'd be up for it!
strings.我决定了！\\n我要在这个世界建立第二个阿克西斯教团！: I've decided!\nI'm going to found a second Axis Church in this world!
strings.神的力量会随着信徒数量和信仰心提升。\\n只要我能获得更多力量，\\n我们就一定: A god's power grows with the number of believers and their faith.\nAs long as I gain more power,\nwe'll definitely be able to go back to our world!
strings.你、你说的是真的吗？\\n但你们的世界和这里并非——: A-Are you serious?\nBut your world and this one aren't—
strings.绝对没问题！\\n各位，请信任我、追随我吧！: It'll definitely work!\nEveryone, trust me and follow me!
strings.我可是女神阿克娅大人啊！: I am the goddess, Lady Aqua!
strings.什么叫绝对没问题！\\n为什么我也得遭殃不可啊！: What do you mean it'll definitely work!\nWhy do I have to suffer for it too!
strings.大、大家只是在热情地帮我传教而已啦！\\n你看他们还帮我印了传单！: E-Everyone's just enthusiastically helping me spread the word!\nLook, they even printed flyers for me!
strings.“只需签名入教，\\n便可天天幸福！天天幸运！\\n包你百病不侵、魅力四射！”…: "Just sign up to join,\nand be happy every day! Lucky every day!\nGuaranteed immunity to all illness, and irresistible charm!"...
strings.这简直跟可疑的推销员没两样嘛……: That's no different from a shady salesman...
strings.至少这次没被逮捕，\\n还算好吧。: At least we didn't get arrested this time.\nThat's something, I guess.
strings.不好！一点都不好！: It's not! It's not good at all!
strings.各位，请听我说几句！\\n请你们今后换种方法传教……: Everyone, please listen to me!\nFrom now on, please find another way to spread the faith...
strings.奇怪……怎么比平常少了好几个人？: That's strange... There are several fewer people than usual.
strings.哦，他们啊，\\n他们好像去推别的女孩子了。: Oh, them?\nI think they went off to stan some other girl.
strings.你说什么——\\n他们怎么敢抛下女神，去找别的女孩子！: What did you say—\nHow dare they abandon a goddess for some other girl!
strings.没关系的，阿克娅大人，\\n我们仍然非常喜欢您！\\n您的女神设定也非常有趣！: It's okay, Lady Aqua,\nwe still really like you!\nYour goddess bit is really fun too!
strings.那不是设定啦！\\n原来你是这么想的吗？！: It's not a bit!\nSo that's what you thought?!
strings.哎呀，怎么说好呢……\\n阿克娅还真是厉害啊。: Well, how should I put this...\nAqua really is something else.
strings.这下你明白了吧，阿尔克。\\n她不仅是个究极废物女神，\\n还是个大麻烦制造机…: Now you get it, Alk.\nShe's not just the ultimate useless goddess,\nshe's a walking trouble factory...
strings.呃、唔……\\n这称呼我不能苟同……\\n不过……唔……: Uh, hmm...\nI can't agree with that label...\nBut... hmm...
strings.哎，这样不也挺好的吗？\\n反正他们双方都没有恶意。: Eh, isn't this fine?\nNeither side means any harm, anyway.
strings.阿克娅大人是我们推心置腹的朋友~\\n不过，要说崇拜和尊敬，\\n好像还是不太一: Lady Aqua is our dear friend~\nBut when it comes to worship and respect,\nthat's a bit different, I guess~
strings.呜哇啊啊啊啊啊！\\n阿尔克，你们一定和他们不一样吧？！\\n你们一定很尊敬我吧: Waaaaaaaah!\nAlk, you guys aren't like them, right?!\nYou respect me, don't you?!
strings.这个嘛，唔……\\n还是再帮你们找找别的回去的办法吧。: Well, hmm...\nLet's keep looking for another way to get you home.
strings.什么嘛！都来崇拜我啊！\\n都来多宠宠我嘛！: What's that supposed to mean! Worship me, all of you!\nSpoil me more!
strings.好不容易能回来了……\\n为什么又——\\n不对，一定是那个荷官出千了——: I finally made it back...\nso why again—\nNo, the dealer must've been cheating—
strings.真是的，\\n这里的治安比帕尔佩布拉还差啊。: Geez,\nthis place is even more lawless than Palpebra.
strings.真的只靠身体能力躲开了啊……\\n好强。看来那样是打不中的啊。: He really dodged it on physical ability alone...\nImpressive. Looks like I can't hit him like that.
strings.目标已清除！\\n可以了，走吧，“死神”！\\n那头老虎厉害得很！别管他！: Target eliminated!\nThat's enough, let's go, "Reaper"!\nThat tiger's dangerous! Leave him be!
strings.啧……怎么一个劲地对我开火啊！: Tch... Why does she keep firing at me!
strings.喂！可恶……那个白痴女人……\\n夏琳——快回答！\\n夏——琳————: Hey! Dammit... that idiot woman...\nCharlene—answer me!\nChar—leeene—
strings.好快……\\n连这样都打不中。: So fast...\nCan't hit him even like this.
strings.哇，被绕后了。你还会说话？\\n好厉害啊……: Whoa, you got behind me. And you can talk?\nThat's amazing...
strings.不过，“狙击手都不擅长近战”……\\n那种观点可是偏见哦。\\n虽然形势……确实: But "snipers are bad at close combat"...\nthat's a prejudice, you know.\nThough the situation... is definitely not in my favor.
strings.你想搞什么？\\n我应该没做什么招惹你的事吧？: What are you after?\nI don't think I did anything to provoke you.
strings.你躲过了我的狙击……\\n那就是理由。: You dodged my shot...\nThat's reason enough.
strings.来吧……\\n来快乐地战斗吧。: Come on...\nLet's have a fun fight.
strings.有完没完！\\n民间警察也出动了！\\n赶紧！给我！回来！！！: Enough already!\nThe civil police are here!\nHurry up! And! Get back here!!!
strings.是吗，你被“死神”缠上了啊。\\n真是灾难。: I see, so the "Reaper" latched onto you.\nWhat a disaster.
strings.她是地下社会的人。\\n毕竟感质之城中企业的争斗\\n往往不会为大众所知啊。: She's from the underworld.\nCorporate conflicts in Qualia City\nrarely become public knowledge.
strings.“死神”夏琳……\\n能从三千米外射中目标的怪物。\\n应该丝毫不逊色于你那儿的: Charlene the "Reaper"...\nA monster who can hit a target from three thousand meters away.\nI'd say she's every bit as good as your people.
strings.不过，听说她性格阴晴不定。\\n甚至会为了自己的兴趣放弃任务。: But I hear she's moody.\nShe'll even abandon a mission for her own amusement.
strings.哈？那样真的干得下去吗？: Huh? Can she really get by like that?
strings.啊……这是广告烟。\\n只是水蒸气而已……你不喜欢吗？\\n那我不抽了。: Ah... This is an ad vape.\nIt's just water vapor... You don't like it?\nThen I'll stop.
strings.别一副和我们很熟的样子凑过来啊……: Don't come sidling up like we're old pals...
strings.都在战场上交过手了……\\n所以是朋友？: We've fought on the battlefield...\nSo that makes us friends?
strings.呵呵……毛茸茸的。\\n不过稍微有点糙啊，\\n要不要帮你洗洗？: Heh heh... So fluffy.\nBut it's a little rough.\nWant me to wash it for you?
strings.第一，完全不懂你想干什么。\\n第二，我不吃这套。\\n第三，赶紧说正事。: One, I have no idea what you're after.\nTwo, that doesn't work on me.\nThree, get to the point.
strings.唔……\\n我只是想知道你的秘密而已。: Hmm...\nI just want to know your secret.
strings.一千五百米——\\n在那距离内我必定能一击毙命。\\n但你却躲过去了，为什么？: Fifteen hundred meters—\nwithin that range, I never fail to kill in one shot.\nBut you dodged it. Why?
strings.凭感觉？喔？\\n这是企业秘密吗？: Instinct? Oh?\nIs that a trade secret?
strings.行吧。\\n反正只要再在战场碰面，\\n总能搞清楚的。: Fine.\nAs long as we meet on the battlefield again,\nI'll figure it out eventually.
strings.你下次会在哪里战斗？\\n我也想去。: Where are you fighting next?\nI want to go too.
strings.不知道你误会什么了，\\n但我不是你的同行啊。: I don't know what you've got the wrong idea about,\nbut I'm not in your line of work.
strings.那没法再和你战斗了吗？: So I can't fight you again?
strings.很遗憾。\\n我可是和平主义者啊。\\n恕我没法当你的对手。: Sorry to say.\nI'm a pacifist, you see.\nI can't be your opponent.
strings.既然是一般人就没办法了。\\n抱歉啊，把你卷进来。\\n下次来和平地喝一杯吧。: If you're just a regular person, it can't be helped.\nSorry for dragging you into this.\nLet's have a peaceful drink next time.
strings.我听说你结婚了啊。\\n你妻子能允许这种行为吗？: I heard you're married.\nDoes your wife allow this sort of thing?
strings.我没结婚啊！\\n你听谁说的？！: I'm not married!\nWho told you that?!
strings.可恶……\\n那群混账就会拿我开涮……: Dammit...\nThose jerks just love making fun of me...
strings.不过，战斗狂里也有\\n那种奇怪的家伙啊……: Still, even among battle maniacs\nthere are some weird ones...
strings.希望你救救我。: I'd like you to save me.
strings.在主干道上开火也没关系！\\n一定要把那家伙干掉！: It's fine to open fire on the main street!\nTake her out no matter what!
strings.我太任意妄为结果还是惹人生气了。\\n我需要能帮我藏身的人。\\n具体希望你能介: I went too far doing as I pleased and made people angry after all.\nI need someone to help me hide.\nSpecifically, I'd like you to introduce me to the Lunus Civil Police Force.
strings.唉~~~~~……\\n你竟然会找我帮忙啊……: Sigh~~~~~...\nOf all people, you come to me for help...
strings.跟我来吧……\\n带你去个比民间警察厉害得多的安全屋。\\n你可别被吓着了啊。: Come with me...\nI'll take you to a safe house way better than the civil police.\nJust don't freak out.
strings.原来如此……很有趣啊？: I see... Sounds fun, doesn't it?
strings.反正那家伙肯定会欢迎你的。\\n在事情过去前就随你待吧。\\n我要走了。: That guy's sure to welcome you anyway.\nStay as long as you like until things blow over.\nI'm off.
strings.不过……\\n挑对手的时候记得长点眼啊。: But...\nwatch who you pick fights with.
strings.有些家伙真的很难缠，\\n劝你别随便招惹他们啊。: Some of them are real trouble,\nso I'd advise against messing with them.
strings.真是的——♡\\n就算我不是喜欢束缚别人的人，\\n你也不能总是一下就跑没影——: Geez—♡\nI may not be the clingy type,\nbut you can't keep vanishing at the drop of a hat—
strings.很有趣的猎物啊？\\n来试试看吧。: Interesting prey, huh?\nLet's give it a try.
strings.你很强啊……自然人能做到这样？\\n虽然白也是啦，吓我一大跳呢。: You're strong... A natural can do this?\nThough Nimbus is the same, he gave me quite a shock.
strings.啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！\\n为什么要往白身上凑啊！！！\\n杀了你杀了你杀了你杀: Aaaaaaaaaaaah!\nWhy are you getting close to Nimbus!!!\nI'll kill you I'll kill you I'll kill you I'll kill you!!!!
strings.怎么偏偏……遇上了最糟的家伙……\\n不行了……不想思考了……: Why... of all people, the worst one...\nIt's no use... I don't want to think anymore...
strings.然后，然后，查特丽娜！\\n爸爸他们说了，炎血魔女会守护大家的！: And then, and then, Chatrina!\nDad and the others said the Witch of Burning Blood will protect everyone!
strings.啊……天快黑了呢。\\n该回帐篷里了吧。: Ah... It's getting dark.\nTime to go back to the tent, right?
strings.啊哈哈，我知道的啦~\\n但明天再聊也行嘛？: Ahaha, I know~\nBut we can talk again tomorrow, right?
strings.但那孩子……却没能迎来明天。: But that child... never got to see tomorrow.
strings.我们拥有的，一定只有现在。\\n所以，我——: All we have is surely the present.\nSo I—
strings.他的名字是萨姆，就住在你附近。\\n你们是来这个世界的第二天认识的。: His name is Sam, and he lives near you.\nYou met on your second day in this world.
strings.他非常认真，非常努力，\\n一直在尽心尽力帮忙开拓。\\n现在已经是大家可靠的大: He's very earnest and hardworking,\nand has given his all to the settlement work.\nNow he's a reliable big brother to everyone.
strings.但不说别的，你会喜欢上他，\\n是因为他温柔又稳重还愿意听你说话——: But above all, the reason you fell for him\nis that he's kind and steady and willing to listen to you—
strings.嘿嘿嘿，今天我也来找你聊天了！\\n你脸上的笑容和种花那天不一样了呢~？: Hee hee hee, I've come to chat with you again today!\nYour smile's different from the day we planted flowers~?
strings.真、真是的！查特丽娜！\\n你怎么会知道这么多啊！: G-Geez! Chatrina!\nHow do you know so much!
strings.可别小瞧了前谍报员啊。\\n而且，宝拉很好懂嘛！: Don't underestimate a former spy.\nBesides, you're easy to read, Paula!
strings.那么那么，实际上怎么样呢？\\n我看刚才的氛围就很不错嘛？\\n你不打算向他告白: So, so, how's it really going?\nThe mood just now looked pretty good, right?\nAren't you going to confess to him?
strings.诶~不嫌弃的话，我可以帮忙哦。\\n毕竟我现在的工作就是帮助大家嘛！: Eh~ If you don't mind, I can help.\nHelping everyone is my job now, after all!
strings.而且，现在连人类和魔族\\n都能举办婚礼了呢。\\n所以，你想怎么做可以哦~: Besides, these days even humans and fiends\ncan hold weddings together.\nSo you can do whatever you want~
strings.没关系的……\\n我只要维持现状就好。: It's okay...\nI just want to keep things as they are.
strings.能和他说上话，我就已经很幸福了。\\n哪怕是世界马上就要毁灭也没关系！\\n大概: Just being able to talk with him makes me happy.\nEven if the world were about to end, I'd be fine!\nProbably...
strings.哎呀~你根本是在秀恩爱嘛！\\n真是的，真是的~！: Oh my~ You're totally gushing about him!\nGeez, geez~!
strings.不过，我明白能说上话这点。\\n能不留遗憾地尽情和人聊天真的最棒了。: But I get the part about being able to talk.\nTalking with someone to your heart's content with no regrets really is the best.
strings.嘿嘿……是啊，确实是呢！: Hee hee... Yeah, it really is!
strings.所以，这样就够了。\\n就算要分开，我也不会觉得难过。: So, this is enough.\nEven if we have to part, I won't be sad.
strings.毕竟我根本没法和他约定什么啊……: After all, I can't make him any promises...
strings.是的。\\n我们正在探讨其他的移居地方案。\\n目标是一座名为旧矿山城的岛屿。: Yes.\nWe're considering other places to settle.\nThe target is an island called Miner's Front.
strings.预计会先派出以研究主任\\n为中心的少数人组成的先遣队……\\n其中确实有名为萨: We plan to send a small advance team\nled by the head researcher first...\nAnd there is indeed someone named Sam on it.
strings.人们还没有在这里完全稳定下来，\\n将人员分散真的没问题吗？: People haven't fully settled in here yet.\nIs it really okay to split them up?
strings.正因为如此。\\n若是积极引入异世界的技术，\\n也能让这里发展得更为迅速吧。: That's exactly why.\nIf we actively bring in technology from other worlds,\nthis place can develop faster too.
strings.我不打算止步于这个世界。\\n我想要创造更多能让我们选择的未来。: I don't intend to stop at this world.\nI want to create more futures for us to choose from.
strings.没、没什么！\\n这也是为了人民嘛。: N-Never mind!\nIt's for the people, after all.
strings.嗯，没错。这是非常好的！\\n如果有什么我能帮忙的——: Yes, that's right. It's a wonderful thing!\nIf there's anything I can do to help—
strings.没什么，我们只是来和你“聊天”。\\n当然，前提是你愿意聊的话。: It's nothing, we just came to "chat" with you.\nOnly if you're willing, of course.
strings.谢谢你们……\\n你们真的是群很温柔的人呢。: Thank you...\nYou really are such kind people.
strings.我听宝拉说……萨姆邀请她了。\\n问她“要不要一起去旧矿山城”。: I heard from Paula... Sam invited her.\nHe asked her "Do you want to come to Miner's Front with me?"
strings.但她拒绝了……\\n她说，她不想再失去什么。: But she turned him down...\nShe said she doesn't want to lose anything else.
strings.反正一切最后都会消失……\\n只要还能在分别前开心地聊天就够了。\\n她是这么和: Everything disappears in the end anyway...\nAs long as they can talk happily before they part, that's enough.\nThat's what she told me...
strings.你觉得……你能理解她的心情？: Do you think... you understand how she feels?
strings.曾经，我和朋友约好明天再见……\\n但那个朋友，却在那天离开了。: Once, I promised a friend I'd see her tomorrow...\nBut that friend left that very day.
strings.既然如此……\\n只要不把话留到明天就好了。: In that case...\nI just shouldn't leave any words for tomorrow.
strings.只要今天，只要现在就好。\\n只要把想说的都说出来，\\n那就算没有明天也无所谓: Just today, just now is enough.\nAs long as I say everything I want to say,\nit doesn't matter if there's no tomorrow—
strings.啊哈哈……我到底在烦恼什么呢？: Ahaha... What am I even worrying about?
strings.我的想法明明和宝拉一样。\\n我根本没有立场去劝她啊……: I think the same way Paula does.\nI'm in no position to persuade her...
strings.还有很多明天，很多未来！: There are still lots of tomorrows, lots of futures!
strings.是查特丽娜和大家，创造了未来哦！: You and everyone, Chatrina, made the future!
strings.我们有东西想让你看……\\n你能跟我们来一下吗？: There's something we want to show you...\nCan you come with us for a bit?
strings.这就是能创造明天的景象。\\n我想，这么说应该不为过吧？: This is a view that creates tomorrow.\nI don't think that's an overstatement, do you?
strings.我听说了，耕种完田地之后，\\n你也一直在帮助大家，\\n还去别的世界学习了培育: I heard that after you finished plowing the fields,\nyou kept helping everyone,\nand even went to other worlds to learn how to grow crops.
strings.他们今后也一定会坚强地生活下去。\\n不论失去什么，失去多少次，\\n都一定能创: They'll surely keep living strong from now on.\nNo matter what they lose, or how many times,\nthey'll surely make a present that leads to tomorrow—
strings.是你和宝拉创造出了这一切啊。: You and Paula made all of this.
strings.只是……只是不想让自己后悔，\\n想去做自己力所能及的事而已。: I just... just didn't want any regrets,\nand wanted to do whatever I could.
strings.你说了那么多，\\n告诉了我们那么多。\\n那我要反过来问你。: You've said so much,\ntold us so much.\nSo now let me ask you.
strings.查特丽娜，\\n你真正想要的就只有现在吗？: Chatrina,\nis the present really all you want?
strings.原来我是想……\\n到了明天也能和大家聊天啊？: So what I wanted was...\nto keep talking with everyone tomorrow too?
strings.嗯，多亏了你们！\\n真的非常谢谢，二位。: Yes, thanks to you two!\nThank you so much.
strings.为了明天——\\n我要去找她聊天了！: For tomorrow's sake—\nI'm going to go talk with her!
strings.喂，春日，先往后撤一点！: Hey, Haruhi, fall back a bit!
strings.没看到朝比奈学姐为了给你回血\\n都快把MP用完了吗！: Can't you see Miss Asahina's almost out of MP\nfrom healing you!
strings.啊！春日你小子！\\n你竟然拿我挡枪？！: Ah! Haruhi, you!\nYou used me as a shield?!
strings.这下糟了啊，\\n朝比奈学姐，快复活他。: Well, this is bad.\nMiss Asahina, revive him, quick.
strings.不行，不能浪费MP。\\n战斗总是会伴随着牺牲，\\n就别管阿虚了。: No, we can't waste MP.\nSacrifices are part of battle,\njust forget about Kyon.
strings.好了，让它尝尝SOS团的厉害吧！\\n该分出胜负了！: All right, let's show it what the SOS Brigade can do!\nTime to settle this!
strings.还挺有趣的嘛！\\n这个叫什么什么世界的游戏！: This is pretty fun!\nThis game called World-something!
strings.名字是什么都无所谓啦！\\n你不觉得这种以合作为卖点的游戏\\n正适合我们SOS: Who cares what it's called!\nDon't you think a game all about teamwork\nis perfect for our SOS Brigade?
strings.（喂，刚才的战斗里哪里有“合作”啊？\\n你是不是把合作和“独大”搞混了啊！）: (Hey, where was the "teamwork" in that last fight?\nAren't you mixing up teamwork and "one-woman show"!)
strings.偶尔来一段充满幻想的冒险\\n也很不错啊！: A fantasy-filled adventure\nnow and then is pretty nice!
strings.哎呀，要是真能去那样的世界\\n一定会更加有趣的吧。: Ah, if we could really go to a world like that,\nit'd be even more fun.
strings.好了，各位！\\n就按这个势头把下一个迷宫的BOSS也——: All right, everyone!\nAt this rate, let's take down the next labyrinth's boss too—
strings.哎呀……真是遗憾，\\n看来今天只能玩到这里了呢。: Oh dear... What a shame.\nIt seems we can only play this far today.
strings.可恶！明明玩得正开心呢……\\n能不能现在马上申请在社团过夜啊？: Dammit! Just when it was getting fun...\nCan't we apply for an overnight club stay right now?
strings.行了，别异想天开了。\\n没人会同意这种申请啊，\\n而且大家都没做好在外留宿的: Come on, quit dreaming.\nNobody's going to approve that,\nand nobody's prepared to stay out overnight—
strings.阿虚你烦死了！\\n我知道的啦，只是随口一说而已！: You're so annoying, Kyon!\nI know, I was just saying it!
strings.那就明天再继续玩吧，\\n大家都要记得把游戏带好哦！: Then we'll keep playing tomorrow.\nEveryone remember to bring the game!
strings.我说啊，古泉……\\n我现在有种非常非常不好的预感……: Hey, Koizumi...\nI've got a really, really bad feeling right now...
strings.我就说吧，果然是这样！\\n可恶啊！: I knew it, it's exactly what I thought!\nDammit!
strings.这里是什么地方？\\n这把武器又是什么啊？: Where is this?\nAnd what's this weapon?
strings.我们也在呢。\\n当然了，凉宫同学也在。: We're here too.\nAnd of course, so is Suzumiya.
strings.她已经兴奋得不行，\\n自己跑出去探险了呢。: She got so excited\nshe ran off exploring on her own.
strings.这样吗……\\n所以这里到底是哪儿？\\n又是春日创造出来的那个空间吗？: I see...\nSo where on earth are we?\nIs this another one of those spaces Haruhi created?
strings.不，这里并不是闭锁空间。: No, this is not a closed space.
strings.但是……也并非完全不一样……\\n长门同学怎么看呢？: But... it's not completely different either...\nWhat do you think, Nagato?

strings.综上所述，\\n这里并非是任何我们已知的空间。: In summary,\nthis is not any space known to us.

strings.来吧。来吧。来吧。来吧。: Come on. Come on. Come on. Come on.
strings.那边那位！这里很危险！\\n请你赶快逃吧！: You there! It's dangerous here!\nPlease run, quickly!
strings.唉，真的有妖怪冒出来了啊……: Sigh, so yokai really have started popping up...
strings.哎呀，唔，这下确实有点不妙啊？: Oh dear, well, this is a bit of a problem, eh?
strings.所以我都说了……\\n您的画会改变世界啊。: I told you...\nYour paintings change the world.
strings.拜托您为我们争取时间了。\\n您可要好好收拾自己的烂摊子啊，Z阁下？: Please buy us some time.\nYou'd better clean up your own mess, Mr. Z.
strings.也就是说，因为我画了妖怪，\\n所以之后也有妖怪冒出来？: So because I painted yokai,\nyokai started showing up afterward?
strings.我们已经简单处理过了。\\n不过，法兰德也发生了同样的事。: We've dealt with it for now.\nBut the same thing has happened in the Farlands.
strings.哎呀哎呀，你们可别骗人。\\n我只是个画师啊？\\n和你们阴阳师不一样——: Oh, come now, don't pull my leg.\nI'm just a painter, see?\nNot a diviner like you lot—
strings.以前也发生过类似的事吧？\\n而且当时，您也使用了能力吧？: Something similar happened before, didn't it?\nAnd back then, you used your power too, right?
strings.但、但是啊，\\n我的力量并不能持续很久，\\n那些妖怪很快就会砰的消失啊？: B-But, you see,\nmy power doesn't last very long.\nThose yokai vanish with a poof in no time, right?
strings.您的画会改变世界的构成。: Your paintings alter the very makeup of the world.
strings.本来，人们的基础观念非常牢固。\\n但是，您的画会直击他们的内心……: Normally, people's basic beliefs are firmly rooted.\nBut your paintings strike straight at their hearts...
strings.而且，那些妖怪已经危害到人类了啊？: And those yokai are already harming people, you know?
strings.我之前还以为……\\n那只是醉汉的酒后戏言呢。\\n没想到有行家来鉴定真伪了。: I thought...\nthat was just a drunk's ramblings.\nDidn't expect experts to come verify it.
strings.好吧……我知道了啦！\\n那我该怎么做才好，小子？: Fine... I get it!\nSo what should I do, kid?
strings.先把那些烂摊子收拾了。\\n再谈之后的事。: First, clean up the mess.\nThen we'll talk about what comes next.
strings.嗯！自己惹出的事得自己解决啊！: Yep! I've gotta clean up my own mess!
strings.呼……这下就暂时解决了……: Whew... That settles it for now...
strings.您究竟拥有多强的影响力，\\n这下您能明白了吧，Z阁下？: Do you understand now just how great\nyour influence is, Mr. Z?
strings.那玩意儿确实不太妙啊……\\n真叫人头疼。: That thing really is bad news...\nWhat a headache.
strings.首先，您不能再随便使用能力。\\n然后，请带上这个。: First, you can no longer use your power carelessly.\nNext, please take this.
strings.这是用于封印的护符。\\n如果您仅仅是想要画画，\\n那它多少能抑制您的力量。: It's a sealing charm.\nIf you only want to paint,\nit should suppress your power somewhat.
strings.哦哦。\\n那我应该能继续画画了吧？: Oh ho.\nSo I can keep painting, then?
strings.暂时应该没问题。\\n但随着时间的推移……不，\\n往后，您的力量会愈发体现在画: It should be fine for now. But as time passes... no,\nfrom here on, your power will show\nmore and more in your paintings.
strings.即便如此，您也要继续画画吗？: Even so, will you keep painting?
strings.我没法停下笔啊……: I can't put down my brush...
strings.只有这件事，我不能放弃。\\n那就是我啊……: That's the one thing I can't give up.\nThat's who I am...
strings.不过，就现实层面来说……\\n我还是有一点疑问啊……: Still, speaking practically...\nI do have one question...
strings.毕竟，画作会改变人，\\n这件事不是理所当然的吗？: Isn't it only natural\nthat paintings change people?
strings.世事无常。世界永远在变化。\\n既然如此，亲手去改变它……\\n也没什么不好吧？: Nothing stays the same. The world is always changing.\nIn that case, changing it with my own hands...\nisn't such a bad thing, is it?
strings.呃，我不是想推卸责任！\\n就是感觉，只要找好时机——: Uh, I'm not trying to dodge responsibility!\nI just feel like if we pick the right moment—
strings.哈哈哈哈哈哈……\\n您究竟多痴迷于作画啊？: Hahahahahaha...\nJust how obsessed with painting are you?
strings.好吧，汝就随心所欲去做吧。\\n尽管去改变世界。: Very well, do as thou pleasest.\nGo and change the world all thou likest.
strings.你是、狐狸小姑娘……不对啊？\\n你是什么人？: You're the little fox girl... no, wait?\nWho are you?
strings.吾的女儿受你照顾了啊？\\n画师老先生。: Thou hast been looking after my daughter, hast thou not?\nOld painter.
strings.你难道是……\\n传说中的大妖怪，\\n白面金毛九尾狐？！: Could you be...\nthe legendary great yokai,\nthe Golden Fox, She of Nine Tails?!
strings.小子，吾改主意了。\\n之前那新的约定作废了。: Boy, I have changed my mind.\nThat new pact of ours is void.
strings.我本想请她统合妖怪。\\n就像我们想要统一东西那样——: I'd hoped to have her unite the yokai.\nJust as we seek to unify East and West—
strings.愿望与畏惧，还有混沌。\\n吾等正是从那其中诞生的。\\n既然如此，为何要加以阻: Wishes, fear, and chaos.\nThat is what we are born from.\nSo why stand in the way?
strings.如果实在需要帮忙，就去找吾的女儿。\\n但汝等也只能像蠢货那样搅乱世间吧。: If thou truly needest help, go to my daughter.\nThough thou canst only stir up the world like fools.
strings.不过，也确实……\\n还是她的做法比较适合这里啊。\\n戏剧之类的，电影之类的。: Still, she has a point...\nHer way does suit this place better.\nPlays and such, films and such.
strings.那我就能画新的画了吗？\\n那样倒也有趣——: So I can paint new pictures, then?\nThat might be fun—
strings.是吗……找狐狸小姑娘啊。\\n倒也不错啊。: I see... The little fox girl, eh?\nNot bad at all.
strings.那就稍微找她帮帮忙吧？: Then shall we ask her for a little help?
strings.也是呢。\\n我觉得这个主意不坏哦。: Sure.\nI don't think that's a bad idea.
strings.很可爱的兽人孩子啊。\\n真的要把这幅画拿去卖吗？: What a cute beastfolk child.\nAre you really going to sell this painting?
strings.当然。这可是演员肖像画。\\n我们要排一场很棒的戏呢。: Of course. It's an actor's portrait.\nWe're putting on a wonderful play.
strings.希望能用它让人与妖共存。: I hope it will help people and yokai coexist.
strings.Z阁下，妖怪们要画得更大一些。\\n这里的人只会把那个狐娘看作兽人，\\n那样一: Mr. Z, draw the yokai bigger.\nPeople here will just see that fox girl as a beastfolk,\nand then it won't work as a curse at all—
strings.知道了知道了！\\n可恶，有委托人在场就是麻烦……: I know, I know!\nDammit, having the client watching is such a pain...
strings.很好，画好了！\\n连我自己都觉得相当不错呢。: All right, done!\nEven I think it turned out pretty well.
strings.原来如此，是在这里选委托啊。\\n这方面倒是和我们的世界相差不多呢。: I see, so this is where you choose requests.\nThat part's not so different from our world.
strings.非常感谢你们。\\n手续之类的我一个人应该也没问题。: Thank you very much.\nI should be fine handling the paperwork by myself.
strings.不过……你们还没有找到回去的办法，\\n就来公会接工作……这样真的好吗？: But... you haven't found a way back yet,\nand you're coming to the Guild for work... Is that really okay?
strings.没事的，总麻烦你们，\\n我心里也很过意不去。: It's fine. I feel bad\ntroubling you all the time.
strings.所以，我们至少得自己养活自己才行。\\n那么，我去了。: So we should at least support ourselves.\nWell then, I'm off.
strings.她还是那么诚挚又踏实啊。\\n就算是在这个世界，\\n她一定也能胜任好工作的。: She's as sincere and steady as ever.\nEven in this world,\nI'm sure she can handle any job.
strings.诚挚吗……\\n你是没看到，才能说得出这种话啊……: Sincere, huh...\nYou can only say that because you haven't seen it...
strings.哎、哎呀，\\n不过，她为人确实很踏实！\\n所以工作上一定不会有问题——: W-Well,\nshe really is a steady person!\nSo I'm sure there won't be any problems at work—
strings.究竟发生什么事了？\\n难道是遇到麻烦了？: What on earth happened?\nDid you run into trouble?
strings.与其说是麻烦，不如说……\\n是这样的，我打算加入冒险者小队，\\n帮助他们探索: It's not so much trouble as...\nwell, I planned to join an adventurer party\nand help them explore the labyrinth—
strings.但其实……我、我太没用了，\\n根本就打不中敌人……: But actually... I-I'm so useless\nI can't hit enemies at all...
strings.根、根本打不中？\\n你一次都没有命中过吗？: C-Can't hit them at all?\nYou've never landed a single hit?
strings.这、这么想来确实，\\n史莱姆事件的时候，\\n你也一直在负责防御啊……: N-Now that I think about it,\nduring the slime incident,\nyou were on defense the whole time...
strings.可能就是因为这个原因，\\n刚开始还有小队愿意接纳我，\\n但之后就一直在吃闭门: That's probably why.\nAt first some parties were willing to take me in,\nbut after that, door after door was shut in my face...
strings.就算是来到了这个世界，\\n身为骑士，我也想要守护他人……: Even in this world,\nas a knight, I want to protect others...
strings.唔……那要不要来分工合作呢？: Hmm... Then how about we split up the work?
strings.哎呀~真是帮大忙了！\\n有骑士大人和冒险者们陪着，\\n我这趟算是安心了！: Ahh~ You're a huge help!\nWith a knight and adventurers by my side,\nI can rest easy on this trip!
strings.您就放心吧，老爷。\\n赌上十字骑士的荣耀， \\n我一定会舍命守护好您的马车！: Please rest assured, sir.\nOn my honor as a Crusader,\nI'll protect your carriage with my life!
strings.嗯，这种防守类型的工作\\n没有人比你更适合了。: Yeah, nobody's better suited\nfor defensive jobs like this than you.
strings.我本来信誓旦旦说要自己想办法，\\n但最后还得靠你们帮助。: I swore I'd figure it out on my own,\nbut in the end I had to rely on your help.
strings.没事啦。\\n这样对我们双方都有利嘛。: It's fine.\nThis works out for both of us.
strings.谢谢你们……\\n我定会尽全力报答这份恩情。: Thank you...\nI'll do my utmost to repay this kindness.
strings.请你们把我当作挡箭牌，\\n尽管使唤我吧！: Use me as a shield,\norder me around as much as you like!
strings.你又这么说，什么挡箭牌啊……\\n我们才不会——: There you go again, a shield...\nWe'd never—
strings.不！请你们拿我当弃子，当牺牲品吧！\\n就算把我扔在魔物之中离去也无妨！: No! Treat me as a pawn, a sacrifice!\nYou may even leave me among the monsters and go!
strings.话说啊，我都不想猜了，\\n没有小队愿意接纳你一定是——: You know, I don't even want to guess,\nbut the reason no party would take you must be—
strings.我来当诱饵！\\n请各位守护好马车！: I'll be the decoy!\nEveryone, protect the carriage!
strings.太、太乱来了！\\n那么多魔物……她一个人怎么行！: Th-That's reckless!\nSo many monsters... she can't take them alone!
strings.我是骑士……是十字骑士！\\n我绝对不会躲在他人身后，受他人保护！: I'm a knight... a Crusader!\nI'll never hide behind others and let them protect me!
strings.不管伤得多重！\\n我都会守护好你——\\n守护同伴到最后一刻！: No matter how badly I'm hurt!\nI'll protect you—\nprotect my comrades to the very end!
strings.达克妮丝……\\n你果然是一位优秀的骑士——: Darkness...\nYou truly are an excellent knight—
strings.啊啊啊……我这副被魔物蹂躏的模样！\\n全被大家看到了！: Ahhh... Me, being ravaged by monsters like this!\nEveryone can see it all!
strings.啊呜！这深入骨髓的冲击……\\n实在是……太棒了！: Ahn! This bone-deep impact...\nIt's simply... wonderful!
strings.去吧，阿尔克、莱特、白！\\n我会留在这里当诱饵，\\n你们就尽管抛下我！走吧！: Go, Alk, Light, Nimbus!\nI'll stay here as the decoy,\njust leave me behind! Go!
strings.唉……要我说，就让她去吧。: Sigh... If you ask me, just let her be.
strings.那毕竟是个人爱好呢……: It's her personal hobby, after all...
strings.等下，不去帮她吗？！\\n喂？！真的不用吗？真的吗？！: Wait, we're not helping her?!\nHey?! Really? Seriously?!
strings.非常感谢你，骑士小姐！\\n你那勇敢挺身战斗的模样……\\n实在是太令我感动了！: Thank you so much, Miss Knight!\nThe way you bravely threw yourself into battle...\nI'm so moved!
strings.不用谢，那是十字骑士该做的。\\n你和你的货物都没事，这就够了。: No need for thanks, it's a Crusader's duty.\nYou and your cargo are safe, that's enough.
strings.那个商人大叔竟然没意识到吗，\\n太强了吧。: That merchant guy didn't even notice?\nImpressive.
strings.也可能是根本不想多思考吧……: Or maybe he just didn't want to think about it...
strings.各位，今天真是谢谢你们了。\\n感觉我今天非常彻底地履行了骑士的职责。: Everyone, thank you for today.\nI feel I fulfilled my duty as a knight very thoroughly.
strings.先不论那是不是骑士的职责……\\n不过我们配合得不错呢？\\n我们也得谢谢你呀！: Whether that's a knight's duty or not...\nwe worked well together, huh?\nWe should thank you too!
strings.是、是吗……\\n能帮上你们，我真的很开心。: R-Really...\nI'm so glad I could help.
strings.啊、嗯。\\n如果再接到类似的工作，\\n就得再拜托你——: Ah, yeah.\nIf we get another job like this,\nwe'll be counting on you again—
strings.没问题，请尽管来找我吧！\\n就算对手是更凶恶的魔物也没问题哦？！: Of course, come to me anytime!\nEven if the foes are even fiercer monsters, no problem?!
strings.被凶恶的魔物们包围、殴打……\\n啊啊啊，实在是让人心痒痒！: Surrounded and beaten by ferocious monsters...\nAhhh, it makes my heart flutter!
strings.哈哈哈，这世上也有勇者大人不懂的领域呢。\\n好了，赶紧回去吃饭吧。: Hahaha, even a hero has realms they don't understand.\nCome on, let's head back and eat.
strings.啊！难道说……\\n你们要把我丢在这片陌生的土地上？！: Ah! Don't tell me...\nyou're going to abandon me in this strange land?!
strings.你？怎么会？！\\n你们上次不还打得你死我活吗？: You? How?!\nWeren't you two trying to kill each other last time?
strings.是吗？\\n但聊过之后发现她很有趣呢。: Were we?\nTurns out she's fun once you talk to her.
strings.你们要办婚礼吗？\\n我得随礼才行啊。: Are you having a wedding?\nI'll need to bring a gift.
strings.婚礼早就办完——不对，不是！\\n求你！别提那个了！\\n我真的不想回忆起来……: The wedding's long over—No, wait!\nPlease! Don't bring that up!\nI really don't want to remember it...
strings.话说！今天你别跟过来啊！\\n我已经有很多小孩要看了！\\n能不能让我一个人待会: Anyway! Don't follow me around today!\nI've already got plenty of kids to babysit!\nCan't you leave me alone for a bit?!
strings.不，今天我有自己的事。\\n真是可惜……: No, I have my own business today.\nWhat a shame...
strings.哎呀呀，各位过得都还好吗！\\n本天才久违地回到星见镇了！: Well, well, how's everyone doing!\nThis genius is back in Starview after so long!
strings.让你久等了，夏琳。\\nPBC开发部的黛妲莉亚来给你送货了！: Sorry to keep you waiting, Charlene.\nDedalia of PBC's development division has your delivery!
strings.你们又是什么时候认识的……: And when did you two meet...
strings.PBC的开发部最近很火呢。\\n我一直很想向他们定制一次看看。: PBC's development division has been hot lately.\nI've always wanted to commission them once.
strings.呵呵呵呵！你真会说话啊。\\n我也最喜欢懂行的孩子了呢！: Heh heh heh heh! You sure know how to talk!\nI love kids who know their stuff!
strings.那么，怎么样呢？\\n能行吗？: So, how is it?\nWill it work?
strings.输出绝对没问题，这点我能保证。\\n不过，真的没问题吗？那可是匹烈马哦。: The output's guaranteed, I promise you that.\nBut are you sure? It's a wild one.
strings.呵呵，我求之不得。\\n赶紧去试射一下吧。: Heh, just what I wanted.\nLet's go test-fire it right away.
strings.先说要去干嘛啊……: Tell me what you're doing first...
strings.帮罗塞莉亚清理海盗。\\n顺便进行试射。\\n很棒吧？: Helping Roselia clear out pirates.\nAnd test-firing along the way.\nSounds great, right?
strings.真受不了……\\n最近又是人鱼，\\n又是蔚蓝弗拉克西斯的。: This is ridiculous...\nLately it's been mermaids,\nand now the Azure Fraxys too.
strings.根本和朱之刃在的时候没区别啊。\\n倒不如说现在我们过得更惨了吧？: It's no different from when the Crimson Blades were around.\nIf anything, we're worse off now, aren't we?
strings.可恶……怎么能输给她们啊！\\n我们才是这片大海的霸主——: Dammit... How can we lose to them!\nWe're the rulers of this sea—
strings.怎、怎么回事？！\\n船怎么了！: Wh-What's going on?!\nWhat happened to the ship!
strings.命中……\\n给他们的船身开了个洞哦。: Hit...\nI put a hole in their hull.
strings.哈哈哈，亏你能打中啊！\\n这枪的反作用力应该很大吧？: Hahaha, I'm amazed you hit it!\nThat gun must have a huge recoil, right?
strings.按常识来思考……\\n要做到这种威力，\\n不如直接上诱导弹。: Thinking about it logically...\nfor that kind of power,\nyou might as well just use guided missiles.
strings.那么，接下来该我们出场了吧？: Now then, I guess it's our turn?
strings.嗯！好了，人鱼海盗团！\\n该上了哦！: Yeah! All right, Mermaid Pirates!\nLet's go!
strings.唉……\\n你们几个……玩得真开心啊……: Sigh...\nYou lot... sure are having fun...
strings.现在……\\n可能是我人生中最开心的时候了。: Right now...\nmight be the happiest time of my life.
strings.怎么搞的！\\n又是人鱼海盗团吗！！！: What the hell!\nThe Mermaid Pirates again!!!
strings.这里是陆地联邦海军\\n战舰蔚蓝弗拉克西斯！\\n双方，立刻停战！！！: This is the Land Federation Navy\nwarship Azure Fraxys!\nBoth sides, cease fire immediately!!!
strings.话说回来，不要在我的海域里\\n搞什么奇怪兵器的试射实验啊！\\n小心我真的把你: And another thing, don't go test-firing\nweird weapons in my waters!\nOr I really will arrest the lot of you!
strings.按经验来说，这种时候走为上！\\n该开溜了，各位！: In my experience, at times like this, run!\nTime to scram, everyone!
strings.你又没阻止我们。\\n所以是共犯吧？: You didn't stop us.\nSo you're an accomplice, right?
strings.还不是你们硬拉我去的！: You're the ones who dragged me along!
strings.这是我从对面的船上偷来的……\\n算是道歉，加上报酬。: I swiped it from the other ship...\nConsider it an apology, plus payment.
strings.不过……干喝也没意思啊。\\n来用扑克决胜负吧。\\n赢了才能喝，输的只能喝合成: But... just drinking is boring.\nLet's settle it with poker.\nWinner gets to drink, loser only gets the synthetic stuff.
strings.这难道不是用来向我赔礼的吗……: Wasn't this supposed to be an apology to me...
strings.呵呵……狩猎海盗真的很有趣呢。: Heh heh... Pirate hunting really is fun.
strings.啊……不对。\\n是自从来了这里以后就很有趣。\\n实在太棒了。: Ah... no.\nIt's been fun ever since I came here.\nIt's really great.
strings.这里有很多有意思的人。\\n也有愿意陪我一起闹腾的人。: There are lots of interesting people here.\nAnd people willing to raise a ruckus with me.
strings.你不会把我也算在\\n陪你闹腾的人里了吧？: You're not counting me\namong the people who raise a ruckus with you, are you?
strings.白是……容易生气，\\n但摸起来很舒服的人？: Nimbus is... someone who gets mad easily,\nbut is nice to pet?
strings.总的来说……我还挺喜欢你的。\\n你很有趣啊。就夸夸你吧。: All in all... I kind of like you.\nYou're fun. Consider that a compliment.
strings.这里的人……会对别人生气，\\n但很少有人会否定别人啊。: People here... get angry at others,\nbut they rarely reject anyone.
strings.呵。毕竟那群家伙都很随心所欲啊。: Heh. That lot all do whatever they please, after all.
strings.这点很重要。\\n这里……让人感觉很轻松。: That's important.\nThis place... feels easy to be in.
strings.谢谢你带我来这里。: Thank you for bringing me here.
strings.所以，和我一起玩吧？\\n我还想去射下更多东西。: So, play with me?\nI want to go shoot down more things.
strings.我想用我的枪……\\n去做更厉害的事情。: I want to use my gun...\nto do even more amazing things.
strings.说来说去还是这个。\\n你实在是个战斗狂啊……: It always comes back to that.\nYou really are a battle maniac...
strings.既然这样……\\n你能射杀异世界的邪神吗？: In that case...\ncould you shoot down an evil god from another world?
strings.我正在找厉害的家伙。\\n最好是在这个容易让人发疯的异世界\\n也能面不改色的人: I'm looking for someone tough.\nIdeally someone who won't bat an eye\nin another world that drives people mad.
strings.穿过深渊————\\n突入法兰德小分队！！！: Through the abyss—\nFarlands strike team, charge!!!
strings.虽然事出突然，但志愿参加的人超多，\\n编队的时候真是够呛呢……这些够了吗？: It was sudden, but tons of people volunteered.\nPutting the squads together was rough... Is this enough?
strings.完全够了！\\n非常谢谢你，直小姐。: More than enough!\nThank you so much, Miss Nao.
strings.不过，吓了我一大跳呢。\\n没想到希尔媞会申请出动战舰。: Still, it really surprised me.\nI never thought Celtie would request a warship.
strings.走普通空域会引发外交问题。\\n但只要用“暗道”，\\n就不会被人看见了呢: Taking normal airspace would cause a diplomatic incident.\nBut if we use the "back roads,"\nno one will see us.
strings.如果他们阻止了仪式，也许会白跑一趟。\\n但是，万一被敌人抢先了……\\n那我们: If they've stopped the ritual, we may have come for nothing.\nBut if the enemy gets ahead of them...\nthen we can catch them off guard!
strings.探查工作就交给那些\\n被扭来扭去东西附身的人吧！: Leave the scouting to the folks\npossessed by those wriggly things!
strings.不过，我们的拼命三郎是不是太多了？: Still, don't we have a few too many daredevils?
strings.唔，噬星兽的本体有点“扭曲”对吧？\\n但泰加先生说只要都给他们一拳就好——: Hmm, the Devourer of Stars' true form is kind of "warped," right?\nBut Mr. Taiga said all you need is to punch it—
strings.只有那种会以拳交流的人\\n才能听懂他在说什么啊~: Only people who talk with their fists\ncan understand what he's saying~
strings.那个闪到腰的大叔也太不会解释了……\\n顺便问一句，希尔小姐能行吗？: That old man with the bad back is terrible at explaining...\nBy the way, can Miss Celtie handle it?
strings.我试过。而且成功了哦？: I've tried it. And it worked.
strings.我们这里就是这样。\\n外面的事就拜托你了。: That's how it is on our end.\nWe'll leave things outside to you.
strings.我们会在国境附近待命。\\n瓦格纳也在，动起手来应该会闹挺大吧。: We'll be on standby near the border.\nVagner's there too, so it'll probably get pretty wild once things start.
strings.等这场战斗……结束以后，\\n我想要……和你聊一聊！: After this battle... is over,\nI want to... talk with you!
strings.我们会尽全力保护法兰德的人们！: We'll do everything we can to protect the people of the Farlands!
strings.我好好思考了一下……\\n究竟什么才是强大，什么才是弱小。: I thought long and hard...\nabout what strength really is, and what weakness is.
strings.啊，原来你在想的是这个？: Ah, so that's what you've been thinking about?
strings.唔，不过也是。\\n你的家人和老爸对你也很重要嘛。: Well, I get it.\nYour family and your dad matter to you too.
strings.有人愿意笑着听我分享\\n我找到的那些光……\\n但同时，也有人会感到害怕。: There are people who'll smile and listen\nas I share the lights I've found...\nbut at the same time, there are those who feel afraid.
strings.强大而美丽的光芒……\\n有时也会成为灼痛他人的火焰啊。: A strong and beautiful light...\ncan sometimes become a flame that burns others.
strings.但我还是要说！\\n希尔媞！你非常美丽！: But I'll still say it!\nCeltie! You're beautiful!
strings.不过……若想与你交流，\\n应该用更适合的方式而非语言啊。: But... to communicate with you,\nthere must be a better way than words.
strings.呵呵……出色的剑气！\\n简直毫无还手之力啊。: Heh heh... Magnificent sword spirit!\nI couldn't even fight back.
strings.在您拔刀之前，\\n我完全没发现……: Until you drew your blade,\nI had no idea...
strings.那是年轻时被我舍弃的道路了。\\n曾几何时，我十分痛恨\\n那些被过度赋予的东西: It's a path I abandoned in my youth.\nOnce upon a time, I deeply resented\nthe gifts I was given in excess.
strings.不过，现在不一样了。\\n为了感受所有的美丽，\\n我会拿出全部的我！: But now it's different.\nTo feel every beauty there is,\nI'll bring out all that I am!
strings.即便是生锈的剑，\\n也能捕捉到你眼中的光。\\n这真的非常让我开心啊！: Even a rusted sword\ncan catch the light in your eyes.\nThat truly makes me so happy!
strings.我说啊，这根本是只有\\n猩猩才能理解的对话吧。: Hey, this is a conversation\nonly gorillas could understand.
strings.不过，我也很喜欢猩猩希尔小姐。: But I love gorilla Miss Celtie too.
strings.所以，这样不也挺好吗？\\n就用你平时的方法，让他们明白呗~？: So isn't that fine?\nJust make them understand your usual way~?
strings.扭扭小队发来通讯！\\n感应到了！就在正下方！\\n全员，准备突击降落————: Message from the Wriggle Squad!\nSignal detected! Right below us!\nAll hands, prepare for assault landing—
strings.希尔媞。\\n对你来说，剑是什么？: Celtie.\nWhat is the sword to you?
strings.让跟随在你身后的人们\\n好好看看你的美丽吧！: Let those who follow behind you\nsee your beauty!
strings.噢噢！噢噢！噢噢噢噢！\\n神啊！神啊！崭新的、神啊……\\n拜托了，求求您，还: Ohh! Ohh! Ohhhhh!\nO god! O god! O new god...\nPlease, I beg you, please—
strings.不会……吧……\\n怎么会、这样……\\n我们的世界、已经……: No... way...\nHow could... this happen...\nOur world... is already...
strings.为了掌握一切，挑战一切，\\n将了解的事与各位分享，\\n我将会战斗。: To grasp everything, to challenge everything,\nand to share what I learn with you all,\nI will fight.
strings.不管有多么艰难——\\n即便早晚会消失无踪——\\n那就是我能做到的事情！: No matter how hard it is—\neven if it will vanish sooner or later—\nthis is what I can do!
strings.所以，请各位看着吧！\\n这把剑终将指向彼方！: So watch, everyone!\nThis sword will point to the beyond!
strings.没办法了……\\n没法再战斗了……\\n我们、已经——: It's no use...\nWe can't fight anymore...\nWe're already—
strings.没错！\\n我也要像那个人那样——\\n我还可以战斗啊！: That's right!\nI'll be like her too—\nI can still fight!
strings.那把剑会斩断弱小的我们，\\n给予我们挑战、打破极限的意志。: That sword cuts down our weaker selves,\nand gives us the will to take on challenges and break our limits.
strings.还请您别把目光\\n从希尔身上移开啊，父亲大人。: Please don't take your eyes\noff Celtie, Father.
strings.与援军联手迎敌！\\n千万别落后了哦？\\n全员，拔剑！突击————: Join forces with the reinforcements and face the enemy!\nDon't fall behind!\nAll of you, draw your swords! Charge—
strings.我乃剑！\\n然而，又并非钢铁！: I am a sword!\nAnd yet, not of steel!
strings.我乃斩裂天空，指向彼方的！\\n星之剑！: I am the one who cleaves the sky and points to the beyond!\nThe Star Sword!
strings.呜、呜呜呜~……\\n我说啊……我们还是回去吧？: Ugh, uuugh~...\nHey... let's just go back?
strings.现、现在放弃还太早了。\\n你前面不还很有干劲……\\n说今天非得找到回去的办法: I-It's too early to give up now.\nWeren't you all fired up earlier...\nsaying we had to find a way back today no matter what!
strings.但是但是！\\n我们被魔物袭击了那么多次！\\n我肚子也饿扁了！: But, but!\nWe've been attacked by monsters so many times!\nAnd I'm starving!
strings.我想回去了啦！\\n我想回去和大家一起吃饭~~！: I wanna go back!\nI wanna go back and eat with everyone~~!
strings.但有阿克娅在，\\n我们还能往更深处走一走~: But with Aqua here,\nwe can go a bit deeper~
strings.有了你的治愈之力，\\n我们才能放心战斗啊。\\n要是你实在想回去——: It's your healing power\nthat lets us fight without worry.\nIf you really want to go back—
strings.真拿你们没办法啊！\\n既然你们说到这个份上，\\n那我也只能奉陪了！: You guys are hopeless!\nIf you insist that much,\nI guess I'll just have to tag along!
strings.噢噢……你们很会哄她了嘛。: Ooh... You've gotten good at handling her.
strings.算是吧。\\n毕竟都相处有一阵了。: Sort of.\nWe've been together a while now.
strings.赶紧的，我们加快脚步吧！\\n跟上本阿克娅大人的步伐——: Come on, let's pick up the pace!\nKeep up with the great Lady Aqua—
strings.倒是没事啦……可恶！\\n突然搞什么啦？: I'm fine... Dammit!\nWhat was that all of a sudden?
strings.怎么回事？\\n是你把我们拉过来的？: What's going on?\nDid you drag us here?
strings.完全正确。\\n不过，这和你们惹出的事比起来，\\n简直是九牛一毛啊。: Exactly right.\nBut compared to the trouble you've caused,\nthis is a drop in the ocean.
strings.什么？\\n和真，你知道他在说什么吗？: What?\nKazuma, do you know what he's talking about?
strings.不知道。\\n话说回来，你到底是谁啊？: No idea.\nAnyway, who the heck are you?
strings.我可没义务告诉你。\\n而且，我需要的只有那女人。: I have no obligation to tell you.\nBesides, the only one I need is that woman.
strings.那磅礴的魔力……\\n称其为异界的神明也不为过。\\n你那魔力……就由我来接收！: That immense magic power...\nIt's no exaggeration to call her a god of another world.\nYour magic power... I'll be taking it!
strings.潜于万物的黑暗啊，\\n畏惧光明的神秘宫殿啊，\\n示吾以汝之傲心！: O darkness lurking in all things,\nO mysterious palace that fears the light,\nshow me thy pride!
strings.你需要的只是能接纳自己的地方，\\n我说的没错吧？: All you need is a place that accepts you,\nam I right?
strings.只要自我能获得肯定，\\n地点和对象都不重要——: As long as you're affirmed,\nthe place and the people don't matter—
strings.你到底想搞什么啊！\\n尽说些拐弯抹角的话！\\n完全听不懂你想干嘛！: What are you even trying to do!\nAll you do is talk in riddles!\nI have no idea what you want!
strings.我算是明白了，\\n我绝对和你合不来。\\n赶紧把我们送回原来的地方！: Now I get it,\nthere's no way I'll ever get along with you.\nSend us back where we came from, now!
strings.啧……你这个任凭自己受欲望驱使，\\n根本不把使命当回事的人，\\n想必是不会明: Tch... Someone like you, driven by desire,\nwho takes no mission seriously,\ncould never understand...
strings.啊？哈？\\n这家伙看起来这么强，\\n我会的攻击技能都不可能有用吧！: Huh? What?\nThis guy looks way too strong,\nnone of my attack skills are going to work!
strings.咦，奇怪，什么都没偷到？\\n难道对他没用？！: Huh, weird, I didn't steal anything?\nDoesn't it work on him?!
strings.怎么回事啦，为什么总在这时候掉链子！\\n偷别人内裤的时候不都好好的吗！: What's the deal, why do you always flop at times like this!\nIt works fine when you're stealing people's panties!
strings.不是的，等等！\\n我对男人的内裤没兴趣——: No, wait!\nI'm not interested in men's underwear—
strings.可以了。别过来，够了。\\n别再进入我的领域了……: Enough. Stay away, enough.\nDon't come into my domain any further...
strings.等等？！\\n你对和真干了什么……: Wait?!\nWhat did you do to Kazuma...
strings.等等，你刚才说了使命什么什么的对吧？: Wait, you said something about a mission just now, right?
strings.看你这么愁眉苦脸的，\\n别管那些使命不就好了？: If it makes you look so miserable,\nwhy not just forget the mission?
strings.拼命压抑自我，\\n也不知道明天会发生什么啊？\\n所以不如快乐地享受现在！: Desperately suppressing yourself...\nyou never know what'll happen tomorrow, right?\nSo you might as well enjoy the present!
strings.若你心怀烦恼，\\n希望你能放下它们，\\n让自己轻松一些——: If you have worries,\nI hope you can let them go\nand take it easy—
strings.总之，如果你想倾诉或者忏悔，\\n我倒也愿意再听你说哦！拜拜啦！: Anyway, if you want to vent or confess,\nI'd be happy to listen again! Bye-bye!
strings.我烦恼的根源……就是你们啊！！！: The source of my worries... is YOU PEOPLE!!!
strings.各位！连惠惠和达克妮丝也来了！: Everyone! Even Megumin and Darkness are here!
strings.听说你们突然消失在了迷宫里，\\n我们真是担心死了！: We heard you suddenly disappeared in the labyrinth,\nwe were worried sick!
strings.你们没事真是太好了！\\n都没受伤吧？: I'm so glad you're okay!\nNo one's hurt, right?
strings.如你所见，完好无损。\\n是吧，和真？: As you can see, perfectly fine.\nRight, Kazuma?
strings.算是吧。不过我们遇到了一个\\n穿黑斗篷的男人……不，大叔？: More or less. But we ran into a guy\nin a black cloak... no, an old guy?
strings.虽然他挺莫名其妙的，\\n但我说我随时愿意听他倾诉，\\n把他搞得喜极而泣了呢！: He was pretty weird,\nbut when I said I'd always listen to his troubles,\nhe got so happy he cried!
strings.啊，这样……不愧是阿克娅呢？: Ah, I see... That's Aqua for you?
strings.不过，还是没找到回去的办法啊。: Still, we didn't find a way back.
strings.就是说啊！\\n我还下定决心，今天绝对要回去的！\\n都怪那个斗篷大叔，真是的~: Exactly!\nI was determined we'd go back today for sure!\nIt's all that cloak guy's fault, geez~!
strings.总之，今天就先回去吧。\\n好久没开宴会了，回星见镇上开个宴会吧？: Anyway, let's head back for today.\nIt's been a while since our last feast, so let's have one back in Starview?
strings.那好，赶紧回去吧！\\n宴会正在等着我们呢！: Great, let's hurry back!\nThe feast awaits!
strings.你可真是单纯啊，\\n我们都还没找到回去的办法呢。: You're so simple-minded.\nWe still haven't found a way back.
strings.放心吧，有我阿克娅大人在呢，\\n我们绝对能回去的！而且——: Don't worry, with the great Lady Aqua around,\nwe'll definitely get back! Besides—
strings.不是有你们在吗。\\n所以，不管身处哪个世界，\\n我们都一定能行的！对吧？: We've got all of you, right?\nSo no matter what world we're in,\nwe'll definitely be fine! Right?
strings.唔，还是很难回到原来的世界吗……: Hmm, it's still hard to get back to your world...
strings.唔……迷宫里可能还有残留的摇曳……\\n但抱歉，我也不能给出确定的答复……: Hmm... There might still be lingering wavering in the labyrinth...\nbut sorry, I can't give you a definite answer...
strings.没事没事，你们愿意帮忙，\\n我们已经很开心了。\\n谢谢你关心我们。: It's fine, it's fine, we're just happy you're helping.\nThanks for worrying about us.
strings.哎呀，我之前还担心\\n你们会不会很消沉呢——: Well, I was worried\nthat you'd all be feeling down—
strings.好，今天也要来了哦——\\n花鸟风月~！: All right, here it comes again today—\nNature's Beauty~!
strings.只有阿克娅那么引人注目，太不公平了！\\n我也想让大家看看我的爆裂魔法！\\n快: It's not fair that only Aqua gets attention!\nI want everyone to see my Explosion too!\nLet me cast an Explosion, quick!
strings.话说，这个世界有没有那种\\n能施展非常猛烈攻击的魔物？\\n或者，有没有能让我: By the way, are there any monsters in this world\nthat can unleash really fierce attacks?\nOr any jobs where I can be used as a shield!
strings.挡箭牌？挡箭牌吗？挡箭牌？？？: A shield? A shield? A shield???
strings.看来她们完全没在消沉，\\n也完全不需要担心啊……: Looks like they're not down at all,\nand there's nothing to worry about...
strings.你们到底有没有\\n正在被监视的自觉啊？: Do you even realize\nyou're under watch?
strings.不，你犯的事才是最不可饶恕的啊。: No, what you did is the least forgivable of all.
strings.所——以——说——\\n那只是偶然啊！\\n那以后我都没有用过STEAL了！: I'm—telling—you—\nthat was an accident!\nI haven't used STEAL since!
strings.而且我们明明想赶紧回去，\\n还一直遵守处罚，没有去迷宫呢！: And even though we want to go home ASAP,\nwe've been obeying our punishment and staying out of the labyrinth!
strings.和真说得没错！\\n其实我们根本没空磨蹭啊。: Kazuma's right!\nWe actually don't have time to dawdle.
strings.我、我看你刚才玩得很开心啊？: Y-You looked like you were having lots of fun just now?
strings.那个和这个是两回事。\\n我必须赶紧回原来的世界，打倒魔王！\\n然后返回天界才: That's a separate matter.\nI have to hurry back to our world and defeat the Demon King!\nThen return to heaven!
strings.阿克娅小姐住在那个\\n叫天界的地方吗？: Miss Aqua lives in a place\ncalled heaven?
strings.没错！\\n我可是阿克西斯教团崇拜的水之女神！\\n是阿克娅大人呀！: That's right!\nI'm the Goddess of Water worshipped by the Axis Church!\nLady Aqua!
strings.她一定又梦见自己是女神大人了。: She must be dreaming she's a goddess again.
strings.抱歉，别看阿克娅这样，\\n她其实也有很多优点的。: Sorry, Aqua may be like this,\nbut she does have plenty of good points.
strings.为什么大家都要用这种\\n和善的眼神看我啊！: Why is everyone looking at me\nwith such kindly eyes!
strings.谁让你每天都让我们看这一出。: Because you put on this show for us every day.
strings.对了，阿克娅，\\n你不能用女神的力量直接把我们送回去吗？: Oh, right, Aqua,\ncan't you just use your goddess powers to send us back?
strings.哼哼，你在说什么呢，和真。\\n要是能行的话我们早就回去了！: Hmph hmph, what are you talking about, Kazuma.\nIf I could, we'd have gone back ages ago!
strings.呜哇啊啊啊啊！史黛拉！！！\\n和真又叫我废物女神了！！: Waaaaaah! Stella!!!\nKazuma called me a useless goddess again!!
strings.总而言之言而总之，\\n在公会取消监视之前，\\n就算我们再想也没法行动啊……: Anyway, all things considered,\nuntil the Guild lifts the watch,\nwe can't do anything no matter how much we want to...
strings.所以，阿尔克，\\n来和我一起想想该怎么\\n混过公会骑士的眼睛吧！: So, Alk,\nhelp me think of a way to give\nthe Guild Knights the slip!
strings.是是是。\\n吃完饭以后一起看看有什么委托可接吧，\\n你们的生活费可要老老实实: Yeah, yeah.\nAfter we eat, let's see what requests we can take.\nYou need to earn your living expenses honestly, okay?
strings.一说到这个你就变得很严肃啊。\\n唔，就没什么别的办法吗——: You get so serious whenever this comes up.\nHmm, isn't there some other way—
strings.你、你怎么了？\\n你怎么浑身黏乎乎的！: Wh-What happened to you?\nWhy are you all slimy!

strings.好多！怎么回事？！\\n这种情况在这里很常见吗？！: There's so many! What's going on?!\nIs this normal around here?!
strings.怎么可能！它们到底是——: Of course not! What are they—
strings.快、快回建筑物里面吧！\\n我才不想在这个世界也变得黏乎乎的！: Qu-Quick, back inside the building!\nI don't want to get slimy in this world too!
strings.不对，等等啊。\\n如果我们能帮上忙，\\n公会骑士一定会更信任我们吧？: No, wait.\nIf we can help out,\nthe Guild Knights are sure to trust us more, right?
strings.确实！\\n那就交给我吧！: Good point!\nThen leave it to me!
strings.神之一击是承载着女神\\n愤怒和悲痛的必杀之拳！\\n你已经死了！: God Blow is a deadly fist carrying\nthe goddess's wrath and sorrow!\nYou're already dead!
strings.是、是哪个史莱姆？！\\n他们在哪儿——呜哇？！: Wh-Which slime is it?!\nWhere are they—Whoa?!
strings.只能找了……可恶！\\n别过来！: We'll just have to search... Dammit!\nStay back!
strings.那个废物女神！\\n每次都这样、每次都这样——: That useless goddess!\nEvery time, every single time—
strings.呵、呵呵……呵呵呵呵。\\n抱歉……如果我有力量的话……: Heh, heh heh... heh heh heh heh.\nSorry... If only I had the power...
strings.呜、呜呜、呜哇啊啊啊啊！\\n为什么我非得遇上这种事不可！: Ugh, uuugh, waaaaaah!\nWhy do I have to go through this!
strings.实在是让人羡慕……不、不是，没事了！\\n史莱姆也不是没有弱点的，\\n只要大家: I'm so envious... N-No, never mind!\nSlimes do have weaknesses,\nso if we all go at them together, there's nothing to fear!
strings.说、说得也是呢！\\n怎么可能有更大更强的史莱姆——: Y-Yeah, you're right!\nThere's no way there's an even bigger, stronger slime—
strings.我不想再被吃掉了啊啊啊！: I don't wanna get eaten agaaain!
strings.吾名惠惠——\\n乃是红魔族首屈一指的魔法师，\\n兼身处异世界的爆裂魔法传道者: My name is Megumin—\nforemost mage of the Crimson Demons,\nand evangelist of Explosion in another world!
strings.世界交汇，我也结识了新的同志。\\n阿尔克、史黛拉……\\n今天我也要向他们传播: Worlds have crossed, and I've made new comrades.\nAlk, Stella...\nToday too, I shall spread the path of Explosion to them—
strings.放、放开我！\\n我是无辜的！是无辜的啊！\\n我没有做过！没有！: L-Let me go!\nI'm innocent! I'm innocent!\nI didn't do it! I didn't!
strings.准确来说，是被当成嫌犯了。: To be precise, she's a suspect.
strings.平白无故怀疑人也没这样的吧？！\\n不过他们没有证据，\\n所以只对我进行了问询: Isn't it wrong to suspect someone for no reason?!\nBut they had no proof,\nso they just questioned me and let me go...
strings.听说最近森林里出现了一个会一边\\n喊着“爆裂魔法”一边袭击人的家伙。\\n好像: I heard someone's been showing up in the forest lately,\nshouting "Explosion magic" while attacking people.\nApparently some people have even been hurt.
strings.就是说啊。\\n对人放爆裂魔法，\\n根本有违爆裂之道。: Exactly.\nCasting Explosion on people\ngoes completely against the path of Explosion.
strings.惠惠绝对不会用爆裂魔法伤害他人。: Megumin would never hurt anyone with Explosion.
strings.而且——如果是真正的爆裂魔法，\\n就不只是受伤那么简单了……: Besides—if it were a real Explosion,\nthey wouldn't just get hurt...
strings.不过，公会骑士还是很怀疑惠惠的样子。\\n该怎么办才好呢……: Still, the Guild Knights seem pretty suspicious of Megumin.\nWhat should we do...
strings.受害者都是在同个地方被袭击的吧？\\n那么只要去那里调查，\\n也许就能找到真正: The victims were all attacked in the same place, right?\nThen if we investigate there,\nmaybe we can find the real culprit?
strings.确实！很好，惠惠，\\n就让我们亲手把犯人揪出来吧！: Good thinking! All right, Megumin,\nlet's catch the culprit ourselves!
strings.好的！\\n各位，请你们也助我一臂之力！: Yes!\nEveryone, please lend me your strength too!
strings.呵呵呵……好好尝尝我的爆裂魔法吧——: Heh heh heh... Taste my Explosion—
strings.就是你吗！\\n胆敢冒用我爆裂魔法的宵小之辈！: So it's you!\nThe lowlife who dares to impersonate my Explosion!
strings.噢噢！您就是惠惠小姐吗！\\n真的非常感谢您给予我的灵感！: Ohh! You must be Miss Megumin!\nThank you so much for the inspiration!
strings.听说您的爆裂魔法强得令人发指，\\n简直是令人心潮澎湃啊！: I heard your Explosion was outrageously powerful,\nit got my heart racing!
strings.于是我反复研究！\\n终于将爆裂魔法钻研到了极致！: So I studied it over and over!\nAnd finally perfected Explosion magic!
strings.你想说的只有这些吗？\\n那就赶紧乖乖束手就擒吧！: Is that all you have to say?\nThen surrender quietly!
strings.呵呵，好吧。\\n那就让你们看看吾之真髄，\\n至高的爆裂魔法！: Heh heh, very well.\nThen let me show you my true essence,\nthe supreme Explosion!
strings.哈哈哈哈，很不错吧！\\n这便是爆裂啊！: Hahahaha, pretty great, huh!\nTHAT is Explosion!
strings.无法饶恕。\\n这算什么爆裂魔法，\\n我绝对不会认可的。: Unforgivable.\nWhat kind of Explosion is that?\nI will never acknowledge it.
strings.爆裂魔法！\\n是操纵者的灵魂本身！: Explosion magic!\nIs the very soul of its wielder!
strings.是会让胸腔发热，\\n让心脏跳动的东西！: It's something that sets your chest ablaze\nand makes your heart pound!
strings.哈哈哈！什么灵魂啊心脏的，\\n你是认真的吗？: Hahaha! Soul and heart, are you\nbeing serious?
strings.还是说~你只会嘴上说说，\\n其实根本不会什么爆裂魔法？\\n原来传闻就只是传闻: Or maybe~ you're all talk\nand can't actually cast Explosion at all?\nSo the rumors were just rumors~!
strings.我和我的同志们所热爱的爆裂魔法！\\n究竟是何物！: The Explosion that my comrades and I love!\nWhat it truly is!
strings.好啊！反正现在也没其他人！\\n上吧，惠惠！: Yeah! There's nobody else around anyway!\nGo for it, Megumin!
strings.啊，等下，还是再稍微考虑下——: Ah, wait, let's think about this a little more—
strings.吾乃操纵破坏与混沌之人。\\n邪恶深渊之火啊，请在此显现。: I am one who commands destruction and chaos.\nO flames of the wicked abyss, manifest here.
strings.愤怒的漆黑啊！烧毁一切虚伪吧！\\n这就是吾之究极爆裂魔法！: O wrathful darkness! Burn away all falsehood!\nThis is my ultimate Explosion!
strings.在这种爆裂面前——\\n我根本……我根本……: Before an Explosion like this—\nI'm nothing... I'm nothing at all...
strings.我不会饶恕你的所作所为……\\n不过，我承认你对爆裂魔法的热情。: I won't forgive what you've done...\nbut I acknowledge your passion for Explosion.
strings.如果你想认真钻研爆裂魔法，\\n我永远会为你加油鼓劲。: If you wish to seriously pursue Explosion,\nI'll always cheer you on.
strings.惠惠小姐……不——\\n请让我尊称您一声师父！: Miss Megumin... No—\nplease let me call you Master!
strings.呵呵呵呵……好吧。\\n愿你能在爆裂之道中寻得幸福！: Heh heh heh heh... Very well.\nMay you find happiness on the path of Explosion!
strings.是，师父！\\n我……我会洗心革面，好好努力的！\\n非常感谢您！: Yes, Master!\nI... I'll turn over a new leaf and work hard!\nThank you so much!
strings.呼——能净化邪恶心灵的爆裂魔法！\\n实在是……太棒了！: Whew—an Explosion that purifies wicked hearts!\nThat was... amazing!
strings.这是迄今为止见过的最漂亮的爆裂魔法。: That's the most beautiful Explosion I've ever seen.
strings.哎呀……嗯……颜色也好，风压也好……\\n真的真的太厉害了……: Wow... Yeah... The color, the blast wind...\nIt was really, really amazing...
strings.对吧，对吧！\\n这就是爆裂！这就是吾之精髓！: Right? Right!\nThat's Explosion! That's my essence!
strings.虽然遇到了很多麻烦，\\n但多亏了阿尔克你们，\\n我再次明白了自己对爆裂魔法的: It was a lot of trouble,\nbut thanks to you, Alk,\nI've realized my love for Explosion all over again!
strings.阿尔克，史黛拉！\\n今后也要一同在爆裂之道上——: Alk, Stella!\nFrom now on, let us walk the path of Explosion together—
strings.果然是你干的啊！\\n这次只能逮捕你了！: So it was you after all!\nWe'll have to arrest you this time!
strings.不、不是的！\\n我只是想让那家伙看看真正的爆裂魔法！: N-No, it wasn't!\nI just wanted to show that guy what real Explosion is!
strings.和真不也说了“上吧，惠惠”吗！: Kazuma even said "Go for it, Megumin"!
strings.哎呀~……我再怎么帮忙，\\n你们也免不了接受询问啊？: Well~... No matter how much I help,\nyou're not getting out of questioning, you know?
strings.虽然我不讨厌你的这种性格！\\n但是，可恶啊啊啊啊啊！: Not that I hate that about you!\nBut, dammit aaaaall!
strings.搞什么啊，这家伙……\\n明明只是野猫，完全忘记野性了吗。: What's with this thing...\nIt's a stray, but it's totally forgotten how to be wild.
strings.它很喜欢蕾薇吧？\\n你看，它在打呼噜呢。: It really likes you, Leve.\nLook, it's purring.
strings.就算你这样讨好我们，\\n我们也没东西给你吃哦。\\n很遗憾喵。: Even if you butter us up like that,\nwe don't have any food for you.\nToo bad, meow.
strings.事情还没完呢。\\n赶紧把这里好好打扫干净，\\n别再弄脏我们的地盘了。: We're not done here.\nClean this place up properly,\nand stop dirtying our turf.
strings.从刚才起就一直吵得要命啊。\\n是你们这群白痴在闹腾吗？: It's been noisy as hell for a while now.\nIs it you idiots making the racket?
strings.什么？无关人士别来插手。\\n还是说，你们想和我的部下玩玩？: What? Outsiders stay out of it.\nOr do you want to play with my boys?
strings.请、请等一下，这是误会！\\n是那群垃圾不好啊？！\\n都怪他们弄脏了我们的地盘: P-Please wait, it's a misunderstanding!\nThose trash are the problem?!\nThey dirtied our turf!
strings.我……我们……只是……\\n想在这里、休息一会儿……\\n呜、呜啊啊呜呜呜~~~: W-We... just...\nwanted to rest here... for a little while...\nUgh, uwaaaaah~~~~~...
strings.怎么回事？\\n你们被讨厌了吗？: What's going on?\nThey don't like you?
strings.他们也许是……“不详之人”。\\n但我也只在书上读到过……: They might be... "the unclean."\nThough I've only read about it in books...
strings.因为血源、差别等等理由\\n被看作“污秽”，\\n被视为不存在的人们。: People seen as "impure" because of\ntheir bloodline, discrimination and such,\nand treated as if they don't exist.
strings.既然您知道，那您也能理解吧？！\\n光是看到这群家伙就很麻烦！\\n所以——: If you know that, then you understand, right?!\nJust seeing these people is a hassle!\nSo—
strings.你们也真是白痴。\\n搬去别的弗罗特或者怎样都好吧。: You're idiots too.\nMove to another Float or whatever.
strings.如、如果可以的话……\\n我们也……呜、呜哇啊啊啊啊~~~！: I-If we could...\nwe would... Ugh, waaaaaah~~~!
strings.那就继续待在原地发抖吧……: Then just stay where you are and keep shaking...
strings.喂，你们两个！\\n接下来的话我只说一次。: Hey, you two!\nI'm only going to say this once.
strings.我不会答应你们什么。\\n也许也没法让你们看到未来。\\n但是……愿意的话就跟我: I won't promise you anything.\nMaybe I can't show you a future either.\nBut... come with me if you want.
strings.突然把你叫到这里来\\n真是抱歉啊，稻穗小姐……: Sorry for calling you\nout here so suddenly, Miss Inaho...
strings.多了好多人啊~……\\n这就是你们的新伙伴吗？: There are so many more of you~...\nAre these your new friends?
strings.唔，该怎么说好呢……: Well, how do I put it...
strings.我、我们是蕾薇大姐头\\n和咲夜大姐的……小弟！: W-We're Boss Leve's\nand Big Sis Sakuya's... underlings!
strings.但是，大姐头对我们的恩情\\n我们根本无以回报，所以……: But we can never repay\neverything you've done for us, Boss, so...
strings.不管到了哪里，\\n蕾薇都会向人伸出手呢。: No matter where she goes,\nLeve always reaches out a hand to people.
strings.然后，不知不觉之中，\\n就变成这么一大群人了。: And before we knew it,\nwe'd become this big group.
strings.我想把他们扔下的啊。\\n但这帮家伙硬要跟着我——: I wanted to ditch them.\nBut these guys insisted on following me—
strings.托他们的福，现在连行动都困难！\\n不管到哪儿都会被当成犯罪集团！\\n实在麻烦: Thanks to them, we can barely even move now!\nEverywhere we go, people think we're a gang!\nIt's such a pain!
strings.原来如此，束手无策了啊~\\n所以才会这么头疼……: I see, so you're at your wits' end~\nThat's why you're so troubled...
strings.所以才会找我来？: So that's why you called me?
strings.呵、呵呵呵呵，\\n你真是可爱啊~~~？: Heh, heh heh heh heh,\nyou're so cute~~~?
strings.干、干嘛啊突然？！: Wh-What's that all of a sudden?!
strings.好吧！\\n细节问题就交给我吧！\\n没问题没问题没问题！: All right!\nLeave the details to me!\nNo problem, no problem, no problem!
strings.住手啊，白痴狐狸！找打吗？！: Stop it, you idiot fox! Want a beating?!
strings.到此为止了，恶鬼酒吞瑰木！\\n今天我一定会消灭你！\\n好好知晓无罪之人的痛苦: This is the end, wicked oni Shuten Kaiboku!\nToday I'll destroy you for sure!\nKnow the pain of the innocent!
strings.噢噢，异国的调料啊。\\n既然只卖这个价钱，\\n那应该可以试试啊……: Oh ho, foreign spices.\nAt this price,\nthey're worth a try...
strings.怎么样？虽然是赶工出来的，\\n但还挺像样的吧？: How's that? It was a rush job,\nbut it's pretty decent, right?
strings.商业与演艺方面的经纪工作\\n就包在我们身上吧！: Leave the business and showbiz management\nto us!
strings.没错。\\n看到突然出现的想要住处的陌生人，\\n大家当然只会害怕嘛。: That's right.\nWhen strangers suddenly show up wanting a place to live,\nof course people get scared.
strings.所以，只要在各个世界巡回，\\n和人们加深关系就好。: So you just tour around the worlds\nand build deeper ties with people.
strings.我们已经和星见镇上各个世界的\\n大人物都打过招呼，也打通关系了。\\n对吧，阿: We've already said hello to the big shots\nof every world in Starview and pulled some strings.\nRight, Alk?
strings.然后增加我的工作量是吧……\\n我光是忙自己的店就够呛了啊。: And then my workload goes up, right...\nRunning my own shop is already more than enough.
strings.不过，这样吗，\\n他们找到办法活下去了啊。: Still, I see.\nThey found a way to survive.
strings.稻穗，那个……也谢谢你。\\n给你添了很多麻烦。: Inaho, um... thanks to you too.\nI caused you a lot of trouble.
strings.没事，不用谢我。\\n毕竟这事对我也有利。: It's fine, no need to thank me.\nIt works in my favor too.
strings.事不宜迟，我打算让\\n妖怪剧团和旅团搞个联动。\\n这就是这次的剧本！: No time to waste, I plan to set up a collab\nbetween the yokai troupe and your troupe.\nHere's the script!
strings.喂……等一下！\\n我和咲夜也要出场吗？！: Hey... wait a sec!\nSakuya and I are in it too?!
strings.世上的事都讲究互相帮助嘛。\\n让我们来做同样的梦吧！: The world's all about helping each other.\nLet's dream the same dream!
strings.我、我绝对不要当史黛拉的替角啊！: I-I'm absolutely not being Stella's understudy!
strings.就是这样——\\n我要和达令举办婚礼了~♡: So yeah—\nI'm having a wedding with my darling~♡
strings.不好意思啊，我知道会给各位添麻烦。\\n但我还是很想让甜心开心啊。\\n就原谅我: Sorry, I know this will trouble you all.\nBut I really want to make my sweetheart happy.\nPlease forgive me.
strings.我也要、拜托各位了。帮帮我吧。\\n尽快、一刻也好……赶紧结束这噩梦！: I'm asking you too. Please help me.\nAs fast as possible, even a moment sooner... End this nightmare!
strings.呃，那个，\\n各位有什么问题请现在提。: Uh, um,\nif anyone has questions, please ask now.
strings.倒不如说，\\n我们心里就只有疑问啊……: If anything,\nall we have are questions...
strings.平行……世界……\\n啊哈哈哈哈。\\n该不会还有一条龙吧~？: Parallel... worlds...\nAhahahaha.\nDon't tell me there's another dragon too~?
strings.翔……我突然肚子好痛……: Sho... my stomach suddenly really hurts...
strings.终究只能把创造和平的英雄的\\n“癖好”公之于众了吗……: So in the end, the "proclivities" of the hero\nwho brought peace must be made public...
strings.不过，真没想到啊。\\n白竟然是会称呼恋人为甜心的那种人。: Still, who knew?\nNimbus is the type to call his lover "sweetheart."
strings.烦死了……\\n我才不会说啊……我不知道啊……\\n那个虽然是我但又不是我啊……: Shut up...\nI wouldn't say that... I don't know...\nThat's me, but it's also not me...
strings.不用害羞。\\n这种事都是先来者为上吧？: No need to be shy.\nIn these matters, first come, first served, right?
strings.等下，雷吉斯，\\n话说你从刚才起就在干什么？: Wait, Regis,\nwhat have you been doing this whole time?
strings.索维拜托我拍纪念影片哦。\\n说要拍成一段令她终身难忘的回忆！: Sohvi asked me to film a commemorative video.\nShe wants a memory she'll never forget!
strings.你知道人道两个字怎么写吗？？？: Do you even know the meaning of the word humane???
strings.索维觉得这样就好吗~？\\n那个……和他结婚没问题吗~？\\n虽然都是白，但不是: Is Sohvi okay with this~?\nUm... is it okay to marry him~?\nThey're both Nimbus, but they're not the same person, right~?
strings.我当然打算和所有白结婚啊。\\n不管有几个白我都可以接受哦！: Of course I plan to marry every Nimbus.\nNo matter how many Nimbuses there are, I'm fine with it!
strings.啊，对了。我有问题。: Oh, right. I have a question.
strings.那个世界的阿步是什么样的？: What's Ayumu like in that world?
strings.喂，这和索维的婚礼没关系吧。: Hey, that's got nothing to do with Sohvi's wedding.
strings.但是啊~你不会很好奇吗？\\n那边的我们有没有哪里不一样。: But come on~ aren't you curious?\nWhether the us over there are any different.
strings.说到这个，我也想问问呢。\\n这里的阿尔克是不是也搞砸了？: Speaking of which, I'd like to know too.\nDid the Alk here mess up too?
strings.好，够了。这个话题到此结束。: Okay, that's enough. This topic is over.
strings.我那边的他可不得了啊。\\n前阵子他终于遇到修罗场，被刺伤了呢——: The one in my world is something else.\nThe other day he finally got caught in a love triangle and got stabbed—
strings.我都让你别说了吧？！: I told you not to say it, didn't I?!
strings.那么，各位！\\n为了索维的幸福，世界的和平，\\n还有白的尊严！: Now then, everyone!\nFor Sohvi's happiness, world peace,\nand Nimbus's dignity!
strings.拜托你们帮忙筹备婚礼了！: Please help us prepare the wedding!
strings.哈啊啊啊啊啊？！\\n什么叫没法为我办婚礼啊？！: Huuuuuuh?!\nWhat do you mean you can't hold my wedding?!
strings.不、不是的。\\n想预约半年后当然没问题。\\n但这么突然，我们也很难办……: N-No, that's not it.\nBooking six months ahead is no problem, of course.\nBut this is so sudden, it's difficult for us...
strings.啊啊啊啊啊，好烦躁……\\n亏我前面心情那么好的！: Aaaaargh, so frustrating...\nAnd I was in such a good mood earlier!
strings.早知道会这样，就该一直把\\n利比尔德乐园的会场包下来的——: If I'd known, I would've kept\nthe Paradise Isle venue booked the whole time—
strings.但是，这下怎么办？\\n必须赶紧——: But what do we do now?\nWe have to hurry and—
strings.事情我们都明白了！\\n就让我们来帮忙吧！: We understand the situation!\nLet us help!
strings.毕竟这里的许多人\\n都被索维大夫拯救过啊。\\n就依靠那些人脉来想办法吧。: Lots of people here\nwere saved by Doctor Sohvi.\nLet's use those connections to figure something out.
strings.没错。曾经饱受困扰的我们\\n都是多亏了她才能拥有浓密的秀发……\\n她简直是我: That's right. We who once suffered so much\nhave thick, lustrous hair thanks to her...\nShe's our savior!
strings.不过，这样就能顺利送他回去了。\\n直她们刚才告诉我，\\n送他走的准备基本都做: Still, now we can send him back without a hitch.\nNao and the others just told me\nthe preparations to send him off are mostly done—
strings.那么，现在我们将为\\n新郎白、新娘索维举办婚礼。: Now then, we shall hold the wedding\nof groom Nimbus and bride Sohvi.
strings.我早就知道这一天肯定会来。\\n但看到女儿身着婚纱，\\n还是让人感慨万千啊。: I always knew this day would come.\nBut seeing my daughter in a wedding dress\nstill fills me with emotion.
strings.白，你愿意娶索维为妻，\\n发誓永远遵循群星的指引，\\n永远爱她吗？: Nimbus, do you take Sohvi as your wife,\nand swear to follow the guidance of the stars\nand love her forever?
strings.索维，你愿意嫁给白，\\n发誓永远遵循群星的指引，\\n永远爱他吗？: Sohvi, do you take Nimbus as your husband,\nand swear to follow the guidance of the stars\nand love him forever?
strings.当然！\\n我愿意对所有的白发誓~♡: Of course!\nI swear to every Nimbus~♡
strings.很好。\\n那么，请二位交换誓言之吻——: Very well.\nThen, please exchange the kiss of your vows—
