strings.由龙来为汝等开路。\\n能行吧？骑士！: A dragon shall clear the way for thee.\nCanst thou do it? Knight!
strings.身为女子，却想成为骑士吗……\\n原来如此，她很憧憬希尔媞吧。: A girl who wants to be a knight...\nI see, she must admire Celtie.
strings.喔，所以要找龙当对手？\\n哎呀……也太乱来了吧……: Oh, so she picks a dragon as her opponent?\nWow... that's pretty reckless...
strings.怎么，原来你没发现？\\n不过……对你来说倒是无所谓吧。: What, you didn't notice?\nWell... I guess it doesn't matter to you.
strings.希望她的剑……\\n某天能指向你啊？: Here's hoping her sword\nis pointed at you someday?
strings.倒是汝，究竟恢复实力了吗？！\\n汝不会忘记了吾等还未分出胜负吧？！: More to the point, hast thou recovered thy strength?!\nThou hast not forgotten our match is yet unsettled, hast thou?!
strings.呃……\\n你还惦记着那个啊？！: Uh...\nYou're still hung up on that?!
strings.“还”？！\\n吾一刻都未曾忘记那日之事！: "Still"?!\nNot for one moment have I forgotten that day!
strings.好了好了，别说那个了。\\n噬星兽都来了哦。: Okay, okay, forget about that.\nThe Devourers of Stars are here.
strings.阿尔克！\\n汝无需再承担开路职责！\\n与吾等一同翱翔吧！: Alk!\nThou needst not clear the way anymore!\nSoar alongside us!
strings.明白——\\n那我得加油不能输给你啊！: Got it—\nThen I'd better do my best not to lose to you!
strings.哼。既然这样，\\n我也要展示一下锻炼的成果呢？: Hmph. In that case,\nI'll show off the results of my training too.
strings.非常好！\\n一同战斗吧！二位！: Excellent!\nLet us fight together! You two!
strings.就让汝等好好瞧瞧\\n支配天地的古龙的真正实力！: Let me show thee\nthe true might of an ancient dragon who rules heaven and earth!
strings.我过来……是想和你聊聊。: I came... to talk with you.
strings.我之前也说过……\\n我已经足够幸福了。\\n所以，那样就好……: I told you before...\nI'm already happy enough.\nSo it's fine like this...
strings.我不想让你后悔……\\n也不想看你露出这副表情。: I don't want you to have regrets...\nAnd I don't want to see you with that look on your face.
strings.要不要再去找他聊聊？\\n现在还来得及——: Why not go talk to him again?\nThere's still time—
strings.查特丽娜为什么会这么说呢？: Why would you say that, Chatrina?
strings.你不是听我说过了吗。\\n我不想再失去什么了。\\n我已经受够那种感觉了！: Didn't you hear what I said?\nI don't want to lose anything else.\nI've had enough of that feeling!
strings.我不想后悔……\\n所以，我已经不想和他说话……: I don't want regrets...\nSo I don't want to talk to him anymore...
strings.你骗人……\\n说什么已经聊够了，都是假的！: You're lying...\nSaying you've talked enough, that's all a lie!
strings.我知道的啊。\\n你很喜欢和人聊天，\\n有人愿意听你说，会让你很开心——: I know.\nYou love talking with people,\nand when someone listens to you, it makes you happy—
strings.和他在一起的时候\\n你真的很幸福……\\n那不都是你告诉我的吗！: When you're with him,\nyou're truly happy...\nIsn't that what you told me!
strings.我什么都愿意听。\\n秀恩爱也好，泄气话也好，\\n愿望也好，什么都好……: I'll listen to anything.\nGushing, grumbling,\nwishes, anything at all...
strings.想说什么就说出来啊，宝拉！: Say whatever you want to say, Paula!
strings.我不想离开他……: I don't want to leave him...
strings.我还想和萨姆聊天……\\n我想一直和他在一起！: I want to keep talking with Sam...\nI want to be with him forever!
strings.但是……来不及了。\\n他已经走了啊……: But... it's too late.\nHe's already gone...
strings.我听说，\\n先遣队已经做好准备要出发了……\\n我甚至没来得及和他告别……: I heard\nthe advance team is all set to depart...\nI didn't even get to say goodbye...
strings.不……我们还有很多能做的，\\n还有很多可以选择的路啊！: No... There's still so much we can do,\nso many paths we can choose!
strings.哇！好快！好快哦！\\n海风吹得好舒服！: Whoa! So fast! So fast!\nThe sea breeze feels so nice!
strings.二位，你们愿意帮忙，\\n实在是太感谢了！: Thank you both so much\nfor helping out!
strings.完全没问题！\\n在这种事上登场方式就是生命啊！\\n对吧，休尔尔！: No problem at all!\nIn situations like this, your entrance is everything!\nRight, Shururu!
strings.没错。\\n服装，和台词，是最重要的。: Exactly.\nCostume, and lines, are what matter most.
strings.好了，我们走吧。\\n你马上就能和他说上话了！: Okay, let's go.\nYou'll be talking to him in no time!
strings.我一事无成，\\n还让你帮了我这么多……我……: I haven't accomplished anything,\nand you've helped me so much... I...
strings.其实啊，创造未来的方法真的有很多哦。: Actually, there are lots of ways to create the future.
strings.找人帮人，\\n或是自己拜托别人、帮助别人都可以——: Finding someone to help someone,\nor asking someone yourself, or helping someone—
strings.或者说一声“来聊聊吧！”也可以哦。: Or just saying "Let's talk!" works too.
strings.呵呵，我听说了，\\n这种时候登场方式是很重要的！: Heh heh, I've heard\nthat at times like this, your entrance is important!
strings.我们早已经站在\\n能创造出明天的今天了啊！: We're already standing\nin a today that can create tomorrow!
strings.好了，说话的时候小心！\\n千万——: Okay, careful when you talk!\nWhatever you do—
strings.宝、宝拉？！怎么回事？！\\n你没事吧？！没受伤吧？！诶？啊？！: P-Paula?! What's going on?!\nAre you okay?! Are you hurt?! Huh? What?!
strings.嘿嘿，这都是多亏了你们啊。\\n太谢谢你们了！: Hee hee, it's all thanks to you two.\nThank you so much!
strings.亚美莉，休尔尔，\\n我可能找到自己想做的事情了！: Amelie, Shururu,\nI think I might've found what I want to do!
strings.就是那样。\\n宝拉和萨姆已经顺利在一起，\\n并且准备在旧矿山城定居了。: That's how it went.\nPaula and Sam are together now,\nand they're planning to settle in Miner's Front.
strings.她看上去非常幸福。\\n看得我都牙痒痒的，\\n但又很想一直从旁守护她！: She looks so happy.\nIt makes me grit my teeth,\nbut I also want to watch over her forever!
strings.其实我想说的就是，\\n帮助民众的方法果然有很多种呢！\\n所以——: What I actually wanted to say is,\nthere really are lots of ways to help the people!\nSo—
strings.能请您将我派遣到旧矿山城吗！: Would you send me to Miner's Front?!
strings.你愿意去当地一起帮忙，\\n实在没有比这更令我放心的了。: Nothing could reassure me more\nthan you going there to help.
strings.虽然你说自己“只会和人聊天”，\\n但不管在哪个世界，\\n能和所有人说上话都是: You say all you can do is "chat with people,"\nbut in any world,\nbeing able to talk with everyone is a remarkable thing.
strings.诶、诶诶？\\n非常感谢您的夸奖……\\n说得我都有点不好意思了。: Wh-Whaaat?\nThank you so much for the compliment...\nYou're making me a little embarrassed.
strings.不过还需要你报告情况，\\n所以记得定期回来啊。\\n而且……: But we'll need your reports,\nso be sure to come back regularly.\nAnd...
strings.一定有很多人想和你聊天呢。\\n当然，也包括我。: I'm sure there are lots of people who'll want to chat with you.\nMyself included, of course.
strings.非常感谢您！\\n那顺便一问，我可以现在就说吗？！: Thank you so much!\nBy the way, can I start talking right now?!
strings.我就知道你很想聊呢……\\n请尽管说吧！: I knew you'd want to talk...\nGo right ahead!
strings.异世界真的太厉害了！\\n有全是海的地方，有全是机械的地方，\\n还有到处都是人: Other worlds are so amazing!\nThere are places that are all sea, places that are all machines,\nand places with people everywhere!
strings.听说别的世界到了秋天\\n还会举办名为万圣节的庆典！\\n您不觉得茶露亚小姐就很: I heard that in other worlds, in autumn,\nthey hold a festival called Halloween!\nDon't you think Miss Challua would look great in costume?
strings.啊，我已经开始期待了！\\n到时候一定要邀请大家一起来——: Ah, I'm already looking forward to it!\nWe definitely have to invite everyone when it comes—
strings.所谓爆裂魔法，是非常纤细的东西！\\n它的颜色会根据当日的魔力、\\n身体状况…: Explosion magic is a very delicate thing!\nIts color changes depending on that day's magic power,\nphysical condition... and state of mind.
strings.在了解了这些以后，阿尔克，史黛拉，\\n你们觉得今天的爆裂魔法如何呢！: Now that you know that, Alk, Stella,\nwhat did you think of today's Explosion!
strings.灼烧肌肤的热度……\\n随之而来的平滑的风压。: The heat that scorched the skin...\nand the smooth blast wind that followed.
strings.将先前被爆炎削平的地面\\n剜得更深的那股破坏力……\\n实在是非常出色！: The destructive force that gouged even deeper\ninto ground already flattened by the blast...\nSimply outstanding!
strings.嘿嘿嘿嘿，不愧是二位！\\n你们已经很理解爆裂魔法了嘛！: Hee hee hee hee, that's you two for you!\nYou really understand Explosion now!
strings.那可不嘛，\\n他们都陪你放了好几次了。: Well, of course,\nthey've watched you cast it plenty of times.
strings.哎呀，现在能用爆裂魔法了，\\n真是太好了呢。: Still, it's really great\nyou can use Explosion now.
strings.没错！也非常感谢莉莉艾小姐！: Exactly! I'm so grateful to Miss Lilie too!
strings.托她的福，我才能向阿尔克和史黛拉\\n教授爆裂之道的真正精髓——: Thanks to her, I can teach Alk and Stella\nthe true essence of the path of Explosion—
strings.和真……我好像要、堕入深渊了。: Kazuma... I think I'm, about to fall into the abyss.
strings.哈？突然这是说什么呢。: Huh? What are you saying all of a sudden?
strings.我、我现在——\\n非常想去厕所……: I, I really—\nneed to go to the bathroom...
strings.事态紧急！\\n现在立刻返回星见镇！: It's an emergency!\nWe're heading back to Starview right now!
strings.等下！太晃了，稳一点啊！\\n你这样颠我，我感觉快不行了！: Wait! You're jostling too much, steady!\nIf you bounce me like that, I'm not gonna make it!
strings.没办法啊，你不是急吗！: Can't be helped, you're in a hurry, aren't you!
strings.话说——\\n红魔族竟然还需要上厕所啊？！: By the way—\nCrimson Demons need to use the bathroom?!
strings.当然不需要了！\\n但那个和这个是两回事！: Of course not!\nBut that's a separate matter!
strings.那你给我下去！\\n随便找个地方解决了，随便找个！: Then get off!\nJust go somewhere, anywhere!
strings.哈——？！？！\\n你想让我在这片空地上解决？！\\n你这个变态！死不足惜！死不: Whaaat—?!?!\nYou want me to do it out here in the open?!\nYou pervert! You deserve to die! To die!!
strings.二、二位！\\n总之现在得赶回去对吧？！: Y-You two!\nAnyway, we need to hurry back, right?!
strings.各位请先回去吧。\\n请直接回去，千万不要回头！: Everyone, please go back first.\nGo straight back, and whatever you do, don't look back!
strings.啊？哈？你说什么呢，\\n你刚才不还很不乐意……: Huh? What? What are you saying,\nweren't you totally against it a second ago...
strings.我不能再因为自己的任性\\n给你们添麻烦了……: I can't keep troubling you\nbecause of my own selfishness...
strings.你们愿意陪我放爆裂魔法，\\n我就已经很满足了……: That you'd keep me company while I cast Explosion\nis already more than enough...
strings.对不起，阿尔克、史黛拉、和真。\\n快把我放下，然后——: I'm sorry, Alk, Stella, Kazuma.\nPut me down, and then—
strings.等、等下啊？！\\n你怎么不听人说话！: W-Wait a sec?!\nWhy won't you listen!
strings.别说了，赶路要紧！\\n你专心顾自己就是了！: Stop talking, focus on getting there!\nJust worry about yourself!
strings.呜哇啊啊？！\\n这、这群羊是怎么回事啊，快让开！: Waaaah?!\nWh-What's with this flock of sheep, get out of the way!
strings.再不赶紧的话，惠惠的尊严就……\\n必须想点办法——: If we don't hurry, Megumin's dignity will...\nWe have to do something—
strings.法杖上的水晶……\\n它们被发光的东西吸引了？\\n既然如此……: The crystal on the staff...\nThey're attracted to shiny things?\nIn that case...
strings.这、这怎么行！那你们不就……: Th-That's not right! Then you'll be...
strings.没问题的。\\n我们一定会赶到惠惠想去的地方！: It's fine.\nWe'll make sure Megumin gets where she needs to go!
strings.史黛拉、阿尔克……\\n你们的好意，我心领了！: Stella, Alk...\nI gratefully accept your kindness!
strings.绝不放弃！亦是一种爆裂之道！\\n和真！拜托你了！: Never give up! That too is the path of Explosion!\nKazuma! I'm counting on you!
strings.我绝对不会让你们白白牺牲！\\n我们走吧，惠惠！: I won't let your sacrifice be in vain!\nLet's go, Megumin!
strings.哎呀，怎么说……真是太好了呢？\\n虽然，一路发生了很多事……: Well, how do I put it... that worked out?\nThough a lot happened along the way...
strings.累死我了……\\n每次都把我们耍得团团转，\\n她倒是考虑考虑我们的心情啊。: I'm exhausted...\nShe always runs us ragged,\nshe could stand to think about how we feel.
strings.哎呀，嗯……就是觉得，\\n我和史黛拉没法时时刻刻陪着你们。: Well, hmm... I was just thinking,\nStella and I can't be with you all the time.
strings.不过真亏你能每天\\n都陪惠惠放爆裂魔法啊。: Still, I'm impressed you go with Megumin\nto cast Explosion every single day.
strings.啊，这个嘛……\\n嗯……自然而然就成这样了吧？: Ah, well...\nHmm... it just kind of ended up that way?
strings.所以说，那家伙实在太娇气了。\\n像上次啊——: Like I said, she's way too spoiled.\nLike last time—
strings.真的非常感谢你，史黛拉。\\n多亏了你，我才没有丧失自己的尊严！: Thank you so much, Stella.\nThanks to you, I didn't lose my dignity!
strings.你们二位愿意挺身守护我！\\n实在是太帅了！: You two put yourselves on the line to protect me!\nThat was so cool!
strings.今天我非常开心呢。: I had a lot of fun today.
strings.和大家一起克服危机！\\n这也是通往爆裂之道的一步呢！: Overcoming a crisis together with everyone!\nThat's one more step on the path of Explosion!
strings.没错。\\n和真也一路背着惠惠直到回来呢。: That's right.\nAnd Kazuma carried Megumin on his back all the way back.
strings.那、那是理所应当的！\\n和真的任务就是把\\n放完爆裂魔法的我背回来嘛！: Th-That's only natural!\nKazuma's job is to carry me back\nafter I cast Explosion!
strings.不、不过！\\n他平时简直处处差劲！\\n上次也是的……: B-But!\nUsually he's terrible at everything!\nLike last time...
strings.啊哈哈，我没事的~\\n抱歉啊，昨天我一下乱了手脚！: Ahaha, I'm fine~\nSorry, I got all flustered yesterday!
strings.嗯，那就行……: Yeah, as long as you're okay...
strings.今天还要不要去哪里约会？: Want to go somewhere on a date today too?
strings.唔……抱歉。\\n今天我想一个人随便逛逛。: Hmm... Sorry.\nToday I want to wander around on my own.
strings.我之前……不是被勇希甩了嘛？: I got... dumped by Yuki before, right?
strings.但那时候，我也没什么所谓。\\n拒绝就拒绝，还能继续当朋友，\\n也没觉得哪里不: But back then, I didn't really mind.\nShe turned me down, but we could still be friends,\nand it didn't feel bad at all.
strings.嗯……我也这么想呢。\\n也有种还是比不过你的感觉。: Yeah... I thought so too.\nIt kind of felt like I'd never measure up to you.
strings.那算什么啊。\\n完全不懂你的意思~……: What's that supposed to mean.\nI totally don't get you~...
strings.我还以为……自己已经很喜欢小缘了。\\n但和她对我的感情比起来，还是不一样啊。: I thought... I already really liked Yukari.\nBut compared to how she feels about me, it's still different.
strings.明明只要和阿翔在一起，\\n我就已经很幸福了……\\n但为什么……会这样……: Just being with Sho\nalready makes me happy...\nSo why... is it like this...
strings.你好像没做什么需要道歉的事吧。: I don't think you did anything to apologize for.
strings.非也！绝非如此！！！\\n在下粗暴地践踏了无辜情侣♡的恋爱之旅！\\n简直是不可: Not so! Not so at all!!!\nI brutally trampled an innocent couple's♡ romantic journey!\nAn unforgivable outrage!!!
strings.斩铁先生没有做错什么。\\n真的没有。: You didn't do anything wrong, Mr. Zantetsu.\nReally, you didn't.
strings.能和阿翔交往，\\n明明是件很开心的事情——: Dating Sho\nshould be such a happy thing—
strings.不……是害怕了解真正的自己吗？: No... are you afraid of knowing your true self?
strings.缘子阁下和在下完全相反。\\n在下去模仿自身憧憬之物，\\n是为了隐藏真实的自我: Lady Yukariko is my complete opposite.\nI imitate what I long for\nin order to hide my true self.
strings.但缘子阁下是为了逃离\\n自己不想成为的模样——: But you, Lady Yukariko, are running away\nfrom who you don't want to become—
strings.那我该怎么办才好啊？\\n请你教教我啊，好吗？: Then what am I supposed to do?\nTell me, won't you?
strings.好吗？好吗？好吗？好吗？好吗？好吗？\\n好吗？好吗？好吗？好吗？好吗？好吗？\: Won't you? Won't you? Won't you? Won't you? Won't you? Won't you?\nWon't you? Won't you? Won't you? Won't you? Won't you? Won't you?\nWon't you? Won't you? Won't you? Won't you? Won't you? Won't you?
strings.我真的、真的……\\n喜欢阿翔……喜欢得不得了！！: I really, really...\nlove Sho... love him so much!!
strings.我只是想和在他一起，\\n找到自由——: I just wanted to be with him,\nand find freedom—
strings.我果然是那个女人的女儿啊，\\n根本无法抗拒那种肤浅的欲望。: I really am that woman's daughter.\nI can't resist those shallow desires at all.
strings.但是那个不想成为的“我”……\\n就是不肯彻底消失！: But that "me" I don't want to become...\njust won't disappear completely!
strings.请、请问你好一点了吗？: A-Are you feeling a little better?
strings.非常抱歉……是我在乱发脾气。\\n不过，多亏这样，我也终于明白了。: I'm so sorry... I was throwing a tantrum.\nBut thanks to that, I finally understand.
strings.是阿翔……拯救了我啊——\\n但是，那样真的让我很痛苦。: Sho... saved me—\nbut that's what hurts me so much.
strings.能面对自己，认清自我……\\n缘子阁下真的很厉害啊。: Facing yourself and recognizing who you are...\nYou're truly amazing, Lady Yukariko.
strings.我要……和阿翔分手。: I'm going to... break up with Sho.
strings.阿翔，抱歉。\\n明明前面还拒绝了你，\\n现在又把你叫到这里来。: Sho, I'm sorry.\nI turned you down earlier,\nand now I've called you out here.
strings.哎呀，没事啦。\\n正好我也有话想和你说呢。: Oh, it's fine.\nI actually had something I wanted to tell you too.
strings.我说啊，小缘，\\n要不要先把“交往”这件事放一放？: Hey, Yukari,\nhow about we put "dating" on hold for a bit?
strings.我还是不太明白小缘的想法啊。\\n所以，唔，怎么说呢——: I still don't really get how you think, Yukari.\nSo, um, how do I put it—
strings.我想要好好正视你。\\n所以，就交往一阵、歇一阵……\\n这主意怎么样呢？: I want to look at you properly.\nSo, we date for a while, take a break for a while...\nHow does that sound?
strings.哪有什么可不可以的……\\n这是我自己决定的啊！: It's not about whether it's okay...\nI decided this myself!
strings.所以，能告诉我你想怎么做吗？: So, will you tell me what you want to do?
strings.呜噢？！\\n这样拉近距离真的不好啦！\\n尤其对我来说！！！: Whoa?!\nGetting this close is really not okay!\nEspecially for me!!!
strings.我、我、我……\\n总有一天，一定要摆脱这诅咒……\\n一定要慢慢地、慢慢去克服: I, I, I...\nsomeday, I'll definitely break free of this curse...\nI'll overcome it, little by little...
strings.所以，我也……要和阿翔一起——: So I'll... do it together with you, Sho—
strings.嗯。\\n那又要请你多关照啦。: Yeah.\nThen I'm in your care again.
strings.嗯、嗯！\\n阿翔……我最喜欢你了！！！: Y-Yeah!\nSho... I love you most of all!!!
strings.那个……\\n差不多了吧……能放开我了吗？: Um...\nThat's about enough... Can you let go of me?
strings.你有在听我说话吗？！\\n这样真的不好啦！\\n完全不是暂时放一放的距离吧！: Are you even listening to me?!\nThis is really not okay!\nThis is not the distance for "on hold" at all!
strings.不行♡\\n我也变得更自由一点了嘛！: Nope♡\nI've gotten a little more free too!
strings.瞬杀！秒杀！\\n不愧是备受期待的新人天才格斗少女！\\n简直是太精彩了！: Instant kill! One-second KO!\nAs expected of the hotly anticipated rookie genius fighter girl!\nWhat a spectacular match!
strings.喔，斗技场的工作很顺利啊。\\n那很好啊。: Oh, the arena work's going well.\nGood for you.
strings.是！\\n今天回来的路上，\\n也有女粉丝和我搭话了！: Yes!\nOn the way back today,\na girl fan even came up to talk to me!
strings.所以，泰加先生！\\n我还想变得更强！: So, Mr. Taiga!\nI want to get even stronger!
strings.如果我能做到更多，\\n能学会更多战斗方法，\\n就一定能帮到白金！: If I can do more,\nand learn more ways to fight,\nI'm sure I can help Platinum Legends!
strings.所以！今后也请你多多指教了！: So! Please keep teaching me from now on!
strings.呵……你总是在为别人着想啊。: Heh... You're always thinking of others.
strings.没问题！\\n就尽情用我的招数去取悦世人吧！\\n那样对我来说也更好！: No problem!\nUse my moves to entertain the world all you like!\nThat suits me better anyway!
strings.白金欢迎临时嘉宾吗？: Does Platinum Legends welcome guest fighters?
strings.嗯，我感兴趣的是变强了的你。: Yes, what interests me is you, now that you've gotten stronger.
strings.我只是永远在寻求强敌罢了。: I'm merely forever seeking strong opponents.
strings.我、我也不太清楚，\\n我会去问问团里的人。\\n应该没有问题！: I-I'm not really sure,\nI'll ask the people in the troupe.\nIt should be fine!
strings.你想策划一场演出？: You want to plan a show?
strings.我真的受了白金很多照顾……: Platinum Legends has done so much for me...
strings.所以，我想编排一场能\\n让观众开心的新表演……\\n以此来报答大家！: So I want to put together a new show\nthat will make the audience happy...\nto repay everyone!
strings.唔……\\n只是以拳脚竞技还不够吗？: Hmm...\nIsn't fighting with fists and feet enough?
strings.但那样还不够“精彩”吧？\\n嗯嗯，我想想……: But it's not "exciting" enough, is it?\nHmm, let me think...
strings.找学院帮忙来一场魔导手甲演武如何？！\\n也许能借机让帕尔佩布拉的战士们\\n一: How about getting the academy's help for a magic gauntlet exhibition?!\nIt might be the chance to turn all of Palpebra's warriors\ninto martial artists at once—
strings.那只是老爷子的私心吧……: That's just your own agenda, old man...
strings.话说，你自己没有什么想做的吗？: By the way, isn't there anything you want to do?
strings.这个嘛……嗯……\\n我说了你们不要笑我……: Well... um...\nPromise you won't laugh at me...
strings.我、我想要艾可莉儿小姐\\n那样的……“闪耀吧……”！: I-I want something like Miss Eclair's...\n"Shine...!"
strings.非常抱歉……是我太傲慢了！: I'm so sorry... I was being arrogant!
strings.不会啊。不是挺好的吗？\\n听起来很有趣啊。: Not at all. Isn't it great?\nSounds fun.
strings.嗯嗯。\\n也就是说，你想要必杀技？\\n想要大声喊出招数名称？: Mm-hm.\nSo in other words, you want a special move?\nYou want to shout the name of your move?
strings.我之前就一直想问了……\\n喊招数名字到底有什么意义？: I've always wanted to ask...\nwhat's the point of shouting the move's name?
strings.唔……但我想要的不只是必杀技……: Hmm... But it's not just a special move I want...
strings.你想要自己的风格对吧？: You want your own style, right?
strings.没错！\\n比如“我乃疾风芙拉菲！”之类的……: Exactly!\nLike "I am Fluffy the Gale!" or something...
strings.毕竟你们是做生意的，\\n思索这些也是为了工作着想。\\n比某个触手女正常得多了: You're in the business, after all,\nso thinking about this is for work.\nWay more normal than a certain tentacle woman.
strings.我、我只是想模仿一下\\n艾可莉儿小姐而已……: I-I just wanted to imitate\nMiss Eclair a little...
strings.不过……蒂妮小姐也确实\\n很有自己的风格呢……\\n也许也能参考一下她？: Still... Miss Denah really does\nhave a style all her own...\nMaybe I could use her as a reference too?
strings.你还真是一本正经啊。\\n说话像演戏一样的女人又要变多了吗……: You're so earnest.\nMore women who talk like they're in a play, huh...
strings.演戏！就是那个！\\n非常谢谢你，白！: A play! That's it!\nThank you so much, Nimbus!
strings.你到底在说什么啊……: What are you even talking about...
strings.那么！今天她的对手是这位！\\n如疾风怒涛般高歌猛进的新人斗士——: And now! Today, her opponent is this fighter!\nA rookie who charges ahead like a raging gale—
strings.啊——哈哈哈哈哈哈！\\n愚蠢的女士们&先生们！\\n准备好接受我的支配了吗？: Ah—hahahahahaha!\nFoolish ladies & gentlemen!\nAre you ready to submit to my rule?
strings.“CRT13”的女王希尔克哈蕾，\\n前来收下这个斗技场了！: Silkhare, queen of "CRT13,"\nhas come to claim this arena!
strings.哎呀，真是位激进的客人。\\n不过，这样真的好吗？\\n这里可是斗技场啊。: My, what an aggressive guest.\nBut is this really wise?\nThis is an arena, you know.
strings.呵呵，女王何需亲自战斗。\\n去吧，我的士兵！斩首兔——: Heh heh, a queen needn't fight herself.\nGo, my soldier! Vorpal Bunny—
strings.芙拉菲！\\n难道……你被洗脑了吗！: Fluffy!\nDon't tell me... you've been brainwashed!
strings.好吧……\\n就用我的光辉让你清醒过来！: Very well...\nI'll bring you back to your senses with my radiance!
strings.希尔克哈蕾小姐……太谢谢你了！\\n还有，真的很对不起！: Miss Silkhare... thank you so much!\nAnd I'm really sorry!
strings.呵呵，没有关系。\\n我早就看过剧本，\\n知道自己是什么角色。: Heh heh, it's no trouble.\nI read the script long ago\nand knew what my role was.
strings.而且……我、我们是朋友吧？\\n所以帮你也是应该的！: Besides... w-we're friends, right?\nSo of course I'd help you!
strings.那个……\\n史黛拉觉得今天的对决如何呢？: Um...\nWhat did Stella think of today's match?
strings.那真是……太好了！\\n我也非常、非常开心！: That's... great!\nI had a really, really good time too!
strings.那大家一起去举杯庆祝一下吧！\\n就去最近很火的那家咖喱店，怎么样？: Then let's all go raise a toast!\nHow about that curry shop that's been popular lately?
strings.我也有很多事想向队长报告！: I have lots to report to the captain too!
strings.敌人比想象中还要棘手啊！: The enemy's tougher than I thought!
strings.但我们的攻击比上次更有效了，\\n只差一口气就能打倒它了！: But our attacks are working better than last time,\nwe're just one push away from beating it!
strings.确认到敌对生物陷入虚弱状态。: Hostile lifeform confirmed to be weakened.
strings.太好了！\\n这是我们大家的胜利啊！: Yes!\nThis is a victory for all of us!
strings.虽然还挺强的，\\n但遇到了我们SOS团，\\n算是你的气数到头了！: You were pretty strong,\nbut your luck ran out\nwhen you met the SOS Brigade!
strings.解析完成……\\n它连通着我们原本的世界。: Analysis complete...\nIt connects to our original world.
strings.这个通道非常稳定，\\n不会很快消失。\\n只不过……它是单向的。: This passage is very stable\nand won't disappear soon.\nHowever... it's one-way.
strings.一切都结束了以后\\n反而感觉有点不舍啊。: Now that it's all over,\nI kind of don't want to leave.
strings.给我等下，阿虚！\\n别自说自话地说结束语啊，\\n我还没准备回去呢？: Hold on, Kyon!\nDon't go giving a closing speech on your own,\nI'm not ready to go back yet!
strings.难得能来这么有趣的世界，\\n能和异世界的大家一起玩耍。: We finally made it to such a fun world,\nand got to play with everyone from another world.
strings.通关以后不继续做做成就就回去，\\n来这一趟也太不值了吧！: Going home without doing the achievements after clearing it\nwould make this whole trip a waste!
strings.（完蛋了啊啊啊！\\n我完全忘记了游戏在通关以后\\n还有收集要素了啊啊啊啊啊！: (We're dooomed!\nI completely forgot games have\npost-game collectibles!)
strings.史黛拉告诉过我，\\n这里还有很多很多其他的世界啊？: Stella told me\nthere are lots and lots of other worlds here, right?
strings.嗯，是那样没错。\\n连我们都没有游历过所有的世界呢。: Yes, that's right.\nEven we haven't visited every world.
strings.那就大家一起出发去探险吧！\\n一定会非常开心的！: Then let's all go explore together!\nIt's going to be so much fun!
strings.隐藏关卡和隐藏BOSS！\\n还有各种提升数值的道具！\\n嘿嘿，实在太让人兴奋: Hidden stages and hidden bosses!\nAnd all sorts of stat-boosting items!\nHee hee, this is so exciting!
strings.（呃啊，绝对会有很多S难度的关卡\\n在后面等着的啊！）: (Ugh, there are definitely tons of S-rank stages\nwaiting for us later!)
strings.（可恶……\\n我到底还能不能活着回去啊？）: (Dammit...\nAm I even going to make it home alive?)
strings.隐藏关卡？隐藏BOSS？\\n呃、唔……\\n要是真的存在就好了呢……: Hidden stages? Hidden bosses?\nUh, um...\nIt'd be nice if they really existed...
strings.这点不用担心。\\n凉宫同学应该会在无意识中\\n把那些全都创造出来吧。: No need to worry about that.\nSuzumiya will probably create them all\nunconsciously.
strings.我们欢迎你们留下。: We'd be happy for you to stay.
strings.嗯，确实……要是你们走了，\\n我也会觉得有点寂寞呢……: Yeah, true... If you all left,\nI'd feel a little lonely...
strings.但我们也不能一直麻烦你们……: But we can't keep imposing on you forever...
strings.不用在意那些。\\n有什么万一的话，就像刚才那场战斗那样，\\n大家齐心协力团结: Don't worry about that.\nIf anything happens, just like that battle earlier,\nwe'll all band together and face it.
strings.没错没错，\\n再偷偷地开作战会议就好！: That's right, that's right,\nand hold secret strategy meetings!
strings.哈哈，这下头疼了。\\n你们这么热情地挽留我们，\\n让我的决心都动摇了啊。: Haha, now this is a dilemma.\nWith you all so eager to keep us,\nmy resolve is wavering.
strings.阿虚，我也想……\\n在这里多待一会儿。: Kyon, I'd also like...\nto stay here a little longer.
strings.当然了，我必须待在凉宫同学身边……\\n但不只是因为那样。: Of course, I need to stay by Suzumiya's side...\nbut it's not just that.
strings.能帮到大家……我真的、非常开心，\\n所以……我还想……: Being able to help everyone... made me really, really happy,\nso... I want to...
strings.你好像还挺乐在其中的啊？: Looks like you're enjoying yourself, huh?
strings.我和她意见相同呢，\\n阿虚你呢？: I'm of the same opinion as her.\nWhat about you, Kyon?
strings.那还用说吗……\\n我也感觉很开心啊！: Need you ask...\nI've been having fun too!
strings.那我们就要继续叨扰各位了，\\n虽然总觉得会给你们添麻烦——: Then we'll keep imposing on you all,\nthough I feel like we'll cause you trouble—
strings.看来大家终于下定决心了啊！\\n那就好好玩遍各个异世界吧！: Looks like everyone finally made up their minds!\nThen let's have fun in every other world!
strings.竟然说要玩遍……\\n你到底想在这里待多久啊？: Have fun in every world...\nJust how long are you planning to stay here?
strings.当然是要去过所有世界再回去啦！: Until we've been to every world, of course!
strings.不，这样不也挺好的吗？\\n你想让异世界也变得热闹起来对吧？: No, isn't that fine?\nYou want to liven up the other worlds too, right?
strings.那是当然的了。\\n而且，准确来说是让“全世界”\\n都变得热闹起来哦！: Obviously.\nAnd to be precise, we're going to liven up\n"the whole world"!
strings.由我们SOS团和阿尔克一行人组成的\\n最强军团来让世界变得更加热闹！: The ultimate army made up of us, the SOS Brigade,\nand Alk's crew will liven up the world even more!
strings.既然到了这个像游戏一样的世界，\\n就应该像享受游戏一样享受它……\\n是这样没: Since we're in a world that's just like a game,\nwe should enjoy it like a game...\nIsn't that right?
strings.说得是呢。\\n既然都来了，是不是也应该换套衣服，\\n融入这里的氛围呢……: That's true.\nSince we're here, maybe we should change clothes\nto blend in with the atmosphere...
strings.我听到了哦，实玖琉~！\\n放心吧，我会精心为你挑选服装的♪: I heard that, Mikuru~!\nDon't worry, I'll carefully pick out an outfit for you♪
strings.好了，异世界之旅才刚刚开始哦！\\n大家鼓起干劲一起出发吧！: All right, our journey through other worlds has only just begun!\nLet's all get fired up and head out!

strings.那么……现在开始训练！: Now then... let the training begin!
strings.原来如此……你确实很强！: I see... You certainly are strong!
strings.但是，你的拳中还留有迷茫……: But there's still hesitation in your fists...
strings.强大并非你的答案……\\n我说的没错吧？: Strength isn't your answer...\nAm I right?
strings.果然……\\n在巴拉克先生看来也是如此吗？: So... even Mr. Barrek sees it that way?
strings.我想说的是，如果你想变强，\\n我完全可以当你的对手。\\n但如果不是，那我就帮: What I mean is, if you want to get stronger,\nI'll gladly be your opponent.\nBut if not, I can't help you.
strings.没关系，感谢你的指点！\\n真的非常谢谢你！: That's okay, thank you for the advice!\nThank you so much!
strings.不过……不管走上哪条路，\\n你都一定会变强。\\n我也想见识下你摆脱了迷茫的拳: Still... whatever path you take,\nyou're sure to grow stronger.\nI'd like to see your fists once they're free of hesitation.
strings.等你不再迷茫的时候，\\n再与我以拳相交吧！: When you're no longer lost,\ncome trade blows with me again!
strings.我也很想帮上别人。: And I really want to help people.
strings.但是，我很怀疑那究竟\\n是不是属于我的想法——: But I'm not sure\nwhether those thoughts are really mine—
strings.原来如此，\\n那确实是个很难的问题。\\n说是人生的命题也不为过呢。: I see,\nthat is a difficult question.\nYou could even call it life's great question.
strings.你想要找到自己的闪光点吧？: You want to find your own sparkle, don't you?
strings.不管是谁，\\n都能像星星那样闪耀，\\n都会伸手去寻找闪光。: Everyone\ncan shine like the stars,\nand reaches out for a light of their own.
strings.但是，天空中却有亿万个光点！\\n那自然会让人迷茫。\\n我也不完全明白自己想要: But the sky holds billions of points of light!\nOf course that makes people lost.\nEven I don't fully know what I want.
strings.但是，如果你只想要一个——\\n那我应该能帮你找到照耀你的星星哦。: But if you want just one—\nI think I can help you find the star that lights your way.
strings.请……请你教教我吧！\\n艾可莉儿小姐！\\n我也……想要变得闪耀！: P-Please teach me!\nMiss Eclair!\nI... want to shine too!
strings.我能做的只是为你准备一个\\n能让你发光发热的舞台而已。: All I can do is prepare a stage\nwhere you can shine bright.
strings.我这次的对手临时决定退出。\\n所以，我正在找闪闪发光的孩子呢。: My opponent for this time suddenly dropped out.\nSo I'm looking for a sparkling kid.
strings.芙拉菲，和我较量一下吧！: Fluffy, have a match with me!
strings.好了，幸运的各位先生女士们！\\n接下来就是今天的压轴表演！: All right, lucky ladies and gentlemen!\nNext up is today's grand finale!
strings.非常感谢你们能来！\\n就让我来为各位介绍一下\\n今日我最棒的对手吧。: Thank you so much for coming!\nLet me introduce\nmy finest opponent of the day.
strings.那是一颗耀眼的原石，\\n是以拳把握未来的斗士——芙拉菲！: A dazzling diamond in the rough,\na fighter who seizes the future with her fists—Fluffy!
strings.呃、那个、呃……\\n我一定会用自己的光芒\\n把你们都打倒……嗯！！！: Uh, um, er...\nI'll defeat you all\nwith my own light... Yeah!!!
strings.呵呵，很不错啊。\\n就让我看看你的耀眼之处吧！: Heh heh, very nice.\nLet me see what makes you shine!
strings.请你多多指教！: I look forward to fighting you!
strings.厉害！和我听说的一样呢。\\n找你来真是找对了。: Amazing! Just like I heard.\nI was right to ask you.
strings.不过动作还有点僵硬啊。\\n你很紧张吗？: But your movements are still a little stiff.\nAre you nervous?
strings.这……但我会加油的——: W-Well... but I'll do my best—
strings.你很厉害啊，小妹妹！\\n再多让我们看看你的招数！: You're amazing, little lady!\nShow us more of your moves!
strings.来吧，让我们看看你的光芒，\\n以及你想要拥有的未来——: Come on, show us your light,\nand the future you want to have—
strings.艾可莉儿小姐……\\n如果我赢了，\\n应该能让观众们更兴奋吧？: Miss Eclair...\nif I win,\nthe audience will get even more excited, right?
strings.应该会让很多人开心吧？！: It'll make lots of people happy, right?!
strings.承载星辰的风啊——: O wind that carries the stars—
strings.哎呀，实在太谢谢你了！\\n观众们也都看得很开心呢！\\n不愧是艾可莉儿推荐来的: Oh, thank you so much!\nThe audience had a great time too!\nJust what you'd expect of Eclair's pick!
strings.啊……不、不好意思。\\n那个……怎么说呢，我——: Ah... S-Sorry.\nUm... how do I put it, I—
strings.我想起了之前当圣诞老人的事……: I remembered the time I played Santa...
strings.艾可莉儿小姐，\\n我果然只能为他人而战啊。: Miss Eclair,\nI really can only fight for others.
strings.那样很好啊。\\n我认为，那份光芒真的非常美丽。: That's a good thing.\nI think that light is truly beautiful.
strings.芙拉菲，\\n能让你变得耀眼的星星，\\n一定就是“笑容”啊。: Fluffy,\nthe star that makes you shine\nmust be "smiles."
strings.非常感谢你！艾可莉儿小姐！: Thank you so much! Miss Eclair!
strings.然后，那个——\\n今后！能让我在白金工作吗！: And, um—\nfrom now on! Will you let me work at Platinum Legends!
strings.就、就算不当斗士也行！\\n让我干杂活也完全没问题！: E-Even if I'm not a fighter!\nI'm totally fine doing odd jobs!
strings.还、还有，\\n我很喜欢和人战斗！\\n所以还能陪各位练习！: A-And also,\nI love fighting!\nSo I can be everyone's sparring partner too!
strings.呵呵，真是刺激的自荐啊。\\n你觉得呢？: Heh heh, what a thrilling self-recommendation.\nWhat do you think?
strings.我们本就想邀请你呢。\\n你愿意加入，我们当然欢迎！: We were planning to invite you anyway.\nOf course we'd welcome you!
strings.祝福你踏上崭新的道路。\\n欢迎来到白金！: Congratulations on your new path.\nWelcome to Platinum Legends!
strings.是！\\n请你们多多指教！: Yes!\nI look forward to working with you!
strings.而我，今天也还活着。: And I am still alive today.
strings.欢迎来到龙龙互动广场！\\n今天这里就正式开放了呢！: Welcome to the Dragon Petting Plaza!\nIt officially opens today!
strings.确、确实听你说起过……\\n但没想到真的能建成啊……: Y-You did mention it...\nbut I never thought it would actually get built...
strings.很厉害吧！\\n是法夫和安巴赫小姐提出的！: Amazing, right!\nFaf and Miss Anbach proposed it!
strings.他们还教了我接触离群龙的方法。\\n里姆尼斯他们也来帮忙了，\\n资金是埃尔梅丽: They taught me how to approach stray dragons too.\nRemnith and the others came to help,\nand Miss Elmelissa provided the funds—
strings.除了这里，收容猫咖和\\n收容狗咖也都建好了！\\n大家真的、真的都好厉害啊！: Besides this, the rescue cat cafe and\nrescue dog cafe are done too!\nEveryone is really, really amazing!
strings.哎呀，不用再那么沉重了吗？？？: Oh, so no more gloomy face???

strings.它们从未使吾战胜宿命……\\n那么，吾便不再需要！: They never let me triumph over fate...\nThen I need them no longer!
strings.汝那是何种表情？！: What is that look on thy face?!
strings.但是，莱特和阿尔克都没事。: But Light and Alk are okay.
strings.那……那与此事有何关系？！: Wh-What does that have to do with this?!
strings.吾已下定决心不再战斗。: I have resolved never to fight again.
strings.你是愿意战斗的龙。\\n是那样没错吧？: You're a dragon who's willing to fight.\nIsn't that right?
strings.我……没能赶上史黛拉。\\n我在“哭哭”的时候才到。: I... didn't make it in time for Stella.\nI got there during the "crying."
strings.抱歉，史黛拉，能让我说几句吗？\\n不对，就算你拒绝我也要说，\\n你不知不知道: Sorry, Stella, can I say something?\nNo, I'm saying it even if you refuse.\nDon't you know—
strings.你这样！也太————土了啊？！: You like this! Are SOOOO lame?!
strings.怎样啊？搞得像个人类一样？\\n根本是在到处给自己找借口啊？\\n真要说你其实就: What's with you? Acting like some human?\nYou're just making excuses all over the place, aren't you?\nWhen it comes down to it, you're scared, right?!
strings.啊~~~！土死了！土死了土死了！\\n实在太逊了吧！什么炎龙王啊？\\n根本就是: Aaargh~~~! So lame! So lame, so lame!\nThat's way too pathetic! What Flame Dragon King?\nYou're crap! The King of Crap!
strings.让他们见识下你的烈火和尖牙啊！\\n我也不知道该让谁见识才好！\\n但那都无所谓: Show them your blazing fire and sharp fangs!\nI don't know who you should show them to!\nBut who cares, just pick someone—
strings.怎样啊？\\n没有什么命运啊宿命啊\\n之类中二的台词你就——: What's wrong?\nWithout your edgy lines about destiny and fate\nand stuff, you just—
strings.咿……\\n那、那个、呃，要说狂妄，\\n我自己也觉得有点——: Eek...\nW-Well, um, uh, about insolent,\nI kind of think so too—
strings.好吧。\\n汝就随我一同——\\n前往最前线吧！: Very well.\nThou shalt come with me—\nto the very front line!
strings.与吾共同航向下段旅途，拉夫马诺！\\n休想让吾留情！汝就拼死跟上吧！: Sail with me on the next leg of the journey, Rustamov!\nExpect no mercy! Follow me as if your life depends on it!
strings.哈哈……哈哈哈哈哈！\\n我看你才是，总那样没志气的话，\\n我可要独占龙王的名: Haha... Hahahahaha!\nIf you ask me, if you keep being so spineless,\nI'll take the Dragon King title for myself, you know?
strings.哪里好了？\\n我简直想反省一下，\\n是不是说得太过火了啊~？: What's great about it?\nI kind of want to reflect on\nwhether I went too far~?
strings.莱、莱特？你刚才、在飞？: L-Light? Were you, flying just now?
strings.沉睡的龙……\\n看来你已经知道了啊……: The sleeping dragon...\nSo you already know...
strings.潜伏于深渊的始原之龙——\\n没想到，它显现于世\\n只是为了区区一名少年。: The Primordial Dragon lurking in the abyss—\nwho would have thought it manifested in this world\nfor the sake of a single boy.
strings.我现在算是明白，\\n那个自称至高者的男人为什么只将\\n继承器留给了我，然后笑: Now I finally understand\nwhy the man who called himself the Supreme One left\nthe cryptic artifacts only to me, and died smiling.
strings.他早知不可能，却还是将\\n“抵达至高”的愿望强加给了我。: He knew it was impossible, yet he still forced upon me\nhis wish to "reach the Supreme."
strings.既然你明白，那为什么？\\n事到如今，你们已经没办法——: If you understand that, then why?\nAt this point, there's no way you can—
strings.当然有啊。\\n不然噬星兽怎会行动。: Of course there is.\nOtherwise, why would the Devourers of Stars move?
strings.世界并没有溶解……\\n但是，龙怀抱的少年却消失了。\\n你能理解这其中的意义吗: The world did not dissolve...\nbut the boy the dragon held vanished.\nDo you understand what that means?
strings.龙拥有了缺陷啊。\\n它的胸口出现了人形的空洞。: The dragon now has a flaw.\nA human-shaped hole in its chest.
strings.那么，只要放入替代品便好……: Then all I need do is put a substitute in it...
strings.不行的啊……你也知道吧？\\n以我的力量，无法抵达龙身边。: That's impossible... You know that, don't you?\nWith my power, I can't reach the dragon.
strings.我明白啊。\\n所以，我一直在等待时机。: I know.\nThat's why I've been waiting for the right moment.
strings.珂艾特看到了！开启吧，深渊之——: Couette sees it! Open, gate of the ab—
strings.演员都到齐了啊……\\n来吧，噬龙者。: The whole cast has assembled...\nCome, Dragon Eater.
strings.数次潜入遥远世界的少女。\\n特异点。新的夹缝魔女。\\n还有——: The girl who dove into distant worlds again and again.\nThe singularity. The new Witch of the Rift.\nAnd—
strings.抱歉啊，“露玛”。\\n我本来没打算再见你的。: Sorry, "Rooma."\nI never meant to see you again.
strings.我这里还有阿鲁玛的一丝残骸。\\n就请你把冥龙的力量还回来吧。: I still hold a scrap of Arma's remains.\nPlease return the power of the Dragon of Darkness.
strings.已经够了……够了啊……\\n全都结束了……大家都不在了啊……: It's enough... enough...\nIt's all over... Everyone's gone...
strings.从我们身上夺走一切的人也好！\\n斯特拉托斯王国也好！都消失了啊！\\n剩下的…: The ones who took everything from us!\nThe Kingdom of Stratos! They're all gone!\nAll that's left... is you and me!
strings.我不是说了吗……\\n那是你和你弟弟的故事。: Didn't I tell you...\nThat's the story of you and your brother.
strings.伊迪亚·斯特拉托斯确实是\\n第一个使用了继承器的人。\\n但是，那只是“最开始: Edea Stratos was indeed\nthe first to use the cryptic artifacts.\nBut that is only "the first page."
strings.你听不明白吗？\\n继承器能转移使用者的记忆。\\n但是，接收到记忆的“大脑”呢: You don't understand?\nThe cryptic artifacts can transfer the user's memories.\nBut what of the "brain" that receives them?
strings.我们所有人都“不一样”啊。\\n对每一个个体来说，\\n过去的记忆不过是书中的一: Each of us is "different."\nTo each individual,\npast memories are just a page in a book.
strings.我们继承到的是更为纯粹的东西。\\n经由无数人传承仍不朽不散之物。\\n层层堆叠: What we inherit is something purer.\nSomething that remains undying through countless hands.\nLayer upon layer of history, will, and wishes—
strings.强行撬开了龙之路？！\\n这怎么可能！: She forced open the Dracostream?!\nThat's impossible!
strings.该死的怪物……\\n但是，你已经失去了勇者之力……\\n我仍然有机会取胜！: Damned monster...\nBut you've lost the power of the hero...\nI still have a chance to win!
strings.站起来，贝尔赛蒂亚。\\n现在不是休息的时候吧。: Stand up, Belsidia.\nThis is no time to rest.
strings.拜托了。我一个人赢不了。\\n我需要你和珂艾特的力量啊。: Please. I can't win alone.\nI need your strength and Couette's.
strings.你能行的。\\n那些孩子不是已经教过你，\\n这种时候应该怎么做了吗？: You can do it.\nHaven't those kids already taught you\nwhat to do at a time like this?
strings.莱特！要来了！\\n星星要掉下来了！: Light! It's coming!\nThe stars are falling!
strings.雷电啊，吾友啊……\\n请将力量借给我吧？: O lightning, my friend...\nlend me your strength, won't you?
strings.竟然还能仿造出剑，\\n你很厉害啊！咏星者卡佩拉！: You can even forge a copy of the sword?\nImpressive! Capella of the Star Augurs!
strings.但是，没用的……\\n这场战斗，是我们赢了！: But it's no use...\nThis battle is ours!
strings.光啊，愿望啊！贯穿吧————: O light, O wish! Pierce through—
strings.你的诅咒……就由我带走！: Your curse... I'll take it with me!
strings.果然……是我彻底输了。\\n还是无法弥补与你们的实力差距啊。: I really... have lost completely.\nI still can't close the gap between us.
strings.我都说了——不能再降了！\\n这个价格已经很优惠了！: Like I said—I can't go any lower!\nThis price is already a bargain!
strings.咦，是阿尔克啊。\\n如你所见，我正在赚生活费呢。: Oh, it's Alk.\nAs you can see, I'm earning my keep.
strings.从公会接委托也能赚到钱，\\n但那样还挺辛苦的。\\n我还是想轻轻松松地赚钱啊。: I can make money taking Guild requests,\nbut that's pretty hard work.\nI'd rather make money the easy way.
strings.所以才开了武器店？\\n这么多武器，你都是从哪儿进货的？: So you opened a weapon shop?\nWhere'd you get all these weapons?
strings.我回收了别人不要的武器，\\n然后用锻造技能都修理过了。: I collected weapons people didn't want\nand repaired them all with my Blacksmith skill.
strings.只不过勉强能用而已。\\n因为外观还是破破烂烂的，\\n只有舍不得花钱的人才会来: They're only barely usable, though.\nSince they still look beat up,\nonly stingy people come to buy them...
strings.所以，根本没我想的能赚。\\n是不是失败了呢……: So I'm not making nearly as much as I hoped.\nMaybe it's a flop...
strings.喔，原来你在认真做生意啊……: Oh, so you're actually running a real business...
strings.只要打磨一下，就会好看很多吧？\\n如果你忙不过来，我也来帮忙吧？: If you polish them up a bit, they'd look much better, right?\nIf you're too busy, I can help too?
strings.每天都来应该不太现实，\\n偶尔一次还是没问题的。: Coming every day probably isn't realistic,\nbut once in a while is no problem.
strings.一点都不夸张。\\n那个自称女神的家伙根本一点忙都不帮！\\n太好了，谢谢你！: It's not a bit much at all.\nThat self-proclaimed goddess never helps with anything!\nThank goodness, thank you!
strings.太感谢了！\\n多亏了阿尔克，\\n现在生意真的很不错呢！: Thanks so much!\nThanks to Alk,\nbusiness is really good now!
strings.喂！佐藤和真！\\n你竟敢把受诅咒的武器卖给我！: Hey! Kazuma Satou!\nHow dare you sell me a cursed weapon!
strings.结果我们被诅咒吸引来的\\n魔物打得落花流水！\\n赶紧退货！还钱——: Monsters drawn by the curse\nbeat us to a pulp!\nWe want a refund! Give us our money back—
strings.他们说的诅咒是什么？\\n和真——: What curse are they talking about?\nKazuma—
strings.我突然想起点急事。\\n我先走了——: I just remembered something urgent.\nI'll be going—
strings.到底是怎么回事？\\n你什么时候弄到了受诅咒的武器，\\n我可完全没听说啊？！: What's going on?\nWhen did you get cursed weapons?\nI never heard anything about it?!
strings.我、我也不知道！\\n我只是把那些看起来稍——微有点\\n不详的武器修了下卖出去: I-I don't know either!\nI just fixed up and sold a few weapons that looked a tiiiny\nbit ominous!
strings.你根本是故意的吧！: You totally did it on purpose!
strings.但那东西看上去很值钱！\\n你就当作没看到，放我一马吧？！: But they looked valuable!\nJust pretend you didn't see anything and let me off the hook?!
strings.其实，我靠那几件武器小赚了一笔呢？\\n哎呀，这钱来得真是轻松！: Actually, I made a nice little profit off those weapons, you know?\nMan, that was easy money!
strings.想轻松赚钱也不能这样吧——: Even if you want easy money, you can't do it like this—
strings.我、我正在思考啦！\\n我可是能和魔王军干部打得势均力敌的男人！\\n区区这点麻: I-I'm thinking!\nI'm a man who can go toe-to-toe with a Demon King general!\nA little trouble like this—
strings.既然那诅咒会吸引魔物……\\n那我们就反过来利用诅咒……怎么样？: If the curse attracts monsters...\nwhy don't we turn the curse to our advantage... how about it?
strings.能吸引魔物的特殊武器？！\\n你为什么要卖这种危险的东西给我们！: A special weapon that attracts monsters?!\nWhy would you sell us something so dangerous!
strings.因为我看出来了，\\n各位都是一流的冒险者。: Because I could tell\nyou were all first-class adventurers.
strings.没错！我还以为，\\n以各位的实力，那点魔物根本不成问题！\\n那武器也许反而能: That's right! I thought\nwith your skills, those monsters would be no problem at all!\nThat weapon might even boost your hunting efficiency!
strings.咦？难不成、该不会……\\n各位莫不是陷入了苦战之中？: Huh? Don't tell me... could it be...\nyou all had a tough fight?
strings.哪、哪有，怎么可能！\\n我、我可是轻松就击败了魔物啊！: N-No way, of course not!\nI-I beat those monsters easily!
strings.没、没错，我也是！\\n既、既然知道理由就没问题了！: Y-Yeah, me too!\nN-Now that we know the reason, it's no problem!
strings.你这家伙……竟然还有点小聪明啊。: You... you've got some cunning after all.
strings.哎呀呀，没和真你厉害啦？\\n不过，希望你能吸取教训，\\n别再耍小聪明赚钱了啊: Oh, not as much as you, Kazuma.\nBut I hope you've learned your lesson\nand won't use cheap tricks to make money again?
strings.嗯，你说得对——\\n我会好好认真做生意的。: Yeah, you're right—\nI'll run my business properly from now on.
strings.欢迎光临——\\n这可是能吸引猎物的剑哦！: Welcome—\nThis is a sword that attracts prey!
strings.放心吧，阿尔克。\\n现在我会让客人签免责声明书，\\n就算出了什么问题，也和我: Don't worry, Alk.\nNow I make customers sign a waiver,\nso if anything happens, it's not my problem!
strings.我绝对不会重蹈覆辙……\\n而且绝对不会放弃躺着赚钱！: I'll never make the same mistake again...\nand I'll never give up making money lying down!
strings.不、不好了——\\n迷宫里的魔物追着一个拿着\\n奇怪武器的冒险者到镇上来了！: Th-This is bad—\nMonsters from the labyrinth chased an adventurer\nwith a weird weapon all the way into town!
strings.阿尔克，我问你啊……\\n我们是朋友吧？: Alk, let me ask you...\nWe're friends, right?
strings.请不要殃及到镇上的人们。\\n你自己好好加油吧，再见。: Please don't drag the townspeople into this.\nGood luck on your own, bye.
strings.等下、等下等下等下！\\n我什么都愿意听你的！: Wait, wait wait wait!\nI'll do anything you say!
strings.帮帮我！我的神！阿尔克大人——: Help me! My god! Lord Alk—
strings.珂艾特那家伙……\\n明明每晚都拉着我说个不停……\\n为什么白天还那么有精神啊: That Couette...\nshe keeps me up talking every night...\nso how does she still have so much energy during the day?!
strings.呵呵，太好了……\\n她们已经打成一片了呢。: Heh heh, how nice...\nThey've really hit it off.
strings.是啊，那可是小孩子的特权呢。: Yes, that's the privilege of children.
strings.杰西卡，你没事吧？\\n到树荫下休息比较好哦。: Jessica, are you okay?\nYou should rest in the shade.
strings.哼……我没问题！\\n话说回来，你给我做好觉悟吧，\\n我绝对会在毕业前超过你的: Hmph... I'm fine!\nMore importantly, you'd better be ready,\nI'm definitely going to surpass you before graduation!
strings.对不起……\\n其实，珂艾特在入学的时候，\\n就已经拿到毕业证书了……: Sorry...\nActually, Couette already got her diploma\nwhen she enrolled...
strings.所以，明年珂艾特就不在学院了。: So next year, Couette won't be at the academy.
strings.什、什么意思啊，\\n我怎么从来没听说过？！\\n不在学院，那要去哪儿啊——: Wh-What do you mean,\nhow come I've never heard about this?!\nIf you won't be at the academy, where are you going—
strings.珂艾特会和白哥哥他们\\n一起去探索深渊。: Couette is going to explore the abyss\nwith Nimbus and the others.
strings.刚才，海底好像裂开了一点。: Just now, it seemed like the seabed cracked open a little.
strings.可能有噬星兽在靠近这里……: A Devourer of Stars might be coming close...
strings.等下等下！你们只说了海底，\\n没说在这么深的地方啊？！: Wait, wait! You only said the seabed,\nyou didn't say it'd be this deep?!
strings.话说，那是参加交流项目的孩子吧……\\n把她也带来真的没问题吗？: By the way, that's a kid from the exchange program...\nIs it really okay to bring her along?
strings.非常抱歉，是我太任性了。\\n但是，拜托让我一起去吧。\\n我一定会自己保护好自: I'm so sorry, I'm being selfish.\nBut please let me come with you.\nI'll definitely protect myself!
strings.守护少女乃英雄的职责！\\n珂玛阁下！在下也会帮忙的！: Protecting maidens is a hero's duty!\nLord Koma! I shall help too!
strings.这种……没有一丝光的地方……\\n就是、海底……: A place like this... without a single ray of light...\nis the bottom, of the sea...
strings.明明那家伙……\\n都要去深渊了……: Even though she's...\ngoing to the abyss...
strings.我怎么能在这里被吓倒啊！: How can I be scared off here!
strings.话说，你别老是顾忌我啊！: And stop always holding back for me!
strings.不用你担心。\\n我一定一定一定会追上你的！: Don't worry about me.\nI'll definitely, definitely, definitely catch up to you!
strings.只要把它关上，\\n那群家伙就过不来了吧？: As long as we close it,\nthose things can't get through, right?
strings.但是，好像……\\n有什么别的东西正在靠近……: But it seems like...\nsomething else is approaching...
strings.珂艾特先把裂缝打开看看。\\n嗯、唔唔……嗯————: Couette will open the crack first to look.\nMmm, nnngh... Mmmmm—
strings.所以，直姐姐也是来关闭裂缝的？: So you came to close the crack too, Nao?
strings.嗯。我好不容易把文件都处理完，\\n想着终于能来利比尔德乐园了，\\n结果却发现: Yeah. I finally finished all the paperwork,\nand thought I could finally come to Paradise Isle,\nand then I found this.
strings.不过，没想到会突然被拉出来，\\n真是吓了我一跳！: But I didn't expect to get yanked out all of a sudden,\nthat really startled me!
strings.哈哈哈，没事啦！\\n还是赶紧把它关上吧！: Hahaha, it's fine!\nLet's hurry and close it!
strings.呼~~~！还是挺累人的呢。\\n也辛苦杰西卡了。: Whew~~~! That's pretty tiring.\nGood work, Jessica.
strings.我算是明白了……\\n奇怪的不仅仅是你，\\n星见镇的人都不能用常规来衡量啊。: Now I get it...\nIt's not just you who's weird,\nnobody in Starview can be measured by normal standards.
strings.不过，珂艾特……\\n我再告诉你一次。: But, Couette...\nI'll tell you one more time.
strings.不管你是毕业，还是去深渊，\\n我都一定会追上你，超越你的！: Whether you graduate or go to the abyss,\nI'll definitely catch up to you and surpass you!
strings.总有一天，珂艾特也要……\\n成为贝尔赛蒂亚姐姐那样的人！: Someday, Couette will...\nbecome someone like Belsidia too!
strings.我看你是别想了。\\n但我应该能成长到那般地步吧。\\n简直现在就开始替你惋惜了: I'd give up on that if I were you.\nBut I should be able to grow that much.\nI already feel sorry for you.
strings.你是在向珂艾特炫耀\\n你压倒性的才能吗？！: Are you bragging to Couette\nabout your overwhelming talent?!
strings.呵呵呵，没事的，珂艾特。\\n未来永远是不确定的哦。: Heh heh heh, it's okay, Couette.\nThe future is always uncertain.
strings.那么，该给努力的你们奖励了。\\n就让姐姐带你们去美容院吧。: Now then, time to reward you two for your hard work.\nLet big sister take you to the beauty salon.
strings.美容院！！！\\n珂艾特很想去！！！: Beauty salon!!!\nCouette really wants to go!!!
strings.嘿嘿嘿嘿……\\n这个夏天的珂艾特——: Hee hee hee hee...\nThis summer, Couette—
strings.别担心。\\n这是给你的惊喜哦。: Don't worry.\nThis is a surprise for you.
strings.甜心……\\n和我一起去我的世界吧。: Sweetheart...\ncome with me to my world.
strings.我会好好爱你的。\\n比这里的白多爱你千万倍。: I'll love you with all my heart.\nA million times more than the Nimbus here.
strings.也许会让这个世界遇到点危机……\\n不过，阿尔克总能有办法的吧。: It might put this world in a bit of a crisis...\nbut Alk will figure something out.
strings.啊，等等！\\n得把白也叫上才行♡: Oh, wait!\nWe have to bring Nimbus too♡
strings.不。\\n再怎么说也没法带上他。: No.\nI really can't bring him along.

strings.哎呀，真是和平啊……\\n有种确实在休息的感觉呢。: Ahh... how peaceful...\nIt really feels like a proper rest.
strings.是啊，这才是休假。\\n昨天真是……闹得有点过了啊。: Yeah, this is what a vacation should be.\nYesterday was... a bit much.
strings.算了算了，奈丝卡今天也很老实，\\n应该没问题的……吧。: Oh well, Naska's behaving herself today,\nso it should be fine... probably.
strings.真要不出问题就好了。: I sure hope nothing goes wrong.
strings.没错没错，我就是奈丝卡。\\n你们是谁？: Yep, yep, I'm Naska.\nWho are you?
strings.我们就是炎之双子！\\n热情的游戏对决兄弟，“Double Up”！: We're the Flame Twins!\nThe passionate gaming brothers, "Double Up"!
strings.顺带一提我是弟弟。: By the way, I'm the younger brother.
strings.呃，啊……\\n谁管你们是谁啊……: Uh, ah...\nWho cares who you are...
strings.那还用说！\\n玩家相见，该做的就只有一件事！: Need you ask!\nWhen gamers meet, there's only one thing to do!
strings.传说中的超级玩家，奈丝卡·艾特兰泽！\\n我们要打败你，成为新的传说！: The legendary super gamer, Naska Etranger!\nWe'll defeat you and become the new legends!
strings.传说？\\n你都在这个世界里干了什么啊？: Legend?\nWhat have you been doing in this world?
strings.哎呀，我也出名了啊。\\n可以啊，来吧。: Oh my, I'm famous too.\nSure, bring it on.
strings.不是，进展得太快了吧！？\\n而且他们有两个人，\\n就算奈丝卡再强——: No, this is moving way too fast!?\nAnd there are two of them,\nno matter how strong Naska is—
strings.不是挺有趣的吗，\\n让她去吧，阿尔克。: Isn't it fun?\nLet her go, Alk.
strings.哼，看来他们没意见了啊。\\n那么，开始吧！: Hmph, looks like they have no objections.\nThen, let's begin!
strings.怎么可能！\\n怎么会在这种时候凑齐最强的组合！？: Impossible!\nHow could she pull off the strongest combo at a time like this!?
strings.唔，你们的想法是不错。\\n要是多来几轮我确实会输吧。: Hmm, your idea wasn't bad.\nIf we'd played a few more rounds, I probably would've lost.

strings.使用红机兵的部件制作的绝品。以高温水蒸气为推力，能将敌人一刀两断的机械剑: A masterpiece made with parts from the Red Steambot. A mechanical sword driven by high-temperature steam that can cleave foes in two.
strings.使用苍机兵的动力部件制作而成的绝品。以魔核为中心并加装了齿轮的项链，能通过变形提: A masterpiece made with power parts from the Blue Steambot. A necklace with gears fitted around a magic core that boosts its output by transforming.
strings.使用闪机兵的蒸汽管制作而成的绝品。能将目标射成蜂巢的机械铳，利用蒸汽压使弹速得到: A masterpiece made with steam pipes from the Flash Steambot. A mechanical gun that can riddle targets with holes, its bullet speed further boosted by steam pressure.
strings.被称为“咏星者”的组织所持有的绝品。以南方天空上的星斗命名，能引出持有者的雷元素: A masterpiece held by the organization called the "Star Augurs." An otherworldly gun named after a star in the southern sky that draws out its wielder's Thunder power.
strings.被称为“咏星者”的组织所持有的绝品。以南方天空上的星斗命名，能引出持有者的风元素: A masterpiece held by the organization called the "Star Augurs." An otherworldly spear named after a star in the southern sky that draws out its wielder's Wind power.
strings.被称为“咏星者”的组织所持有的的绝品。以南方天空上的星斗命名，能引出持有者的暗元: A masterpiece held by the organization called the "Star Augurs." An otherworldly blade named after a star in the southern sky that draws out its wielder's Dark power.
strings.被称为“咏星者”的组织所持有的绝品。以南方天空上的星斗命名，能引出持有者的火元素: A masterpiece held by the organization called the "Star Augurs." An otherworldly whip named after a star in the southern sky that draws out its wielder's Fire power.
strings.被称为“咏星者”的组织所持有的绝品。以南方天空上的星斗命名，能引出持有者的水元素: A masterpiece held by the organization called the "Star Augurs." An otherworldly bow named after a star in the southern sky that draws out its wielder's Water power.
strings.被称为“咏星者”的组织所持有的绝品。以南方天空上的星斗命名，能引出持有者的光元素: A masterpiece held by the organization called the "Star Augurs." An otherworldly sword named after a star in the southern sky that draws out its wielder's Light power.
strings.试图将天之伟力化为吾物的绝品。吸收了从歼灭者处得到的结晶后，能逐渐进化并强化的剑: A masterpiece that seeks to claim the might of the heavens. A sword that gradually evolves and grows stronger by absorbing the crystals taken from the Purgers.
strings.使用森林之主的遗骸制作的绝品。遵照巨熊设计的不可思议的大锤，摸上去十分柔软但挥舞: A masterpiece made from the remains of the forest's master. A mysterious mallet designed after the great bear, soft to the touch yet incredibly hard when swung.
strings.使用火魔的素材制成的绝品。以蕴含着庞大热量的角打造而成的细剑。只消灼热的一刺就能: A masterpiece made from Fire Fiend materials. A rapier forged from a horn holding immense heat. A single searing thrust burns foes from the inside out.
strings.与水蚀荒龙战斗后获得的绝品。三叉枪尖上始终缠绕着水流的神秘之枪: A masterpiece obtained after battling the Tide-Eroding Serpent. A mysterious lance whose trident tip is always wrapped in flowing water.
strings.使用水鬼的素材制成的绝品。据说拥有共鸣之力、能将同伴的愿望汇入拳中: A masterpiece made from Water Demon materials. Said to hold the power of resonance, channeling allies' wishes into one's fists.
strings.在王陵深处发现的绝品。古代虎王们为了获取神谕而使用的锡杖: A masterpiece found deep in the royal tomb. A ringed staff the ancient tiger kings used to receive oracles.
strings.使用雷龟的素材制成的绝品。以雷龟的胡须为弦加工而成的连射性非常优秀的弩，能让万雷: A masterpiece made from Thunder Turtle materials. A crossbow strung with the turtle's whiskers, with superb rapid fire that rains down countless thunder bolts like despair.
strings.沉睡在犬族仓库中的绝品。以野猪鬃毛为材料制作的炸弹袋，能通过挥动的速度控制炸弹的: A masterpiece that slept in the dogfolk's storehouse. A bomb pouch made from boar bristles; the speed of its swing controls how often bombs launch.
strings.使用风师的素材制成的绝品。取蛇口腔中的毒牙研磨而成的短剑。闪耀着魅惑光芒一看便知: A masterpiece made from Wind Master materials. A short sword ground from a snake's venomous fang. Its blade glints with a bewitching, obviously poisonous light.
strings.与光芒荒龙战斗后获得的绝品。在达成霸业之人头顶熠熠生辉的王冠，冠上有以荒龙之翼为: A masterpiece obtained after battling the Radiant Serpent. A crown that shines atop the head of one who has achieved supremacy, adorned with decorations modeled on the Serpent's wings.
strings.使用光蛛的素材制成的绝品。以蛛腿为弓，蛛丝为弦制作而成的大弓。用它射出的一箭能让: A masterpiece made from Light Spider materials. A great bow with spider legs for its limbs and spider silk for its string. Its arrows put foes into eternal sleep.
strings.在妖异神社深处发现的绝品。据说在点亮时若是发出了两声鸣叫便能招来吉祥之事: A masterpiece found deep within a bewitched shrine. It's said that if it cries twice when lit, it brings good fortune.
strings.使用暗凤的素材制成的绝品。用凤翼上的尖角研磨而成的镰刀。从镰身上渗出的青蓝色波动: A masterpiece made from Dark Phoenix materials. A scythe ground from the sharp spines of the phoenix's wings. The azure waves seeping from its blade invite death.
strings.从守护者保护的遗迹中挖掘出的绝品。能赋予使用者超越常人力量的拳套，但原理不明: A masterpiece excavated from ruins protected by a guardian. Gauntlets that grant their wearer superhuman strength, though how they work is unknown.
strings.使用北海巨妖的遗骸制作的绝品。以皇帝冠名的长杖，能赋予所有者海洋支配者之力: A masterpiece made from the remains of the Kraken. A long staff bearing the name of an emperor that grants its owner the power to rule the seas.
strings.使用祸树的树液与枝干制作的绝品。刀神以树脂研磨而成，上有松散稀疏的刃纹: A masterpiece made from the sap and branches of the Bane Tree. The blade is ground from resin and bears a loose, sparse temper line.

strings.别想跑！\\n那个女人……\\n应该跑不了多远才对！: Don't let her get away!\nThat woman...\ncan't have gotten far!
strings.不过是条被饲养的狗……\\n我要让她好好搞清楚，\\n反抗主人的奴隶会有什么下场: Just a kept dog...\nI'll make her understand exactly\nwhat happens to slaves who defy their master!
strings.是逃跑的奴隶啊……\\n好像还有一口气呢……: A runaway slave...\nLooks like she's still breathing...
strings.别管那些了，得快点把她带到\\n能休息的地方！: Forget that, we need to get her\nsomewhere she can rest, fast!
strings.我叫阿尔克。\\n他们是莱特和白。\\n你呢？: I'm Alk.\nThese are Light and Nimbus.\nAnd you?
strings.这把剑应该是你的吧？\\n总之我们把它也捡回来了。: This sword is yours, right?\nWe picked it up anyway.
strings.我又不会偷你的剑。: I'm not going to steal your sword.
strings.你还是再躺一会儿比较好哦。\\n我会叫旅店的人准备吃的——: You'd better lie down a little longer.\nI'll have the inn prepare something to eat—
strings.会说话的野兽？\\n呵呵，正好能当成不错的礼物。: A talking beast?\nHeh heh, that'll make a nice gift.
strings.哈，呼……\\n那些人想干什么啊？: Hah, whew...\nWhat do those people want?
strings.前面我们逃出来的时候，\\n我看到了一张通缉令。: When we escaped earlier,\nI saw a wanted poster.
strings.被通缉的是用剑袭击了有钱的主人，\\n把警卫都全部打倒后逃走的女奴隶——: The one wanted is a slave woman who attacked her rich master\nwith a sword, took down all the guards,\nand ran away—
strings.是你……把他们都打倒的吗？: Did you... take them all down?
strings.我不知道……\\n他们要我和魔物战斗，给他们助兴……\\n让我握住这把剑……: I don't know...\nThey made me fight monsters for their entertainment...\nand made me hold this sword...
strings.我很害怕，完全无法反抗……\\n但是，握住剑以后……: I was so scared, I couldn't resist at all...\nBut when I gripped the sword...
strings.哼。\\n不过那些家伙好像不会放过我们啊。: Hmph.\nDoesn't look like those guys will let us off, though.
strings.真是让我费了好大功夫啊，娜希尔。: You've given me quite a lot of trouble, Nasir.
strings.你的惨叫和眼泪全都是属于主人的。\\n可别以为自己能轻松地死去啊？: Your screams and tears all belong to your master.\nDon't think you'll get to die easily, now?
strings.啊啊，又来了……\\n我又听到了……那个声音——: Ahh, again...\nI hear it again... that voice—
strings.既然全都会被夺走……\\n早晚……都会被夺走的话……: If everything will be taken...\nsooner or later... taken away anyway...
strings.那就用一把火把它燃尽吧！: Then I'll burn it all to nothing!
strings.只要……只要烧成灰就好了……\\n把所有、一切都——: If I just... just burn it all to ash...\neverything, all of it—
strings.没事，他还活着。\\n烧得也不是很严重……: It's okay, he's alive.\nThe burns aren't too bad...
strings.简直像是被附身了啊……\\n是因为这把剑吗。: It's like she was possessed...\nBecause of that sword?
strings.不只因为它吧，\\n要说还是那女人自己动的手。: Not just that.\nIf you ask me, the woman did it herself.
strings.但是……没法扔下她不管啊。: But... we can't just leave her.
strings.没错，不能把她扔在这儿。\\n实在太危险了……: Right, we can't leave her here.\nIt's way too dangerous...
strings.带她一起回星见镇吧。\\n这样可以吗？: Let's take her back to Starview with us.\nIs that okay?
strings.表情那么吓人……\\n但这不是都哭出来了吗。: Such a scary face...\nBut she's crying, isn't she.
strings.我不会……原谅……\\n这一切、全部——: I won't... forgive...\nany of this, all of it—
strings.我还以为这个图书室里可能会有……: I thought this library might have it...
strings.不，不是什么重要的事。\\n只是想稍微调查一下我的故乡。: No, it's nothing important.\nI just wanted to look into my homeland a bit.
strings.对不起，你的好意我心领了，\\n但这个图书室我已经——: Sorry, I appreciate the thought,\nbut I've already gone through this library—
strings.不，还是问问看你吧。\\n或许你会知道。: No, maybe I should ask you.\nYou might know.
strings.我在调查我故乡遗留下的传说——\\n“碎星巨神”。: I'm researching a legend from my homeland—\nthe "Titan."
strings.那个可憎的魔像\\n原本好像只是巨神的仆人。: That hateful golem\napparently used to be just a servant of the Titan.
strings.你和白一起打倒的那个魔像吗？\\n但是……操控它的是——: The golem you and Nimbus defeated?\nBut... the one controlling it was—
strings.王族拥有操控魔像的力量。\\n没什么可奇怪的。: The royal family has the power to control golems.\nNothing strange about that.
strings.他们利用这份力量\\n宣称自己是继承了巨神之力的\\n神官后裔……: They use that power\nto claim they're descendants of the priests\nwho inherited the Titan's might...
strings.但是只要能找到寄宿着巨神之力的圣遗物，\\n就能夺走他们的力量了。: But if I can find the holy relic that holds the Titan's power,\nI can take their power away.
strings.你就是在找那个圣遗物？: So you're looking for that holy relic?
strings.没错。\\n我在调查有关圣遗物的线索。: That's right.\nI'm looking for clues about the holy relic.
strings.这间图书室的书我基本\\n都读过。\\n但是，我不记得有类似的记录——: I've read almost every book\nin this library.\nBut I don't remember any record like that—
strings.我知道。\\n我也把这里的藏书都看过一遍了。: I know.\nI've read everything here too.
strings.但是，身为这个镇子的管理者，\\n你……是不是知道什么？: But as this town's administrator,\nyou... might know something?
strings.不，对不起。\\n别在意了，是我不好。: No, I'm sorry.\nDon't worry about it, my mistake.
strings.本来就是带着几分幻想的传说。\\n忘记它吧。: It's a legend with a fair bit of fantasy anyway.\nForget about it.
strings.如果能找到巨神，\\n你会许什么愿？: If you found the Titan,\nwhat would you wish for?
strings.我会拜托它把从我\\n手中夺走的东西还回来。: I'd ask it to give back\nwhat was taken from me.

strings.白痴白痴白痴白痴白痴白痴白痴！\\n你这个大白痴！: Idiot idiot idiot idiot idiot idiot idiot!\nYou big idiot!

strings.啊不过你应该会有种\\n被陌生的孩子抱着哭的感觉吧？\\n真对不起！: Ah, but you must feel like\nyou got hugged and cried on by a kid you don't know, right?\nI'm really sorry!
strings.怎么会呢……\\n必须道歉的是我才对啊……: Not at all...\nI'm the one who should apologize...

strings.阿尔克会煮红色的汤，\\n里面放了南瓜，非常好吃。\\n还会做甜甜软软的鸡蛋面包: Alk makes a red soup\nwith pumpkin in it, and it's really good.\nHe also makes sweet, fluffy egg bread.
strings.他做的紫薯炖菜也超级美味，\\n但没有配料的咖喱就有点单调。\\n还有——: His purple sweet potato stew is super tasty too,\nbut his curry with no toppings is a bit plain.\nAnd also—
strings.那、那个，和普通欧姆蛋不一样，\\n我喜欢的是——: Th-That one, it's not a normal omelet,\nthe one I like is—

strings.你果然……是哥哥啊~~~！\\n呜哇啊啊啊啊啊——: You really... are my big brotherrr~~~!\nWaaaaaaaah—

strings.话说啊……你的哭法是不是有点奇怪？！: By the way... isn't the way you cry a little weird?!

strings.嗓门好大啊，\\n在外面都听得一清二楚诶？: You're so loud,\nwe could hear everything from outside?
strings.我已经等得不耐烦了，\\n也该去大闹一场——: I'm tired of waiting,\ntime to go raise some hell—

strings.好了，那么来整理一下现有的信息吧。: Okay, let's go over what we know.
strings.首先，那里毫无疑问是阿尔克原本的世界。\\n但那里的人们现在都被困在一定范围之内: First, that place is without a doubt Alk's original world.\nBut the people there are now trapped within a certain area.
strings.而被称为『埃癸斯』和『星命会』的\\n两个团体正处于对抗之中、吗……: And two groups, called "Aegis" and "The Starsayers,"\nare at odds with each other...
strings.星命会说自己正在维持秩序，\\n但你们并不相信他们的话是吗？: The Starsayers say they're keeping order,\nbut you don't believe them?
strings.我认为咲夜小姐在说谎。\\n虽然不知道哪部分是谎言……\\n但说实话……我想和他: I think Miss Sakuya is lying.\nI don't know which part is a lie...\nbut honestly... I'd like to keep my distance from them.
strings.但也不知道那群埃癸斯的小鬼\\n能不能和我们好好沟通啊？\\n首先，我们都不知道: But who knows if those Aegis brats\nwill even talk to us properly?\nFor starters, we don't even know where they are, right?
strings.要去找埃癸斯的话，\\n我可以为你们带路。: If you're looking for Aegis,\nI can show you the way.

strings.我也想帮助阿步，\\n希望你们能带我一起去。: I want to help Ayumu too,\nso please take me with you.
strings.我也……拥有能力。\\n埃癸斯正在召集超能力者，\\n他们也来问过我——: I... have powers too.\nAegis is gathering psychics,\nand they came to ask me too—

strings.顺利的话就能向你们提供增援，\\n还能把你们那边的人接过来。\\n史黛拉，你能帮: If it goes well, we can send reinforcements\nand bring people over from your side.\nStella, can you give me a hand?
strings.但还有一个坏消息。\\n那就是我们的时间不多了。: But there's also bad news.\nWe're running out of time.
strings.摇曳的周期快要来临了。\\n一旦发生摇曳，我这里的连接点就会消失。\\n我们之间: The wavering cycle is coming soon.\nOnce the wavering happens, my connection point will vanish.\nAnd the link between us will be cut.

strings.如果出现了摇曳的征兆……\\n希望你们能考虑放弃枪并从那里撤离。: If there are signs of the wavering...\nI'd like you to consider giving up on the gun and pulling out.

strings.会轮回转生哦。\\n它会循着龙的道路，\\n再次出现在世界上的某个地方。: It will be reborn.\nIt will follow the dragon's road\nand appear somewhere in the world again.
strings.我们已经，将你和冥龙，分离了。\\n已经，没问题了。: We've already, separated you\nfrom the Dragon of Darkness.\nIt's all, right now.
strings.哼，快忘了那种玷污龙血的蠢货罢。: Hmph, forget that fool who sullied dragon blood.

strings.玛丽娜姐姐……\\n果然还是、不用了……\\n让珂艾特……来做就好……: Big sis Marina...\nNever mind after all...\nLet Couette... do it...

strings.顺便一说，现在的我叫卡佩拉。\\n用这具身体和你见面好像还是第一次啊？: By the way, these days I go by Capella.\nI believe this is the first time we've met in this body?
strings.希望你能明白，\\n一旦改变宿主，大脑也会随之变化。\\n癖好和性格也会产生变化: I hope you understand,\nwhen the host changes, the brain changes with it.\nHabits and personality change too.
strings.哈哈哈，被永恒不变的你这么评价\\n倒是有点让人安心啊。: Hahaha, hearing that from someone eternally unchanged like you\nis rather reassuring.

strings.这片贫瘠的大地能够\\n轻易地夺走你们的性命。\\n所以，我决定了。: This barren land\ncan easily take your lives.\nSo, I have decided.
strings.我会将龙之力授予你们。\\n尽管饮下我的血，食用我的肉吧。: I shall grant you the power of dragons.\nDrink my blood and eat my flesh as you will.

strings.贝尔赛蒂亚姐姐怎么又来了？: Why are you here again, Belsidia?

strings.但是，我这近身魔法格斗术\\n也不是一时半会儿就能学会的。\\n如果硬要在短时间: But my close-range magic martial arts\nisn't something you can learn overnight.\nIf I had to teach you in a short time—

strings.白接下来必须接下\\n泰加阁下呕心沥血\\n磨练出的致命一击。: Nimbus must now take\nthe deadly blow Lord Taiga honed\nwith his heart and soul.

strings.哈、呵呵呵……\\n开什么玩笑……\\n你们是想让我死几次啊……: Hah, heh heh heh...\nYou've got to be kidding...\nHow many times do you want me to die...
strings.你现在冲动得如同野兽，\\n难道这就是你的本性吗？: Right now you're as reckless as a beast.\nIs this your true nature?

strings.那你又为何想要变强呢？: So why do you want to get stronger?

strings.但是，塞林，你知道我们白虎一族\\n为何会生得那么高大强壮吗？: But, Selenius, do you know why we of the White Tiger clan\nare born so big and strong?

strings.胆小也没关系，天真也没关系。\\n但你一定要变得强大而可靠哦……\\n我的塞林！: It's okay to be timid, it's okay to be naive.\nBut be sure to grow strong and dependable...\nmy Selenius!
strings.我只是、受够了而已……\\n不管是掠夺、还是受人掠夺……\\n还是无动于衷地冷眼: I'm just, sick of it...\nPlundering, being plundered...\nwatching coldly without lifting a finger, I'm sick of all of it.
strings.我不想让别人和我受到相同的伤……\\n只是那样而已。: I don't want others to get hurt the way I did...\nThat's all.

strings.如果现在把限制器拿掉，\\n他的力量就会直接爆发。\\n所以至少一周内都不能使用: If the limiter comes off now,\nhis power will just explode.\nSo he can't use his power for at least a week.

strings.那个臭老头根本没跟我说过这些啊——: That damn old geezer never told me any of this—

strings.赫尔加小姐就是赫尔加小姐，\\n是我的师父啊。: Miss Helga is Miss Helga.\nYou're my master.

strings.不是汇报过了吗？\\n维斯塔族对我们并没有敌意，\\n只是没法离开那个地方——: Didn't we report it?\nThe Vesta clan bears us no hostility,\nthey just can't leave that place—

strings.帕尔佩布拉是一座尊重个人自由的城镇。\\n正因为接纳了常人眼中的异端和异常，\\: Palpebra is a town that respects individual freedom.\nIt's precisely because we accept those others see as heretics and misfits\nthat Palpebra prospers today.

strings.泽赫尔先生是怎么想的呢？\\n你不是说想避免武力冲突吗？: What do you think, Mr. Zekhel?\nDidn't you say you wanted to avoid an armed clash?

strings.确实如白所说，\\n维斯塔族拥有相当强的战斗力……\\n但换句话说，她们没有除此: It's true what Nimbus said,\nthe Vesta clan has considerable fighting strength...\nbut in other words, they have no other means.

strings.也许我这样想是错的，\\n但我认为……无论选择哪一边，\\n都等于是抛弃了另一边: Maybe it's wrong of me to think this,\nbut I think... whichever side we choose,\nit's the same as abandoning the other—

strings.绯河，你忘记托尔先生的话了吗？: Hikawa, have you forgotten what Mr. Tor said?
strings.可恶！可恶可恶可恶可恶可恶——: Dammit! Dammit dammit dammit dammit dammit—
strings.不行啊，勇希！\\n只靠我们两个！果然不行啊……: It's no use, Yuki!\nJust the two of us! It's no use...
strings.还是快去“星命会”那里！: We have to get to "The Starsayers"!
strings.你这家伙又是谁啊……: And who the hell are you...
strings.什么什么，搞角色扮演吗？\\n真行啊，是正义的伙伴啊~: What's this, cosplay?\nNice, a hero of justice~
strings.你也是“超能力者”吧？\\n既然如此为什么要保护那种家伙。: You're a "psychic" too, right?\nThen why protect people like them.
strings.我不知道你们有什么恩怨……\\n我也不知道这里都发生了什么……\\n我什么都不知: I don't know what grudge you have...\nI don't know what's happened here...\nI don't know anything...
strings.但是，你还想继续的话……\\n就让我来当你的对手！: But if you want to keep going...\nI'll be your opponent!
strings.你这种家伙……\\n我最讨厌了啊！: People like you...\nare the ones I hate most!
strings.勇希……\\n我说，我们不是在做梦吧？: Yuki...\nhey, we're not dreaming, are we?
strings.唔……\n你要不要重新考虑一下？\n公会比较推荐你接——:
Hmm...
Would you like to reconsider?
The Guild recommends you take—
strings.那个任务怎么行啊！: No way I'm taking that request!
strings.啊……对不起……\n但是那个任务太没意思了。:
Ah... Sorry...
But that request is so boring.
strings.低层我已经去过好多次了……\n又赚不到钱，又会让身手变迟钝。:
I've been to the lower floors so many times...
They don't pay, and they dull my skills.
strings.我明白你的意思。\n但是，去从未去过的阶层出任务，\n生还率真的很低的。:
I understand what you mean.
But taking requests on floors you've never been to
has a really low survival rate.
strings.低层的经验也不是没用。\n等你有了成绩，我就可以让你\n和上级冒险者组队，一起出:
Experience on the lower floors isn't useless either.
Once you have some results, I can have you
team up with senior adventurers on requests.
strings.我也为你想了新的方案！\n所以请不要着急——:
I've come up with a new plan for you too!
So please don't rush—
strings.这种时候还不着急的人，\n根本不可能变强吧！:
If you don't rush at a time like this,
how are you ever gonna get stronger!
strings.原来如此，停滞不前的新人冒险者啊。: I see, a rookie adventurer who's stuck in a rut.
strings.他说与他同时成为冒险者的人\n都已经在迅速地攻略迷宫了，\n所以他很焦虑。:
He says the people who became adventurers at the same time
are already rapidly clearing the labyrinth,
so he's anxious.
strings.焦虑会阻碍进步。\n但这种事也不是靠劝\n就能劝住的。:
Anxiety hinders progress.
But that's not something you can
just talk someone out of.
strings.我觉得只是进步比较慢的话，\n也可以试试别的方案。\n但他好像没明白我的意思。:
I think if he's just progressing slowly,
he could try a different plan.
But he didn't seem to get what I meant.
strings.从迷宫回来的冒险者说，\n中层出现了摇曳的征兆！:
Adventurers coming back from the labyrinth say
there are signs of wavering on the middle floors!
strings.需要立刻对中层\n发出警戒令！\n还得赶快通知冒险者们！:
We need to issue a warning
for the middle floors immediately!
And notify the adventurers right away!
strings.我、我明白了。\n我马上就联系各部门——:
U-Understood.
I'll contact every department at once—
strings.就让我们去帮忙传话吧！: Let us help spread the word!
strings.有人看到\n夏农你负责的那个\n冒险者到中层去了。:
Someone saw
the adventurer you're in charge of
heading to the middle floors.
strings.让我去救他吗？\n可、可是，我……:
You want me to go rescue him?
B-But, I...
strings.这不是挺好的吗。\n公会的人到迷宫里直接发号施令，\n冒险者肯定会听的。:
Isn't it perfect?
If someone from the Guild gives orders right there in the labyrinth,
the adventurers are sure to listen.
strings.本来不该让职员\n做这种事的……可是！\n这样或许能帮到更多的人！:
Staff really shouldn't be doing this kind of thing...
but still!
This way we might be able to help more people!
strings.可恶……果然……\n我还是不行……:
Dammit... I knew it...
I'm just no good...
strings.在这里吹着风，\n我就想起了\n我还憧憬着冒险者时的事。:
Standing here in the breeze,
I remembered
when I used to dream of being an adventurer.
strings.那个人说，他再也不当冒险者了。: He said he's quitting being an adventurer.
strings.听说你以前也是冒险者。: I heard you used to be an adventurer too.
strings.我想，我以前可能也和他一样，\n一心只关注厉害的人。:
I think I might have been just like him once,
only paying attention to the amazing people.
strings.或许是因为这样，\n他让我挺感慨的。:
Maybe that's why
he moved me so much.
strings.我还以为我可以支持所有人的梦想，\n真是太傲慢了……:
I thought I could support everyone's dreams,
how arrogant of me...
strings.感觉到了瓶颈还要坚持往前走，\n是件很困难的事。\n能坚持的人都是值得尊敬的。:
Pushing on even when you've hit a wall
is really hard.
Those who can keep going deserve respect.
strings.但是，即便是遇到瓶颈，\n然后停滞不前了，\n那时的经历也是有用的。:
But even if you hit a wall
and stop moving forward,
that experience is still worthwhile.
strings.你一定就是那样的吧？: That's what happened to you, isn't it?
strings.希望那个人将来\n也能这么想……:
I hope that someday
he'll be able to see it that way too...
strings.非常感谢！\n期待您再次光临。:
Thank you very much!
We look forward to your next visit.
strings.其实我真的已经\n打算放弃冒险了……:
Actually, I'd really
made up my mind to quit adventuring...
strings.但和女朋友一起吃饭的时候，\n我突然又想了起来……:
But while I was eating with my girlfriend,
it suddenly came back to me...
strings.你说的那个新方案，\n可以说给我听听吗？:
That new plan you mentioned,
could you tell me about it?
strings.没问题！\n新的方案是吧！:
Of course!
The new plan, right!

Parfait, Alk's cooking teacher, gave him advice, while Tharros, running wild as usual, made him feel nostalgic. Amid the chaos, Alk finally found his own path, and charged at Tharros alongside his friends.
strings.阿尔克与伙伴们一同参加了毕业典礼，而直在千钧一发时机撕裂空间来到了典礼现场。这破: Alk and his friends attended the graduation ceremony, and Nao tore through space to arrive at the ceremony in the nick of time. Her unprecedented entrance left Alk stunned, and her speech afterward moved him deeply. At the after-party, everyone talked about their futures, and learned that the book Stella was writing for them was almost finished.
