strings.形似兔子的谜之兽——虽然外貌看似如此，\n但其皮囊之下的本质其实与龙类似。\n硬:
A mysterious rabbit-like beast. That's how it looks,
but beneath its hide, its true nature is close to a dragon's.
If anything, it's closest to the Holy Dragon Rustamov.

When a hero dies, the next eligible one
"receives only the hero's power."
This way of passing on power resembles a dragon's rebirth.
To block the hero's function and prevent the next hero from being born,
the other Stella used the Star's Reverse Lance to warp the hero.

Light was able to teleport away from the Demon King
because that function erupted in its abnormal state.
And so the broken goddess, the patched-together fake,
and the warped hero met in Starview.
strings.现在的他几乎丧失了所有雷姆纳的记忆。\n而原初样本——星乃命的记忆，\n对他来说:
He has now lost almost all of Remna's memories.
The memories of the prototype sample, Mikoto Hoshino,
are to him like watching an old film, no longer something he can trace.
This was the result of "their" farewell.

They can no longer share the same dream.
But the boy chose to watch the two of them go,
and then set out on his own path.
May light shine on the road ahead for them too.
strings.玖兹的骑士团长，\n统领着家族军队的精悍武人。\n身为尤维尔·玖兹的亲哥哥，\n:
Knight commander of House Nouin,
a fierce warrior who leads the family's army.
He is Yuwel Nouin's older brother, and though he never says it,
he worries a great deal about his brother,
who is so rigid he might snap.

When his brother returned to the Farlands, grown,
Ignatz not only accepted his proposal
to join forces with the House of Tris,
but also promised to support the New Swallow Knights.
strings.少年莱特犹如隐居老人一般，\n守护着孩子们，陪他们冒险。\n但是——\n\n“成:
Young Light, like a retired old man,
watches over the children and goes on adventures with them. But—

"Becoming a hero out of a fairy tale doesn't seem so bad."

Under the silent pressure of three witches—
Belsidia, Maiko, and Couette—
Light had to take responsibility for those words
and set out on adventures with them.

The four traveled every world to recover the cryptic artifacts.
And every time, Light casually says
"I'll protect you" and follows through.

"You're sowing the seeds of disaster."

The Wicked Witch of the Rift coldly declares,
and the shut-in witch agrees.
As for him, he has no idea what they're talking about.
Today, too, the fairy tale continues.
strings.原本乃神谕局、即世界弹射的管理者。\n也是接收星之女神神谕的统治者。\n因此，他:
Originally the Oracle Bureau, administrators of the World Flipper,
and rulers who received the Star Goddess's oracles.
As such, they held enormous influence in the world.
However, because of Stella's loss of function,
the ocean world suffered a great sea level rise disaster.
Disagreements over racial design split them into
a faction that went to live in the sea and one that stayed on land,
and their power declined sharply.
The Land Government was founded by those who stayed on land.
strings.虽以异种族融合为目标，\n但组织内部的中心管理者却是\n旧王国的当权人士及管理物:
Though it aimed at uniting the different races,
the core administrators of the organization were
former kingdom officials and ex-merchants who controlled supplies.
To them, the other races were disposable weapons.
As Lilith and the others gradually took real power,
the many corruptions of the old system finally came to light.
Even facing the end of the world,
those people never stopped their political infighting.
strings.经过审讯之后，莉莉丝等人发现，\n某个研究者集团在混乱之中接近了反抗组织。\n\:
Through interrogation, Lilith and the others learned
that a certain group of researchers had approached the resistance amid the chaos.

The arrested ex-noble merchants only knew
that they were scholars of the old Stratos royal family,
descendants who called themselves "Doctors of Astronomy."

However, after exchanging information with Starview,
it became nearly certain that they were the "Star Augurs."
strings.至高者从与星乃命的遗体产生共鸣、\n获得了自我的诺瓦身上吸取了教训，\n经过周密:
An "improved model" the Supreme One carefully designed
after learning from Nova, who gained a self
by resonating with Mikoto Hoshino's remains.

To erase free will,
the Supreme One suppressed all emotion and impulse in the design.
Performance dropped somewhat,
but it was easier to control, so it was formally adopted.

The designers went to great lengths to change the sex,
perhaps drawing on the old world's myths.
But that is proof of how much they feared
the free will in Nova.
strings.女神的运作非常顺利。\n系统能够长期稳定运行，\n至高者也从物理层面隔绝了\n她:
The goddess operated very smoothly.
The system ran stably for a long time,
and the Supreme One physically cut off
her contact with Mikoto Hoshino.
No risk factors remained.

And yet, the goddess broke.

The countless heroes she drove on and destroyed.
Their regret and anger, and the peace they taught her,
opened a small hole in the goddess's heart.
No matter how many times her memories were stripped with the Star's Reverse Lance,
that hole never disappeared.

And so the system the Supreme Ones designed slowly began to collapse.
strings.到了最后，\n星之女神几乎彻底丧失了功能。\n\n对被禁止接触异世界的各个世界来:
In the end,
the Star Goddess lost nearly all her functions.

For the worlds forbidden from contact with other worlds,
this meant that information and technology stagnated.
Many worlds declined as a result.
Communication through "oracles" eventually ceased as well.
Outside of the few worlds that kept their memories,
everything about the Star Goddess became legend.
strings.某个冬天，从天而降的有翼之物摧毁了城市。\n那一年，街头没有了圣夜祭的华彩装饰。:
One winter, winged things fell from the sky and destroyed the city.
That year, the streets had no Holy Night decorations.
But a certain saint who bravely faced the winged things said,
"Even so, we'll have Christmas."

Answering her call came a blue-skinned Santa,
a tiger-eared Santa, a queen Santa, and so on and so forth.
A mysterious band of all sorts of Santas
paraded through the streets like a night parade of a hundred demons,
giving the children little presents.
strings.另外，感质之城中存在某种速成全身义体。\n即将头部以下的所有身体替换为\n统一规:
In Qualia City, there is also a kind of rapid full-body prosthetic.
Everything below the head is replaced
with standardized mass-produced parts, at a very low price.

However, these bodies connect poorly to the brain,
and can mostly only move using their own autonomous functions.
It's like putting a human head on an automaton.
They were designed to use cheap human brains to support inferior AI
and mass-produce soldiers of a certain quality.
Normally, prosthetics adapt to the brain's functions,
letting the neural modules inside keep changing and growing.
These do the exact opposite.
There are many reports of users' brain function deteriorating.
strings.星见镇的改造人之中，除开兹茵可，\n义体化率最高的乃塔吉斯。\n他的义体化率已和:
Among Starview's augments, other than Tink,
the most heavily prosthetized is Teurgis.
His prosthetic ratio is almost no different from a rapid body,
but all his parts are top-grade,
tuned to match an optimal neural module.
Bulleta and King Johnson are moderately prosthetized,
but their bodies perform extremely well—
model examples of "successful" gunners.
The least prosthetized is Katyusha.
And she's wondering whether she should
swap in a better alcohol-processing organ.
strings.计划的目标乃“由完美的个人引领的统治”。\n拉芙便是浓缩了这一理念，\n被创造出:
The plan's goal was "rule led by a perfect individual."
Laf, the condensed form of this ideal,
was created as the first-generation "CEO who never fails."
Emotions erased, self sacrificed for duty,
always able to make the optimal decision.
What the Noxel Group sought in Laf
was a responsibility no human should have to bear.
strings.然而，最终的产物却是充满人性的化身。\n会为要去海边的搭档准备最棒的泳装与装备\:
Yet the final product was the very embodiment of humanity.
She'll use every bit of money and power
to get the best swimsuit and gear for a partner heading to the beach.
Laf proved to the Noxel Group
that people can never become machines.
The group is now continuing to observe
the first-generation products placed in other companies.
But those too have gained humanity.
As a result, the second-generation plan and beyond have been frozen.
strings.在摇曳的迷宫诞生50周年的庆典上\n发生的袭击事件背后，有一个自称是\n普罗基欧:
Behind the attack at the 50th anniversary celebration
of the Kaleidoscope's birth was a male Star Augur
calling himself Procheon, hiding in the shadows.

He stole the treasure, the Anti-Law Observer,
lured a Serpent into the Kaleidoscope,
and planned to pin all the blame on his accomplice,
Ogas Oxtan, and the House of Oxtan.
But thanks to the adventurers' efforts,
the incident was resolved.
What Procheon truly wanted
remains a mystery.
strings.在法兰德再次发生的魔物灾害事件，\n已经被查明是与咏星者有关。\n\n他们在艾特:
The renewed monster outbreak in the Farlands
has been found to involve the Star Augurs.

They had set up a laboratory in House Oxtan's territory,
secretly received funds and equipment,
and researched the "tentacled" monsters
believed to be the cause of the outbreak.

This implicated not only House Oxtan,
but also its parent house, the House of Kwetur.
The House of Kwetur insists House Oxtan bears the main responsibility,
but Vyron, who has long pursued the Iselia assassination case,
is convinced the ties between them
have continued from then to this day.
strings.《恋梓》的故事并非按时间线描绘。\n现在，其分为本篇《剑豪草薙篇》，\n以女主人:
The story of KoiAzu isn't told chronologically.
It's now split into the main "Kusanagi the Swordmaster" arc,
the heroine-led "Yokai Princess Inaba" arc,
and the "Otherworld Academy" arc spun off from the Inaba arc.
All three are currently being serialized.
The only one that's actually gone without updates is the Kusanagi arc.
Other spin-offs keep popping up one after another.
strings.近期《恋梓》本将推出以草薙篇中\n出场的神秘美少年月咏为主角的新连载。\n然而那:
KoiAzu was recently set to launch a new series starring
Tsukuyomi, the mysterious beautiful boy from the Kusanagi arc.
But it was delayed because Gramp Zigza went traveling.
The manuscript was mixed with inspiration from various other worlds,
causing setting conflicts everywhere,
so it had to be changed from a series into an all-star comedy short.

Readers say excitedly:
"It's just a comedy short, right?
But it totally exposed Tsukuyomi's hidden, heavy reverence
for Inaba from the main story!
That's definitely not my imagination!"
strings.经过魔物灾害再次袭来事件后，\n身为下任王位争夺战的有力竞争者的\n王子们的势力:
After the renewed monster outbreak,
the balance of power among the princes
who are leading contenders in the coming succession war
changed greatly,
and ordinary citizens have become more interested in it too.

Also, the prince who is fourteenth in line to the throne
seems to have been completely excluded.
strings.莎蒂雅家族原本坚定地执行着\n在魔物灾害发生时，若没有正当理由，\n便不能踏上其:
The House of Tris had firmly upheld the iron rule
that during a monster outbreak, without just cause,
one must not set foot in another house's territory.
But Yuwel Nouin's request gave them cause,
and the head of the house personally led troops
against the outbreak.

As a military power, the House of Tris had always tended
to avoid actively joining political struggles,
but since the incident, a rumor of uncertain truth has been spreading
that the current head, Ciel Tris,
acted in order to back an heir to the throne.
strings.在魔物灾害再次袭来的事件中\n肆拉家族与艾特兰家族一同\n坚决地拒绝了赫克西斯家:
During the renewed monster outbreak,
the House of Kwetur, together with House Oxtan,
firmly rejected House Swes's proposal
to ask Palpebra for help.

Later, the research being conducted
at the secret monster laboratory found in House Oxtan's territory
was found to be connected to the House of Kwetur too.
The House of Kwetur explained it as
some people acting rashly to solve the monster problem,
and House Oxtan acting on its own.

The investigation found no further evidence
to refute this statement.
But the other houses distrust the House of Kwetur more than ever,
and its influence in the country has fallen sharply.
strings.袭击“摇曳的迷宫诞生50周年”的庆典，\n并将龙招至会场的，\n是一名名叫奥加斯:
The one who attacked the "50th Anniversary of the Kaleidoscope's Birth" celebration
and lured a dragon to the venue
was a man of House Oxtan named Ogas.

Investigations found he was colluding
with a Star Augur calling himself Procheon,
and that his background was tied to the parent House of Kwetur.
But before the investigation into his identity was over,
he was escorted back home at the Farlands' request.

No official record remains of Ogas's actions or his statements,
and the Farlands seem to have covered the matter up.
Ogas himself is under long-term house arrest.
strings.在魔物灾害再次袭来的事件中，\n艾特兰家族虽然和肆拉家族一同拒绝了\n向帕尔佩布:
During the renewed monster outbreak,
House Oxtan, together with the House of Kwetur, rejected
the proposal to ask Palpebra for help,
but in this incident, an unrecorded monster laboratory
in House Oxtan's territory was exposed.

The laboratory had been deliberately hidden,
and supplied funds and equipment to the cult known as the Star Augurs.
House Oxtan claimed its purpose
was ultimately to solve the monster problem,
and that the parent house knew nothing about it.
But the other houses are still harshly
holding House Oxtan responsible for the incident.

Since then, with its relationship with the House of Kwetur soured as well,
House Oxtan has all but lost its footing.
strings.作为九骑士家族中负责维持治安的那一个，\n从魔物灾害发生的第一时间起，\n玖兹家:
As the house of the Nine responsible for keeping order,
House Nouin fought the outbreak alone
from the moment it began.
But as the disaster grew,
House Nouin began to struggle.

For political reasons, House Nouin
could never accept help from the House of Tris.
But after Yuwel, who should have been missing, returned,
things began to improve.
For its part in quelling the outbreak,
House Nouin earned the trust of the nation and the people.
strings.“提欧先生，玛格诺斯先生！报告！\n有一批身份不明的势力称自己的难民，\n要求我:
"Mr. Teo, Mr. Magnos! Report!
A group of unknown origin claiming to be refugees
is asking us to take them in!
Th-They look like catfolk,
but... they have manes!!"

—Testimony of a guard who burst into the council, several years later.
strings.遭遇歼灭者袭击之后，\n观察者仍未停止出版。\n其内容涵盖种种便民生活信息，\n:
Even after the Purgers' attack,
Observer kept publishing.
Its content covers all sorts of useful everyday information,
plus gossip columns, comics and more,
providing people with entertainment as always.
strings.自复兴祭之后，\n观察者编辑部便开始了招募新员工。\n不论年龄，不问出身，连涩谷:
Since the Revival Festival,
the Observer editorial office has been recruiting new staff.
Any age, any background, even people from Shibuya can join.
The magazine's production quality has improved noticeably,
and it occasionally runs quite sharp articles
that some readers can't put down.
strings.某天的会议记录（摘要）\n\nN：影丘，我们多写点那个吧。\n 就是餐:
Meeting minutes from a certain day (excerpt)

N: Kageoka, let's write more of those.
      You know, restaurant reviews.
K: I'm not good at them. Aren't you asking the wrong person?
N: Not at all. Your articles are really popular.
      Everyone says "the blunt writing is actually helpful."
K: Then why don't you write more gossip, Ms. Nanami.
N: Eh~ I'm not good at that.
K: You are. I think you're great at it.
      It's for stupid people to read anyway.
L: (suddenly bursts into the meeting room) Everyone!
      A new ramen shop opened in Shibuya,
      let's go cover it together!
N: Ooh, nice, Luluca!
      Let's go, Kageoka!
K: I'm not going.

The ramen shop was rated 3★ out of 5.
strings.按水善的话来说，\n妖怪原本只存在于东国。\n而八岐大蛇之所以会出现在东国，\n:
According to Suizen,
yokai originally existed only in the Eastern Land.
And it seems the Yamata no Orochi appeared in the Eastern Land
because tens of thousands of yokai were sealed there.

The souls released by the Dragon Heaven Formation should have
increased the yokai in the Eastern Land and prolonged the chaos.
But thanks to the cooperation of the Diviners' Commission and the nine-tailed fox,
and the influence of the fun yokai plays,
things don't seem to be getting any worse.
strings.魔法世界的居民们、尤其是精灵使，\n在遇到妖怪时往往会露出十分复杂的表情。\n妖:
People of the magic world, especially spirit users,
tend to make very complicated faces when they meet yokai.
Yokai are like spirits in nature.
But something's different. Very different.
Calling them some sort of mystical beings
sounds almost like a joke.
Where on earth do they come from?

One day, at the Shibuya branch of the Special Technical Processing Division,
Gramp Zigza was suddenly drawn to a certain book.

"Oh, what's this?
So other worlds have yokai encyclopedias too!"

They are things born from stories.
From now on, there will surely be more and more of them.
strings.在泥沼般的现实中也要\n一步一个脚印努力向前。\n即便现在无法立刻解决任何问题，:
Even in a swamp-like reality,
keep pushing forward one step at a time.
Even if no problem can be solved right away,
keep building toward a better future.

Claw and Albert's ideals were surely
passed on to the next generation.
A peaceful world may come
sooner than they imagined.
strings.歼灭者来袭之时，雷拉斯解除了咒缚，\n将他从崩坏的城镇中救了出来。\n\n长期离:
When the Purgers attacked, Reylas undid the curse
and rescued him from the collapsing town.

The demon eye, long separated from its host,
rejected Reylas when the curse was lifted.
This was unexpected for Reylas,
but he decided to transplant the demon eye back into Ortanus.
With the two brothers controlling it together, they succeeded in lifting his curse.
Afterward, the demon eye fully adapted to Ortanus's body,
and since Reylas wished it too,
it stayed with Ortanus.
strings.复活后的他仿佛摆脱了心魔一般变得稳重。\n不过按雷拉斯的话来说，这才是本来的他。:
After his revival, he became calm, as if freed from his demons.
But according to Reylas, this is who he really was.
After living with his brother for a while,
he vanished shortly before their people came to Palpebra.
Reylas occasionally receives letters from him on his travels.
strings.禁令颁布之后，\n仍有数名希望求教之人出现，\n促使泰加再度开设了格斗讲座。\n:
After the ban was issued,
several more people asked to be taught,
prompting Taiga to reopen his martial arts lessons.
But after Ricardo collapsed and was taken to the hospital,
a stern-faced Fellowship of Floof surrounded Taiga
and sternly explained human anatomy to him.
This also led to the development of the magic gauntlets.
strings.兄妹二人最终于深渊之中重逢。\n\n在某次探索之中，异界探索队\n发现了一条与噬:
The siblings were finally reunited in the abyss.

During one exploration, the Abyss Exploration Team
found a dragon fighting the Devourer of Stars' kin.
But no matter how her brother called out,
that dragon—Enith—never answered,
and instead gritted her teeth and flew off alone.

The Remnith siblings have dragon blood.
It was the Devourers of Stars, who seek to turn dragons into Serpents,
that caused the incident by the lake that year.
And their true target was Enith,
who holds both a dragon's power and a human's will and wishes.
According to Rams and the other ancient dragons,
Enith knew all this,
and so decided to throw herself into battle as bait.
strings.得知这些之后，\n里姆尼斯采取的行动则是召集同伴。\n\n冰牙龙、炎龙王、屠龙者:
After learning all this,
what Remnith did was gather his allies.

The Ice Fang Dragon, the Flame Dragon King, the Dragon Slayer,
a little evil dragon, and a summoner who is friends with dragons.
People who share the same anger
naturally share the same goal.

Defeat the Devourers of Stars, and save the dragons—
to reach the same destination as his sister,
the brother and his allies set out on their journey.
Their anger will surely forge itself into a blade aimed at the star-devouring beasts.
strings.现在，莉莉丝等人正策划着新的移居计划，\n并已派出了先遣队前往矿山城。\n\n她:
Lilith and the others are now planning a new migration,
and have already sent an advance team to Miner's Front.

She has signed a resource and technology supply agreement with the ocean world,
which has also become the foothold for building a new artificial island.
Development everywhere will surely advance steadily.
strings.在阿尔克等人战斗结束数月之后——\n时机已然成熟，两种新的白人偶诞生了。\n\n:
A few months after Alk and the others' battle ended—
the time was ripe, and two new Nimbus dolls were born.

One is the Mini Doll: False Darling IV,
finally made small,
with a Devourer of Stars stably implanted,
perfect as a wedding favor.

The other is False Darling V,
made with fur from Darling Nimbus.
strings.或许是受到制作素材的影响，\n虚假达令Ⅴ在诞生时便拥有极其可怕的\n“存在本身便:
Perhaps because of its materials,
False Darling V was born with the terrifying property
that "its very existence interferes with possibility."
So it was destroyed by everyone the moment Sohvi unveiled it.

However, that whole commotion
caused Nimbus enormous mental fatigue.
Under its influence, he tacitly accepted
the existence of the (relatively) harmless False Darling IV.
strings.白金突然获得一颗崭新\n璀璨的原石——芙拉菲。\n她以新颖的近身魔法格斗术\n以:
Platinum Legends suddenly gained
a brilliant new diamond in the rough—Fluffy.
Her novel close-range magic martial arts
and relentless fighting spirit electrified audiences,
and she keeps winning more and more fans.

Though challengers flock to her,
Eclair just laughs easily and says,
"I'll never hand over my ace."

The fighters who keep shining on stage
will light up people's hearts again today.
strings.现已升入魔法学院中等科。\n他的世界正不断被特进班以及\n新结识的人们破坏，而他:
Now in the magic academy's middle division.
His world keeps getting wrecked by the advanced class
and the new people he's met, and he grows because of it.

His dream for the future is to take over his father's business
and stand beside the person he admires.
"Could I be like his dragon...
But I'll never tell him that!"
strings.〇月×日・晴\n\n今天对搭载了新术式的\n魔像进行了启动实验。\n然而，该魔像:
Month 〇, Day ×, Sunny

Today we ran a startup test
on a golem fitted with a new spell.
However, the golem went haywire and did something unexpected.
Thanks to a little wind mage nearby,
it didn't turn into a big deal.
But the teachers chewed me out.
I promised them I'd never make the same mistake again,
and it only made them angrier.
I don't get it.

Month △, Day ☆, Cloudy
Today I tested a new startup core in a golem,
and unsurprisingly it went haywire again.
Thanks to Ms. Cipher's ice magic,
the whole academy got frozen,
but the damage was kept to a minimum.
I thought it was fine since the two malfunctions had different causes,
but I still got chewed out.
I don't geeet iiit!

—Excerpts from a certain student's diary
strings.现在，吃饭功能终于再次为机人所周知。\n然而，仍有诸多机人忌讳摄取有机物。\n\:
Now the eating function is once again widely known among androids.
However, many androids still avoid taking in organic matter.

So, to let androids without the eating function
also "experience what eating feels like,"
promotional food for androids was developed.

Its delicate yet rich, stimulating flavor is widely praised.
As a result, a certain mech designer has received
many orders to install the eating function.
The androids who visit her all say
they "want to taste real curry."
strings.~某篇使互联网沸腾的怪文书~\n\n让我把真相告诉你们吧。\n吃饭功能根本不是什:
~A strange post that set the internet ablaze~

Let me tell you the truth.
The eating function was never taboo.
The original androids all had it.
So why did it disappear?
Isn't it obvious? Because there was no more food.
Our ancestors lost any rational reason to take in
energy through the mouth, so the eating function was naturally abandoned.
That must have made her so sad.

Whether you see installing the eating function as a great revival
or a brave leap into a new world
is up to you.
But I think
never tasting a minced meat and onion omelet is one of life's great losses, you know?
strings.第二年，他获得了投资，设立了三号四号店。\n数年之后，他与父亲的企业合作，\n在:
The next year, he got investment and opened branches three and four.
A few years later, partnering with his father's company,
he opened chain stores in every other world.
Later, he fell into a whirlwind romance with a woman
he met at one of his chain stores, and married her.
Surrounded by many children and grandchildren,
family and friends, he lived a beautiful life—

"Wouldn't that be great~!"
the young man said with a laugh, cooking yakisoba.
strings.她目标中的巅峰已然溃散。\n\n至少，已经有数名战士\n抵达了当时她心中的地点。:
The summit she aimed for has crumbled.

At the very least, several warriors
have already reached the place she once held in her heart.
In the future, their number will surely grow.
That was no summit,
merely the peak of a certain system.

More importantly, a fist like a joke
shattered every system, logic, and premise in a single blow.

So, will the god of war stop in her tracks?

The world has been completely broken,
and martial arts have entered a new realm.
Even as she trembles, her body is filled with joy.
Though she herself hasn't realized it yet.
strings.大部分妖怪剧都根据画狂老人的作品改编而来。\n不过，随着规模扩大，其题材也更为多:
Most yokai plays are adapted from Gramp Zigza's works.
But as they've grown in scale, their subjects have grown more varied too.
Plays adapted from the different myths and stories of each world
are especially popular with audiences.

Strangely, though,
yokai who perform in their true form
are a huge hit in Shibuya.
This has made some yokai especially happy,
led by Nurikabe, Ittan-momen, and Konaki-jiji.
strings.即便新剧本层出不穷，\n恋梓仍然是妖怪剧中的主心骨。\n不过，由于原作者的失踪，:
Though new scripts keep coming,
KoiAzu is still the backbone of the yokai plays.
However, since the original author disappeared,
there's been no news of new installments, which has become a big problem.

"If you keep this up, we'll just write the sequel however we like, you know?"

The fox girl pushed up her strangely glinting sunglasses.
Behind her stood a rather suspicious android.
Cornered, the art-mad painter scratched his cheek and replied:

"Do as you like."

"That won't do—"

After some arguing, everyone finally reached an agreement.
The KoiAzu yokai play would be produced as a standalone "side story,"
and must pass "original author supervision" before release.
The painter decided to send his top apprentice to help with production.
Naturally, without that person's consent.
But the painter said, "That one's sure to do it."
strings.后来，自称玉子的八坂琼勾玉\n以少女（奶奶）的形态出现在了众人面前。\n\n按玉:
Later, the Yasakani no Magatama, calling itself Tamako,
appeared before everyone in the form of a girl (grandma).

According to Tamako, their former masters
were the family that ruled the Land of Wa.
But that bloodline died out long ago,
and only a stone monument enshrined in a farming village records their existence.
strings.第五次胜负总算实现了希尔媞\n与强者交手的夙愿。\n这样的交手现在已成为了某种惯:
On the fifth bout, Celtie finally fulfilled
her long-held wish to cross swords with a strong opponent.
Such matches have now become something of a custom.
Quite a few people in Starview don't want to show their true strength.
Like Zekhel, who never reveals his hand,
and Soushiro, ever breezy and unwilling to spar.
(Alk is the exception.)
This keeps the sword demon's every day very fulfilling.
strings.当帕尔佩布拉处于\n“如火如荼三个月”的重建之时，\n菊野在某座已被烧毁的破屋上:
When Palpebra was in the midst of
its "three fiery months" of rebuilding,
Kikuno hung a "White Cloud Tower II" sign
on a burned-out shack,
determined to comfort the exhausted men and women, young and old.

Some were unhappy that she chose that moment to open.
But for many more,
chatting and having a drink in the shabby White Cloud Tower
truly gave them the energy to face tomorrow.

Also, as public order inevitably worsened,
White Cloud Tower II gave a refuge to those with nowhere to turn
who could only live in the world of the night.
strings.帕尔佩布拉复兴之后，\n当时的破屋也得以重建，\n正式开业成为了“二代白云楼”。:
After Palpebra's revival,
the old shack was rebuilt as well,
and officially opened as "White Cloud Tower II."
It's said that many merchants
waged fierce funding wars behind the scenes.
But none of that left any record.

It has now become a peaceful social space—
welcoming those drawn to the night in all sorts of ways,
and it's famous in many respects.
strings.后来，恩利尔与某位画师相遇，\n并以此为契机回到了自己的巢穴。\n然而，那里却不:
Later, Enlil met a certain painter,
and with that as a turning point, returned to its nest.
But for some reason an ancient fire dragon had settled there.
And so Enlil understood
it was enough, time to set out on a journey.

In the distant future, there are many legends
of a dragon calling itself "Fangless"
that granted power to those who fought the strange.
That dragon may well be Enlil.
But that is another story.
strings.本应是期间限定的限时支部。\n但在兹茵可的决断之下，\n特别技术处理课从TriM:
It was supposed to be a limited-time branch.
But at Tink's decision,
the Special Technical Processing Division went independent from TriMinutes,
renamed itself the "Shibuya Underground Processing Section," and continued its work.

Besides Shibuya boys and girls working part-time,
its new members include people who once belonged to TriMinutes.
Its activities grow livelier by the day.
strings.见岛勇希的异能。\n能将一切以她为目标的能力及载体\n尽数“隔绝”的超能力。\n:
Yuki Mishima's ability.
A psychic power that "blocks off"
every ability and carrier aimed at her.

This power was originally only meant to cut her off from the outside world.
But as her wish to protect others grew stronger,
her ability expanded as well.

That snowflake crystal barrier blooms like a flower.
strings.勇希希望能将此种能力运用在\n自己完全不擅长的格斗术之中。\n最后得到的便是通过:
Yuki hoped to use this ability
in martial arts, which she's terrible at.
What she came up with was a new move
that "pushes" stacked snowflake barriers
at the opponent with a punch.

The move has many drawbacks; it can't be used repeatedly,
or at the same time as her regular snowflake barrier.
But Yuki is satisfied, saying
"It's cool, and it's just like a finishing move from an anime."
strings.由希尔克哈蕾担任领队的偶像组合。\n除希尔克哈蕾与兔兔以外，\n还有十一名成员（:
An idol group led by Silkhare.
Besides Silkhare and Rabi-Rabi,
it has eleven other members (dolls).

Their flawless coordination and acrobatic performances
are unmatched, but—

this group's true identity is assassins
tasked with destroying the idol industry.
strings.现在，由于其隶属的团体遭到逮捕，\n加之有传言称她们将成立新组合FRD100，\:
Now, with the group they belonged to under arrest,
and rumors that they'll form a new group, FRD100,
many fans worry the group is about to disband.

However, in a surprise interview,
Miss Silkhare denied those worries.
She stated clearly that "that's a separate matter,"
and declared that from now on, no longer as assassins,
but as idols, CRT13 will continue.
strings.宇宙十二支国的神兽。\n\n与希尔克哈蕾一同结成了\n卯国的偶像组合“CRT13:
A sacred beast of the Cosmic Zodiac Nations.

Together with Silkhare, it formed
the Rabbit Nation's idol group "CRT13."

To Silkhare, it's like family.
strings.举止沉稳的绅士。\n但曾是稀世闻名的花花公子。\n身上至今刻有历经诸多修罗场的证:
A calm, composed gentleman.
But once a legendary playboy.
He still bears the marks of countless love-triangle battles.

They say a certain parting changed him completely...
but no one knows the truth.
strings.曾非常受欢迎的一大表演团体。\n但随着时代变迁，\n人们的兴趣逐渐移向了偶像产业:
Once a hugely popular performing troupe.
But as times changed,
people's interest shifted to the idol industry.

To revive their popularity,
they plotted to destroy the idol industry.
But CIPO exposed their scheme and rounded them all up,
and their ambitions withered miserably.

Also, the "falling popularity" excuse
was just Vorpal taking it out on idols.
Other circuses still draw huge crowds today.
strings.希尔科哈蕾梦想中和100个朋友\n一起成立偶像组合的计划。\n在星见镇的伙伴们的:
Silkhare's dream plan to form an idol group
with 100 friends.
With the help of her friends in Starview,
she decided to restart the plan she'd given up on.

At night, Silkhare lies in bed
grinning and worrying,
"What if we end up with more than 100 people?!"
strings.被见岛勇希所救，\n爱上了见岛勇希的涩谷少女。\n\n其实同样是超能力者。\n但:
A Shibuya girl who was saved by Yuki Mishima
and fell in love with her.

She's actually a psychic too,
but hides it with contact lenses.
When Shibuya was cut off from the world,
Aegis tried to force her to join,
and she came to adore Yuki for stepping in to stop them.

Though her love didn't bear fruit,
she became someone Yuki can never forget.
strings.宇宙偶像身上的神秘力量。\n原理与效果都完全不明。\n但确实能从其中感受到\n一:
A mysterious power found in cosmic idols.
Its principles and effects are completely unknown.
But you can certainly feel
a chaotic momentum from it.

When an idol unleashes this power with strong feelings,
people see visions of a mysterious space glittering with starlight.
How it works is still unknown.
Perhaps it comes from resonance with the observer?
strings.宇宙偶像之力现存在几种亚种。\n其一便是“宇宙平面模特之力”。\n在此种力量的影:
There are currently several variants of cosmic idol power.
One is "Cosmic Model Power."
Under its influence,
people fall into a mental state of being captivated
by alluring photo spreads.
strings.“宇宙刑警之力”\n乃宇宙偶像之力的亚种之一。\n\n在此种力量的影响下，\n人:
"Cosmic Detective Power"
is one variant of cosmic idol power.

Under its influence,
people fall into the mental state of being in an interrogation room
with a pork cutlet bowl placed in front of them.
strings.“宇宙友情之力”\n乃宇宙偶像之力的亚种之一。\n\n在此种力量的影响下，\n人:
"Cosmic Friendship Power"
is one variant of cosmic idol power.

Under its influence,
people fall into the mental state of walking home from school with friends.
However, it doesn't make it any easier to make friends.
strings.帕尔佩布拉在万圣节\n遭遇死者复苏事件时，\n法蒂玛教会也在背后尽了自己的努力。:
When the dead rose in Palpebra
on Halloween,
the Church of Farlana did its part behind the scenes too.
All the gravekeepers turned out,
running around to coordinate and clean up.
strings.本只是索隆领内少量酿造的无名之酒。\n后来被热爱索隆这片土地、\n与骑士一同巡游:
Originally a nameless liquor brewed in small amounts in Oinas territory.
It was later discovered by Iselia,
who loved the land of Oinas and traveled with her knights,
and became famous under the name "Yuni."
As it gradually entered the Palpebra market,
many in Starview came to love it too.
strings.“最近很火的PBC开发部”\n\nPBC开发部的产品其实本就颇为流行。\n但最近:
"PBC's Development Division, the hot topic lately"

PBC Development's products were already fairly popular,
but lately they've been boldly innovative,
and are a big hit with people who love cool things.

They say it's because the president personally brought in
two mega-genius beautiful newbie engineers of unknown origin.
But the truth is unclear.

Insiders say, "From experience,
there's bound to be a runaway incident soon, so everyone be careful."
strings.在雷龙尚且幼小之时，\n集她憧憬于一身的龙。\n年轻、勇猛、比任何人都强大，\n:
When the Thunder Dragon was still small,
this was the dragon she admired most.
Young, brave, stronger than anyone,
yet fallen for the sake of other dragons.

When they met again after rebirth,
that dragon seemed to have forgotten his former gentleness.
But his nature never changed.
That flame went out before the Thunder Dragon many times,
repeating rebirth.

Now, the Dragon King clad in azure flame
is more beautiful than any form the Thunder Dragon remembers.
strings.七大领域乃至高者统治时“编写”的。\n与它们相比，深渊另一头的遥远世界\n从各种:
The seven great realms were "written" during the Supreme One's rule.
Compared to them, the distant worlds beyond the abyss
are far more abnormal in every sense.

Below are records of extremely dangerous worlds found on six expeditions.
Merging with them would destroy every world.
strings.CASE1：腐肺的世界\n\n探索初期发现的世界。\n延绵至地平线的岩地上只有\:
CASE 1: The World of Rotting Lungs

A world found early in the exploration.
Rocky land stretching to the horizon, with nothing but
countless lumpy, raised holes.
Not dangerous, but nothing useful either.
That's what everyone thought at first.

But those countless holes were the planet's own breathing pores.
Every three hours, they released a toxic gas that covered the whole planet.
Breathe it in and your lungs rot, and you quickly cough up blood and die.

"Air isn't always something the body can breathe."

This lesson chilled everyone to the bone.
Yet compared to the even more abnormal adventures later,
this world was peaceful, even soothing.
In fact, precious minerals lie beneath this planet's surface.
So Renoir and a few others hope to visit again.
strings.CASE2：忘我的世界\n\n被苍郁的巨大植物覆盖的世界。\n有些形似森林世界。:
CASE 2: The World of Self-Forgetting

A world covered in lush, giant plants.
Somewhat like the forest world.
This time, having learned their lesson,
the team sent drones ahead to study the planet's atmosphere.
For days the drones sent back safe readings,
and everyone relaxed about this green world.

But by then,
the team members smiling at each other could no longer use "language."

And those deep in the forest didn't notice anything wrong.
They danced around like animals, spinning in circles on the spot.

In the end,
crew members on the ship noticed something was off and sent drones to bring them back.
It took hours for everyone to return to normal.

The mages concluded that this "forest"
could use spells to rob humans of their intelligence.
Some radically suggested "burning it down"—

"So in other words, there's an evil Challua here?"

That finally made the team realize the danger,
and they decided to cut the connection and withdraw from this world.
strings.CASE3：可逆的世界\n\n“掉地上的苹果又回到了手里。”\n“因为头疼喝了药:
CASE 3: The Reversible World

"An apple I dropped came back into my hand."
"I took medicine for a headache,
then found the headache was a side effect of the medicine."

Strange reports like these, the kind that get laughed at with "Were you dreaming?",
kept piling up.
Eventually, everyone discovered an unbelievable truth.

First, time was flowing backward.
Cause and effect reversed as time ran in reverse.
If they stayed in this world where causality was scrambled,
even if someone were reversed into "never having been born,"
no one would likely notice.

This terrifying warning made everyone decide to withdraw immediately.
However, a few people put up feeble resistance—

"I want to be younger. I don't want to be twice your age!
At least... at least let me go back to thirty!"

A forty-year-old man who'd started worrying about his hair color
desperately tried to stay in this world until the last moment,
but was kicked back by the former pirate captain.

Also, perhaps due to this incident,
some members really do look younger than before.
strings.已经拥有了崭新意义的星星\n现在也成了代表她自身的名字。\n\n某位画师以她为象:
The star, which now has a brand-new meaning,
has also become the name that stands for her.

A certain painter, taking her as a symbol,
painted a picture that crosses boundaries and connects different people,
and named the painting after it.

May a shooting star pour hopes and wishes into this painting.
strings.法蒂玛教的禁书: The Church of Farlana's Forbidden Books
strings.被法蒂玛教列为禁书的书目\n大致分为两类。\n其一是不符合教义的魔导书。\n法蒂:
The books the Church of Farlana has banned
fall roughly into two groups.
One is grimoires that don't fit its doctrine.
The Church of Farlana believes light magic can communicate with the gods,
so it reveres gentle light mages as saints
and treats dark magic as heresy.
This view often puts the Church in conflict with the Magic Association.
strings.其二则是法蒂玛教的外典。\n尤其是关于荷羊人与叹息之地的书物\n大多都由艾特兰本:
The other is the Church of Farlana's apocrypha.
Books about the Sheephirds and the Land of Sighs in particular
are mostly kept under strict guard by the Oxtan main house and the Grand Church.
This is because, to the Church of Farlana,
seeking the Land of Sighs from the Farlands' founding legend
and learning the Guide's true identity are great taboos.
strings.对于法蒂玛教来说，\n叹息之地乃概念中的起始之原，\n而非实际存在的地点。\n并:
To the Church of Farlana,
the Land of Sighs is a conceptual place of origin,
not a real location.
And according to doctrine, the Guide was a land-walker,
and the ancestor of the current royal family.
The legends of the Sheephirds directly contradict this doctrine,
so the Church of Farlana is very sensitive to their movements.
strings.在极东的叹息之地，\n我不眠不休地祈祷了三天三夜。\n然而，女神并没有回答我。\:
In the Land of Sighs in the far east,
I prayed without sleep or rest for three days and three nights.
But the goddess did not answer me.
All I wished was for the goddess to save us.
Even a single drop of rain for the starving people.
But legends are only legends after all.
There are no gods in this land.

Only our kind neighbors.
Those shepherds, nothing more.
strings.大约两百年前，法兰德发生了大规模饥荒。\n该笔记便是出自当时前往\n现在的帕尔佩:
About two hundred years ago, the Farlands suffered a great famine.
These notes were written by a monk who traveled at that time
to what is now Palpebra to train.
They record his wish to save the people,
his thoughts as he traced the legend of the Guide,
and how he was saved by the local nomads, the Sheephirds.
strings.虽是宣扬互助精神的朴素笔记，\n但由于其中零散的描述已断定\n现在帕尔佩布拉所在:
Though they are humble notes preaching mutual aid,
scattered descriptions in them conclude
that the land where Palpebra now stands is the Land of Sighs,
so the Church considers them forbidden.
The author was a devout believer,
but because he also researched the Land of Sighs,
he was ultimately excommunicated by his home church.
strings.艾特兰家族自然知晓此禁书的存在。\n但族中之人对其的感想两极分化。\n要么是对质:
House Oxtan naturally knows this forbidden book exists.
But opinions within the house are split.
Some resonate with its simple wishes and salvation.
Others are outraged by passages that come close to
praising the shepherds of Palpebra.
strings.尼尔娅娜发起的教育项目。\n在得到了星见镇的全面协助后，\n项目旨在定期邀请各世:
An education project started by Nihilyana.
With Starview's full cooperation,
it regularly invites students from every world for exchanges,
so they can learn about different races, cultures,
histories, magic systems and many other values.

The project is still in a trial phase.
Only a small number of people take part.
strings.本项目的原则并非为学生提供知识，\n而在于拓展他们的世界观。\n因此，项目的重头:
The project's principle isn't to give students knowledge,
but to broaden their view of the world.
So its focus isn't classroom learning,
but experiences gained through leisure and fun.

Because it aims to give a common sense different from existing education,
it has drawn opposition and concern from conservatives.
But the children who've taken part all loved it,
and eagerly await the next one.
strings.另外，由于需要精通异世界的领队，\n星见镇上的大多数人也参与了此项目。\n不过，:
Also, because it needs chaperones well-versed in other worlds,
most people in Starview have taken part in the project.
Their reasons vary widely, though.
Some simply resonate with Nihilyana's ideals,
while others come for the work and treat it as a regular vacation.
strings.沃伦塔斯魔法学院的学生。\n珂艾特的同班同学。\n实力在特进班中也属于顶级，\n:
A student at the Voluntas Arcane Arts Academy.
Couette's classmate.
Top-tier even in the advanced class,
everyone around her thinks she has a bright future.
She's often called a genius,
but she's actually a steady, diligent hard worker.
Her hard work is what supports her confidence and competitiveness.
strings.《珂艾特受害者协会》会长。\n\n她的双亲都是魔法师学者。\n自幼她便认真努力，:
President of the "Couette Victims' Association."

Both her parents are mage scholars.
Since childhood she's been earnest and hardworking,
building her self-esteem in a straightforward way—
but the sudden appearance of Couette
completely shattered her worldview.

Her pride was crushed, but it didn't disappear.
She will surely see Couette as a hurdle to clear,
and keep studying hard from now on.
strings.稀世魔法师珂艾特\n在进入沃伦塔斯魔法学院\n就读之时便获得了毕业证书。\n她将:
The rare mage Couette
received her diploma the moment she enrolled
at the Voluntas Arcane Arts Academy.
She compiled the troubles she met on her travels
and how she solved them into this extraordinary casebook.

Every story begins with the first inter-world exchange program
held on Paradise Isle.
strings.CASE：1《古老的海中祭坛》\n概要：与人鱼之外的海栖人类的遭遇\n\n事件的:
CASE 1: "The Ancient Undersea Altar"
Summary: An encounter with sea-dwelling humans other than mermaids

It all started when Couette and a new friend
from the exchange program, the blonde girl Picolita,
found an unknown aquatic human with a fish's head,
a "Deep One," washed up in a restricted area of Paradise Isle.
strings.在深海者的请求下，\n珂艾特与皮西卡、皮可丽塔、\n路易克、艾玛以及直等人出发\:
At the Deep One's request,
Couette set out with Pythica, Picolita,
Luik, Emma, Nao and the others
to explore the mysterious depths of the northern sea.
There, after clashing with
the remnants of an armed group calling themselves the Dorsal Fins
and followers of the Devourer of Stars,
they discovered the ruins of an ancient civilization once called the "Altar."
strings.CASE：2《诗篇伊迪亚断章》\n概要：击退咏星者并回收继承器\n\n与舞子·沃:
CASE 2: "Fragments of the Edea Canticle"
Summary: Repelling the Star Augurs and recovering a cryptic artifact

A few weeks after settling things with Maiko Warren,
Maiko revealed what she knew to everyone.
So Couette, along with Light and Belsidia,
hurried to a certain company in Qualia City.
But waiting for them in a secret lab
was the Star Augur Deneb, who had survived grave wounds in the Farlands
and now had a prosthetic body.
strings.既然继承只是“书中的一页”，\n那只要将记忆转录进纯粹的大脑便好。\n\n为了重:
If inheritance is just "a page in a book,"
then all you need is to transcribe the memories into a pure brain.

To revive the crumbling Star Augurs,
Deneb tried to use a cryptic artifact on an artificial body
and create a new Capella.
He even used the cryptic artifact as bait
to join hands with several companies and radical androids,
throwing Qualia City into chaos.
But with the help of Laf, Nate and others,
Couette's group defeated Deneb,
recovered one of the cryptic artifacts,
and brought the situation under control.
strings.双星剑世界弹射器。\n\n曾一分为二的破星剑在融合之时，\n吸取了其中部分思念，:
The Twin Star Sword World Flipper.

When the Starbreaker, once split in two, was fused back together,
it absorbed some of the thoughts within
and gained a brand-new form.

Its authority to cut down worlds—that is, stars—has evolved,
and the sword now holds the power to "connect,"
cutting through boundaries, opening paths, and linking star to star.

Its power is the same in nature as the lance that gave it new life.
It rebuilds things by fitting foreign matter into lost or critically damaged parts—
in other words, it is also the power of "patching together."
strings.在这种力量的影响下，\n阿尔克能够模仿伙伴们的力量与招数。\n而能参考的对象仅限:
Under the influence of this power,
Alk can imitate his friends' powers and moves.
But he can only draw on those who showed him
his next goal on his journey—
that is, people who greatly influenced him.

Basically, people he admires and respects.
But also some people he'd never admit to liking.
In fact, Alk himself hasn't noticed this.
strings.默默立于利比尔德闹市区的酒吧。\n聚集了无数寻求一夜之梦的男女。\n欲望的熔炉。:
A bar quietly standing in Paradise's downtown.
It gathers countless men and women seeking a dream for one night.
A melting pot of desire.
Of course, children aren't allowed.

Those who don't know how to enjoy the night count as children too.
Grown-up kids are often seen getting kicked out.
strings.“嗯，是啊。一开始我吓了大一跳。\n我还是第一次见到那样毛发浓密的兽人。\n但他:
"Yes, that's right. At first I was totally shocked.
It was my first time seeing such a thickly furred beastfolk.
But his desperate attempt to act flirtatious,
those moist eyes, that mane, those ears—
ahh, even remembering it now is so beautiful!"

Testimony of member #1, the fan club president.
strings.此FC中也存在种种派系。\n如“想被成长了的帅哥提欧弟弟\n用熟练的姿态求爱派”:
This fan club has all sorts of factions.
Like "I want a grown-up, handsome Teo
to court me smoothly,"
"I want to see him cry,"
"I must be the one to protect him,"
"I want him to act cocky with me...
so jealous of that big brother who looks like his own kind," and so on.
strings.置于星见镇图书室的相册。\n主要收藏了在利比尔德乐园拍摄的照片。\n无论是谁都能:
A photo album kept in the Starview library.
Mainly holds photos taken on Paradise Isle.
Anyone can leave a comment on the paper tucked inside.
strings.第3张：\n正在准备度假用品的艾可。\n她带了相机、泳装、裙子、\n美容用品、宣:
Photo 3:
Echo packing for vacation.
She brought a camera, swimsuit, skirt,
beauty products, pamphlets,
travel guides and more.
She packed so much
some of it is spilling out of the case.

You're so excited~ (Alice)
M-Miss Alice, don't you
have even more luggage? (Primula)
Echo, are you really bringing that swimsuit?!
The amount of fabric! Eeek!! (Pythica)
I... I'll do my best! (Echo)
strings.第11张：\n\n满面笑容兜售果汁的提欧。\n还拍到了红着脸接过果汁的客人\n以:
Photo 11:

Teo beaming as he sells juice.
Also captured: a customer taking juice with a red face,
and fans holding uchiwa fans.
The fans say "Teo sweetie, give us a wink."

Such idol power! (Beaucy)
So beautiful! (Margaret)
What's the Teo Sweetie Fan Club? (Albert)
Wah! Aaaaaaaah!!! (Teo)
strings.第24张：\n在海边烧烤的众人。\n主体是勾肩搭背喝酒的\n白、杰拉尔、斩铁三人:
Photo 24:
Everyone having a beach barbecue.
The focus is Nimbus, Gerard and Zantetsu
drinking arm in arm.
Also captured: Ryuichi in the distance, looking thoroughly disgusted.
strings.第45张：\n在海之家烹饪的阿尔克。\n表情认真严肃，\n眼睛里却闪烁着有如孩童:
Photo 45:
Alk cooking at the beach house.
His expression is serious,
but his eyes sparkle with childlike joy.

If he's making that face,
he must be cooking monster cuisine. (Shota)
This one wishes to taste that again~
The King's Seafood Hotpot! (Zantetsu)
Me too! (Denah)
No problem! (Parfait)
Someday, I'll definitely... (Alk)
Scary. (Shota)
strings.置于星见镇图书室的第二本相册。\n由于摄影师众多，\n不知不觉中照片和相册的数量:
The second photo album kept in the Starview library.
With so many photographers,
the number of photos and albums grew before anyone knew it.
strings.第57张：\n和朋友一起比出胜利手势的珂艾特。\n一旁的金发少女挽着珂艾特的手，:
Photo 57:
Couette making a victory sign with her friends.
A blonde girl on one side has her arm linked with Couette's,
while a black-haired girl on the other side puffs out her cheeks,
looking disgruntled.

Taking a photo with friends...
made Couette really, really happy! (Couette)
strings.第73张：\n一起吃巨型芭菲的缘子与翔太。\n\n拜托了，请再多冲洗一些。\n张:
Photo 73:
Yukariko and Shota sharing a giant parfait.

Please, print more copies.
We'll discuss the number separately.
If possible,
could I have the film too? (Yukariko)
strings.第88张：\n在图书室做补习作业的奈芙提姆。\n她的妹妹正在一旁守护着因为没能\:
Photo 88:
Nephtim doing make-up homework in the library.
Her little sister watches over the girl,
who's heartbroken about missing the vacation.

Nephtim is so disappointed...
Make-up classes should vanish from the world! (Nephtim)
Big sis rode off on a motorcycle trip with Yuki Mishima
because it looked cool,
and skipped class for a month without permission.
Light says she brought it on herself. (Aliksir)
Ugh... (Nephtim)
strings.正式名为“落日岩礁”。\n乃利比尔德乐园的观光胜地之一。\n以能眺望到美丽的夕阳:
Officially named "Sunset Reef."
One of Paradise Isle's tourist spots.
Famous for its beautiful sunset views.
There's also a well-known rumor about it.
They say if lovers hang a love lock on the cliffside railing,
their love will last forever.

Love locks are sold at the kiosk near the cape.
Visitors, buy with confidence!
strings.操里缘子与伊野里翔太间\n关于基本未来交往的条约。\n\n包括在相互理解之上加深:
A treaty between Yukariko Kuguri and Shota Inori
on their basic future relationship.

It covers deepening their relationship on mutual understanding,
policies on how their relationship progresses or pauses,
a ban on excessive close contact, and so on.
But the content is actually vague and arbitrary.

The two have run into many exceptions while dating.
Some experts have questioned the treaty.
"Does this thing even mean anything?
You're basically already dating normally, aren't you?"
strings.西历世界的伟人爱因斯坦\n发现并提出了“狭义相对论”。\n日本人则以神话传说为其:
Einstein, a great man of the Western Calendar world,
discovered and proposed "special relativity."
The Japanese named it after a myth.

The phenomenon can be summed up simply as
"the faster an object moves,
the slower time passes for it."
The Western Calendar world has proven it to be a real phenomenon.

There's another similar phenomenon that isn't the Urashima effect.
Namely, "the stronger an object's gravity,
the slower time passes for it."
This too has been proven in the Western Calendar world.
strings.涩谷在封闭状态中度过了三个月。\n而外界的时间却已流逝了一万年。\n涩谷与帕尔佩:
Shibuya spent three months cut off.
Meanwhile, ten thousand years passed outside.
When Shibuya's connection with Palpebra was cut,
everyone experienced a week in an extremely short time.
These examples made sci-fi-loving Yuki Mishima
exclaim "It's like the Urashima effect,"
and the concept became widely known.

However, physics-loving Seiji Takamori says:
"This breaks the law of conservation of energy,
so I can't explain it either."
So perhaps what happened here is just
some phenomenon similar to the Urashima effect.
strings.S：原来如此。完全不懂。\nY：唔……也是呢。这很复杂啊。\nA：有点像是世界变:
S: I see. I don't get it at all.
Y: Hmm... Yeah, it's complicated.
A: It's kind of like the world lagging.
S: What do you mean... like a phone?
A: Yeah. Think about it, if you run too many games,
      your phone starts lagging, right?
S: Ah, that's just 'cause your phone sucks lol
      But yeah, we used to do that all the time.
A: So the faster it goes, the heavier it gets,
      the more there is, the heavier it gets. Right?
S: Oh, I see, that kinda makes sense~
      Huh... wait? That sounds kinda scary?
Y: I have novels about this! Want to read them???
S: Why's she so excited all of a sudden...
strings.勇者莱特归来已是五十年后。\n尤维尔·玖兹消失了三年。\n以上情况都说明，\n被:
The hero Light returned fifty years later.
Yuwel Nouin vanished for three years.
These cases show that
people swept into the gaps between worlds by the wavering
experience time stopping.

If the "abyss" created by countless world mergers
is like a black hole,
producing extremely strong gravity from excessive mass,
this phenomenon is very likely tied to the abyss's formation.
strings.凪原步、阿尔克的选择便是\n再现当时在涩谷发生的事。\n\n龙沉睡于深渊之底。\:
The choice made by Ayumu Nagihara—Alk—
was to recreate what happened in Shibuya back then.

The dragon sleeps at the bottom of the abyss.
So he forcibly drove his sword
into the singularity in the parallel world observation device,
connecting the Palace of Stars to the abyss for an instant.

The vortex of information and mass condensed in the abyss
swallowed the time flowing in the Palace of Stars as well.
For Alk and Nova, only an instant passed.
But it "bought three months" for their friends,
enough to find a way to come to their rescue.
strings.曾经王都艾克赛里奥常见的花。\n\n世界迎来毁灭之时，它黯然凋谢。\n但现在，它:
A flower once common in the royal capital, Excelio.

When the world met its end, it quietly withered.
But now, it will sprout and grow under a new sun.
strings.但为什么叫“艾克赛里恩鸢尾”呢？\n王都的名字是艾克赛里奥呀。\n“恩”是从哪儿:
But why is it called the "Excelion iris"?
The capital's name is Excelio.
Where does the "n" come from?
According to my research, maybe its original name
was "Excelio's iris,"
and it gradually turned into "Excelion iris."
What do you think?
Besides, "Excelion" definitely sounds cooler
than "Excelio's," right!

Oh, by the way, its flower language is "hope."
Lovely meaning, right~
I'm so glad it can bloom in this forest.

—From the casual chatter of a certain former spy.
strings.承诺与爱人相伴一生的仪式。\n\n“不论疾病或是健康，\n不论悲伤还是欢喜，\n:
A ceremony promising to spend one's life with a loved one.

"In sickness and in health,
in sorrow and in joy,
I swear
I will stay by your side
until death do us part."

The above are the vows recommended by Observer magazine.
What the couple actually vows is up to them.
strings.CASE1：\n\n龙与三名女性在星见镇举办的婚礼。\n婚礼上并无正式的宣誓仪式:
CASE 1:

A wedding in Starview between a dragon and three women.
There was no formal exchange of vows.
Guests enjoyed fine food, drink and entertainment.
It was more of a party than a wedding.

The three women in wedding dresses looked very happy.
The dragon beside them gazed gently at their beaming faces.
strings.CASE2：\n\n前斯特拉托斯王国的女性\n与魔族男性举办的婚礼。\n二人在移:
CASE 2:

A wedding between a woman of the former Stratos Kingdom
and a fiend man.
The two met before migrating to the new world,
grew closer, and finally decided to marry.

Blessed by the forest and the spirits,
the two will surely create new life from here on.
strings.CASE3：\n\n在旧矿山城举办的婚礼。\n\n在宴会上，\n媒人的演讲（30:
CASE 3:

A wedding held in Miner's Front.

At the banquet,
the matchmaker's speech (over 30 minutes) was very well received.
That super-long speech full of love and passion
kept the bride laughing and crying the whole time.
strings.CASE4：\n\n在大圣堂匆忙举办的婚礼。\n\n此次婚礼几乎未留下任何记录。:
CASE 4:

A hastily held wedding at the Grand Cathedral.

Almost no record of this wedding remains.
Only all sorts of rumors run wild.
Such as "both the bride and groom were twins,"
"this wedding concerned the fate of the world,"
"every guest was very furry,"
"the next day the couple came back to the Grand Cathedral to book a ceremony,
but because the groom firmly refused,
the wedding had to be postponed," and so on and so forth.
strings.CASE5：\n\n在大圣堂举办的婚礼。\n新人并非CASE4中的二位。\n此次:
CASE 5:

A wedding held at the Grand Cathedral.
Not the couple from CASE 4.
This couple held two weddings,
in each of their hometowns, Palpebra and a Float.

The couple invited many friends to the banquet,
and declared publicly that they'd build a happy family.
Their dream came true the following year.
strings.调查内容：\n“恋爱”究竟是何物。\n\n调查理由：\n每个人在恋爱中的状态，\:
Subject:
What exactly is "romance"?

Reason:
Everyone acts differently when in love,
and defines love differently,
which is very interesting.

Method:
Interviews.
strings.Q：对你来说，“恋爱”是什么呢？\n\n鲁·鲁特：\n哼……坠入爱河的瞬间，\n:
Q: What is "romance" to you?

Lu Root:
Hmph... The moment you fall in love,
you just know—ah, that's love.

Shota:
What kind of answer is that?

Alk:
Let's ask a professional.

Wilfred:
Huh! Uh, um... for example...
your heart races when you're with them.
Everything about them looks cute.
You want to touch her but you're scared to.
Just being together makes you happy,
but somehow it's still not enough.
Every time you remember she loves you too, you want to cry.
You want to return her feelings, and also—

Lu Root:
So annoyiiing—
The professional's so annoyiiing—
strings.Q：对你来说，“恋爱”是什么呢？\n\n涅特：\n我自己也想知道啊……\n\n贾:
Q: What is "romance" to you?

Nate:
I'd like to know too...

Themis:
Hmm, I could teach you plenty of ways...

Nate:
Don't say! That! While looking at me!!!
strings.最终报告：\n\n我还是不太明白恋爱是什么。\n\n但我想，恋爱应该是自由的。:
Final report:

I still don't really understand what romance is.

But I think romance should be free.
strings.我是从今日开始担任\n莉莉丝殿下秘书的艾丽娅纳斯。\n\n在下曾十分无礼地直接找:
I am Aliyanas, starting today
as Lady Lilith's secretary.

I once very rudely went straight to Her Highness to protest and negotiate.
Yet Her Highness still chose to keep me by her side as secretary.
I am deeply grateful.

Below is a report on an incident we encountered.
strings.约一月前，我们得知有谣言称\n“我等能够回到原来的世界”。\n通过对其出处及失踪:
About a month ago, we learned of a rumor that
"we can return to our original world."
Investigating its source and a series of disappearances,
we found that the director of the Resource Management Bureau
was forcing elves, fiends, beastfolk and others into improper labor,
and arrested him on the spot.
Below is the interrogation record of the incident.
strings.发言者：资源管理局局长\n“我们是王国的血脉，\n是合法的统治者。”\n“反正他:
Speaker: Director of the Resource Management Bureau
"We are of the kingdom's blood,
the rightful rulers."
"They're not human anyway,
what's wrong with using them and throwing them away?"
"When it comes down to it, Lilith Stratos is too lax.
The people should be managed by those who rule.
They don't need freedom or choices."
strings.备注：实施移居计划时，\n该局长曾强烈反对\n将世界崩坏这一情报公布于众。\n\:
Note: When the migration plan was carried out,
this director strongly opposed
making the news of the world's collapse public.

In my humble opinion... this is a defeat of intellect and reason.
He fancied himself a human of noble standing,
yet exploited people's crisis for his own likes and desires.
I request severe punishment for him.
strings.附注：该事件十分紧急。\n已临近确认截止日期。望您迅速处理。\n若您遗忘，我会亲:
Addendum: This matter is urgent.
The confirmation deadline is near. Please handle it promptly.
If you forget, I will come to your office to collect it personally.
Please be prepared.
strings.报告人：秘书艾丽娅纳斯\n\n本日正午，魔族与精灵\n在木材采伐场发生争执。\n:
Reporter: Secretary Aliyanas

At noon today, fiends and elves
got into a dispute at the lumber site.
I went to question them.
Below are both sides' testimonies.
strings.精灵：现在的开拓不需要那么多木头。\n在我看来，我们已经过度采伐了。\n尤其是魔:
Elf: The current settlement work doesn't need that much wood.
In my view, we're already overlogging.
Especially the fiends, they're very wasteful.
The trees here aren't infinite.

Fiend: Harvesting forest resources is public work in the first place.
The natives here allowed it too.
Elves have no right to lecture me.
strings.魔族的发言确实十分合理。\n然而精灵族群似乎愈发反感森林采伐。\n对与森林共生的:
The fiend's statement is certainly reasonable.
However, the elves seem increasingly opposed to logging.
For elves, who live in harmony with the forest,
logging truly goes against their culture.
On this matter, I believe we should mediate between both sides,
designate the area around the elves' residences as a nature reserve,
and reassign the fiends to the curse crystal mine.
I ask that you consider this.
strings.私以为……此事件仅是问题的冰山一角。\n我等已决定要在这片土地上共同生存。\n摆:
In my humble opinion... this incident is just the tip of the iceberg.
We have decided to live together on this land.
Having escaped the crisis and begun a new life,
we naturally face many problems.
Cultural differences are only the part that has surfaced.
After the long war,
the fiends already had a rift with the other races.
So I believe we must watch the situation carefully.
strings.另外，在下认为，\n对此我等无需太过悲观。\n我等已知异种族之间实现了通婚。\n:
Also, I believe
we needn't be too pessimistic about this.
We know that intermarriage between races has taken place.
With the development of Miner's Front and the curse crystal mine,
the number of available jobs is growing day by day.
We are certainly moving toward the future.

Addendum: If there are any personnel changes,
please inform me in advance next time.
Even though this time it was only a single girl,
arranging everything took a great deal out of me.
strings.近身魔法格斗术的祖师泰加\n新领悟到的武学阶段——\n不，应该说是崭新的世界。\:
A new stage of martial arts—
no, a whole new world—
newly grasped by Taiga, founder of close-range magic martial arts.
Details unknown, principles unknown.
Throwing a punch summons rainbow-colored light,
and before you know what happened, the opponent is down.

Mr. A, once punched to the brink of death in one blow:
"That move is useless for breaking up fights."
Mr. S, once punched to the brink of death in one blow:
*No comment.
strings.白虎青年的觉醒让老格斗家决定奋起直追。\n即便根源乃“龙”，他也毫不畏惧。\n为:
The white tiger youth's awakening spurred the old fighter to catch up.
Even if its source was a "dragon," he wasn't afraid in the least.
Why does he tirelessly train his fists?
Carrying that question, he leapt before anyone else—

and dissolved, vanished.

But Taiga came back.
His friends were very surprised, and he was even more shocked.
But his take on what happened differed from his friends'.
strings.泰加在“某处”看到了。\n伙伴们和自己一样，溶解消失。\n凝视星辰的眼睛化为一位:
Taiga saw it "somewhere."
His friends dissolving and vanishing, just like him.
The eye gazing at the stars turning into a boy.
Time seeming to flow backward.

His friends laughed and said nobody had vanished.
Taiga was outraged.
"Then which of you remembers
when and how this old man, who should have died, came back?!"
But no one could answer his question. Himself included.

In any case, after that,
Taiga awakened a new power.
strings.泰加与沃伦塔斯魔法学院共同开发的手甲。\n（按宣传说法）穿戴后，\n任何人都能使:
Gauntlets jointly developed by Taiga and the Voluntas Arcane Arts Academy.
(According to the marketing) when worn,
anyone can use close-range magic martial arts.
But it requires martial arts knowledge
and a flexible understanding of magic.
strings.通过手甲，强行将帕尔佩布拉的人们\n无法解释的海洋世界魔法刻进身体，\n以此扩张:
The gauntlets forcibly etch the ocean world's magic,
which Palpebra's people can't explain, into the body,
expanding the wearer's worldview.
But during development,
students fainted one after another as their worldviews broke down.
So the design had to use Palpebra-style magic.
*Cipher, whose proposal wasn't adopted, was very sad.

For Fluffy, who is from the ocean world,
this design should actually be very dangerous.
But no problems seem to have come up in actual use.
strings.一击必杀之技。\n乃人们在历经修炼之后获得的\n“唯有这个不能退让！”的绝招。\:
Moves that defeat in a single blow.
Ultimate techniques people gain after training,
the "one thing I'll never give up!"
Broadly split into those who shout the move's name and those who don't.
Shouting the move's name isn't about looking cool, but a kind of ritual
to firmly fix a clear image matching the move in one's heart.
Of course, some shout because "it's cool."
And some just copy their friends' finishing moves.
strings.“当时那孩子的说法是\n阿尔克违反了契约，\n不给她提供饭菜了。\n不过，那肯定:
"At the time, that girl claimed
Alk broke their contract
and stopped giving her meals.
But that was obviously an excuse.
She'd wanted to fight Alk for ages.

But Alk was in the wrong too.
He could have brushed it off like he usually does.
He must have thought nobody heard,
but I definitely heard him.

What he said was—what a total pain."

"Um, uh, you're going to... say all of this?"

"What, isn't this an interview?"

"Please spare me..."
strings.“一开始是阿尔克占了绝对优势呢。\n当然，我也猜到会是那样了。\n\n不过，那孩:
"At first Alk had the overwhelming advantage.
Of course, I expected that.

But that girl is scary too.
Through the spiral,
she grasped the 'power' of the cycling world.
I'd secretly learned it too—
but she evolved it at the critical moment."

"Right! That was the Dracostream, wasn't it!
That really was the dragon's road, right?!
Barely anyone at the dojo can 'understand' it!
She's seriously amazing!"

"So he borrowed that power too.
And managed it on his own—"

"This guy egged her on like that.
Saying something like 'you're weak if you can't accept it.'
That's what you said, right?"

"Uh... I did say that..."
strings.“最强是唯一的。答案也只有一个。\n对没法理解他人的那孩子来说，\n这样思考才能:
"The strongest is unique. There's only one answer.
For a girl who can't understand others,
thinking that way is what puts her at ease.

But did you really need to point it out?
That's not like you at all?"

"But... it really pissed me off.
What she says and what she does are so far apart.
She can't accept others,
yet she's always so arrogant...
There's cocky you can forgive and cocky you can't—"

"Sigh, you're so childish...
I think you've had enough to drink."
strings.感谢以上各位配合采访。\n\n我也采访了谢胧小姐，\n她表示她对自己非常生气，\:
Thanks to everyone above for the interviews.

I also interviewed Miss Xielong.
She said she was very angry at herself,
and after asking herself "why, don't mess with me,"
she's now learned the old man's technique.

Why on earth would that be...
strings.可以在感质之城买到的飞行部件。\n\n现在最为流行的是Vala·Pastma\n:
Flight parts you can buy in Qualia City.

The most popular right now is the nitro plasma engine model
made by Vala Pastma.
Connecting to the spinal cord lets it raise speed without limit.
Its original, edgy design is also very popular.
People say it's "cool beyond words,"
and are rushing to order from Vala Pastma.
strings.尽管感质之城中十分流行飞行部件，\n这里的人仍然无法操纵重力。\n因此，伊野里翔:
Though flight parts are very popular in Qualia City,
people there still can't control gravity.
So Shota Inori's race footage
shocked all sorts of people,
and some even plotted to kidnap him.
Fortunately, the plot was foiled by a joint Noxel Group & PBC unit.
The only one who doesn't know about it is Shota Inori himself.
strings.塔吉斯使用的机翼外装乃神经连接式。\n但感质之城中同样存在\n仅需要背在背上就能:
The wing gear Teurgis uses is the neural-link type.
But Qualia City also has
flight parts that work just by wearing them on your back.

Nova once tried out a wearable flight part.
But it was a "romance model" modified by Wilfred and some PBC staff
after taking lots of Teurgis's suggestions,
and it vanished in an explosion seconds after he put it on.
Nova himself seemed to enjoy it,
and really wants to take part in the next modification.

This video series passed 100 million total views,
and caused a surge in young people wanting wing gear surgery.
But most foamed at the mouth during surgery,
lost consciousness, and had to give up.
Afterward, many comments appeared below the videos
demanding the uploader pay their surgery cancellation fees.
strings.之后，投稿人上传了使用机翼外\n与三位友人一同翱翔的飞行体验视频。\n该视频获得:
Later, the uploader posted a flight video
of soaring with three friends using wing gear.
It got tons of views,
and all sorts of comments.

"The flying prince is so nervous, so cute lol"
"The partner kid's so cool~ like a villain."
"The cute boy is adorable."
"Bulleta's still cooler."
"Film more of that cute boy."
"These wing parts were co-developed
by PBC's mechanical division! That's PBC for you!
Contact me with any questions!"
strings.加入了涩谷地下处理科的女高中生。\n本名为田中心爱（Tanaka Kokoa）\:
High school girls who joined the Shibuya Underground Processing Section.
Real names: Kokoa Tanaka
and Momoka Nakata.

They've been neighbors since they were little.
The two have taken countless photo-booth stickers together.
So as not to lose them,
they hid all their sticker albums somewhere safe.
strings.最近的梦想是换上机械义足，\n购买机械羽翼到天空翱翔，\n还有说服可莎穿上一样的:
Their latest dream is to get mechanical legs,
buy mechanical wings and soar through the sky,
and convince Katyusha to wear the same uniform
and take photo stickers with them.
(They've already taken photo stickers
with Tink, Stella and Nova)

The mechanical legs idea met strong opposition
from both sets of parents.
Lately they've been in heated three-way talks
with their middle school homeroom teacher, Mayor Takamori, and their parents.
strings.骗吃骗喝四天王: The Four Heavenly Kings of Eating on Credit
strings.多次要求阿尔克无偿请客吃饭的人。\n\n不过该称呼只是部分人随意分类。\n四天王:
People who've repeatedly asked Alk to feed them for free.

However, the title is just a loose label some people use.
There are definitely more than four.
Anyone who shrugs and says "those Heavenly Kings are hopeless"
is a Heavenly King too.
strings.经常光临阿尔克的咖喱店的\n当然不只有骗吃骗喝四天王。\n通常来说，大部分人乖乖:
Of course, it's not just the Four Heavenly Kings of Eating on Credit
who frequent Alk's curry shop.
Generally, most people pay up properly.

A man in his forties who orders a ton no matter how broke he is.
A former pirate who always drops by after returning from a voyage.
A mediator who always comes with some reserved excuse.
A good-looking adventurer with a sharp tongue.
Listing them all would take three days and three nights.
As for the prince and company who came back half-dead,
since they spent all their money reforming society,
Alk decided to feed them for free.
That definitely doesn't count as eating on credit.
strings.某位斗士眼中的芙拉菲: Fluffy, as Seen by a Certain Fighter
strings.记者N：\n感谢您今天愿意接受采访！\n最后我还想问一个与希·伊尔小姐\n没有直:
Reporter N:
Thank you for the interview today!
Lastly, I'd like to ask something not directly
about you, Miss Shi-il... is that okay?

Heel fighter Shi-il:
Sure, go ahead.

Reporter N:
Thank you!
I'd like to ask about the popular new fighter, Fluffy.
What's she like behind the scenes?

Heel fighter Shi-il:
It's not great to reveal a fighter's real self...
but I can answer that.
She's like that off-stage too.

Reporter N:
Like that?

Heel fighter Shi-il:
That's right. She's a very focused, earnest good kid.
And a very worthwhile opponent.
Ah, but...
strings.反派斗士希·伊尔：\n那个……接下来的是非官方发言。\n七海小姐认识那边的人吧？:
Heel fighter Shi-il:
Um... this next part is off the record.
Miss Nanami, you know people on that side, right?
Do you... know who those beastfolk are?

Reporter N:
Huh? Beastfolk?

Heel fighter Shi-il:
Yeah. Fluffy's friends.
After every one of Fluffy's shows,
that rabbit faithfully comes to give its impressions.
Sometimes it even
partners with Fluffy in the shows, right?

It's got such a strong personality!
A useless heel like me...
can't get anyone to remember me!
At the last show,
I got stepped on by that queen,
and now my nickname is "Pig"!

Reporter N:
Um, it'd be best not to talk about
personal hobbies like that in front of kids...

Heel fighter Shi-il:
But my reputation's been damaged!
strings.与我们认知中的世界存在细微差别，\n蕴含了不同可能性的世界。\n\n若某时某刻某:
Worlds slightly different from the one we know,
holding different possibilities.

If someone had made a different choice at some moment,
the future would have changed completely.
"There are as many possible worlds
as there are choices."
That should have existed only as a concept, yet—

the abyss connected them to the real world.
strings.同时存在两个及其相似的世界\n这件事本身就十分危险。\n失去了能区分这两者的根基:
Two extremely similar worlds existing at once
is dangerous in itself.
Without the foundation that tells them apart,
every existence and phenomenon would blend together,
even twisting and breaking cause and effect—
every world could be utterly destroyed
in the very next instant.

The world faced a crisis without anyone noticing,
and was saved without anyone noticing.
strings.会将恋人称为甜心的白。\n拥有其他可能性的白之一。\n从平行宇宙误入了这个世界。:
A Nimbus who calls his lover "sweetheart."
One of the Nimbuses with other possibilities.
He wandered into this world from a parallel universe.
No one knows what choice led
this Nimbus and Sohvi to love each other.

By the way, "Darling Nimbus" is just for
telling them apart; his real name is still "Nimbus."
strings.达令·白发自内心地爱着索维。\n他的爱毫无虚假。\n然而……除了索维，\n还有许:
Darling Nimbus loves Sohvi from the bottom of his heart.
His love is completely genuine.
However... besides Sohvi,
many other women received his genuine love too.
To put it bluntly, he's scum.
But his sweethearts love that about him too.

"That's how we pulled it off.
Didn't you say so too?"

"Said... what?
Never mind, don't say it. Don't say anything."

"I'll take care of all of them—"

"I told you to shut up???"
strings.不管有几个白都可以接受: Fine with Any Number of Nimbuses
strings.完全不是那样。\n大部分人都会十分困扰。\n\n不过，这番话中确实倾注了\n索维:
That's not true at all.
Most people would be very troubled.

However, these words truly pour out
Sohvi's unquestionable love for every Nimbus.
strings.普·莉莉艾身边的小龙。\n在莉莉艾还是新人的时候，\n某次她来到帕尔佩布拉外围的:
The little dragon by Pur Lilie's side.
When Lilie was still a newbie,
she once wandered into the forest on the outskirts of Palpebra,
and got startled when it popped out of the ground.
That's how the girl and the dragon met.
Lilie ran off in fright back then,
but Pur Chi looked so weak and hungry
that she couldn't help sharing an apple with it.
Ever since, Pur Chi has stuck to Lilie.
Now it's Lilie's trusted partner,
helping her at work and protecting her.
strings.在修尔特指出普·奇是龙之前，\n包括莉莉艾在内的公会职员\n及冒险者们无一人意识:
Until Schulte pointed out that Pur Chi was a dragon,
not one of the Guild staff, including Lilie,
or the adventurers realized it.
After all, people often find unknown animals
in the outskirts of Palpebra.
And Pur Chi looks nothing like a typical dragon.
strings.为它取名的自然是普·莉莉艾。\n它性格温和，非常亲人，是个慢性子。\n但又很聪明:
Naturally, Pur Lilie named it.
It's gentle, very friendly, and easygoing.
But it's also clever, understands Lilie's commands,
and does a great job carrying cargo and such.
Though sometimes it gets distracted by snacks and forgets its job.
Its position at the Guild is section chief,
which outranks Rinne Hikawa.
strings.“靠关系进来的荷羊人。”\n“主动找事的怪人。”\n“被高层盯上的麻烦的家伙。”:
"A Sheephird who got in through connections."
"A weirdo who goes looking for trouble."
"A troublemaker the higher-ups have their eye on."

The Labyrinth Explorer Life Safety Improvement Publicity Dept.
Before Lilie set up this odd department
and showed what she could do,
she cried herself to sleep more nights than she can count.
But Lilie could face that hardship cheerfully
precisely because Pur Chi was always by her side.

Pur Chi isn't essential to the work.
But to Lilie,
this mysterious little dragon is an irreplaceable friend and partner.
strings.面向新注册冒险者的培训制度。\n为了提升冒险者从迷宫生还的概率，\n公会为他们准:
A training system for newly registered adventurers.
To raise adventurers' chances of surviving the labyrinth,
the Guild offers basic combat training,
workshops on labyrinth survival,
career guidance outside adventuring, and more.
Those who complete all the training
also receive a subsidy from the Guild.
strings.培训指导员包括了从艾莉亚、\n蕾维、优娜、伊凡等现役冒险者\n到杰克这样的监察员:
The instructors include a wealth of talent, from active adventurers
like Ellya, Leve, Yuna and Ivan
to inspectors like Jack.

Also, the "Adventure Guide" handed out
to every adventurer who takes the training is very popular with trainees.
strings.“接受培训的都是些新手。”\n\n部分人则认为参与培训乃不体面之举，\n并如此出:
"Only newbies take the training."

Some people considered taking the training undignified,
and belittled the system like this.
But ever since Ellya's party, which has explored the deep layers,
started requiring new members to complete the training first,
that attitude naturally disappeared.
strings.帕尔佩布拉的收藏者们。\n多收藏各式以咒具为代表的\n来自异世界的珍品、名品。\:
Palpebra's collectors.
They collect all sorts of rarities and masterpieces from other worlds,
cursed tools above all,
and actively trade them.
They hold Guild-issued certificates
and can legally sell cursed tools.
strings.放弃被歼灭者彻底摧毁的沃伦塔斯天塔。\n建造能攻入敌阵的六龙战舰。\n将摇曳的迷:
Abandon the Voluntas Sky Tower, utterly destroyed by the Purgers.
Build a six-dragon warship that can storm the enemy.
Remodel the Kaleidoscope into a "dock."
Rebuild Palpebra, the worst hit of all.

"All of the above must be done at once, within three months."

To carry out this extraordinary operation,
the Guild issued a series of requests.
They later became legendary as the "Major Requests."
strings.起初，如此不合理的作战\n自然遭到了议会的强烈反对。\n\n然而，多·库库斯带着:
At first, such an unreasonable operation
naturally met fierce opposition from the council.

However, Do Kukus showed up with a massive amount of materials,
talent and technology that seemed to appear out of nowhere,
and left every opponent speechless.

Normally, the council would strictly seal away
tools and technology rivaling super cursed tools.
But to the ambitious, hoping for revival—
and looking forward to the "next step"—
those were exactly what they craved.
So they could hardly refuse the plan.

And so, Palpebra went through
three fiery months.

*Also, to raise funds,
the Guild took on enormous debt.
Records show the finance department resisted in vain to the very end.
strings.不过，比起库库斯派的暗中出力。\n人们引以为豪并牢记在心的还是\n冒险者公会帕尔:
Still, more than the Kukus faction's work behind the scenes,
what people proudly remember
are the "Major Requests" led by
the Adventurers' Guild Palpebra Central Headquarters.

Some requests were highly specialized,
others were like errands for kids,
creating jobs for adventurers and many others.
Guided by the hope of "rebuilding and rebirth,"
many people found joy in being useful.

Also, since the Guild introduced a points system,
at the time you could often see
veteran adventurers and street kids
competing for points and laughing as they traded information.
strings.指帕尔佩布拉被歼灭者烧毁后，\n通过“重大委托”重建复兴，\n直至获得新生的动荡:
The turbulent three months after Palpebra was burned by the Purgers,
during which it was rebuilt and revived through the "Major Requests"
until it was reborn.

Since the town had been destroyed anyway,
why not rebuild it better than before?
Many residents and adventurers eagerly took part and made suggestions.
After all sorts of attempts,
many of them later succeeded.

In those three months, people went through countless failures,
and in the end achieved great success.
Below are some of the records.
strings.委托其一：建设\n\n多·库库斯：\n公会下达了许可。\n此次可在迷宫附近部署机:
Request 1: Construction

Do Kukus:
The Guild gave permission.
This time we can deploy android-type equipment near the labyrinth,
but otherworldly equipment is expensive to maintain...

Laf:
If you leave it to our company,
we'll gladly provide a deluxe warranty.
What do you say?

Regis:
Oh my, you're in charge of building the launch site, aren't you?
Don't worry,
I happen to have a batch of idle Updaters on hand—

Result:
Equipment around the labyrinth will be android-type.
strings.委托其二：送货\n\n阿克塞姆：\n话说，现在有超多搬运工作要做吧。\n是不是能:
Request 2: Deliveries

Axem:
By the way, there's a ton of hauling work right now, right?
Couldn't we sell a lot of skateboards while we're at it?

Oreo:
Good point! I have Berulun,
so it never crossed my mind!
I'll go tell Miss Lilie!

Result:
After extreme skateboards were introduced,
delivery efficiency shot up.
But because of frequent accidents,
the Guild later introduced a license for extreme skateboards.
Bicycles from Shibuya, being easy to ride,
later became the most popular way to get around.
At the time, transport businesses sprang up everywhere:
yokai ran wheel-cart transport, and birdfolk took on air freight.
They say transport was the industry that profited most from the Major Requests.
strings.委托其三：手机\n\n伊野里翔太：\n感觉委托简直堆积如山啊。\n要是能通过手机:
Request 3: Phones

Shota Inori:
Feels like the requests are piling up like a mountain.
Taking requests through a phone would be so much easier~
Not that there's any network here.

Regis:
Oh really? Sounds interesting.

Result:
Later, a group of unfamiliar androids appeared in Palpebra,
surrounded by mountains of equipment,
and some say they heard them constantly complaining, "We were tricked,"
"How are we supposed to finish this," "I want to go home," and so on.
The phones they produced were released after the Major Requests ended.
strings.委托其四：重建酿酒厂\n\n泰奇安娜：\n酒可是很重要的啊~\n有些人只能用酒精:
Request 4: Rebuild the Brewery

Techiana:
Booze is important, you know~
Some people can only heal real-life pain with alcohol.
So big sis here thinks
