we should restore the wine cellars as a priority.

Raul:
Hahahaha. That does make sense.
But you just want a drink yourself, right?

Result:
Despite pleas from many people, adventurers first among them,
the Guild decided it couldn't prioritize rebuilding breweries at this stage.
But such passionate support
gave Palpebra's breweries the drive to rebuild as well.
strings.为保障并改善迷宫探索者的生活安全，\n负责为其提供各项信息的公会内部部门。\n部:
A department within the Guild that provides
all sorts of information to protect and improve labyrinth explorers' lives and safety.
Its director is Guild receptionist Pur Lilie.
It has two staff members.

Because Lilie joined the Guild through connections,
a new department had to be created
to give her a nominal "position."
That may be the truth,
but in the end Lilie decided the department's name and work herself,
played along, and threw herself into her job.
strings.晋升为帕尔佩布拉中央本部长后，\n莉莉艾仍打算大力开展宣传部工作。\n\n格雷布:
Even after being promoted to Head of Palpebra Central HQ,
Lilie still plans to push forward with the publicity department's work.

The insurance plans handled by the Grebe Company,
explanations and guidance for the adventurer training system,
second-career support for retired adventurers,
and other policies that have earned many adventurers' trust
are all the fruits of the publicity department's efforts.
strings.以某位伟大冒险者为原型打造的铜像。\n充满了力量与勇气，能够激励人们。\n几经波:
A bronze statue modeled on a certain great adventurer.
Full of power and courage, it inspires people.
After many twists and turns, it is now displayed in the Guild archives.
The head of the Grebe Company personally wrote its description.
Full of the sorrow and romance of adventurers,
it has become a famously long piece of writing.
strings.米雷亚第一公主的常年奋斗\n终于换来了米雷亚王国\n与帕尔佩布拉逐渐加深的友谊。:
The years-long efforts of Mirea's first princess
have finally led to a deepening friendship
between the Kingdom of Mirea and Palpebra.

When the Major Requests began,
adventurers from Mirea all took part,
and contacted the people back home in Mirea
to provide the Guild with plenty of lumber from their vast lands.
People from the homeland also flocked to help rebuild,
making Mirea more and more famous in Palpebra.
strings.不过，在经历了重大委托之后，\n出现了不少被帕尔佩布拉的魅力俘获，\n表示“帕尔:
However, after the Major Requests,
quite a few were captivated by Palpebra's charms,
saying "Palpebra's great"
and "Mirea really is the countryside," and left their homeland.

As a result, Mirea's population is shrinking faster,
and the first princess has once again declared she'll "defeat Palpebra."
Still, Mireans often hold barbecue parties in Palpebra
under the pretext of class reunions.
strings.研究魔眼的大家族。\n支配着提亚特近郊的城寨都市。\n其血脉能让魔眼之力显现。\:
A great family that studies demon eyes.
It rules a fortress city near Tiatha.
Its bloodline can manifest the power of demon eyes.
Relying on that power,
during the Farlands' hegemonic era it was tasked with
defending Tiatha against Farland invasion.
strings.原本只是受各处排斥的异能者组成的集团。\n其成员都拥有与现存魔法体系不同的力量。:
Originally just a group of outcast ability users.
Its members all had powers different from existing magic systems.
After becoming Tiatha's defensive force
and gaining a certain foundation,
they continued researching demon eyes,
eventually establishing them as a special magic dependent on bloodline.
However, because demon eyes are inherited through the blood,
blood purists gradually emerged within the family,
finally leading to the tragedy of Ortanus freezing the entire clan.
strings.雷拉斯为族人解咒之后，应他的要求，\n部分研究者来到了沃伦塔斯魔法学院，\n成立:
After Reylas lifted his people's curse, at his request,
some researchers came to the Voluntas Arcane Arts Academy
and set up a research lab.
Perhaps because Palpebra is full of
psychics and mages far stronger than them,
or perhaps because of Ortanus's influence,
the blood purists in the family are now steadily dwindling.
strings.复兴祭结束后不久，\n冒险者公会为挑战深层等危险领域的\n冒险者发放的携带型终端:
Portable terminals the Adventurers' Guild handed out shortly after the Revival Festival
to adventurers taking on dangerous areas like the deep layers.

They have a guide function
that shows the way home to those swept up in the wavering.
They also have an emergency distress signal,
so even if you've fully entered another realm,
as long as you're within the seven great realms,
the Soaring Prince Squad will come to the rescue.
They have many other functions quite unlike Shibuya's phones.
strings.公会对外宣称其为魔法学院的试制品。\n实际是以机人的技术修复的涩谷遗物。\n甚至:
The Guild publicly calls them magic academy prototypes.
In reality, they're Shibuya relics restored with android technology,
and even further upgraded using technology
obtained from the Palace of Stars.
In a sense, they're OOParts.

The communication facilities were hastily built
while developing the Draco Voluntas's "port."
All the technicians were lone Updaters
lured in by Rek Regista.
And they seem to have been worked rather hard by Regis.
strings.“开发新的通讯服务？还要运营？？\n你是不想放我们活着回去了吗！\n雷克·雷吉斯:
"Develop a new communication service? And run it too??
You don't want us to make it home alive, do you!
Rek Regista!!"

Amid screams like these,
development of the communication service ended up stopping at
a very simple business chat line,
used only by academy teachers and Guild staff.
Due to the limits of the communication facilities,
the current service only works around Palpebra.
But these problems will eventually be solved.
Phone users and their demands are sure to grow without limit.
Their suffering is far from over.
strings.诚司：业务用聊天路线的开发已经暂告段落。\n不过该项目还处于试验阶段，\n还请各:
Seiji: Development of the business chat line is done for now.
But the project is still in a trial phase,
so please help us test it.

Reylas: Hmm, so now I can send messages to everyone?
Can you see what I'm saying?

†Absolute Zero†: Yes, I can see it.
So we just use it for work contact?

†Absolute Zero†: Ah.

Cipher: Wrong one.

Cipher: I was logged into the wrong account.

Nicola: Ms. Cipher.

Nicola: The headmaster wants to see you.

Cipher: IT WAS AN ACCIDENT!!!
strings.宗士郎：分享自涩谷——\n奈芙提姆小姐由于学分不够，\n接下来一段时间需要进行补:
Soushiro: Shared from Shibuya—
Miss Nephtim doesn't have enough credits,
and needs make-up classes for a while.
If she shows up at your place,
please send her back.

Leleni: She needs make-up classes?!

Leleni: We're done for.
She just went to get crepes
with Picolita, Jessica and Couette.

Reylas: Ms. Leleni,
Picolita has make-up classes today too.

Leleni: Huh.
strings.尼尔娅娜：我与PBC沟通之后，\n决定把黛妲利亚和夏·丝丝叫来\n参加下一次异世:
Nihilyana: After talking with PBC,
I've decided to invite Dedalia and Sha Sisi
to the next inter-world exchange program.
Everyone, please be careful.

Nicola: When's the next one?

Nihilyana: Tomorrow.

(followed by a string of screaming emojis)
strings.妮可拉：那个………………\n请问……有人能帮我准备明天的课吗……\n\n蕾蕾妮：:
Nicola: Um.........
Could... someone help me prepare tomorrow's class...

Leleni: What class?
I'm guessing a lab class.

Nicola: Uh, while practicing the experiment,
I used up all the Fire Elements meant as catalysts.

Nicola: 10 kg... all used up...

Leleni: @here Emergency call.
Nicola messed up!
All free teachers, go find merchants now!

Nicola: I'm sooo sorryyy~~~~!!!
strings.经历歼灭者的袭击之后，\n沃伦塔斯魔法学院在重建过程中\n开设的临时学校。\n\:
A temporary school opened by the Voluntas Arcane Arts Academy
while it was being rebuilt after the Purgers' attack.

It wasn't limited to academy students;
any minor could come and study.
The school also provided meals and lodging for those attending.
strings.本计划的目的也在于培养\n能派遣至异世界的人才。\n\n魔法学院重建完成之后，\:
The plan also aimed to train
people who could be sent to other worlds.

After the magic academy was rebuilt,
the temporary school closed.
But it became the foothold for later world study abroad
and the inter-world exchange program.
strings.某段时期公会内部人员\n秘密策划的集会的计划书。\n以下摘录其中部分。\n\n目:
The plan for a gathering secretly organized
by Guild staff at one point.
Below is an excerpt.

Purpose: Celebrate Director Pur Lilie's promotion
Place: Guild meeting room after hours
Gift presenter: Sharon Elt
Cake maker: Rinne Hikawa

Notes:
Director Lilie must never find out!
Everyone, please be very careful not to leak anything.
strings.绯河凛音：不对，等下啊。\n蛋糕制作人员是什么？？\n为什么要我做这种事？\n不:
Rinne Hikawa: No, wait a sec.
What's this cake maker thing??
Why do I have to do this?
Isn't this to celebrate Lilie? Get a professional!

Sharon: Eh~ that's exactly why, since it's for her.
If she gets to eat a cake you made,
Lilie will be absolutely thrilled~~~~?

Rinne Hikawa: Like I care!
I'm absolutely not doing it!

Kira: Is that... really okay?
If she doesn't want to, we shouldn't force her...

Yuki Mishima: It's fine.
Whenever she says "like I care,"
she's just hiding that she's embarrassed.

Rinne Hikawa: Hey, Mishima!
I can see that!!
strings.感质之城的都市传说。\n自古以来便有许多围绕它的传闻。\n据说其会调整市场，\n:
An urban legend of Qualia City.
There have long been many rumors about it.
They say it adjusts the market
so the Noxel Group can reign over Qualia City forever.
In fact, after the DAN and PBC incidents,
both companies' stock prices swung wildly,
yet the combined earnings of the Noxel Group and AltMeme
nearly cancelled out to zero.
strings.约翰逊王注意到了这一现象，\n并长期追踪希望能解开它的谜团。\n网络上无处不有它:
King Johnson noticed this phenomenon,
and tracked it for a long time, hoping to solve the mystery.
Its presence is everywhere on the net,
constantly guiding and balancing the Noxel Group and its rivals.

But then the god suddenly appeared in physical form.
Laf's former confidant, Radius, said—

"This is the Ruler's request.
The agenda is upgrading our relationship."

Using Replia as its terminal,
the god sent a request to establish relations with Starview.
In the end, it achieved its goal.
The God of the Net was welcomed by Starview.
strings.神诞生于企业出现很久之前。\n乃至高者与史黛拉掌权时\n导入这个世界的AI“统治:
The god was born long before the corporations appeared.
It's the AI "Ruler" introduced into this world
while the Supreme One and Stella held power.

The lives of Qualia City's people are completely covered by the net.
The Supreme One introduced it merely as an experiment,
but even after Stella lost her functions,
it kept running stably, sustaining Qualia City's prosperity.

But the worlds are now connected.
To reach areas the net can't,
the AI is seeking an upgrade.
strings.目前来说，\nAI无法观测到感质之城的外部，\n也无法计算外部进入的因素。\n这:
For now,
the AI can't observe the outside of Qualia City,
nor calculate factors coming in from outside.
That means
the AI can no longer define the overall optimal solution,
nor maintain balance,
and its systems in Qualia City have stalled.

So the AI sent out the terminal Replia
in hopes of observing the outside world.
For Starview,
this was just inter-world exchange as usual,
and they had no reason to refuse.
strings.AI之所以选择雷普利亚，\n是因为二者的存在形态类似。\n双方都为人类创造，都是:
The AI chose Replia
because their forms of existence are similar.
Both were created by humans, both are humans' tools,
without "will," holding only "purpose."
So they have a lot in common.

Laf likened this Replia and the AI
to bees and ants.
The one she'd once wished could be free
has now returned as the ultimate tool,
which leaves Laf with complicated feelings.
Still, she's actively interacting with it,
trying to accept this form of existence.

"Let's keep learning together.
Welcome back, Radius."
"Yes. I look forward to working with you.
Great Mother Laf."
strings.另外，在得知这一系列事之后，\n丝缇涅尔闹起了别扭：\n“它根本把我想做的事都做:
Also, after learning about all this,
Stinelle sulked:
"It totally did everything I wanted to do!!!"
strings.摩卡可可义足手术逃逸事件: The Moka & Kokoa Prosthetic Leg Surgery Escape Incident
strings.事件概要：\n可可与摩卡（涩谷在住）\n经过多次尝试终于说服父母，\n来到感质之:
Summary:
Kokoa and Moka (Shibuya residents)
finally convinced their parents after many attempts,
and came to Qualia City for leg mechanization surgery.

However, when they arrived at the hospital for surgery,
the two ran away.
Afterward, the two tearfully declared firmly to Tink
"We'll never say we want mechanical limbs again."
strings.摩卡与可可的证词\n\n・夏琳说她知道一家\n “去了就能直接做手术的医院:
Testimony of Moka and Kokoa

・Charlene said she knew a
    "hospital where you can get surgery right away,"
    so we asked her to take us.

・Turns out it was a back-alley clinic.
    Super scary. And the explanation was scary too.

・They said if people from other worlds get Qualia City prosthetics,
    there are "glitches."
    Like your legs moving on their own, or hearing voices.
    Or your leg and hand sensations merging.
    Or feeling like your very existence is a glitch.

・We'll take good care of our own legs for now.
strings.那些可怕说明的大半其实都是事实。\n\n尤其在来自以魔法为前提的世界的人\n——:
Most of those scary explanations are actually true.

Especially for people from worlds that assume magic
—that is, people with a different "worldview"—
prosthetics often can't perform properly,
and sometimes even cause severe rejection.

But there are exceptions to everything.
For those who have already rebuilt their worldview,
prosthetics can broaden their world even further.
In other words, these girls who survived a broken world
and now goof around in a magic world might be fine—
but for now, they've decided to treasure their own legs.
strings.威尔弗雷德开发的身体强化装甲。\n为了守护所爱的人，\n为了求婚（原因不明）而做:
Body-enhancing armor developed by Wilfred.
His graduation project, made to protect the one he loves
and to propose (reason unknown).

It has an emotion amplifier,
but the creator himself had no idea.
This led to a runaway incident during testing.

The cause: the former Golem Club president secretly
fitted it with the core of a magicrystal sheep maker.
The former president stated:
"I didn't say so, but it's in the manual."
strings.事实上，PBC也参与了该装甲的制作。\n已获得内定，毕业后就将进入PBC的\n前:
In fact, PBC was also involved in making this armor.
The former president, who already had a job lined up at PBC after graduation,
told PBC's president about it.
Amused, the president offered a lot of help
(the real aim being to test PBC's research technology).
The result was this insane armor with performance beyond its limits
and the ability to go haywire.

If it were ever mass-produced,
it would surely upset the balance of power.
So it's actually a very dangerous treasure.
strings.不过，其需要大量稀缺资源才能驱动。\n即便大企业也非常难以将它投入实用。\n威尔:
However, it needs a large amount of rare resources to run.
Even big corporations would have trouble putting it to practical use.
Will often casually activates it on dates and such,
but behind the scenes that burns through an enormous amount of money.

In the end, PBC cut off its support for the armor
after getting the test data.
Faced with this sudden bad news,
Wilfred... cried for days...

But he never intended to give up.
He's now working desperately on an energy-saving version.
All to protect the one he loves.
strings.会议名：\n结婚攻略作战会议（第3次）\n\n今日的议题：\n商讨W氏与M氏的婚:
Meeting name:
Wedding Strategy Meeting (3rd)

Today's agenda:
Discuss Mr. W and Ms. M's wedding

Members:
Mr. W, Mr. A, Mr. S, Ms. N

Minutes:
Recorded by an experimental autonomous-AI sheep
strings.副议题1：友人代表致辞\n\nS：致辞到底该说什么好啊？\nW：你、你们说什么我:
Sub-agenda 1: Friends' representative speech

S: What are you even supposed to say in a speech?
W: A-Anything you say would make me happy...
S: Can we mention how you made power armor just to get married,
    and then it went haywire?
N: And how you had so much fun at the Revival Festival
    that you kissed in the street in front of everyone.
W: Uh, ah...
S: And that thing. In summer on Paradise Isle,
    everyone was swimming, but those two for some reason
    hid behind the rocks—
W: (*Scream so loud the audio distorted)

Conclusion:
Mr. A, Mr. S and Ms. N will give the friends' speech.
Also, Mr. C, who has resignation experience, will be invited as a lecturer.
The content will be decided before the wedding.
strings.副议题2：挑选纪念赠品\n\nS：纪念品还得是那个吧。\n 写了新人名字的:
Sub-agenda 2: Choosing wedding favors

S: For favors it's gotta be that, right?
    Couple's bowls with the newlyweds' names on them?
W: !! B-But they'd have our names on them,
    would anyone actually use them...
A: Hmm. Ah~... Hmm... Uh...
    Anyway, as long as you two are fine with it?
W: R-Really?
    Is tableware with our names and photos printed on it okay?!
S: Print... your photos... on tableware?

Conclusion:
The proposal to print photos on tableware
was overruled by Mr. A with "Sorry. Let's not."
Mr. W was crushed, but finally decided
on plates with the couple's names as the favor,
along with baked goods from Cardol's Sweets.
strings.副议题3：为新娘写信\n\nS：实际来说，威尔前辈，\n 你觉得她会喜欢你:
Sub-agenda 3: A letter to the bride

S: Honestly, Will,
    do you think she'll like a letter from you?
W: I-I don't know...
    But I want to put all my feelings into it...
S: Feelings, huh~... I see~~
N: Sho, summer's over,
    go easy on Will.
S: But you know,
    sometimes I kinda get how he feels now.
W: D-Do you need my advice? I'll listen!
S: Why're you so happy about it...
    Actually, last time, Yukariko and I~
    (*Omitted)
    Anyway! What about you!
    You're usually really into this kind of topic, right?
    Hey... don't go quiet.
    Huh?! You don't want to be recorded?!
A: Tch...
S: It's all been recorded?!

Conclusion:
Because the conversation went off track,
the letter's content will be discussed at the next meeting.
strings.感质之城中廉价的嗜好品之一。\n本体乃普通的水蒸气发生器，\n但同广告食品一样，:
One of Qualia City's cheap indulgences.
It's just an ordinary vapor generator,
but like promotional food,
it uses electrical signals to let you taste whatever flavor you bought.
It's completely harmless to the body,
and most legal services even allow minors to use it.
But because "smoking" has long had a bad image
in the minds of Qualia City's people,
the product has sparked a lot of debate.
strings.事例1：Y氏与广告烟\n\nY：其实我对这个还挺感兴趣的。\n\nS：我就知道！:
Case 1: Ms. Y and Ad Vapes

Y: Honestly, I'm kind of interested in these.

S: I knew it!!!
    Actually, I thought you'd try real cigarettes.

Y: No way. They're really bad for you.
    Wh-What's so funny?! Ayumu!

S: So have you tried this one?

Y: Well, no.
    It'd be bad if Nephtim copied me~

A: True. Absolutely right.
strings.事例2：射手H氏与广告烟\n\nH：结果对身体没害的那些\n 还是卖不出去:
Case 2: Gunner Mr. H and Ad Vapes

H: Turns out the ones that are harmless
    still don't sell.

A: What do you mean?

H: "Doing something bad" is what has value~
    So only the ones that stimulate the brain sell.

A: Hope.........
    You've been hanging out with Regis a lot lately, haven't you.

Recently, a curry shop busted a major criminal operation.
With the Guild Knights' help, the culprit was arrested without a hitch.
strings.事例3：机人R氏与广告烟\n\nR：当然是因为吃饭功能啊。\n 呵呵呵，你:
Case 3: Android Mr. R and Ad Vapes

R: Because of the eating function, of course.
    Heh heh heh, you must remember too, right?
    After tasting his cooking,
    my stars practically exploded...
    Oh, compared to your cooking,
    that's just a crude flavor, you know?

    And then I realized,
    could I do the same thing?
    Of course, the really dangerous part comes after!
    Depending on how it goes, this might open a window
    bringing magic into a mechanical civilization—

    No good after all?
    Hahahahaha!
    I thought it was pretty fun, though...

All ad vapes developed by Mr. R were recalled.
However, Ms. Nihilyana is very interested in them,
so things may head in an even more troublesome direction.
strings.出于某些迫不得已的缘由，\n夏琳失去了容身之处，搬到了星见镇。\n但来到这里之后:
For unavoidable reasons,
Charlene lost her place to stay and moved to Starview.
But after coming here, she made new friends,
got an amazing gun, made a splash in the ocean world,
and finally joined the otherworld expedition team.
Below are things she saw and heard on her journey.
strings.记录1：D-573阿尔忒弥斯加农\n\n破坏建筑物本来并非狙击手的职责，\n但夏:
Record 1: D-573 Artemis Cannon

Destroying buildings isn't really a sniper's job,
but Charlene always wanted to try.
A certain up-and-coming gunsmith and a certain up-and-coming engineer
felt the same, and built her this
44mm-caliber oddity that can barely be called a gun.
During a test fire, Charlene sank a pirate ship in one shot,
leaving the pirates in tears.
strings.记录2：于海上\n\n夏琳对恋爱并不太感兴趣，\n但她很喜欢听别人讲故事，\n并:
Record 2: At Sea

Charlene isn't very interested in romance,
but she loves hearing other people's stories,
and once listened intently as a certain Nimbus's bride went on and on.
So the subtle relationship between the charming mermaid leading the Mermaid Pirates
and a certain captain who always wears a villain's face
couldn't help but catch her interest.

"Captain, do you like Amelia?"

The captain roared in fury:
"I'm devoted to Marina alone!!"
Then the laughing mermaid kicked him into the sea.
strings.记录3：异界\n\n探索队中的强者们深深吸引了夏琳。\n尤其是后来才与队伍汇合的:
Record 3: Another Realm

The strong fighters on the expedition fascinated Charlene.
Especially a dual-wielding girl who joined the team later,
who left a very scary impression on her.
She hid her presence, quietly took a sniping position,
and the moment she imagined aiming her rifle at the girl—

the girl smiled and looked straight up at her.

That's how the two girls who later competed in the expedition
over who killed more otherworldly gods first met.
strings.记录0：过去的幻影\n\n曾经，有人离她而去；\n有人说不能把工作交给怪物；\n:
Record 0: Phantoms of the Past

Once, someone left her;
someone said you can't trust a monster with the job;
someone mocked her for losing her mind
after her comrades and family all died in battle.
She wanted to deny it,
but some of it was hard to deny.
Such as—"the Reaper can't get along with people."

"Heh... That's not true at all."
strings.在水善的安排下，\n隐秘众潜伏进了帕尔佩布拉的暗处。\n\n他们的主君将他们视为:
Under Suizen's arrangement,
the Hidden Ones slipped into Palpebra's shadows.

Their lord saw them as unclean and cast them aside.
After plotting rebellion and many twists and turns,
they were still willing to be others' tools.

And the turning point that changed them
was those "three fiery months."
strings.“那么，现在召开二次说明会！\n能请你们帮忙派发传单吗？”\n\n灾难导致的疲敝:
"Now, it's time for the second briefing!
Could you help hand out flyers?"

Exhaustion from the disaster and uncertainty about the future
filled Palpebra with suspicion and doubt.
The Hidden Ones thought their job would be to manipulate and control information.
But they received the exact opposite orders.

Some were deeply confused,
and some stepped out of the shadows into the light because of it.
Those three fiery months broke their world.

*Notably,
the princess of the former Stratos Kingdom later recalled
that this experience was a great reference for her.
strings.再后来，在复兴祭结束后，\n隐秘众中也出现了一些特例。\n\n其一是选择脱离忍者:
Later, after the Revival Festival,
some exceptions appeared among the Hidden Ones.

First, those who chose to leave the ninja life
and become residents of Palpebra.

Second, those drawn by the adventurers' brilliance
who became operators on the six-dragon warship.

Third, one who set out on a journey to other worlds,
met a certain spy, astonished her,
earned her respect, and became her chat buddy.
strings.不过，特例毕竟是特例。\n大部分密探仍潜伏在阴影之中。\n\n他们听命于统领阴阳:
But exceptions are just exceptions.
Most of the agents still lurk in the shadows.

They answer to the boy who leads the Diviners' Commission.
Lately, they're said to have been sent into
the Swallow Knights and the Fang Mercenaries too.

Few have ever seen their true faces.
But they say you can occasionally spot a certain agent
eating ohagi with the girl-grandma.
strings.偶尔会在星见镇开办的人生咨询处。\n玉子会在那里倾听来访者的烦恼，\n与其一同度:
A life advice corner occasionally held in Starview.
Tamako listens to visitors' worries there
and spends a leisurely time with them.

But most people come for
Granny Tama's special ohagi and hot tea.
strings.咨询者1：画师R小姐\n\n师父根本不肯更新恋梓，\n还说“你来画也行”。\n于:
Visitor 1: Painter Miss R

Master just won't update KoiAzu,
and even says "you can draw it."
So Kugui and I gave it our all and tried drawing it,
but it's completely different from Master's KoiAzu.
It only makes me want to see Master's sequel more.

How can I get Master to update?

Granny Tama:
Just hold enough passion.
But Granny thinks
if you show that master of yours your work,
he might want to draw it himself.
By the way, Granny loves Princess Inaba most of all.
strings.咨询者2：漫游诸国改造社会的S小姐\n\n人生太开心了，叫人好害怕。\n虽然遇到:
Visitor 2: Miss S, Who Roams the Lands Reforming Society

Life is so fun it's scary.
There's been lots of trouble,
but traveling with everyone... really... really...
is so exciting... it feels so warm...
I even got so moved I accidentally cried...

Can I really live such a happy life?
Can I have another drink?
And, can I have some more food?

Granny Tama:
Mm. Of course.
Help yourself.
strings.咨询者3：灵镜M小姐\n\n八云说，哪怕自己的生命终将凋零，\n也想要永远和我在:
Visitor 3: Miss M the Spirit Mirror

Yakumo says that even if his life must wither someday,
he wants to be with me forever.

If that's his heart's true wish,
I want to grant it for him...
What do you think, Tamako?

Granny Tama:
Heh heh heh, what adorable children.
You don't need Granny's opinion, decide it between yourselves.
As for whether it becomes a curse,
that too is for the two of you to decide.
strings.画狂百鬼夜行绘卷: The Art-Mad Painter's Night Parade Scroll
strings.画狂老人Z随身携带的绘卷。\n收录了大量漫游异界时绘下的画作。\n其中也绘有各种:
A scroll Gramp Zigza carries with him.
It holds many pictures painted while roaming other worlds.
It also includes all sorts of creatures he can bring to life for self-defense.
They range from ordinary monsters like Polu to unusual beings like Serpents.
strings.其之壹・无牙之龙恩利尔\n\n描绘了失去了双牙的法兰德邪龙。\n本应令人恐惧的巨:
Part I: Enlil the Fangless Dragon

Depicts the evil dragon of the Farlands who lost both its fangs.
The great dragon, which should be fearsome, looks
somewhat listless and friendly in this picture.
The painting is much loved,
and made the art-mad painter famous among the nobility.

"Who are you?! Where did you come from!"

After crossing worlds, what appeared before him was a dragon.
Even the art-mad painter was scared at that moment.
But for some reason the dragon looked terrified too,
which piqued the painter's interest.
And so, the evil dragon's tale of anger and sorrow
and the painter's laughter went on all night.
What was born from that is this painting.
strings.其之贰・虚假达令\n\n画狂老人曾在星见镇停留了一段时间。\n当时他接下某位女性:
Part II: False Darling

The art-mad painter once stayed in Starview for a while.
At the time he took a commission from a certain woman and painted a picture.
What's in the scroll now are sketches from different angles.
The lifelike tiger man in the picture is very strong when brought to life,
and the painter often uses it for self-defense.

As for what the delivered painting was used for,
the painter himself has no idea.
strings.其之叁・风神雷神图\n\n风神雷神自古以来便是颇具人气的题材，\n画狂老人也曾以:
Part III: Wind God and Thunder God

The Wind God and Thunder God have long been a popular subject,
and the art-mad painter has painted them before.
But with M.O.F as the occasion,
he painted an extremely unique new Wind God and Thunder God.
The Thunder God painting shows a cheerful woman,
so vivid you can almost hear the drums.
The Wind God painting shows a stylish man
wearing sunglasses, with clothes tied around his chest.
The two paintings are finely detailed and realistic,
so much that you can almost feel they "really exist."
strings.米雷亚王国举办的收获祭——\n“Mireia・OctoberFes”的简称。\n:
Short for the harvest festival held by the Kingdom of Mirea—
"Mireia OctoberFes."

Originally just a small local festival,
but the princess rose up declaring "Mirea will have a celebration too!" Thanks to her efforts, it grew enormously.
With help from many quarters,
the harvest festival has become a delicious celebration.
Visitors can enjoy plenty of beer,
and taste local dishes made with fresh produce.
strings.星见镇在举办M.O.F时大力予以协助，\n镇上的许多人也都参加了这场庆典。\n数:
Starview gave M.O.F a lot of help,
and many people from town attended the festival.
Several women in dirndl outfits
brought a joyful atmosphere to the festival.
Everyone could enjoy the festival,
laughing, chatting, singing and dancing to their hearts' content.
Everyone's faces were full of smiles and joy.

But perhaps there was a bit too much joy—

That's right. Some heavy drinkers. Lots of beer.
Plus Mirea's people, who love outdoor events and parties more than anything.
This festival was bound to become an enormous chaotic party.
strings.混乱的开端，\n是喝上头的凉风为大家表演起了余兴。\n于是其他醉汉及米雷亚国民紧:
The chaos began
when a tipsy Suzukaze started performing for everyone.
Other drunks and Mireans followed right behind,
and Katsuchi passionately performed a thunder dance.
The art-mad painter even painted a kagura stage,
sending the frenzy ever higher, when, unexpectedly—
"Zeppu," calling himself the incarnation of the Wind God, descended from the sky.

In that moment,
M.O.F truly became a harvest festival that could summon gods.
strings.绝风与加津知一同表演了雷舞。\n最后众人发现，绝风并不是神明。\n这一系列的骚动:
Zeppu and Katsuchi performed the thunder dance together.
In the end, everyone realized Zeppu wasn't a god.
This whole commotion made M.O.F
a legend in many people's hearts.
Their excitement didn't fade even after the festival ended,
and they hope the next one will be held soon.

Also worth mentioning—
the painting the art-mad painter made of Katsuchi and Zeppu during the festival
later became a (self-declared) national treasure of Mirea.
strings.结束了如火如荼的三个月及重大委托之后，\n前往星之宫的伙伴们遭遇了一系列事件。\:
After the three fiery months and the Major Requests ended,
the friends heading for the Palace of Stars ran into a series of incidents.

Between a Devourer of Stars encountered during the warp
and Denah trying to shoot it down,
the six-dragon warship fell into the abyss
and reached a mysterious realm called the "Underworld."

A husband and wife met again in the realm of the dead.
But the red thread between them was severed by a flash of steel.

Just as the boys experienced,
this journey too had its farewells.
strings.牵牛宗士郎的亡妻伊织化作了恶鬼。\n\n潜伏在洞穴深处的诅咒化身、\n被水善称为:
Soushiro Kengyu's late wife, Iori, had become an oni.

An incarnation of curses lurking deep in the cave,
a being Suizen called the Magatsu Orochi,
bared its fangs at the group.

During the retreat, the samurai smiled and offered to stay behind as the rearguard.
Someone had to hold off the pursuers.
And he himself wished to face the oni.

The samurai walked toward his wife, now a monster,
and facing the cursed screams, he opened his arms
and embraced her trembling body as it asked him why.

"I can tell at a glance, you're lying."
strings.“为什么要哭，阴阳师小鬼？”\n\n了解一切的水善咬紧牙关准备做出决断时，\n稻:
"Why are you crying, diviner brat?"

As Suizen, who understood everything, gritted his teeth and prepared to make the call,
Inaho asked him straight out.

"Aren't we going to help them?
Think of something!
What should I do?!"

Just like in the past,
her smile always easily melted his resolve.
And so, the boy gripped the spirit blade that volunteered to fight,
and charged out with his sun.
strings.“快去吧，宗士郎。”\n\n伊织脸上挂着泪，一边笑了。\n拼上性命化作九尾的水善:
"Go, Soushiro."

Iori smiled through her tears.
Suizen, who had become a nine-tail at the risk of his life, arrived at that moment,
and placed the spirit blade Murakumo in Soushiro's hands.

"The children are waiting for their teacher to come home."

"Iori."

"Yes."

"I love you."

"Yes. I love you too."

With a flash of the spirit blade, the two worlds separated.

And so, the Battle of Yomotsu Hirasaka came to a close.
strings.据水善所说，\n那个领域如同滞留深渊的“沉淀”。\n残留思念会留存于现世。\n那:
According to Suizen,
that realm was like a "sediment" settled in the abyss.
Lingering thoughts remain in this world.
So it's no surprise that the abyss holds a place where information about the dead accumulates—
a place bound by curses.

Perhaps, at the end of that realm,
lies the true "far side of death."

But that realm has been severed.
The curse is undone, and it will never be born again.

A teacher dressed like a samurai arriving at a school in Shibuya
is a story for later.
strings.暴风雨的化身。\n与雷之化身加津知一同表演了雷舞。\n能以热情洋溢的三味线呼风唤:
The incarnation of storms.
He performed the thunder dance with Katsuchi, the incarnation of thunder.
He can summon wind and rain with his passionate shamisen,
shaking people's souls with raging storms.

Like Katsuchi,
he vanished while performing the thunder dance in the realm called Takamagahara,
and his whereabouts were unknown afterward.

At M.O.F (Mireia OctoberFes),
he descended onto the kagura stage Gramp Zigza painted.
With no time to rejoice at reuniting with Katsuchi,
he immediately joined the thunder dance, creating a legendary night.
strings.加津知出现在了星见镇。\n那么，绝风去了哪里呢？\n\n答案就是偶像决战之地。\:
Katsuchi appeared in Starview.
So where did Zeppu go?

The answer: the battleground of idols.
The front line of the Cosmic Idol War!

"Oh? You want to compete with me?
Sure, I accept your challenge!"

The shamisen Zeppu played
stirred up wave after wave in the idols' hearts.
Elegance and savagery. Passion and sorrow. Foe and friend.
By the time the battle ended, they had become friends.

The suspicious sunglasses and the clothes tied around his chest
seem to have been gifts from those friends.
strings.以某种方式摆脱了本该到来的“死亡”，\n拥有自我意志，偏离了正常生命， \n却能:
People who somehow escaped the "death" that should have come,
who have their own will and have strayed from normal life,
yet keep walking the world.
Also called "the living dead."

To the hero Light, the undead
were beings who hated humans, symbols of threat.
But a kindly old man laughing heartily with spirits
shattered that perception.
strings.已死之人重新复活并非少见之事。\n低级不死者——会动的尸体便是其例。\n\n附有:
The dead coming back to life isn't rare.
Lower undead—moving corpses—are one example.

The dead carrying lingering thoughts can move,
and even act as if they have emotions and will.
But just as strong light leaves its mark on photo paper,
they're only a kind of silhouette, and will eventually fade.
An ever-changing will, a new will,
needs a vessel that can create it (usually a brain).

So the undead, to maintain their selves,
tend to keep or reuse their appearance from life.
A certain undead who is hollow inside yet can still
laugh heartily is an exception.
strings.最初不死王只是在模仿真祖，\n使用从他人处夺取的生命，\n进行无限制的恢复。\n:
At first the Undead King only imitated a true ancestor,
using life stolen from others
for endless recovery.
Back then, he was better called a regenerator.

But he sought more.
The power and time to exterminate all the vermin.
An eternal, undying existence that would never fade.

He rewrote the flow of power deep underground—
the "Dracostream" through which life cycles—
and "copied" his own brain into it.
At the cost of countless sacrifices, the great secret art was completed.
But in truth, that was the beginning of all his suffering.
What awaited him next was more than a thousand years of loneliness and regret.
strings.新设立的墓地。\n位于帕尔佩布拉与涩谷附近的丘陵。\n\n为了让逝者能够安息，\:
A newly established cemetery.
Located on a hill near Palpebra and Shibuya.

So the departed can rest in peace,
and those left behind can mourn,
this was one of the first places built
in Palpebra after the Purgers' attack.
strings.有一位守墓人照看着公共墓地，\n负责修整墓碑，驱赶破坏墓地的人。\n在他的精心照:
A gravekeeper looks after the public cemetery,
tending the gravestones and driving off vandals.
Under his careful care,
the cemetery's peace has never been disturbed since it was built.

Whenever someone comes to visit a grave and offer flowers,
the gravekeeper always watches quietly from nearby.
Sometimes he also listens to visitors share their memories.
strings.守墓人曾向某位来扫墓的人提问。\n究竟怎样才算是哀悼。\n\n双手合十。献上花朵:
The gravekeeper once asked a visitor
what it really means to mourn.

Putting your hands together. Offering flowers.
Tending the gravestone. Thinking of the departed.
Remembering the time you spent with them.
Everyone's answer must be different.
But this is a beautiful place where everyone
can mourn in their own way.

That small smile set the gravekeeper thinking.
After that, whenever he met grave visitors,
he would say these words to them—

May the stars guide you.
strings.在帕尔佩布拉的万圣节上，\n真正的精灵引领了一场大游行。\n伴随着祝福与祈祷，\:
At Palpebra's Halloween,
a true spirit led a great parade.
Amid blessings and prayers,
the dead went to "the other side."

However, before the parade ended,
unprecedented incidents happened everywhere.
Below are some of them.
strings.吸血鬼少女与朋友们的遭遇1：\n\n不行了。好可怕。好想回家。要死了。\n露米拉:
What happened to the vampire girl and her friends 1:

No way. So scary. I want to go home. I'm gonna die.
Lumiraka and Yuki screamed.
Behind them, chasing relentlessly under the name of tag,
were dead children (a huge number of them).
Prika was caught right at the start,
joined the ranks of the dead, and happily chased the two along with them.

In tears, Lumiraka begged for help from
a passing desert general and a lion from the mercenary band.
But facing the horde of the dead, the two took to their heels.
Only the girls' wails echoed through the town.
strings.吸血鬼少女与朋友们的遭遇2：\n\n捉迷藏游戏一直持续到了黎明。\n露米拉卡询问:
What happened to the vampire girl and her friends 2:

The game of tag went on until dawn.
Lumiraka asked Prika—
Prika, why weren't you scared?!

"Huh? Because, think about it,
it's just like when I talk to my dolls, right?"

Later, the two girls said
Prika was the scariest thing of all that night.
strings.心动奇迹的遭遇：\n\n心动奇迹的万圣迷你演出大获成功后，\n她们静静守望着一脸:
What happened to Heart Miracle:

After Heart Miracle's Halloween mini-show was a huge success,
they quietly watched the satisfied dead depart.
Unexpectedly, Katie almost got sent off with them.

"Waaaaaah—?!?!
Katie, you can't goooo—!!"
"Ah, okay. I'll come back, then."

The sudden disbanding crisis vanished as quickly as it came.
Afterward, until Halloween was over,
Noeni and Capycapy never left Katie's side.
strings.沙漠猛将的遭遇：\n\n虽然被会动的死者吓得不轻，\n但据哈里达尔所说，\n他在:
What happened to the desert general:

Though badly scared by the moving dead,
Haridal says
he saw a certain dear friend while fleeing.

Experts say
there were no lingering thoughts on the general's earring.
But either way, he can believe it's there.
He can welcome it, or see it off, either is fine.

The general nodded and looked up at the night sky.
"Then I hope we meet again next year. My friend—"

But the next instant, when an undead tapped his shoulder,
the general bolted like a startled rabbit.
strings.摘自某位遗物回收人的日志——\n\n我是一个默默无闻的遗物回收人。\n尽管专断独:
From the log of a certain memento recoverer—

I'm an unremarkable memento recoverer.
Even though our high-handed guild master is a pain,
even though we're always seen as reapers,
I've kept working until now.

Today is Halloween.
These past few years, it's been our busiest time.
I don't like being busy.
It means countless partings between the dead and the living.
It's all that pumpkin head's fault.
strings.那个南瓜头出现的时候，\n我们所有人都在为送走死者而奔波。\n毕竟生者中混入了死:
When that pumpkin head appeared,
all of us were running around trying to send off the dead.
After all, the dead mixing with the living is terrifying.

And then, we heard singing.
In astonishment, we watched
the dead leave together with the pumpkin head.

Thinking back, maybe it was from then on
that our work became less hard than before.
Maybe because a colleague did great work in that incident,
the townspeople's attitude gradually softened.
But... that was only the beginning.
strings.后来，经历了想玩耍的精灵的大闹，\n又经历了传说中吸血鬼遗物的失控，\n再度过了:
Later, we went through a rampage of spirits wanting to play,
then the legendary vampire relic going haywire,
then that tragedy, and now we've reached today.

I think I'll never forget that sight as long as I live.
Those awakened to protect the town,
and those who fell in battle,
all the dead lining up and slowly leaving,
entering that huge vortex guided by a true spirit.
They were only lingering thoughts,
but somehow, they looked very happy.

Cheerful farewells echoed all over town.
It was sad, but lively, and very reassuring.
If the true spirit can help again next year,
I'd like to see them off like those people did.
strings.拉杰尔特王子的改造社会之旅: Prince Razelt's Journey to Reform Society
strings.参加了毕业典礼之后，\n拉杰尔特王子召集伙伴，\n再次踏上了漫游诸国的旅途。\n:
After attending the graduation ceremony,
Prince Razelt gathered his companions
and set out once more on a journey through the lands.
The first to join was Beith, who had decided to go independent.
He volunteered while tipsy,
declaring he'd become a man who'd win back Marina's heart.
The second was Tekto, who happened to be there.
He joined purely because he got swept up in the mood.
Add Gerard, who for some reason was recognized by the royal shield,
Suzukaze, who was looking for a stable job,
and Margaret, who tagged along without asking,
and their journey was lively indeed.
Sometimes the ninja and samurai would temporarily join too.
strings.众人积极地在各个世界帮助着人们。\n在大海世界，尽管被吓得发抖，\n他们还是击退:
They eagerly helped people in every world.
In the ocean world, though shaking with fear,
they repelled a ghost ship they met while escorting a merchant vessel.
In the Land of Yamato, they defeated a corrupt official squeezing the people,
only to be mistaken for outlaws deceiving the shogun and nearly arrested.
Sometimes, penniless,
they'd suddenly show up at Alk's curry shop.
Recently, the group was spotted
at Palpebra's Halloween and at M.O.F.
strings.一行人非常喜欢时常举办的M.O.F，\n因此暂时留在了米雷亚。\n但某天，拉杰尔:
The group loved the frequently held M.O.F,
so they stayed in Mirea for a while.
But one day, Razelt learned his homeland was in danger,
and a great war against the Devourers of Stars was about to begin.

We can't go on like this.
This is no time to enjoy festivals.
Let's go! Everyone!!

Most people at the festival had no interest in who he was.
But the warriors, knees shaking with nerves, still answered loudly.
The very next day, a great army set out from Mirea.
strings.报告人：秘书艾丽娅纳斯\n\n继果园及农场之后，\n前几日我等正式开始了牧场的试:
Reporter: Secretary Aliyanas

Following the orchards and farms,
a few days ago we officially began a trial run of the ranch,
to meet the ocean world's demand and export products to it.
Preparations to automate wool processing,
in common with the Miner's Front system, are also underway.
However... this caused a commotion.
I report it here.
strings.・关于肉类生产\n前几日，被称为始祖派的精灵占领了牧场。\n他们会效仿无需进食的:
・On meat production
A few days ago, elves known as the Purist faction occupied the ranch.
They emulate the high elves, who need no food,
and especially abhor eating meat.
So they oppose eating the ranch's sheep.
Persuaded by Mr. Roslund, who happened to be there,
they gave up the occupation and dispersed.
But I believe this needs follow-up.
At the upcoming harvest festival,
I will arrange for the three alliance leaders to taste
the spicy herb-wrapped meat made by Miss Stella.
Please be sure to attend.
strings.私以为……现在始祖派乃少数派，\n既然高等精灵艾丝缇莉艾尔大人好食肉类，\n他们:
In my humble opinion... the Purists are now a minority,
and since the high elf Lady Estariel enjoys meat,
they have no room to object.
However, their aversion is a seed of division,
and simply suppressing it may lead to fatal consequences.
Crops are our main export,
and they are highly skilled at cultivating them.
So I would like to invite the Purists
to plan the harvest festival menu and cook the dishes together.
I ask that you consider this.
strings.报告人：谍报员查特丽娜\n\n现为您报告近一个月来的\n旧矿山城的开拓情况。\n:
Reporter: Spy Chatrina

Here is my report on the past month's
settlement progress in Miner's Front.

(Items marked * are the reporter's personal opinions)
strings.・关于羊毛加工\n因精纺机制作完成，\n现已开始对羊毛进行加工。\n得到的产品非:
・On wool processing
With the spinning machine completed,
we've begun processing wool.
The resulting products are perfect.
They can sell for a high price in the ocean world too.
*Woolen goods are so soft and wonderful.

・On clothing production
We've tried making clothes from the woolen goods we produce.
The finished items are very durable, soft and warm,
and meet the ocean world's demand.
So clothing production could become one of our core industries.
*Miss Lilian and Miss Linkarina
spared no effort helping design the products,
and I'm very grateful to them.
I've sent the finished clothes along with this report.
Please be sure to try them on.
And please send me a photo! Please!
strings.※关于殿下曾提起的二号利比尔德乐园计划，\n建一座“游乐园”怎么样呢？\n我曾在:
*About the Paradise Isle No. 2 plan Your Highness mentioned,
how about building an "amusement park"?
I talked with Princess Toria at M.O.F,
and we might be able to build it jointly with the Kingdom of Mirea.
Building on a filled-in volcanic crater might be a bit hard,
but an amusement park looks like so much fun~!
With a merry-go-round, a drop tower, a roller coaster, and, and (omitted)

*We may not have time for tertiary industries yet,
but to make Your Highness's dream come true,
I'll report again when I have other ideas.
I'll go ask Miss Aliyanas for advice too!
strings.P.S.\n\n不知茶露亚小姐游行的时候，\n殿下是否在场呢？\n我碰巧回到森林:
P.S.

I wonder if Your Highness was there
during Miss Challua's parade?
I happened to be back in the forest world
and saw her parade...

It was so beautiful it brought me to tears,
I don't even know how to describe it.

If, when the end comes,
they could be by my side,
maybe I wouldn't be afraid to leave.
strings.厄莉：\n\n她本就十分想要念书，\n因此学习积极性非常高。\n由于基础不足，她:
Arly:

She always wanted to study,
so she's very motivated.
Lacking the basics, she isn't progressing quickly.
But now her steady efforts are starting to pay off.

She's also learned a lot about administrative work
from Lilith's high elf secretary.
strings.阿露姆：\n\n与姐姐相反。\n非常重视演艺部的活动，\n在学习上则没有多少热情:
Arum:

The opposite of her sister.
She takes the entertainment club very seriously,
but has little enthusiasm for studying.
Still, with her naturally sharp intuition,
her grades aren't bad at all.

She sometimes goes to the labyrinth to earn pocket money.
But she's gradually stopped fighting, mostly taking gathering requests.

Lately she often visits Felis, the child of a fiend and a human.
She also teaches what she's learned to other children.
She's slowly becoming like a "big sister."
strings.艾力克：\n\n在看到森林世界中新建设的牧场以后，\n他就对畜牧业产生了极大的兴:
Alec:

After seeing the newly built ranch in the forest world,
he became very interested in animal husbandry.
After school he often visits the Sheephirds' settlement with classmates.
All the knowledge he gains there
is sure to help him in the future.
strings.M.O.F结束仅过了几周\n便举办的第二届M.O.F。\n\n在星见镇的帮助下，:
The second M.O.F, held
just a few weeks after the first.

With Starview's help,
the first M.O.F was on an unprecedented scale—
so Princess Toria, having tasted the fruits of mobilization,
decided to hold M.O.F again in the name of Halloween.

Though it was billed as a Halloween event,
they couldn't gather enough pumpkins,
so the committee finally decided to use mushrooms instead.
strings.第二届M.O.F的举办虽多半出于气势。\n不过——\n\n・米雷亚重振国家的目标:
The second M.O.F was held mostly on momentum.
However—

・Mirea's goal of revitalizing the nation.
・A small country, but with open land suited for events.
・Cheerful citizens who love festivals.
・Outdoor skills honed by weekly barbecues.
・Merchants who spotted a business opportunity.

All of the above happened to make the festival possible,
and together with various coincidences and miracles,
the second M.O.F was every bit as popular as the first.

Also, contrary to Princess Toria's wishes,
quite a few citizens wanted to attend Palpebra's Halloween.
So this M.O.F's dates were adjusted slightly.
Even so, it overlapped with Palpebra's Halloween for three days.
strings.两届M.O.F的间隔时间不超过一个月，\n足以看出人们的热情。\n不过，已经没有:
The two M.O.Fs were less than a month apart,
which shows how passionate people were.
But there were no events left to hold!
Platinum Legends saved the day with a special show.
In particular, the match between the shining star
and Mirea's strongest knight (wearing a mushroom helmet)
had everyone going wild.
But they say the one who drew the most attention
was a certain rose beauty serving as referee.
strings.目睹茶露亚行使伟大之力后，\n尼尔娅娜对她的评价。\n瑞西塔尔更是表示，\n她们:
Nihilyana's assessment of Challua
after seeing her wield great power.
Regitare went further, saying
their power rivals that of dragons and the Devourers of Stars.

Below is a study of true spirits
scribbled down passionately on Halloween night
by a certain magic theory researcher.
strings.一万两千年前，人们通过龙眼，\n获得了在梦中描绘虚无的力量。\n如果我们真的都是:
Twelve thousand years ago, through the Dragon's Iris,
people gained the power to paint the void in dreams.
If we truly are all their descendants,
and some power lies within us all,
then why is the world still so "unfree"?
The world is still bound by laws of magic.
I, too, still lack magic power.

For example, if you take a pencil
and press a line hard into paper,
even if you erase the graphite, a mark remains.
Many people have already carved their strokes into the world,
and all I can do is take that bumpy canvas
and paint within all sorts of limits.
And I truly need a framework,
a realm with clear direction called theory.
*Suizen calls it "spells."
*The "spell" closest to us is "language."
*If the world had no language, I couldn't write theory either.

The question is, who drew the first stroke?
strings.魔法理论家们常年探讨的谜团之一便是，\n“为何魔法只能用于战斗呢？”。\n了解历:
One mystery magic theorists have long debated is,
"Why can magic only be used for fighting?"
Anyone who knows history will feel
that it'd be nice if the world had magic that conjures bread.

I think the first picture must have been about power and conflict.
If we can only keep painting on top of it,
if magic can only keep developing on top of it,
then the current situation makes sense.

Humans once defeated the dragon of the beginning.
Back then they certainly needed power.
But it's hard to imagine
ordinary humans painting the power to kill a god—
to paint power rivaling a god.
Did people back then encounter the root of magic,
a being that could rival dragons?

On Halloween night, my hypothesis was confirmed.
strings.我房间中的以太观测机强烈地振动起来。\n\n与生着双翼之物降临的那夜相同。\n那:
The ether observation device in my room shook violently.

Just like the night the winged ones descended.
It was the medium of miracles, the essence of the elements—ether.
Even high mages can only barely grope at
a faint outline of it in the world of concepts.
But now it was surging violently, filling the town.
Two spirits played and danced in those waves,
with countless ether gushing out of their bodies.

Once, humanity encountered true spirits.
The spirits dissolved into the world, turning themselves into ether.
And that is when we gained our canvas.

The first thing painted may have been a portrait.
The wish people made then to fight the dragon
still gives us the power to fight today.
strings.不过，她有着自己的意志。\n她不会成为人类的画布，\n而将绘下属于自己的篇章。\:
But she has a will of her own.
She won't become humanity's canvas,
but will paint a chapter of her own.

She's just a mage who laughs and dances,
and came here to play
so those seeing others off won't be lonely anymore.

I don't think she'll give humanity any more than that.
For some reason, that makes me very happy.

It seems the parade is still going on.
I'm going out to have fun too!
strings.世界上充满了以太，\n而魔法正是以太震荡涌动引发的现象。\n这便是“以太理论”的:
The world is full of ether,
and magic is a phenomenon caused by ether surging and stirring.
This is the core of "ether theory,"
which holds that
elements are matter formed when ether loses its freedom.

Many others, however, believe
ether is only a concept in a caster's inner cosmology,
not a substance that actually exists.
strings.哈？\n\n那是当然的。它就不是物质啊。\n被以太充盈的空间，\n和这个物质世界:
Huh?

Of course. It's not a substance.
Space filled with ether
isn't in the same phase as this material world.
But high-level casters can transcend phases.
In other words, they can open that door.
Or should I say, pull the world over?

Ether is extremely hard to observe,
but we can observe the things it affects.
If you thread the needle from different angles,
you can depict the real ether, right?

Huh? What? It's all just theory?
Is having lots of magic power that great?!!!

—The shout of a certain magic theorist
strings.观测结果变了，真让人头疼。\n\n我请涩谷的能力者们帮忙，\n试图从他们的力量中:
The observation results changed. What a headache.

I asked Shibuya's psychics for help,
trying to study how ether behaves through their powers.
But honestly, the results were shocking.
No ether could be observed in them at all.
How can they use powers without ether???

However, in the second experiment, it was observed.
And in the third, very strong ether was observed.

The first time, the observation device malfunctioned.
Or maybe not.
They've merged with our world.
This world has been disturbed,
while their world, on the contrary, is gradually solidifying.

If that's true,
then ether didn't exist at the very beginning?

I have to rethink everything.
Uh-oh, this is getting super interesting.
strings.书中事无巨细地记录了某个神官的故事。\n他试图保护王国与家人免受疫病侵扰，\n却:
The book records in exhaustive detail the story of a certain priest.
He tried to protect his kingdom and family from plague,
but was accused of using forbidden arts, and after his family was killed,
lost his mind and fell into endless rage and hatred.

Using forbidden arts to destroy his country, and gaining an undying soul as a result.
The book's opening is full of delusional-sounding accounts like this.
The rest is filled with regret, repentance, and the anguish of longing for death.
strings.起始之龙陷入沉睡，勇者也已经消失。\n古龙终于从漫长的命运之中解脱。\n\n那我:
The dragon of the beginning has fallen asleep, and the hero is gone.
The ancient dragons are finally free of their long fate.

So we won't be reborn anymore?
The young Holy Dragon's question left them pondering.
No one will know the answer until that moment comes.

But either way, they'll keep enjoying their dragon lives for now.
strings.炎龙王，那之后——\n\n起初他并不情愿加入探索队。\n但如圣龙与雷龙预料的那样:
The Flame Dragon King, and after—

At first he was reluctant to join the expedition.
But just as the Holy Dragon and Thunder Dragon predicted,
the dragon now giving it his all is Vagner.

His conviction is very firm.
The Holy Dragon and the Dragon of Darkness not joining the expeditions displeases him greatly.
What a pain. Please do something about them.
Even Alk and Light have received such complaints.

His flame surely won't die out anytime soon.
strings.雷龙，那之后——\n\n拉姆斯选择了留在星见镇，\n守望伙伴们。\n偶尔会加入异:
The Thunder Dragon, and after—

Rams chose to stay in Starview
and watch over her friends.
She occasionally joins the otherworld expedition team.

She often has tea with Stella
and listens to the stories the girl writes.
The girl showed the Thunder Dragon a dream,
and she'll surely stay by the girl's side from now on.

Sometimes she's also seen with the magatama relic
helping townspeople with their life troubles.
strings.旋风龙，那之后——\n\n修尔特曾在战斗结束后\n短暂加入过异界探索队。\n但归:
The Whirlwind Dragon, and after—

Schulte briefly joined the otherworld expedition team
after the battles ended.
But the first thing he did when he came back
was apply for indefinite long-term leave.

During his leave, together with three girls,
he took on cooking, shopping, travel and more.
He wants to treasure their limited lives,
and make memories with them.

Having found meaning in work,
he's also considered going back.
But for now he plans to enjoy his vacation with the ones he loves.
strings.冰牙龙，那之后——\n\n终于得到了真正的自由。要不出去旅行吧。\n一切都结束之:
The Ice Fang Dragon, and after—

Finally truly free. Maybe I'll go traveling.
After it was all over, Anbach said so cheerfully.

However, either the little dragons pestered her to play,
or she couldn't stop worrying about those unreliable adventurers,
and she ended up joining the otherworld expedition team.
She even somehow joined the rebuilding effort—
there were just too many reasons for her to stay.
But when she grumbles "I'm so unfree," her voice is gentle.

Still, on her days off she goes shopping with friends,
and plans to open a general store someday.
strings.冥龙，那之后——\n\n冥龙曾经未能拯救的魔族——\n现在已经迈入了崭新的生活。:
The Dragon of Darkness, and after—

The fiends the Dragon of Darkness once failed to save
have now stepped into a brand-new life.
And he chose to stay with them.
They say he not only works hard on the settlement and plays with the children,
but also mediates between fiends and other races.
He's quite active.

In private, he often gets caught up in Couette's extraordinary incidents,
or dragged off on otherworld expeditions by Rustamov.
He always seems to be getting jerked around, but he never minds.
When talking about his life,
Rooma's eyes are always very calm and full of joy.
strings.圣龙，那之后——\n\n时而参加探索队，时而一个人旅行。\n时而也会帮助他人。\:
The Holy Dragon, and after—

Sometimes he joins the expedition, sometimes he travels alone.
Sometimes he helps others.
"Nothing can bind me anymore!"
Having boasted so, the Holy Dragon lives as he pleases.
But every time he comes to the forest world,
he tells of his heroic exploits,
and declares "I'll show you how awesome I am."
Sadly, his schemes fall flat every time.

"Couldst thou not grow up a little faster?"
Every time he's taunted like this, Rustamov puffs up in a huff.
strings.西历终结之时，\n不断增加的超能力者在梦中见到了龙眼。\n然后，从涩谷的遗迹、那:
At the end of the Western Calendar,
the ever-growing number of psychics saw the Dragon's Iris in their dreams.
Then, from the ruins of Shibuya, that "great hole,"
a giant dragon appeared.

Its claws tore the world apart.
Its roar dissolved reality.

After the First Dragon appeared,
the ruins of Shibuya became a singularity leading to other worlds,
what would later become the abyss.
People gradually came to see the multiple worlds as reality.
strings.物理法则加速变化。\n空间溶解。异形之物不断出现。\n人类开始恐惧，视始龙为威胁:
The laws of physics changed faster and faster.
Space dissolved. Grotesque things kept appearing.
Humanity grew afraid, seeing the First Dragon as a threat.

However, every modern weapon,
nuclear weapons included,
was useless.
Only psychics could harm it.
But their powers running wild caused dissolution,
which only made the First Dragon stronger.

At the time, humanity lost every means of resistance.

Only when humanity encountered other worlds
and gained the worldview later called "magic"
could they finally face the First Dragon.
strings.西历终结，新历大约40年时。\n人类与伟大之人邂逅，获得了力量。\n他们与众多世:
After the Western Calendar ended, around New Calendar year 40.
Humanity met a great being and gained power.
Joining forces with many worlds, they finally defeated the First Dragon.

The First Dragon's core—
the eye that let people see dreams—vanished into the abyss.
But most of its remains stayed in the world.
From the dragon's spine, people found the power that later
let them win the Multiworld War—
the broken half-body of "Mikoto Hoshino."

The heroes tried to repair that broken world.
But that opened the long era
of the Supreme Ones' rule.
strings.雷姆纳将弥漫在星之宫与\n至高者梦境中的龙之力归还给了始龙。\n\n然而，始龙将:
Remna returned the dragon power that filled
the Palace of Stars and the Supreme Ones' dream to the First Dragon.

However, the First Dragon had divided its power among the hero,
the Purgers, the ancient dragons, the Serpents and more.
The power left in the Palace of Stars was like a faint spirit,
far weaker than it once was.
Without the First Dragon's power to unify it,
Remna's wish—
a world changed by turning back time—couldn't come true.

Alk's appearance meant his plan had already failed.
Perhaps he summoned the dragon only to bring it all to an end.
strings.格拉姆·沃伦塔斯撰写的考察概要。\n整理了以始龙为根基的龙族的定位。:
A summary of findings written by Gram Voluntas.
It organizes the place of dragonkind, with the First Dragon at its root.
strings.始龙\n\n起始之龙。龙族的起源。\n从遥远世界到来之物。\n或许召唤它的少年赋:
The First Dragon

The dragon of the beginning. The origin of dragonkind.
A being that came from a distant world.
Perhaps the boy who summoned it gave it the form of a dragon.

The humans of Shibuya have also testified.
The Western Calendar world did regard dragons as mythical creatures,
and there were many paintings depicting them.
strings.古龙\n\n以复原始龙为目标，\n使用始龙的残骸创造出的六条龙。\n继承了大量始:
Ancient Dragons

Six dragons created from the First Dragon's remains,
with the aim of restoring it.
They inherited much of the First Dragon's power.
They can cross worlds on their own,
and live forever through reincarnation.

*The Thunder Dragon truly is very beautiful.
The shiny one is no good at all.
strings.歼灭者\n\n至高者的道具。\n虽为人形，但其内在与龙相似。\n或许是为反省创造:
Purgers

Tools of the Supreme Ones.
Humanoid, but similar to dragons inside.
Perhaps out of regret for creating uncontrollable ancient dragons,
they deliberately distorted their own form
to create these ugly, degraded humanoid weapons.

The aberrant individuals that appeared in the Wavering Labyrinth
share the same traits as Wild Dragons.
It has now been determined that the Starbreaker
restored them to their form as dragons.

*I meant to go complain to that Nova brat,
but Nihilyana stopped me. Why.
strings.龙\n\n通常所说的龙。\n会通过繁衍适应世界。\n多数已失去神秘感。\n由于古:
Dragons

Dragons as commonly understood.
They adapt to the world by breeding.
Most have lost their mystique.
Since ancient dragons cannot reproduce,
these are not their descendants.

The oldest fossils found so far date back 12,000 years.
Perhaps the First Dragon's death gave birth to them,
and their seeds were scattered to every world through the Dracostream.

Dragons may be especially numerous in our world
because Palpebra's Great Hole is their very place of origin.
strings.荒龙\n\n寻求始龙之力的异界之物——\n孔洞另一侧被称为噬星兽的存在\n寄生于:
Wild Dragons

Otherworldly beings seeking the First Dragon's power—
dragons born when the beings beyond the hole called Devourers of Stars
parasitize dragons and twist them.

Very powerful, but without intelligence or will.
So they pose almost no threat.
However, there was an incident where a Shibuya psychic resonated with one.
From this we can conclude
that Wild Dragons, like the aberrant Purgers in the labyrinth,
can gain power closer to the source
through the intervention of will—that is, "wishes."

*The Academy calls them Wild Dragons,
but such monsters don't deserve the name of dragon at all.
strings.前往提亚特的新飞燕自由骑士团\n与克亚雷等谍报员遭遇的事件。\n\n一行人的目的:
An incident encountered by the New Swallow Knights
and intelligence agents such as Chiare on their way to Tiatha.

The group's goal was to investigate the link between the Starsayers
and a cult lurking in Tiatha,
but its leader had awakened as a resonator
and successfully summoned a Devourer of Stars,
and the area around an abandoned church on the outskirts briefly became an otherworld.
strings.自春季起，某自称是法蒂玛教\n新兴派系的教团逐渐在提亚特露头。\n他们敌视创造了:
Since spring, a cult calling itself a new sect of the Church of Farlana
had been surfacing in Tiatha.
They were hostile to Palpebra, which created the "godless age,"
and proclaimed they would bring a new god down.
Without a doubt, it was no ordinary cult.
They had absorbed a former Farlands criminal organization,
and had the Starsayers backing them.
strings.所幸，尤维尔等人早已注意到了他们，\n并在出现更大伤亡之前将其击溃。\n不过，骑:
Fortunately, Yuwel and the others had noticed them early,
and crushed them before there were more casualties.
Even so, the knights had to gather all their strength
to finally destroy the Devourer of Stars' main body.
Moreover, the cult in Tiatha was only a branch;
the organization itself was still active within the Farlands.
strings.伴随着吞噬星辰之物的突然出现，\n法兰德全境各处都发生了异界化现象。\n\n六条:
With the sudden appearance of the devourer of stars,
otherworlding phenomena occurred all across the Farlands.

Six dragons and warriors saved the Farlands from crisis.
Later generations regarded the story as myth,
and named it "the Farlands Devourer Incident."
strings.事件的起因乃咏星者决定放弃法兰德，\n并打算召唤噬星兽将整个国家沉入异界。\n\:
The incident began when the Starsayers decided to abandon the Farlands,
and planned to summon a Devourer of Stars to sink the whole country into an otherworld.

The New Swallow Knights noticed the Starsayers' plot
early on and took countermeasures.
Then, joining forces with Starview, which had gathered in the Farlands,
they destroyed the otherworldly evil god.
The decisive event that turned the battle toward victory
was the Celtie assault force's raid on the main body.
strings.提亚特的事件乃此次事变的发端。\n\n新飞燕自由骑士团得知，\n法兰德内部同样有:
The incident in Tiatha was where it all began.

The New Swallow Knights learned
that someone within the Farlands was also trying to summon a Devourer of Stars.
They informed the Kingdom of the Farlands,
and tried to nip it in the bud.

However, even facing crisis,
the Farlands struggled to act quickly,
and its people could not set aside their divisions and unite.

In the end, it was the princes who solved the problems at home together.
Lornite provided information to every house,
Arthram mediated between the houses,
and with Valein's unyielding stance in negotiations,
all knight houses except the Fourth and Eighth Houses finally agreed
to work together to resolve the nation's crisis.
strings.然而，问题在于人员的数量。\n\n咏星者在全国各地都安排了仪式，\n阻止他们则需:
However, the problem was manpower.

The Starsayers had arranged rituals all over the country,
and stopping them meant suppressing every site at once.
For that, every knight house's strength was essential.
The New Swallow Knights worked closely with the knight houses
in an intelligence war where no leak could be allowed.

The free knights rushed all over the mired Farlands.
In the end, most rituals were stopped in advance,
or destroyed right after they were activated.
strings.即便如此，事件并无法和平收场。\n\n由于国境附近兵力不足，\n星见镇的战力被秘:
Even so, the incident could not end peacefully.

Due to a lack of troops near the border,
Starview's forces were secretly stationed there.
After the summoning, they battled a huge number of Devourers of Stars.

The greatest danger was that the knights couldn't call them into the country.
A summoning also took place in the kingdom's heart, the royal capital.
There, people saw an evil god tearing the "world" apart.

At the same time,
people also saw a warship and a girl descending from the sky.

Later, the battle became legend among the people.
The "Sword Saint" who slew the evil god and the great dragon soaring the skies
were especially beloved.
strings.引发了这一系列事件的核心——\n咏星者果不其然忽然失去了踪影。\n不过，大部分底:
The core that set off this whole series of events—
the Starsayers, as expected, suddenly vanished.
However, most of their lower ranks were arrested,
and the ties between the Fourth and Eighth Houses and the Starsayers came to light.

The shadow over the Farlands was finally swept away.
Those who press straight on toward the light.
Those who learned the truth beneath the shadows.
Those who accept both the pure and the impure, with an eye on the bigger picture.
The past has not been fully settled,
but the next generation is slowly taking on the future.
strings.法蒂玛教古老经典……\n其实乃玛登·艾特兰杜撰并散播的虚假教典。\n\n书中内容:
An ancient scripture of the Church of Farlana...
in fact a false scripture fabricated and spread by Marden Oxtan.

The content is almost entirely Marden's invention,
with the Devourer of Stars' kin Lost cast as a fictional divine messenger.
To follow the Sheephird legends,
the text is written on the premise that the Star Goddess truly exists
and that Palpebra is the Land of Lamentation.
Once published,
it caused an uproar in the Church and the main House of Oxtan.
strings.为了让人们觉得“艾特兰本家”已因为\n“可疑的宗教团体咏星者”而陷入癫狂，\n并:
To make people believe the main House of Oxtan had gone mad
because of "the suspicious religious group, the Starsayers,"
and to expose the hidden ties between the knight houses and the Starsayers,
Marden repeatedly stated when publishing the scripture
that the Starsayers had granted him the divine kin Lost,
and helped him find the truth.
strings.厌恶世界，加入秘密结社，\n最后找到了新的信仰。\n实际上，玛登至今为止的经历\:
Hating the world, joining a secret society,
and finally finding a new faith.
In fact, Marden's life up to now
mirrors the scripture he fabricated.
In other words, he didn't lie.
Naturally, the main House of Oxtan urgently summoned him,
and he was harshly reprimanded—

"You're the ones who've always used faith as a tool, aren't you?
Then I can too.
After all, I'm an Oxtan too, aren't I?"
strings.玛登的计划进行得十分顺利。\n艾特兰及肆拉与咏星者的关系大白于天下，\n王也批准:
Marden's plan went very smoothly.
The ties between House Oxtan, House of Kwetur and the Starsayers came to light,
and the king approved an investigation.
However, Marden failed to foresee two things.
One, it drove the Starsayers into a corner,
making them decide to find a "scapegoat" and abandon the Farlands entirely.
Two, the scripture gave a reason for the sense of "loss"
pervading the kingdom.
In the end, the scripture became
the last straw that led to the Farlands Devourer Incident.

However, that's only Marden's own view.
Many believe that no matter what,
the Farlands Devourer Incident was unavoidable.
But Marden still blames himself greatly,
and his drinking increased for a while.
A certain lion who can't hold his liquor often keeps him company.
strings.莎蒂雅分支家族中的少女骑士。\n家中代代都有莎蒂雅骑士。\n听说本家一名与自己年:
A girl knight from a branch family of House of Tris.
Her family has produced Tris knights for generations.
After hearing that a girl her own age from the main family
had defeated Enlil,
she longed to become a knight.
She often dresses as a boy, playing vigilante to protect citizens.
Her family and the local citizen knights recognized her long ago,
but all pretend not to know.
strings.她的天赋并不足以支撑她孤身击败邪龙。\n周围对她的期待并非成为强大的骑士，\n而:
She doesn't have the talent to defeat an evil dragon alone.
Those around her expect her not to become a strong knight,
but to fulfill her duties as a noble.
Elsie understands this very well,
and it makes her very frustrated.

But a fire has already been lit in her heart.
Even if someday she gives up the way of the sword,
that fire will keep burning in her heart and be passed on.
strings.法蒂玛教中地位特别的人的称号。\n\n在法兰德王国建国传说中，\n引导者循着“星:
A title for people of special standing in the Church of Farlana.

In the founding legend of the Kingdom of the Farlands,
a guide followed the "starlight" and led people out of the barren lands.
The Church believes powerful light magic resembles that "starlight,"
and regards those who can use exceptional light magic as saints.

Generally, saints are mostly women—"holy maidens."
This is because the Church sees the "stars" as the goddess's incarnation,
and women more easily win public support.
Orvielle was recognized as a holy maiden by the Church
because her magic resembles judgment descending from the heavens.
strings.传说，法蒂玛教“为王族带来了指引”，\n因此他们曾拥有极其庞大的权力。\n然而现:
Legend says the Church of Farlana "brought guidance to the royal family,"
so it once held enormous power.
Now, however, the Church is declining.
To win back people's hearts, the order desperately needs a symbol.
Finding and nurturing qualified people has been the order's long-cherished wish.

But in fact, the order sees saints only as a "front."
As symbols, saints must follow protocol in everything,
living in an extremely oppressive environment.
strings.教团中某些派系会召集贵族子弟，\n投入力量试图从小将其培养成圣人候补。\n\n然:
Some factions within the order gather the children of nobles,
putting effort into raising them as saint candidates from a young age.

However, a candidate girl with rare talent
suddenly ran away and vanished before being recognized as a saint.
This not only dealt a blow to House Oxtan,
but also greatly weakened House Swes, which worked with them.

Meanwhile, that candidate is now in Starview,
happily teaching Stella her light magic illusions.
strings.于M.O.F-2nd-数周后举办的第三届M.O.F。\n\n前两次的成功让托莉亚:
The third M.O.F, held a few weeks after M.O.F 2nd.

The success of the first two went to Princess Toria's head.
"It's no exaggeration to say
the age of Mirea has arrived—!!"
And so, with no preparation at all,
the third M.O.F began.

It no longer had anything to do with the season, the purpose, or even October,
but because the princess wanted to make use of the fame she'd worked so hard for,
the festival kept the name M.O.F and was dubbed 3rd.
strings.由于事前根本没有任何计划，\n加之已找不到其他能成为庆典重头的活动，\n为了举办:
With no plans made in advance,
and no other events left to headline the festival,
to hold M.O.F 3rd,
the people of Starview and Princess Toria had to run around everywhere.

Through everyone's efforts,
the group finally forced together a PBC heroes show,
the entertainment club's Rap & Dance performance,
the World's Greatest Golem Tournament, and more,
and barely managed to hold the festival... however...

In conclusion, M.O.F 3rd was a failure.
strings.原因在于，人们已经对庆典感到了疲惫。\n与喜欢热闹的米雷亚国民不同，\n一般人根:
The reason: people were tired of festivals.
Unlike the party-loving people of Mirea,
most people simply didn't have the energy for back-to-back events.

So in the end, only familiar faces attended M.O.F 3rd.
Thanks to the cheerful, party-loving Mireans,
the festival atmosphere was quite lively,
but the Kingdom of Mirea's finances took a huge hit.
This taught Princess Toria
how important scheduling and marketing are.
strings.不过，这次庆典也发挥了其作用。\n在3rd即将结束、发生紧急事件时，\n汇聚在庆:
Still, the festival served its purpose.
When an emergency arose as 3rd was about to end,
the powerful figures gathered at the festival quickly sprang into action.

At that time, Prince Razelt's party, staying in Mirea,
received word that the Farlands faced a national crisis.

Learning the whole story, Princess Toria immediately decided to help.
Taking Mirea's elite with her,
she set off for the Farlands with the prince's party without delay.

To be continued in the next M.O.F——
strings.噬星兽的召唤、异界化。\n法兰德险些被尽数吞噬。\n那一切的开端是提亚特发生的事:
The summoning of Devourers of Stars, the otherworlding.
The Farlands was nearly swallowed whole.
It all began with the incident in Tiatha.
However—
its premise was the day of parting with the dragon.

The first to feel fear were the clergy.
"Divine messengers" descended from the sky over Palpebra.
Yet the "divine messengers" were all destroyed.
At first, the clergy didn't believe it was real.
But it planted a seed of fear in their hearts.

On the day the boy inside the dragon in the Palace of Stars disappeared,
those seeds finally brought unbearable fear.
That day, many clergy saw in their dreams
a "great being" shattering and sinking beneath the water.

They faced the transformation of the world.
strings.见到梦境的并不只有神官，\n还有后来被称为感应者的人们。\n当许多人作证表示，\:
It wasn't only the clergy who saw the dream,
but also people later called resonators.
When many testified
that everything that happened in Palpebra was real,
an indescribable emptiness arose in their hearts.

"The rightful god must be restored."

More and more people preached heretical doctrines,
and countless new groups appeared in the Farlands.

Later people discovered
that the Starsayers were the ones supporting those cults.
Hoping for god's return. Hoping for a new god to descend.
It was that sorrowful wish that drew the Devourers of Stars.
strings.法蒂玛教自然无法容忍新兴组织崛起。\n然而，教团本身已失去了立足的根基，\n有如:
Naturally, the Church of Farlana couldn't tolerate new groups rising up.
However, the order itself had lost its footing,
and anxiety spread as if they'd been thrown into the vacuum of space,
so they failed to act in time.

According to later investigation and analysis by Suizen and others,
the Farlands, full of anxiety,
was already gradually being eroded by the otherworld at that time.
The "reality" beneath people's feet had completely changed,
becoming thin ice that would easily shatter.
strings.那一天，薄冰彻底碎裂了。\n蠢动的邪神。飞翔的龙。打破常理的超人们。\n还有在破:
That day, the thin ice shattered completely.
A writhing evil god. Flying dragons. Superhumans defying common sense.
And a Sword Saint fighting fiercely amid the light of a shattered world.

The terror Eltide Tris saw in her daughter's sword
was finally revealed before everyone.

However, quite a few knights decided to take up the sword again
and follow the Sword Saint.
It's said that many outstanding figures who would lead the Farlands
later emerged from among them.

Also, thanks to a certain holy maiden's guidance
and tireless efforts to keep communicating,
most of the clergy and resonators tormented by anxiety
later regained themselves.
strings.噬星兽事变震动了法兰德全境。\n在许多骑士与战士的努力下，\n异界的怪物被击退了:
The Devourer Incident shook the entire Farlands.
Through the efforts of many knights and warriors,
the otherworldly monsters were driven back.
But behind the incident,
the princes each had their own thoughts and efforts.
They too will face an ever-changing future.

Below are the deeds of the four princes
deeply involved in the Devourer Incident.
strings.瓦雷因·塞洛诺亚的奔走——\n\n瓦雷因最大的功绩乃“绝不放弃”。\n\n他撬动:
Valein Nialas's Efforts—

Valein's greatest achievement was "never giving up."

He moved a country that could not be moved.
Lornite provided information to everyone and broke the deadlock.
Arthram built bridges for the houses
unwilling to give up their neutrality.
But the road before them was so steep,
with countless setbacks waiting ahead.

Even so, he kept negotiating.
Because Valein never gave up,
the princes could join hands, and the knight houses could unite.
strings.洛耐特·塞洛诺亚的杀手锏——\n\n洛耐特的功绩乃“情报泄露”。\n他秘密收集了:
Lornite Nialas's Trump Card—

Lornite's achievement was "the leak."
He secretly gathered internal information on House of Kwetur, which supported him,
and made it all public.

Every piece of evidence backing the New Swallow Knights' accusations,
and the location of every site where summoning rituals would be held.
This made the doubtful nobles immediately turn to expose House of Kwetur.
It was truly a trump card.

For Lornite himself, it was also a move that brought him back from the brink.
After the incident settled,
he officially gained House of Tris's support.
strings.亚斯拉姆·塞洛诺亚的计划——\n\n法兰德已经开始行动了。\n接下来的问题是，\:
Arthram Nialas's Plan—

The Farlands had already begun to move.
The next question was,
who would lead? And who would follow?

It was Arthram who took the lead in allowing the New Swallow Knights to operate in the country,
and united the First, Fifth and Seventh Houses.
The Second House, House of Dau, which controls finances and has strong influence over the other houses,
was already in his grasp.
His actions greatly cut down the time wasted on politics.

He had also hoped to take credit from Valein and Lornite.
But as House of Kwetur and House Oxtan lost power,
his position grew ever more secure.
strings.拉杰尔特·塞洛诺亚的奋斗——\n\n亚斯拉姆在合作之前提出了一个条件。\n“让拉:
Razelt Nialas's Struggle—

Before cooperating, Arthram set one condition.
"Keep Razelt away from politics."
Starview did accept his demand.

However, for some reason,
Razelt came to the battlefield with Mirea's warriors.
This made Arthram pull a more twisted face than ever before.

But in the end, no house was willing to back Razelt.
That really isn't for you. Better give it up.
Everyone said so in unison.
And so, Razelt was never again drawn into the succession struggle.

However, later generations mentioned again and again
this timid prince who appeared when the nation was in peril.
His deeds became people's favorite anecdote.
strings.塞洛诺亚家族的未来——\n\n所有人都以为，王位继承之争会愈加激烈。\n然而风波:
The Future of House Nialas—

Everyone thought the succession struggle would grow even fiercer.
But once the storm passed, things didn't go that way.

Outside beings that can shake the world.
Overwhelming power rivaling the gods
behind the New Swallow Knights.
To stand against such beings,
they need to build their strength,
and sometimes must choose to cooperate—

Whatever the three princes truly think,
they have indeed set out on the path of cooperation and unity.

That distant kingdom
will surely be reborn as a nation that carries on into the future.
strings.在法兰德噬星兽事变中，\n新飞燕自由骑士团的作用尤为关键。\n起初，他们花费了很:
In the Farlands Devourer Incident,
the New Swallow Knights played an especially crucial role.
At first, they spent great effort dealing with
nobles who refused to act in the face of national crisis.
But thanks to the princes' efforts,
preparations for battle went smoothly.

But that wasn't enough.
Yuwel was very worried the worst would happen.
strings.他知道，一旦咏星者召唤出噬星兽，\n只有星见镇的力量才能与之抗衡。\n虽得到了亚:
He knew that once the Starsayers summoned a Devourer of Stars,
only Starview's power could stand against it.
Though he had Prince Arthram's help,
even he couldn't bring Palpebra's forces
or people from other worlds into the country for reconnaissance.
Ordering Vyron and a few others to infiltrate the country was already a gamble.

But that wasn't enough—

That day, Yuwel went to Arthram
and requested that a "Palpebra mercenary unit" be stationed near the border.
Arthram granted his request.
strings.部署在国境附近的部队\n名义上是为了进行人道支援。\n但亚斯拉姆心里明白，\n也:
The unit stationed near the border
was nominally there for humanitarian aid.
But Arthram knew in his heart,
and accepted, that it was really a reserve force.
