However, those who arrived bearing the New Swallow Knights' crest
to identify them as allies
were a giant dragon and warriors from another world.

Before planning this, New Swallow Knights captain Yuwel Kuez
had prepared himself to be banished forever.
strings.尤维尔的恐惧确实成为了现实。\n面对异界的侵蚀与噬星兽的威胁，\n新飞燕自由骑士:
Yuwel's fear did indeed come true.
Facing the otherworld's erosion and the Devourers' threat,
the New Swallow Knights and the knights of the Farlands
together saved many, many people.

Naturally, once things settled down,
the council harshly held Yuwel accountable for his actions.
For a while afterward, he was busy apologizing everywhere.
Yuwel himself said he was lucky enough not to be banished,
but fatigue was written all over his face.

Still, thanks to this, the New Swallow Knights
became national heroes who traveled with dragons,
remembered by the people for a long time.
strings.艾尔蒂德·莎蒂雅。\n曾是被誉为最强剑士的法兰德全军总督。\n前莎蒂雅领主。\n:
Eltide Tris.
Once the Farlands' commander-in-chief, hailed as the strongest swordsman.
Former lord of House of Tris.
Parent of Celtie and Ciel.

The first to see Celtie's true nature,
and to fear it.
But the daughter only smiled lonely,
and with the words "please watch me," walked into the light.
The eyes watching her back no longer held fear,
only relief and sorrow.
strings.艾尔蒂德·莎蒂雅评价女儿的剑术时使用的词。\n不过，她的剑与格斗家泰加的拳相同，:
The words Eltide Tris used to describe her daughter's swordsmanship.
However, like the fists of the martial artist Taiga,
her sword truly can slay enemies in other phases.
Later, the term came to refer to this ability.

Notable examples—or rather, what unintentionally became references—
are the world-severing sword, and the slashes of the Starbreaker and twin star swords.
Celtie reproduced that power with her own technique.

After Celtie, centered on the Abyss Exploration Team,
more and more people can use the same power.
For example, a certain small rabbit warrior
can kick an otherworldly evil god in two.
And such scenes have long become commonplace for everyone.
strings.某个神秘男人在贤王伊迪亚临死时\n交给他的、能继承记忆的器物。\n舞子的继承器藏:
A device for inheriting memories that a mysterious man
gave to the Wise King Edea on his deathbed.
Maiko's inheritor is hidden in the mark on her neck.

Inheritors can write information into a human brain.
For as many inheritors as exist,
there are as many successors—Capellas.
All Capellas can share memories through synchronization.
*Among the Starsayers are several Capellas living under new names.

However, inheritors can only copy memories;
the brain serving as the vessel keeps its original traits.
Every Capella has the same memories,
but their personalities are completely different.
Perhaps because, to them,
copying and inheriting memories is only natural,
some individuals have a rather faint "self,"
and will even destroy themselves to hide evidence.
strings.也就是说，被莱特等人说服的\n仅仅是继承了记忆的舞子·沃伦一人。\n其他卡佩拉仍:
In other words, the only one persuaded by Light and the others
was Maiko Warren, who had inherited the memories.
The other Capellas still exist in corners of the world.

Then let's recover them all.
Having decided so, the hero and the witches
set out on a great adventure to track down the Starsayers.

Should we invite everyone to come along...?
To Rooma saying this, Maiko replied—
I'm the only one who'll get tied down by you. Better give it up.
strings.咏星者的发源经过充满谜团。\n而他们的始祖其实是\n使用継承器获得了永生的伊迪亚:
The origins of the Starsayers are full of mystery.
In truth, their founders were
Edea, who gained eternal life using the inheritors,
and Belsidia, who met the Dragon of the Underworld at the bottom of the demon realm
and gained power after falling into the abyss.

The Starsayers sought to build a force that hides in the gaps and observes the stars—
that is, one that could escape the Star Goddess's watch
and oppose the Supreme Ones.
Centered on the court astronomers of the Kingdom of Stratos,
they gathered power from every world.

It was then that the Starsayers learned from the Dragon of the Underworld
a method of teleportation using dragon blood as a medium.
This greatly expanded their power.
strings.然而，随着新的勇者出现，\n二人的关系因意见立场相左而产生了裂痕。\n伊迪亚等人:
However, when a new hero appeared,
the two fell out over differing opinions and positions.
Edea and the others argued the hero should be assassinated,
while Belsidia firmly opposed it.

In the end, the hero was murdered.
However, after the power reincarnated and a new hero awakened,
the Star Goddess sensed the presence of an outside enemy,
and sacrificed a dragon to wipe out the Starsayers and the world.

The Witch of the Gaps learned her own foolishness.
She couldn't protect the hero, nor her companions,
nor even her little brother's heart.

After that, Belsidia disappeared.
Only much later were the Starsayers revived.
strings.重新崛起的咏星者已与之前截然不同。\n贝尔赛蒂亚等人的名字虽成为了传说，\n但关:
The revived Starsayers were utterly different from before.
The names of Belsidia and the others became legend,
but the memory of destruction never faded.

The Starsayers have no base or physical form,
sharing "knowledge" for reaching the supreme only through a network.
They forever lurk in the dark, living as parasites on others.
And the fear carved deep into their souls
means they never forget to thoroughly "shift the blame."

They'll pay any price, and flee to the ends of the earth.

House of Kwetur's mistake
was thinking itself on the same side as the Starsayers,
not knowing they could abandon the Farlands or even the whole world.
Sacrificing the Farlands was utterly unthinkable to House of Kwetur.
strings.不过，对咏星者来说，\n法兰德王国确实是最大的宿主。\n阿德拉哈、普罗基欧、卡佩:
Still, to the Starsayers,
the Kingdom of the Farlands was indeed their biggest host.
Adala, Procheon, Capella, Shaula.
Those close to the supreme are all gone,
wiped out by the same force—
the Farlands Devourer Incident
is proof of the Starsayers' fear and impatience.

Maiko Warren hid founder Edea's identity,
remained with the Starsayers under the name Capella (and other aliases),
and passed their information to Light and the others.
Surely in the near future,
the group will settle things with the Starsayers once and for all.
strings.旅行者们的集团。\n仰慕蕾薇及咲夜，\n将她们称为“大姐”与“大姐头”。\n没有:
A group of travelers.
They adore Leve and Sakuya,
calling them "Big Sis" and "Boss."
With no fixed base, they travel across worlds,
searching for a place where they can find peace.

They're really more like traveling performers.
Wherever they stay, they put on shows and trade with locals,
offering profit and smiles in exchange for a place to rest.
They're especially popular in unchanging rural villages,
where their performances are one of the few entertainments.
strings.蕾薇随性而起的冲动成就了旅团。\n最开始，他们只是一群可疑的流浪者，\n不管去到:
The troupe was born of Leve's spur-of-the-moment impulse.
At first, they were just a group of suspicious vagrants,
treated with wariness wherever they went.
But with help from Inaho, Regis, King Johnson,
and everyone in Starview,
this group was reborn as the Star-Crossing Troupe.

Now they've left Leve's management
(or rather, Leve can no longer manage them)
and set out on their own journey.

Yet for some reason, whenever the troupe runs into trouble,
it's always Alk who steps in to solve it.
He himself has quite a few complaints about this.
strings.旅团中的大部分人都是\n一直被虐待、否定、剥削的人，\n而蕾薇（不假思索地）向他:
Most of the troupe are people
who were long abused, rejected and exploited,
and Leve (without a second thought) reached out to them.
So the troupe is very diverse,
from humans to mechanoids, beastfolk, cyborgs and more.

However, the troupe's members aren't fixed.
As they visit various worlds, someone always
luckily finds a place of their own.
But since Leve always brings back new members,
the troupe's total size doesn't change much.
strings.没有承诺，也没有保证。\n但是，伸向他们的手确实非常温暖。\n\n今天，渡星旅团:
No promises, no guarantees.
But the hand reached out to them was truly very warm.

Today too, the Star-Crossing Troupe sets off on its journey.
While searching for a peaceful place,
they laugh cheerfully and bring smiles to people.
strings.在科隆兹弗罗特上，\n因某些微不足道的原因被视为“污秽”、\n遭人厌恶的人们。\:
On Kolonzfrot,
people regarded as "unclean" for some trivial reason
and shunned by others.

Their circumstances are naturally very pitiful.
But though the names and reasons differ,
the same kind of people exist in every society.
And people often find it hard to recognize this problem.
strings.目睹了星见镇的热闹场景之后，\n蕾薇向着遥远的天空吐出的话语。\n\n没有任何人:
Words Leve spat at the distant sky
after seeing the lively scenes of Starview.

No one knows
that short sneer
held her joy and loneliness, and countless emotions.
strings.渡星旅团与稻穗的剧团的合作剧目。\n讲述了因孤独而逃离城堡的缇亚菈公主\n在异国:
A joint production by the Star-Crossing Troupe and Inaho's theater troupe.
It tells the story of Princess Tiara, who fled the castle out of loneliness,
and after meeting orphans in a foreign town,
gained an irreplaceable friendship.

Given the troupe's inexperience,
the characters' backgrounds were based on specific actors.
However, only one person never noticed this at all.
strings.自帕尔佩布拉与涩谷融合之后，\n蕾薇与咲夜便一直试图夺取星之逆枪，\n并为了寻找:
Ever since Palpebra and Shibuya merged,
Leve and Sakuya had been trying to seize the Starbreaker,
roaming otherworlds in search of a breakthrough to change the world.

"We should lie low in Palpebra
and take the Starbreaker from those idiots by force."
Leve's opinion made a lot of sense.
"Our fighting strength is way too far behind."
But Sakuya's rebuttal was very reasonable too.
"Besides, maybe we'll find inspiration if we go traveling!"
Following Sakuya's offhand suggestion,
the two decided they'd just drop by Palpebra to shop now and then.
strings.她们立下了强烈的决心，踏上了旅途。\n但她们的旅行其实非常随性。\n\n时而在海:
They set out on their journey with fierce resolve.
But their travels were actually very carefree.

Sometimes they splashed around at the beach to their hearts' content.
Sometimes they admired autumn leaves in the mountains.
Sometimes they enjoyed sweets in town.
Sometimes they got excited over stories in books.
Sometimes they lost everything at the casino.
Sometimes they headed to a magic festival to join the fun.

Traveling with the first friend she'd ever made
was really—really, really so much fun.
strings.曾经，有一群战败的人们。\n为了获得胜利，\n他们滥用了深渊之力，并因此被囚禁。:
Once, there was a group of defeated people.
To win,
they abused the power of the abyss, and were imprisoned for it.
However, a dragon took pity on them,
and lent them its power.

The gentle Dragon of Darkness told the Thunder Dragon and the other dragons of his dream.
Someday, no one will lose anything anymore,
and no one will take anything from anyone.
Everyone can join hands and see the same dream.
Could such a world ever come true?

However, the undying Dragon of Darkness was twisted by hatred.
For the sake of her twisted brethren,
the dragon told his words to her companions countless times.

And now, the words spoken by the great Holy Dragon
made the Thunder Dragon feel happy, and deeply nostalgic.
He said—we're on the road to that dream.
strings.弱小、强大、丑陋、美好。\n人类各不相同，他们无法见到相同的梦。\n所以，黑暗会:
Weak, strong, ugly, beautiful.
Humans are all different; they can't see the same dream.
That's why darkness embraces everyone.

That man gave the stars a name, and said she was beautiful.
But did he really believe those words?
Wasn't he the one who knew best that it was all fantasy?
Now, there's no way to know.

To her, those were words of salvation.
But now, she no longer knows whether to believe them.

"Let's all dream the same dream together!"

So those words surprised her greatly.
Why would that idiot fox say something like that...?
strings.“我们绝无可能变得相同。”\n“但是，在爱上同样的东西，\n一同欢笑的那个瞬间，:
"There's no way we could ever be the same."
"But in the moment we love the same thing
and laugh together,
we're seeing the same dream, right?!"

"That's just sophistry..."
The fox girl's words left her stunned.
Sakuya laughed happily beside her.

Oh well, whatever.
Whether it's a lie or a fantasy,
I can lie with a straight face now too.

So, what kind of story will that idiot write?
Let me take a good look at whether it's worth my starring in.
strings.新人公会骑士的信: A Letter from a Rookie Guild Knight
strings.亲爱的奶奶。\n\n您过得还好吗？腰还会痛吗？\n我现在生活得还算好。\n\n一:
Dear Grandma,

How are you? Does your back still hurt?
I'm doing pretty well these days.

I'm really sorry I haven't had time to write.
It's been over half a year since I became a guild knight.
These six months have been total chaos.
Things have finally settled down a bit lately,
so I'm writing to tell you how I've been.
strings.新人培训结束之后，\n我主要负责了巡逻工作。\n啊，不过，\n我偶尔也会为孩子们:
After rookie training ended,
I was mainly in charge of patrols.
Oh, but
sometimes I also teach kids about crime prevention.
Nova comes to play the criminal every time.
His acting is really funny, and really intimidating.
I wish you could see it too, Grandma.
strings.还有，帕尔佩布拉开展了动物保护活动以后，\n公会骑士也会一起去帮忙。\n我们会保:
Also, since Palpebra started its animal protection program,
the guild knights go help out too.
We take in and protect cats, dogs, and rabbits.
I'm not planning on getting any new animals,
but it's still nice to be around them this way.
I can understand what animals say, which makes the work easy.
I'm really glad I have this ability.

That's about what my life is like...
But I haven't given up on finding the one who killed Rufu.
strings.其实，我有了挺大进展，也找到了犯人。\n一切说来真的很复杂，\n但我完全没打算原:
Actually, I made a lot of progress, and found the culprit.
It's all really complicated,
but I have no intention of forgiving that person.

But maybe because I told everyone how I felt,
I'm not as angry as I thought I'd be.
Both the feeling that I can't forgive them,
and the feeling that I'm just sad Rufu died,
I told everyone about all of it.
And they all came to comfort me. It was so strange.

From now on, I'll keep doing my best as a guild knight.
strings.还有其他一些事想要告诉您，\n但信中实在无法详述。\n等我回来的时候再慢慢聊吧。:
There are other things I want to tell you,
but I can't go into detail in a letter.
Let's talk properly when I come back.

I'll come home this winter.
It's getting cold, so remember to dress warmly.
I'll write again.

P.S.
Someone gave me a spice that makes curry really delicious.
I'll bring some next time. Look forward to it.
strings.建设在奶牛场角落的广场。\n人们能在此处与公会保护的离群龙族交流。\n\n得知某:
A plaza built in a corner of the dairy farm.
Here, people can interact with stray dragons protected by the Guild.

After learning what a certain boy wanted,
dragons and dragon-related people all pitched in to help.
The plaza was built with everyone's joint funding.

To keep hunters targeting dragons away,
anti-human traps made by a certain trapper
are set up all around the plaza.
The Flame Dragon King often visits too.
strings.保护龙族的目的主要有以下两个。\n\n・防止荒龙化\n荒龙化现象并未完全消失。\:
There are two main reasons for protecting dragons.

・Preventing wild-dragonification
The phenomenon of dragons turning wild hasn't completely disappeared.
To keep the town from suffering more damage,
and to let dragons keep their own will,
protective measures are very necessary.

・Species conservation
To humans, dragons have long been a threat,
something that had to be destroyed.
So lately, the dragons around Palpebra have been dwindling.
However, the dragons protected humanity from the Purgers.
That changed how the townspeople see dragons,
and they readily accepted the conservation program.
It's said that among the volunteers
was a certain dragon slayer who once defeated Fafnir.
strings.由公会城市开发课主导的动物保护活动。\n保护对象有野猫野狗\n以及离开了原本栖息:
An animal protection program led by the Guild's Urban Development Division.
It protects stray cats and dogs,
as well as rabbits that have left their natural habitats.

The Urban Development Division has also set up various cafés
where people can interact with the protected animals.
After a strict screening,
visitors can also adopt those animals.
strings.近来经常结伴出现在帕尔佩布拉的\n部分人（2名）的自称。\n※该名称已得到了专业:
What a certain group (of two) often seen together in Palpebra lately
call themselves.
*The name has been approved by a professional.

The name comes from pride in themselves and their friends.
Some use that pride to go flirting,
while others just want to share sweets with their pals.

Below are some of the members who often hang out together.
strings.・里姆尼斯\n自称“长得很帅的本大爷们”中的一人。\n近来总会与诺瓦一同去搭讪。:
・Remnith
One of the self-proclaimed "Us Handsome Fellas."
Lately he always goes flirting with Nova.
He gives the ladies the most perfect day.
But since he must set off on his travels again,
he can't promise the ladies a next date.
A truly sinful man.

・Nova
He's gradually come to enjoy flirting,
and keeps asking his friends if they're going flirting today.
He'll smile and call people cute,
whisper "you're really amazing" to the ladies,
and promise them another date next time—
he says with a smile that he wants to figure out
just how far you have to go for it to count as what everyone calls "love."
His friend S often tells him, "Maybe tone it down a little?"
strings.・塔吉斯\n近来提议说“我们这帮人去开执事酒馆\n绝对能赚到大钱的吧？！”，\n:
・Teurgis
Lately he's been saying "If our crew opened a butler bar,
we'd totally make a fortune, right?!"
and is actively planning it.
He finds flirting fun.
But it usually ends with him being just friends with the girls.
Why?

・Libram
One of the self-proclaimed "Us Handsome Fellas."
A man who got a short vacation after the Devourer Incident,
and spent it having a blast with his friends.
Since Nova claimed "I don't know how old I am,
so it's fine if I drink, nobody'll get mad,"
out of worry he prepared non-alcoholic drinks for Nova.
He doesn't go flirting.
strings.・雷拉斯\n似乎很乐于见到朋友们吵闹的模样。\n虽不会去搭讪，\n但偶尔会在听学:
・Reylas
Seems to enjoy watching his friends goof around.
He doesn't go flirting,
but sometimes gets confessed to while listening to students' love troubles.
Why? He's baffled.
To this, Nova, imitating a certain white tiger friend, said:
"You really are a sinful man."

・Invetra
"I don't go flirting either."
"But every time a girl says you're cute,
   you never deny it."
"Nova! Mr. Nova! Stop it!"
strings.在M.O.F -3rd-数周后举办的\n第四届也是最后一届M.O.F。\n\n与:
The fourth and final M.O.F,
held a few weeks after M.O.F 3rd.

Unlike the previous M.O.Fs held on momentum,
M.O.F Final was held to celebrate
the triumphant return of Princess Toria, Mirea's elite,
and Prince Razelt's party from the Farlands.

A triumphant return... though in fact Prince Arthram
was furious that Prince Razelt brought troops,
and Razelt had to meekly bow his head in apology before leaving the Farlands.
Though the Farlands' affairs had nothing to do with Mirea,
the people of Mirea were still overjoyed to see
those who fought rescue a nation in crisis and return safely.
Naturally, a grand celebration was a must.
strings.但就算想办庆典，\n也找不出什么像样的活动了吧？\n当所有人都那么想的时候……\:
But even if they wanted a festival,
there weren't any decent events left, were there?
Just when everyone thought so...
the Kingdom of Mirea finally encountered——
the remarkable talent known as BRASS.

And so, at this M.O.F,
four groups of cosmic idols including Noeni gave it their all,
unleashing cosmic energy in their performances.
Once rather quirky,
they had grown tremendously in Starview,
and their skill was beyond question.
M.O.F was a huge success.
But in the next instant, something strange happened.

The sky shattered,
and a mysterious male idol and a dragon suddenly descended.
strings.突然降临在M.O.F上的神秘组合\n乃代表辰国的宇宙偶像C·RYU（矢龙）\n以:
The mysterious duo that suddenly descended on M.O.F
was C·RYU, the cosmic idol representing the Dragon Nation,
and his partner, the divine beast Kormetare.
Before New Year's even arrived,
the cosmic energy surging from the performances had called forth a new idol.
And so, the idol showdown arrived as promised——

One against four obviously had no chance.
C·RYU got thoroughly beaten up (figuratively speaking),
and was defeated in no time.
But the audience went wild for the sudden surprise performance.
M.O.F Final was a huge success too.
strings.时间还未到正月，\n却突然出现在米雷亚王国的\n代表“辰国”的宇宙偶像。\n名字:
A cosmic idol representing the "Dragon Nation"
who suddenly appeared in the Kingdom of Mirea
before New Year's had even arrived.
His name is written C·RYU, read "Shiryu."
Male. A local idol.
He specializes in tricky performances
in both dialect and standard speech.

He calls himself a legend beyond idols—
a super idol, a "Superstar."
strings.他的名字非常耐人寻味。\n让人不禁猜测他与某条“龙”之间的关系。\n不过，二者其:
His name is very intriguing.
It makes one wonder about his connection to a certain "dragon."
But in fact, there's no connection at all.
The names are just similar by coincidence.

He himself did nothing wrong.
But since the name is so easily confused,
every time he introduces himself, he startles lots of people.
So he seriously considered changing his name.
But persuaded by Shota Inori and Nova,
he decided to keep it.
Now he's working hard at his idol activities,
vowing to change how people see the name through his fame.
strings.继古龙、荒龙之后出现的新龙种“偶像龙”。\n宇宙十二支国的神兽。\n\n与C·R:
A new dragon species, the "Idol Dragon," appearing after the Ancient Dragons and Wild Dragons.
A divine beast of the Cosmic Twelve Zodiac Nations.

Together with C·RYU, it forms
the Dragon Nation idol unit "IDRA."
Light element.
strings.前神明的调停人事件簿: Casebook of a Former God Turned Mediator
strings.我是拉迪乌斯。\n机缘巧合之下，\n我来到了这家企业调停事务所SO.CLO.，\:
I am Radius.
By a twist of fate,
I came to this corporate mediation office, SO.CLO.,
as a mediator's assistant.
My current subject of observation is my kin,
born of a bizarre fate... no——

"Are you~~~~ stupid or what?!"

It is the corporate mediator here, an ordinary girl.
strings.“这么明显的洗钱，\n你还说自己不知道这违法？\n太离谱了。没道理的。\n我没法:
"Money laundering this obvious,
and you say you didn't know it was illegal?
That's ridiculous. Makes no sense.
I can't defend you. Good luck~"

"No no no no! Please wait!
It wasn't illegal at our company originally!
But when the unified law was enacted,
head office suddenly changed its stance..."

"The Unified Corporate Law was enacted recently, sure.
But couldn't you see the signs?
Do you never watch the news?
Why didn't you prepare in advance??"

"Because head office... told us to..."

"Sigh~~~~
That's exactly why they dumped you.
What a total small fry.
How many eras behind is your brain?"
strings.“拉迪乌斯，把这些整理一下。”\n\n当我整理完资料，准备交给社长时，\n发现她:
"Radius, organize these."

When I finished organizing the documents and went to hand them to the boss,
I found her taunting the client
while carefully reading the documents.

This is what's most interesting about her.
She calls herself a former god, looks down on others,
always sighs that people are hopeless,
yet always ends up helping them.

"Hey, old man,
you still haven't brought up the thing we most need to talk about."

"Th-the fee? No problem, name your price!
Don't worry, as long as we win the case, money's no issue—"

"Not that. Sigh, how disappointing.
No wonder you got dumped."
strings.她的存在形态并不合理。\n即尊重个体，又心怀整体，\n还想要拯救夹在两者之间的人:
Her form of existence makes no sense.
She respects the individual, yet cares for the whole,
and still wants to save those caught in between.

"Tell me, could you swallow your pride for your subordinates,
and beg in tears to a girl not even half your age?
Could you say the words 'please save us'?"

So, O ruler.

"If you're willing,
I'll take responsibility and mediate this case.
That's me! Corporate mediator
Stil Ofstineta♡"

I will continue to observe her.
Surely her "humanity"
is a variable your calculations need?
strings.今天镇上要举办庆典。\n听说帕尔佩布拉和涩谷\n和法兰德要缔结友好条约。\n迷宫:
There's a festival in town today.
I heard Palpebra, Shibuya
and the Farlands are signing a friendship treaty.
When the labyrinth turned 50,
they had a festival too,
but Shibuya wasn't here back then.

I heard lots of things happened in the past,
so Palpebra and the Farlands didn't get along.
Ten years ago I wasn't even born yet,
so those stories sound like history.
And apparently there weren't even phones back then.
Unbelievable.
strings.我和弟弟一起去了庆典。\n蒂亚小姐她们的演出实在太棒了，\n不管看几次都觉得太棒:
I went to the festival with my little brother.
Miss Dia and the others' show was amazing,
no matter how many times I see it, it's amazing!
My brother kept watching the yokai play.
He loves Miss Leve way too much.

Mom and Dad set up a stall at the festival too.
But they get all lovey-dovey in front of customers,
it's so embarrassing, so I didn't go over at all.
Last time I complained to Nova about it,
but he said "they're already holding back."
Can't they hold back another 90%?
strings.对了，今天最开心的是见到了莱特先生！\n他还是那么帅。太棒了。\n他还很开心地说:
Oh right, the best part of today was seeing Mr. Light!
He's as cool as ever. Amazing.
He happily said he's finally an adult,
and can drink openly now.
He's super cute when he's drunk. Thank you, thank you.

Then in the evening I went with him to our usual curry shop.
The owner seems to be off traveling again.
It's a shame I couldn't hear his adventure stories.
strings.我还在咖喱店见到了\n好久没见的史黛拉小姐和白先生。\n他们在聊最近看的书。\n:
At the curry shop I also ran into
Miss Stella and Mr. Nimbus, who I hadn't seen in ages.
They were talking about books they'd read recently.
So I told Miss Stella
I'd read her first book.
Miss Stella said she was happy.

Then Mr. Nimbus smiled and said "That takes me back,"
and Miss Stella smiled and said "Yes."
strings.我还不懂，怀念是种什么感觉。\n但等我能明白的时候，\n我也像想他们那样笑着说\:
I still don't understand what nostalgia feels like.
But when I'm able to understand,
I want to smile like them and say
"that takes me back" and "that was fun."

I'm getting a little sleepy. I'll stop here.
Next week I'm going to eat cake with Miss Celtie.
We'll talk lots about love. I can't wait!
strings.我是星见镇的猫: I Am a Cat of Starview
strings.我是猫。\n我的名字叫戴拿。\n我和同胞还有主人一起生活在星见镇。\n那里是我们:
I am a cat.
My name is Dinah.
I live in Starview with my kin and my master.
That place is our territory.

Our territory is always noisy,
so I can never nap properly.
But lately there have been fewer and fewer people.
My master only comes back when she doesn't have "class."
All I can do is look after my servant Stella every day.

A quiet town is great for napping.
But I have fewer servants now.
This is a very serious situation.
strings.“喵，戴拿，\n你的毛有点乱了喵。”\n“确实。你一定睡得很奔放吧~？”\n\n:
"Meow, Dinah,
your fur's a bit messy, meow."
"It sure is. You must sleep pretty wildly~?"

Just as I was fuming, I heard my servants' voices.
Mew and Mia had come.
They're ones who know their place.
Now they're skillfully brushing my fur——
Ahh~ right there! Keep going!
No! A little lower!

"Meow! Dinah, stop squirming!"
"Hahaha! Its tail's swishing so much it looks like three!"

Mew is a bit clumsy.
She's not good at hunting either.
I can't help it. I have nothing else to do today anyway.
Let me show her what real hunting is.

"Ah! Dinah!
We're not done brushing you, meow!"
strings.“卑尔根先生在钓鱼呢。”\n“今天晚上要吃鱼喵？\n戴拿，你怎么在这里？”\n\:
"Mr. Vargen is fishing."
"Are we having fish tonight, meow?
Dinah, what are you doing here?"

Need you ask? To get my revenge, of course.
Vargen may be one of my servants,
but he's a demon who always makes me hold back.
He always has tasty things on him,
yet every time he deliberates before offering any.

Today I'll definitely steal his catch.
A strong kick, a leap, aiming for the container of fish.
Come now, it's time to offer it to me!

"Ah!
Dinah, you knocked over the bucket!"

Myaaaaaaaah————!!!!
Water, it's water!!!!
strings.“卑尔根先生，对不起喵！\n鱼都被放跑了……”\n“无妨。毕竟是戴拿干的。\n你:
"Mr. Vargen, I'm sorry, meow!
All the fish got away..."
"It's fine. Dinah's the one who did it.
You two didn't get wet, did you?"

Even I fail sometimes.
A servant's job is to make up for my mistakes.
So hurry, dry my fur, Mia.
That's right, with a towel.
I will never forgive that thing that blows hot air.
Hurry and dry me off!

"What's wrong? Some kind of trouble?
I'll help."
"Oh, Colt... It's nothing.
Dinah just caused some trouble, that's all."
"Oh... Huh?!
It let all the fish go?
That's not good, Dinah."

Hmph, today I keep meeting troublesome servants.
Colt has lately become one who makes me hold back too.
Seems Samantha and Miles aren't here today.
With a little demanding, they'd offer up their catch right away...
strings.科特摸了摸我，\n说他接下来要和纱玛莎还有米雷斯一起出去，\n还说会买鱼回来，然:
Colt petted me,
said he was going out with Samantha and Miles,
said he'd buy fish on the way back, and left.
Not long ago his palms were much softer...
And he keeps getting taller.
He could at least consider me, who has to look up at him.

"Dinah, there you are."
"Oh, Stella? You need Dinah for something?"

Ohh, Stella! My most loyal servant!
I left Mia's side and went to her feet.
Then she stroked me back and forth.
Mm-hmm, ohh, right there...

"Dinah, Alice and Primula are back."

What? My master is back?
strings.“戴拿，我回来了！”\n\n一见面，主人就带着灿烂的笑容抚摸了我。\n不愧是主人:
"Dinah, I'm home!"

The moment we met, my master petted me with a radiant smile.
As expected of my master. Her petting technique is top-notch.
At some point,
my kin Lyra also appeared and was being affectionate with Primula.

"Heh heh, you're all so lively."
"Seriously. While your masters are out studying so hard,
you guys sure are having fun."

My master said so, yet she looked very happy.
She also mentioned lots of names I'd never heard.
Honestly. Seems they've been having lots of fun
somewhere without me.

My noisy masters.
It makes me a little nostalgic for the old days.
This place was always full of voices like this.
A quiet town is nice, of course...
but it's only after the noise that you come to love the quiet.

This place will never lack for bustle.
The long-missed noise above my head makes me feel at ease.
I'll get ready to sleep——

"By the way, you smell a bit, don't you?
Looks like it's bath time!"

Bath?! Wait, Master!!
No! Anything but that——!!!!
strings.M.O.F -Final-之后举办的\n第五届也是（第二次）最后一届M.O.F。:
The fifth and (second) final M.O.F,
held after M.O.F Final.

However... whether this M.O.F should be
counted among the official M.O.Fs is debatable.
Because this M.O.F Final 2nd was unofficial——
to be precise, it was the after-party of Final.
strings.庆典从何开始已暧昧不清。\nFinal结束后，少数尚未尽兴的人\n（主要是饮酒者:
It's unclear exactly when the festival began.
After Final ended, a few people who hadn't had their fill
(mainly drinkers) took the leftover food
and gathered in a corner of the plaza.
Before anyone knew it, more and more people joined,
and the small gathering turned into a leisurely drinking party.

Many people from Starview joined in at the time too.
strings.没什么特别的活动，气氛也不如之前热烈。\n人们只是漫无边际地聊着无聊的话题。\n:
There were no special events, and the mood wasn't as lively as before.
People just chatted aimlessly about trivial things.
But for some reason, they all had a great time.
Nothing important happened,
but that time was still irreplaceable.

Final 2nd really was just an after-party——

Except that it lasted a whole month.

That's right. This after-party of an M.O.F
didn't end once the night was over.
From that day, it went on until Christmas,
and then all the way to the New Year!
strings.那简直是用来展销没用的大人们的集市。\n不过，为了他们的名誉，\n还是要补充一下:
It was practically a market showcasing useless adults.
However, for the sake of their reputation,
it should be added
that the participants over that month weren't all the same people.
Most returned to their normal lives
after a few hours, or at most a few days (as they should).

Those who missed Final,
but now had free time and showed up.
Those who came to watch because the crowd looked like they were having fun.
Those who tried to start a business and got scolded.
Those who left for work once and then came back.
People kept joining in an endless stream,
and that's why this little M.O.F lasted so long.
strings.不过，散漫也要有个限度。\n\n最终，理智的大人们在新年第三天\n强行解散了Fi:
Still, there's a limit to slacking off.

In the end, the sensible adults forcibly broke up Final 2nd
on the third day of the New Year.
And so the farce finally ended.
Lazing around is the best, sure,
but lazing around forever is no good at all.

And so, the series of M.O.Fs that began in autumn
truly came to a close this time.

However, it's only a temporary break.
Princess Toria has already decided to make M.O.F an annual festival.
People have already started working hard to prepare for the autumn festival.
Even when the festival ends,
the memories made won't disappear.

Even if the people attending are no longer the same,
M.O.F will never truly leave us.

As long as people hold wishes in their hearts,
the festival will come again, countless times.

M.O.F is forever………
strings.在与伙伴们一起挑战了邪神、\n事件暂且告一段落之后，\n阿尔克终于兑现了与妹妹的:
After challenging the evil god together with his companions
and the incident coming to a temporary close,
Alk finally kept his simple promise to his sister,
and set out on an adventure with her.

For him, it was his first adventure in a long while.
And he was indeed... a little careless and complacent.

I've learned to fight with one eye.
On the trip to Tiatha,
I beat the Starsayers single-handedly.
And, believe it or not, I did, after all,
save the world—that may be overstepping a bit,
but at least I helped save the world.
I contributed, I tried my best!
That's what he thought.

His long-restrained but now slightly inflated confidence
was suddenly shattered.
strings.为什么？\n答案是，无法听懂对方的语言。\n\n现在想来，之前从未发生过这样的事:
Why?
The answer: he couldn't understand their language.

Come to think of it, this had never happened before.
But this time, he couldn't communicate with the otherworld's inhabitants at all.
The mental structures of those far-world inhabitants
are often different from humans'.
In that distant world, power is everything.
And his attempts were far too timid.

That easily left him defeated.
He'd thought that, knowing so many worlds, he could adapt.
His sister's especially gentle comfort made him happy, yet ashamed.

And one thing changed the situation.

That's right. It was curry.
strings.追着坠落深渊的搭档，阿尔克抵达了神域。\n当他拿起某块从伟大之物身上脱落的\n如:
Chasing his partner who'd fallen into the abyss, Alk reached the divine realm.
When he picked up something that had come off a great being,
like a glittering ore,
he was utterly stunned.

This smells SO good?!

In that instant, his world burst open.
Countless possible selves rushed out from within him,
urging him: Run!
You can make a brand-new curry!

After that, Alk didn't waste a single second.
He resolutely made contact with the far-world inhabitants.
Even if minds differ, as long as there are "points" you can understand,
you can connect them and draw a "picture."
Following this hypothesis,
he tried again and again, sometimes breaking things, sometimes fixing them.
In the end, he finally managed to communicate with the far-world inhabitants,
and even reached a trade agreement with them.

And so, the exploration team finally made a connection with another world.
strings.“听起来是很波澜壮阔的冒险故事，\n但最后只是拿到了新的香料吧？”\n\n“没错:
"Sounds like a really epic adventure story,
but in the end you just got a new spice, right?"

"That's right!!"

Not knowing how to answer, Shota could only nod.
So is this the ultimate spice, then?
He meant the question to lure Alk into saying more.
Hmm, I guess it's one more option.
Alk's casual answer made Shota give up pressing.
Oh well, fine. He's happy, so that's awesome.
Still, Shota wanted to poke fun at him.

"Didn't you say you were going to figure out your feelings?
Why did you only find new curry?"

"Ugh."

"Actually, I don't care about that.
But you get so long-winded every time you drink, you know?"

"Ughh."

Taichi Yuhino's laughter echoed through
the Shibuya branch of the Special Tech Defense Force, with only the three of them.
A gathering of three who only talk about trivial things here——
mainly love talk.

I'll do my best next time.
In the end, the topic was closed with that vague conclusion.
strings.他们知道，\n这个曾去往世界尽头冒险的青年，\n同时也是个容易回避恋爱关系，\n:
They know
that this young man who went adventuring to the ends of the world
is also a young man who easily avoids romance,
and doesn't understand himself at all.

And the ones who fell for him know it too.
Even if he apologizes, it won't solve anything.
They've completely seen through him.

"Anyway, just do what you think.
Wait, don't wait, or make them wait.
By your principles, that's how it goes, right?"

This conversation, repeated who knows how many times, made Taichi laugh.
And Alk gave his cold reply for who knows how many times.
He's right, but——

"Still wavering at this point,
isn't that a bit too lame?"

"Hey, don't steal my line——"

"'Mm, it really is lame.'"

"Ughh..."

This exchange had been repeated who knows how many times.
It's because I'm lame that I want to try harder.
Even if he wanted to say that, he'd only get the answer
"That's all up to you, isn't it?"
Shota thinks it's all his own business, too.
Even if he suddenly came back with someone they didn't know,
Shota wouldn't find it strange.
After all, even though he always wavers,
when he makes a decision, he's very firm.

What do you think I should wear?
And not long after,
the young man came to them with a deep frown,
asking exactly that.
strings.说实话，他确实懈怠了。\n\n遥远的世界确实充满危险。\n但他的伙伴们也绝非常人:
Truth be told, he had gotten lax.

The distant worlds were certainly full of danger.
But his companions were no ordinary people either.
Sword Saints, ninjas, dragons, martial artists.
Even Nao Nagihara, whom he was supposed to protect, had grown much stronger.

So, you're content to stay like this?
Faced with that question, he answered:

"I have no interest in being the strongest.
I need power only so I don't lose anything again.
So, this is enough——"

"I don't accept that reason at all————?!"

He was taken out in an instant in a bout with the Fist King Barrek.
That was fine, at least. No, actually it wasn't.
The problem was
that he then suffered a crushing defeat at Ricardo's hands.

"I have no interest in being the strongest...
Hahaha! You know that, right? Don't you?
Can't be helped. Told you it can't be helped!"

Faced with a grinning Ricardo taunting him nonstop,
Nimbus was furious enough to go berserk.
Not enough. None of it was enough.
strings.为了一雪前耻，白开始了奋斗。\n他减少了饮酒量，\n主动冲到第一线，承担了各种危:
To wipe away his shame, Nimbus began working hard.
He cut back on drinking,
charged to the front lines, and took on all kinds of danger.
But he pushed himself too hard——

During a voyage through otherspace, he fell into the abyss.

Fortunately, Charlene had the quick idea to fire a beacon at him,
so everyone barely managed to track his location.
But he fell to a depth the exploration team had never reached,
and continuing the search could mean running into
beings even more terrifying than evil gods.

Even so, his companions didn't hesitate one bit.
Ricardo, whom Nimbus had protected in battle,
angrily demanded everyone set out to search.

About a month later——

The group found Nimbus, who had become king of an otherworld.
strings.“等下，完全搞不懂啊，\n话说，这到底是怎么回事？\n简直让人怀疑自己精神正不正:
"Wait, I don't get it at all,
seriously, what is going on?
It makes you question your own sanity——
or rather, this is just unforgivable, right?"

Next to a horrified Teo,
Claw made a face no one had ever seen before.

The cat clan doesn't need a white tiger. It'd only get in your way.
Wasn't that what you said back then?
Besides, this was beyond my control.
It just sort of happened.
I had no idea I'd become king.

His defense was mostly ignored by the furious black panther.
Only after hearing Nimbus's account did everyone learn
that after falling he'd met mysterious creatures,
instinctively helped them, and won their favor.
While Nimbus thought he was living an elegant life,
the ceremony crowning him king had ended without him noticing.

"Not bigamy, but bi-kingdom?
Sigh~~ What an unimaginable betrayal...
And what elegant things were you doing over there?"

Searching for Nimbus took a month,
but the black panther's anger took even longer to subside.
strings.不过，白的遭遇却带来了好运。\n他的搭档找到了新的咖喱香料，\n异界探索队也发现:
Still, Nimbus's ordeal brought good fortune.
His partner found a new curry spice,
and the Otherworld Exploration Team found a world suitable for merging.

It took everyone a great deal of effort
to separate Nimbus, who'd become king (or something like it),
from the otherworld creatures' system.
But all in all, it was a good thing.

The inhabitants of that world gave Nimbus a brand-new power
that could completely overwhelm Barrek and Ricardo.
Later, the warriors mastered that power too,
and could stand against Nimbus...
but until then, Nimbus did plenty of taunting.

"There's no way that bastard would behave himself."
strings.莱特并未经常参与异界探索。\n他的时间都用在了与贝尔赛蒂亚等人\n周游七大领域，:
Light didn't often join the otherworld expeditions.
He spent his time with Belsidia and the others
traveling the seven domains, confronting and talking with the Starsayers.

He also went to the homeland of Phiria and the others,
resolved conflicts the Starsayers had stirred up there,
and helped many people.
His deeds left the name "Hero"
in many worlds.

And just as Belsidia said,
the problem was that his heroic deeds
sowed seeds of love wherever they went.
(As his body grew older,
this problem became even more obvious.)

Like a black hole,
he drew courtship from national leaders and many others,
even disrupting the international situation of other worlds.
And he himself had no awareness of the root of the problem.
strings.“天啊，真人果然不一样啊。”\n\n“你在说什么呢……”\n\n“这种地方！就是:
"Wow, the real deal really is different."

"What are you talking about..."

"That! That right there!
You guys should really teach him properly, right?"

Facing a dumbfounded Rinne, Yuki gave a wry smile.
He really is like an oblivious male lead.
After hearing what Yuki said——
Ryuichi has books like that!
Luik said.
Meryll and Ryouki said they want to put out a book about him.
Alk said.
Couldn't that be adapted into a yokai play?!
Inaho said.
Hero light novel...?
Takamori's remark was baffling.

The old friends gathered at the Guild
were still saying things that made no sense,
but it brought a gentle smile to Light's face.
strings.还是兽姿时，莱特便经常会来到公会。\n他和阿尔克等人在这里接过许多委托。\n也曾:
Back when he was in beast form, Light often came to the Guild.
He took on many requests here with Alk and the others.
Faf even saw him as a mascot rival.
And of course, the kids squished him countless times.
And many, like Walter,
misunderstood him but were still kind to him.
Now when he comes to the Guild,
some adventurers laugh and ask him to show up in beast form now and then.

He'd gritted his teeth countless times at his own lack of power.
Even though he never wished for it,
this truly was a place where he belonged.

"I see...
So I really love this place..."

You're only saying this now? Pur Lilie's eyes went wide.
Maybe I really am a bit oblivious.
Light said with a smile.
strings.“找到咏星者的据点了。”\n\n头顶传来了声音。\n撕裂空间出现的贝尔赛蒂亚低头:
"We've found the Starsayers' base."

A voice came from above.
Belsidia, appearing through a tear in space, looked down at me,
with a smile unlike any before.

I stood up, twisted the corner of my mouth,
and said she really never lets me rest.
Then, something occurred to me.

"Alk, can you come help us?"

"Huh?"

"We can't handle it with just us."

You're lying, right? Alk tilted his head and laughed.

"Then let's bring Stella too.
Nimbus is probably at the tavern."

"Okay. Let's go together."

"Waah?! You scared me to death!!!?"

Stella suddenly appeared beside Belsidia.
She said they'd been having tea together.

"Okay... let's go!"

Since then, everyone has changed a lot.
And they'll keep changing from now on.
But I'll never forget
that it was those encounters, that joy,
that made me whole again.

I am Light.
Light—who played the hero of a fairy tale.
strings.发生了奇妙的事情。\n\n起初，史黛拉只是想要帮助稻穗。\n然后，不知为何，她被:
Something strange happened.

At first, Stella just wanted to help Inaho.
Then, for some reason, she was cast as the movie's heroine.
In the end, she even rewrote the movie's script.

Being able to help Inaho, whom she admires.
Being able to pass her treasures on to others.
For Stella, it was a rare experience.

Unfortunately, Stella doesn't have what it takes to be an actress.
So afterward, she decided to create stories.
In fact, Stella has already written several yokai plays.

It truly was a wonderful thing.

Except that she, who looks exactly like her, was there too.
strings.因为我讨厌你啊。\n\n如果硬要换一种说法的话，\n那就是——\n总感觉很无趣。:
Because I hate you.

If I had to put it another way,
it's that——
it just feels no fun.

That person became the actress she herself couldn't be——
and could even move her hands and feet separately perfectly.
The sight of that person on stage
made her feel a bit like it was no fun.
Back then, it was only a little.

"Huh? What the heck,
you can't even do something like this?"

The smug smile on Leve's face
stirred up waves in Stella's heart like never before.

"I can't forgive her."

Anger showed on a certain girl's steel cheeks.
That was Tiva Media.
strings.而此时，她来了。\n说着同样的梦这种甜言蜜语一般的话，\n将本不可混杂的事物交融:
And then, she came.
The one who speaks sweet nothings like "the same dream,"
blending things that should never mix——
the root of all evil, Inaho Tamamo.

"I have a great idea!"

said the innocent nine-tailed girl.
And her idea really was great.
To be precise, it was fun.

One, Leve is bad at singing.
Two, Stella sings well, and has Dia's approval.
Three, Inaho wants to direct an opera.

One day, Leve learned
that the song she had long refused to sing
had at some point been released.
Or rather, it had spread all over town.
And the flags fluttering in the wind read——
Leve's Idol Debut!

That threw her into utter chaos.
strings.等回过神来，她已经站上了舞台。\n\n男女老少期待的目光聚集在她的身上。\n我？:
By the time she came to her senses, she was already on stage.

The expectant eyes of young and old gathered on her.
Me? Sing?? Is this hell???
When she turned around to ask Inaho for help,
she saw a face exactly like her own.
That person twisted the corner of her mouth and said:

"Y-you can't even do something like this?"

Had she calmed down,
she'd have seen that person didn't really mean it.
But at the time she had no room to think about that.

That day, Leve danced
while lip-syncing her way through the performance.

"No, that wasn't a recording. She was singing herself."

According to a cosmic professional,
it was a strange but somewhat clumsy and adorable song and dance performance.

"That was the wonderful duo's first time on stage."
strings.来自世界弹射器的管理者: From the Keeper of World Flipper
strings.星见镇的管理者史黛拉编写的书。\n记录了与星见镇众人的回忆以及她的宝物。\n\n:
A book written by Stella, keeper of Starview.
It records memories with everyone in Starview, and her treasures.

Below is the afterword at the end of the book.
strings.你好，我是史黛拉。\n\n我写了这本书。\n真的非常非常感谢你能读到这里。\n\:
Hello, I'm Stella.

I wrote this book.
Thank you so, so much for reading this far.

Actually, I rewrote this afterword many times.
Words are really hard.
They're hard to hold onto, and slip away if you're not careful.
When I try to catch them and chase them,
before I know it I stray from where I meant to go,
and head off in a completely different direction.
How can I be like Alk?

I'm not Alk.
I'm different from him.
But inside me, there's a little Alk.
And a little Light, a little Nimbus,
a little Challua, a little Marina.
This page is almost full, so I can't list everyone.
With a heart torn to pieces,
I'll have to shorten them to "little everyone."
(A heart torn to pieces sounds really painful...)
strings.小小的大家能出现在我心里，\n真的让我非常高兴。\n\n我想让小小的大家变得更大:
Having little everyone inside me
makes me really happy.

I want little everyone to grow a bit bigger.
Maybe that's why I wrote this book.

To you, who read this book——

Will the little everyone I know
appear in your heart?

If they can appear there,
if I can appear there too,

maybe that's also why I wrote this book.
strings.如果某天，\n我们能在某处相遇。\n\n请告诉我你的事情吧。\n\n请让小小的你:
If someday,
we meet somewhere,

please tell me about yourself.

Please let a little you
appear in my heart.

Then I'm sure I'll be very happy.

I'm Stella of Starview.
I welcome you.
strings.从遥远世界而来的红魔族少女。\n无比热爱爆裂魔法，\n只会使用爆裂魔法。\n但爆:
A Crimson Demon girl from a distant world.
She loves explosion magic more than anything,
and can only use explosion magic.
But she can only cast it once a day.
strings.从遥远世界而来的水之女神，\n同时也是受阿克西斯教信仰的主神。\n能力值非常高，:
The goddess of water from a distant world,
and the chief deity worshiped by the Axis Order.
Her stats are very high, and she excels at purification and healing magic,
but her intelligence is below average and her luck is rock-bottom.
She's great at party tricks and loves fizzy drinks.
strings.从遥远世界而来的女骑士。\n挺身阻挡敌人攻击的身姿可谓勇敢非常，\n实则是为了独:
A lady knight from a distant world.
The way she throws herself in front of enemy attacks looks truly brave,
but really she just wants to take the enemy's attacks and verbal abuse all to herself.
strings.从遥远世界而来的少年，\n因意外事故转生到了异世界。\n梦想体验充满剑与魔法的惊:
A boy from a distant world
who was reincarnated in another world after an accident.
He dreamed of a thrilling adventure full of swords and magic,
but reality didn't go as he'd hoped.
With companions full of all sorts of flaws,
every day of his is full of farce and fuss.
strings.该内容暂未开放: This content is not yet available
strings.从异世界穿越而来的勇者，SOS团团长。拥有能随心改写世界的力量，让这个世界也轰轰: The commander of the SOS Brigade, summoned from another world. She has the power to rewrite the world at will and has made this world wildly lively too, but she herself is completely unaware of it.
strings.来自遥远的世界，SOS团引以为傲的文学少女……表面看似如此，然而其真实身份是对有: From a distant world, the SOS Brigade's proud literature girl... or so she seems on the surface, but her true identity is a humanoid interface for contact with organic life forms, in other words an alien. In an emergency she can use almighty powers to protect the SOS Brigade and this world, making her very reliable.
strings.来自遥远的世界，SOS团的吉祥物兼女仆。实际上是来自遥远未来的未来人。当然了，这: From a distant world, the SOS Brigade's mascot and maid. In fact, she's a time traveler from the far future. Of course, this fact is "classified information" to everyone except certain members.
strings.突然穿越到异世界的神秘吟游诗人。真实身份是守护世界的超能力者，但知晓此事的人屈指: A mysterious bard who suddenly crossed over into another world. His true identity is an esper who protects the world, but only a handful of people know this. He's also the SOS Brigade's vice-commander.
strings.穿越了深渊，撷取了虚无，\n与龙成为了朋友的少女。\n为了寻找能互相激励的志同道:
A girl who crossed the abyss, seized the void,
and became friends with a dragon.
To find like-minded friends to inspire each other,
Couette is about to set off on vacation——
this summer is sure to be unforgettable!
strings.龙啊，寄于我身吧。龙啊，寄于我身吧。\n不断祈愿，颤抖着迈足前进的少年\n终于得:
Dragon, dwell within me. Dragon, dwell within me.
The boy who kept praying and stepped forward trembling
finally gained strength.
Even if the blazing midsummer sun still irritates him,
and the hot hustle and bustle still annoys him——
when people call his name,
his answering voice carries a hint of gentleness.
strings.“快把时间倒回去然后带我去啊！”\n时间虽无法倒流，\n但思绪却能传达得到。\n:
"Turn back time and take me with you!"
Time can't be turned back,
but feelings can still get through.
Shota Inori's sloppiness, half-heartedness, carelessness, and slapdash ways
his kindness, strength, weakness, voice, breath, movements, smile
eyes, lips, neck, collarbone, the backs of his hands, fingers, waist, back, knees, heartbeat
and every other part of him, she loves them all most most most of all♡
strings.“我一定会好好去学习的！”\n狮子男孩现在迎来了夏天！\n曾为了自由而战的少年究:
"I'll definitely study properly!"
Summer has come for the lion boy!
What will the boy who once fought for freedom find
at a summer resort freer than anywhere else?
Summer is about to become a trial and come at the boy.
strings.反抗组织的前谍报人员。\n永远冷静、慎重、沉默寡言……\n虽然我也想那么评价自己:
A former intelligence agent of the resistance.
Always calm, cautious, and taciturn...
is how I'd like to describe myself,
but actually I love chatting with people more than anything!
Thanks to everyone, I can now
spend happy days in a new world.
I'll work tirelessly for all of you even if it breaks me——
Ahh, I'm so sorry! I talked too much again!
strings.那场激烈的战斗结束之后，\n伙伴们都踏上了各自的道路。\n她也不例外。\n曾经，:
After that fierce battle ended,
her companions all went their own ways.
She was no exception.
Once, she was a soldier of the Land Federation.
Then, she was Santa Claus. As for her next goal——
it's finding a job where she can cut loose and fight people.
strings.自称世界第一的射手。\n他人口中世界第一的麻烦制造者。\n老是借钱，还把朋友，\:
Self-proclaimed world's greatest shooter.
World's greatest troublemaker, according to others.
Always borrowing money, and dragging friends
into his debt-collection messes.
Just as everyone wondered
what trouble he'd bring this time——
he, bearing wings like his partner's, only smiled.
strings.人生可谓是一连串的选择。\n有多少种选择，\n便有多少可能存在的世界。\n而她，:
Life is a series of choices.
There are as many possible worlds
as there are choices.
And deep in the abyss, she met
"the him that might have been."
And so the two... met...
strings.帕尔佩布拉冒险者公会的女性职员。\n荷羊人多从事牧羊工作，\n她却是其中少有来到:
A female staff member of Palpebra's Adventurers' Guild.
Most Sheephirds work as shepherds,
but she's one of the few who came to Palpebra to work.
She got the job through connections and originally had her own post,
but she took it upon herself to create a department called
the "Labyrinth Explorer Life Safety Improvement Promotion Division."
She's someone who chose to support adventurers, always on the front line.
strings.沃伦塔斯魔法学院的研究生，\n爱上了青梅竹马的胆怯少年。\n在呐喊出心声之后，二:
A graduate student at the Voluntas Arcane Arts Academy
who fell in love with a timid childhood friend.
After shouting out her feelings, the two became a couple.
She wants to stay with that person from now on,
and weave a brand-new relationship with them——
saying it takes courage,
he put on this far too clumsy armor.
strings.感质之城地下社会中首屈一指的佣兵，\n外号死神。\n哪怕目标在三千米外也绝不会失:
The foremost mercenary of Qualia City's underworld,
nicknamed the Reaper.
Never misses even a target three kilometers away,
a cold sniping machine...
But everyone unanimously denies that description.
That person is more like a wild beast that does as it pleases.
strings.和之国及东国首屈一指的画师。\n已年过75，但好奇心和上进心\n从未衰减，身体也:
The foremost painter of the Land of Wa and the Eastern Lands.
Over 75, yet his curiosity and drive
have never waned, and his body only gets healthier.
An art-mad painter who boasts he'll paint everything in the world.
And his next subject——is another world.
strings.损坏的女神的旅途之中，\n为她带去最初也是决定性光芒的精灵少女。\n为了抚平受伤:
The spirit girl who brought the first and decisive light
to the broken goddess's journey.
To soothe wounded hearts and wipe away falling tears,
a true spirit manifested in the world.
Now, to grant a new wish,
she has changed her form once again.

So, starting today, Challua is a magical girl!
strings.伟大的古龙，炎龙王。\n不断与宿命抗争战斗，\n但直到终结之时，他也未曾迎来胜利:
The great ancient dragon, the Flame Dragon King.
He kept fighting against fate,
yet never won, right up to the very end.
Now, freed from destiny,
a raging fire still burns in his heart.
strings.破损的星星。被终焉折磨、渴望解脱之人。\n然而，少年从未忘记自己真正的愿望。\n:
A broken star. One tormented by the end, longing for release.
Yet the boy never forgot his true wish.
So that the stars and life can move forward together,
he will keep living, holding the flowers that bloom from what's missing
and the guilt that can never fade.
strings.在旅途尽头找到的世界\n与少女曾经的愿望和梦并不相同。\n不过，那样也无妨。\n:
The world found at the end of the journey
wasn't the same as the girl's old wish and dream.
But that's all right.
Freed from destiny,
she buries her departed friends deep in her heart,
then takes her new friends by the hand,
and takes her own step toward the world.
strings.曾因超越常人的天赋被视为剑鬼，\n受人畏惧、遭人疏远的天才剑士。\n然而，想将自:
A genius swordswoman feared and shunned,
seen as a sword demon for her superhuman talent.
But the girl who wanted to turn herself to steel
has regained the wish called "sharing."

Standing in her path are the gods of other worlds.
And... the eyes of the weak one she loves.
strings.在拉夫马诺与阿鲁玛德乌斯的帮助下\n取回了人类姿态的莱特。\n\n被力量与使命摆:
Light, who regained his human form
with the help of Rustamov and Armadeus.

After being toyed with by power and duty and suffering countless setbacks,
the man still decided to take up his sword and bravely face the future.
No matter how many times, he'll rise again.
Because they taught him how to find himself again.
